6079            validate_incoming_session_pix_config(&self.cfg.pix_config, MAX_ASSUMED_SESSION_PACKET_RATE)?;
6080
6081            // The authoritative cross-component check, and the first moment it can be made: the
6082            // supervisor's deadlines are meaningless without the reconstructor lifetimes they race
6083            // against, and the reconstructor arrives here rather than at construction.
6084            //
6085            // `SessionManager::new` normalizes against the *default* reconstructor config, which is
6086            // what makes the common programmatic case correct without an API break. A caller that
6087            // pairs a supervisor config with a non-default reconstructor is caught here instead — as
6088            // an error rather than a clamp, because at this point both halves were chosen
6089            // deliberately and silently overriding one of them would be the wrong answer.
6090            crate::supervision::validate_pix_supervision(
6091                &self.cfg.pix_config.supervision,
6092                pix.share_processor.config(),
6093            )?;
6094        }
6095
6096        self.msg_sender
6097            .set(msg_sender)
6098            .map_err(|_| SessionManagerError::AlreadyStarted)?;
6099
6100        if let Some(pix) = pix {
6101            self.pix_toolbox
6102                .set(pix)
6103                .map_err(|_| SessionManagerError::AlreadyStarted)?;
6104        }
6105
6106        if let Some(admission) = admission {
6107            self.admission_tx
6108                .set(parking_lot::Mutex::new(admission))
6109                .map_err(|_| SessionManagerError::AlreadyStarted)?;
6110        }
6111
6112        // Re-map the user-provided sink errors to `SessionManagerError` and erase the concrete
6113        //  type so that the `SessionManager` does not need to be generic over it. This also avoids
6114        // having to spawn a separate task to forward items between channels: senders simply lock
6115        // the sink and send directly.
6116        let new_session_notifier: BoxSink<IncomingSession> =
6117            Box::pin(new_session_notifier.sink_map_err(SessionManagerError::other));
6118        let new_session_notifier = Arc::new(hopr_utils::runtime::prelude::Mutex::new(new_session_notifier));
6119
6120        let (session_close_tx, session_close_rx) =
6121            crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async(self.cfg.maximum_sessions + 10);
6122        self.session_notifiers
6123            .set((new_session_notifier, session_close_tx))
6124            .map_err(|_| SessionManagerError::AlreadyStarted)?;
6125
6126        let (start_session_tx, start_session_rx) =
6127            crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async(start_session_channel_capacity());
6128        let _ = self.start_session_tx.set(start_session_tx);
6129
6130        let (start_control_tx, start_control_rx) =
6131            crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async(start_control_channel_capacity(&self.cfg));
6132        let _ = self.start_control_tx.set(start_control_tx);
6133
6134        let myself = self.clone();
6135        let closure_diag = hopr_utils::runtime::diagnostics::ConcurrentDiagnostics::new(
6136            "session_close_for_each_concurrent",
6137            module_path!(),
6138            file!(),
6139            line!(),
6140        );
6141        let ah_closure_notifications = hopr_utils::spawn_as_abortable_named!(
6142            "session_close_notifications",
6143            session_close_rx.into_stream().for_each_concurrent(
6144                self.cfg.maximum_sessions + 10,
6145                move |(session_id, closure_reason, instance)| {
6146                    let myself = myself.clone();
6147                    let closure_diag = closure_diag.clone();
6148                    closure_diag.wrap(|| {
6149                        // These notifications come from the Sessions themselves once
6150                        // an empty read is encountered, which means the closure was done by the
6151                        // other party.
6152                        //
6153                        // Routed through `close_session_with_reason` rather than removing the slot
6154                        // here, so that this path — the one an Exit-side session server actually
6155                        // closes on — can answer with a SURB drain like every other. Identical
6156                        // behaviour when it does not.
6157                        //
6158                        // Scoped to the instance that reported: the pseudonym is reusable, so a late
6159                        // notification of a torn-down Session must leave its successor alone.
6160                        #[cfg(feature = "telemetry")]
6161                        if myself
6162                            .sessions
6163                            .get(&session_id)
6164                            .is_some_and(|slot| Arc::ptr_eq(&slot.instance, &instance))
6165                        {
6166                            set_session_state(&session_id, SessionLifecycleState::Closing);
6167                        }
6168                        if !myself.close_session_scoped(&session_id, closure_reason, CloseScope::Instance(&instance)) {
6169                            // Do not treat this as an error
6170                            debug!(
6171                                ?session_id,
6172                                ?closure_reason,
6173                                ?instance,
6174                                "could not find the session instance to close, maybe the session is already closed or \
6175                                 its pseudonym has been taken by a successor"
6176                            );
6177                        }
6178                        futures::future::ready(())
6179                    })
6180                }
6181            )
6182        );
6183
6184        // This is necessary to evict expired entries from the caches if
6185        // no session-related operations happen at all.
6186        // This ensures the dangling expired sessions are properly closed
6187        // and their closure is timely notified to the other party.
6188        let myself = self.clone();
6189        let ah_session_expiration = hopr_utils::spawn_as_abortable!(async move {
6190            let jitter = hopr_api::types::crypto_random::random_float_in_range(1.0..1.5);
6191            let timeout = 2 * initiation_timeout_max_one_way(
6192                myself.cfg.initiation_timeout_base,
6193                RoutingOptions::MAX_INTERMEDIATE_HOPS,
6194            )
6195            .min(myself.cfg.idle_timeout)
6196            .mul_f64(jitter)
6197                / 2;
6198            futures_time::stream::interval(timeout.into())
6199                .for_each(|_| async {
6200                    trace!("executing session cache evictions");
6201                    myself.sessions.run_pending_tasks();
6202                    myself.session_initiations.run_pending_tasks();
6203                })
6204                .await;
6205        });
6206
6207        // Process Start protocol messages. Two lanes: `StartSession` parks on admission and gets its
6208        // own pool, so a flood of it cannot starve the control traffic of live Sessions.
6209        let myself = self.clone();
6210        let session_diag = hopr_utils::runtime::diagnostics::ConcurrentDiagnostics::new(
6211            "session_start_session_for_each_concurrent",
6212            module_path!(),
6213            file!(),
6214            line!(),
6215        );
6216        let ah_start_session = hopr_utils::spawn_as_abortable_named!(
6217            "session_start_session_processor",
6218            start_session_rx
6219                .into_stream()
6220                .for_each_concurrent(
6221                    Some(MAX_CONCURRENT_START_SESSIONS),
6222                    move |(pseudonym, protocol_msg, packet_info, stored, span)| {
6223                        let myself = myself.clone();
6224                        let session_diag = session_diag.clone();
6225                        session_diag
6226                            .wrap(|| {
6227                                let myself = myself.clone();
6228                                async move {
6229                                    // Routing puts only `StartSession` on this lane.
6230                                    let HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(session_req) = protocol_msg else {
6231                                        unreachable!("only StartSession is routed to the session lane")
6232                                    };
6233                                    // Before any refusal or admission work: a repeat must not be admitted again.
6234                                    let _opening_guard = match myself.claim_opening(pseudonym, session_req.challenge) {
6235                                        OpeningClaim::InFlightRepeat(opening) => {
6236                                            myself.carry_or_book_repeat_surbs(&opening, &pseudonym, stored);
6237                                            crate::counters::START_SESSION_REPEATS_RECEIVED
6238                                                .fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
6239                                            debug!(
6240                                                challenge = session_req.challenge,
6241                                                "dropping a repeated session request: the original is still being \
6242                                                 admitted"
6243                                            );
6244                                            return;
6245                                        }
6246                                        OpeningClaim::EstablishedRepeat(slot, guard) => {
6247                                            book_replay_surbs(&guard.opening, &slot, &pseudonym, stored);
6248                                            let result =
6249                                                myself.answer_repeated_opening(pseudonym, &session_req, &slot).await;
6250                                            drop(guard);
6251                                            report_start_result(result);
6252                                            return;
6253                                        }
6254                                        OpeningClaim::New(guard) => guard,
6255                                    };
6256                                    let result = match myself
6257                                        .refuse_pix_over_direct_return_path(
6258                                            pseudonym,
6259                                            &session_req,
6260                                            packet_info.min_return_path_hops,
6261                                        )
6262                                        .await
6263                                    {
6264                                        Ok(false) => {
6265                                            let opened =
6266                                                myself.handle_incoming_session_initiation(pseudonym, session_req).await;
6267                                            // The opening's SURBs are in the pseudonym's ring already, promoted
6268                                            // into the admitted class with it, but arrived before the Session
6269                                            // existed, so dispatch could not book them. Without them the Exit's
6270                                            // estimate starts, and stays, below what the ring holds. What the
6271                                            // ring lost as they arrived is not this Session's to book: its
6272                                            // estimate never counted that stock, which a newer generation
6273                                            // superseded from an earlier Session under the pseudonym, and an
6274                                            // opening's few SURBs do not overflow a ring on their own.
6275                                            let carried = _opening_guard
6276                                                .as_ref()
6277                                                .and_then(|guard| guard.opening.pending.lock().take())
6278                                                .unwrap_or_default();
6279                                            if opened.is_ok()
6280                                                && let Some(slot) = myself.sessions.get(&pseudonym)
6281                                            {
6282                                                let _ = book_start_message_surbs(
6283                                                    &slot,
6284                                                    &pseudonym,
6285                                                    SurbsStored {
6286                                                        saved: stored.saved + carried.saved,
6287                                                        evicted: carried.evicted,
6288                                                    },
6289                                                );
6290                                            }
6291                                            opened
6292                                        }
6293                                        refused => refused.map(|_| ()),
6294                                    };
6295
6296                                    report_start_result(result);
6297                                }
6298                            })
6299                            .instrument(tracing::debug_span!(parent: &span, "session.start_protocol"))
6300                    }
6301                )
6302                .with_current_subscriber()
6303        );
6304
6305        let myself = self.clone();
6306        let control_diag = hopr_utils::runtime::diagnostics::ConcurrentDiagnostics::new(
6307            "session_start_control_for_each_concurrent",
6308            module_path!(),
6309            file!(),
6310            line!(),
6311        );
6312        let ah_start_control = hopr_utils::spawn_as_abortable_named!(
6313            "session_start_control_processor",
6314            start_control_rx
6315                .into_stream()
6316                .for_each_concurrent(
6317                    Some(self.cfg.maximum_sessions + 10),
6318                    move |(pseudonym, protocol_msg, _packet_info, _stored, span)| {
6319                        let myself = myself.clone();
6320                        let control_diag = control_diag.clone();
6321                        control_diag
6322                            .wrap(|| {
6323                                let myself = myself.clone();
6324                                async move {
6325                                    let result = match protocol_msg {
6326                                        HoprStartProtocol::SessionEstablished(est) => {
6327                                            myself
6328                                                .handle_session_established(InitiationReply::Established(est))
6329                                                .await
6330                                        }
6331                                        HoprStartProtocol::SessionResumed(res) => {
6332                                            myself.handle_session_established(InitiationReply::Resumed(res)).await
6333                                        }
6334                                        HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(error_type) => {
6335                                            myself.handle_session_error(pseudonym, error_type).await
6336                                        }
6337                                        HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(msg) => {
6338                                            myself.handle_keep_alive(pseudonym, msg).await
6339                                        }
6340                                        HoprStartProtocol::SsaCommit(client_commit_msg) => {
6341                                            myself.handle_ssa_commit(pseudonym, client_commit_msg).await
6342                                        }
6343                                        HoprStartProtocol::SsaRequest(server_commit_msg) => {
6344                                            myself.handle_ssa_request(pseudonym, server_commit_msg).await
6345                                        }
6346                                        // Handled in `dispatch_message`.
6347                                        HoprStartProtocol::ForwardReceipts(_) => Ok(()),
6348                                        // Routing puts `StartSession` on the session lane.
6349                                        HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(_) => {
6350                                            unreachable!("StartSession is never routed to the control lane")
6351                                        }
6352                                    };
6353
6354                                    report_start_result(result);
6355                                }
6356                            })
6357                            .instrument(tracing::debug_span!(parent: &span, "session.start_protocol"))
6358                    }
6359                )
6360                .with_current_subscriber()
6361        );
6362
6363        Ok(vec![
6364            ah_closure_notifications,
6365            ah_session_expiration,
6366            ah_start_session,
6367            ah_start_control,
6368        ])
6369    }

6371    /// Check if [`start`](SessionManager::start) has been called and the instance is running.
6372    pub fn is_started(&self) -> bool {
6373        self.session_notifiers.get().is_some()
6374    }
6375
6376    /// Installs the SURB-store admission seam this manager calls at Session establishment and
6377    /// teardown.
6378    ///
6379    /// Late-injected through a `OnceLock` for the same reason `msg_sender` and `admission_tx` are:
6380    /// the only in-tree implementation wraps the SURB store, which the composition root builds
6381    /// alongside — but never inside — this crate. `false` means a controller was already installed,
6382    /// which no in-tree caller can produce (it installs exactly one, right after construction) and
6383    /// is reported rather than ignored so a double-wired node is visible at the call site.
6384    ///
6385    /// Leaving it unset is *functional*, not fatal: the manager then never admits, and every
6386    /// Session's SURBs land in the store's quarantine class. That failure mode is what the store's
6387    /// admission counters exist to surface, which is why this does not fall back to a no-op
6388    /// controller that would hide the absence.
6389    pub fn set_surb_admission(&self, ctl: Arc<dyn SurbAdmissionControl>) -> bool {
6390        self.surb_admission.set(ctl).is_ok()
6391    }
6392
6393    /// Installs the sink for the forward receipts of outgoing Sessions; `false` if one was installed already.
6394    ///
6395    /// Without one, no Session asks its Exit for receipts.
6396    pub fn set_forward_receipt_sink(&self, sink: Arc<dyn ForwardReceiptSink>) -> bool {
6397        self.forward_receipt_sink.set(sink).is_ok()
6398    }
6399
6400    /// Atomically allocates a new [`SessionSlot`] for `session_id` and returns an RAII
6401    /// [`SessionSlotGuard`] for it.
6402    ///
6403    /// Establishing a session involves several fallible steps *after* the slot has been
6404    /// inserted. The returned guard rolls the slot back - tearing the partially
6405    /// established session down via [`release_session_slot`] - unless it is
6406    /// [committed](SessionSlotGuard::commit).
6407    ///
6408    /// The active-sessions gauge is incremented here, with the insertion, and decremented by
6409    /// [`release_session_slot`] on every path that removes the slot — a close or the guard's
6410    /// rollback — so, like `active_sessions`, it counts every slot exactly once. It is not counted
6411    /// at the commit: a close can reach a slot whose setup is still in progress, and if that setup
6412    /// then fails, the slot would be decremented without ever having been counted.
6413    ///
6414    /// Returns `None` if a slot for `session_id` already exists; in that case nothing is
6415    /// inserted, the gauge is left untouched, and no guard is produced. The atomic `entry`
6416    /// API guarantees that only one concurrent caller can claim the slot for a given
6417    /// pseudonym (avoiding a TOCTOU race), which also rules out loopback sessions onto
6418    /// ourselves.
6419    ///
6420    /// Capacity is enforced by an atomic counter incremented *before* the cache insertion,
6421    /// making it impossible for two concurrent callers (with different session IDs) to both
6422    /// succeed when the cache is already at `maximum_sessions`.
6423    fn allocate_session_slot(&self, session_id: SessionId, slot: SessionSlot) -> Option<SessionSlotGuard<'_>> {
6424        // Try to claim a session slot before touching the cache. `fetch_update` atomically
6425        // increments only if the value is strictly below the limit, preventing two concurrent
6426        // callers from both succeeding when already at capacity.
6427        let counter = &self.active_sessions;
6428        #[allow(clippy::incompatible_msrv)]
6429        let did_reserve = counter
6430            .try_update(Ordering::Relaxed, Ordering::Relaxed, |n| {
6431                (n < self.cfg.maximum_sessions).then_some(n + 1)
6432            })
6433            .is_ok();
6434
6435        if !did_reserve {
6436            return None;
6437        }
6438
6439        // Lift the slot's admission cell out before the slot is moved into the cache: the guard keeps
6440        // it so `commit_slot_guard` can recognise the cached slot as this establishment's own by cell
6441        // identity, even though the key it re-reads by is a reusable pseudonym.
6442        let admission_cell = slot.admission_token.clone();
6443        let instance = slot.instance.clone();
6444
6445        let result =
6446            self.sessions
6447                .entry(session_id)
6448                .and_compute_with(|entry: Option<moka::Entry<SessionId, SessionSlot>>| {
6449                    if entry.is_none() {
6450                        moka::ops::compute::Op::Put(slot)
6451                    } else {
6452                        // Duplicate key — release the reservation so the counter stays accurate.
6453                        counter.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
6454                        moka::ops::compute::Op::Nop
6455                    }
6456                });
6457
6458        match result {
6459            moka::ops::compute::CompResult::Inserted(_) => {
6460                #[cfg(all(feature = "telemetry", not(test)))]
6461                METRIC_ACTIVE_SESSIONS.increment(1.0);
6462
6463                // Notify any waiting message handler (e.g. handle_ssa_request) that the slot
6464                // is now available. Drain and signal the senders registered for this SessionId.
6465                if let Some(waiters) = self
6466                    .slot_allocated
6467                    .lock()
6468                    .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
6469                    .remove(&session_id)
6470                {
6471                    for w in waiters {
6472                        let _ = w.send(());
6473                    }
6474                }
6475                // take_guard borrows self, so the guard stores the counter and the admission seam
6476                // as clones rather than borrowing them.
6477                Some(SessionSlotGuard::new(
6478                    &self.sessions,
6479                    session_id,
6480                    counter.clone(),
6481                    self.surb_admission.clone(),
6482                    self.cfg.surb_resolution_wait,
6483                    admission_cell,
6484                    instance,
6485                ))
6486            }
6487            _ => None,
6488        }
6489    }
6490
6491    /// The outgoing Session under `pseudonym` that the initiation `challenge` opened, if any, whether or
6492    /// not its setup has finished.
6493    ///
6494    /// What scopes a challenge-named error after the reply: the pseudonym is reusable, so the challenge
6495    /// is what tells the Session the error is about from its predecessors and successors.
6496    fn forward_instance_of_challenge(
6497        &self,
6498        pseudonym: &HoprPseudonym,
6499        challenge: StartChallenge,
6500    ) -> Option<Arc<SlotInstance>> {
6501        self.sessions
6502            .get(pseudonym)
6503            .filter(|slot| {
6504                matches!(slot.routing_opts, DestinationRouting::Forward { .. }) && slot.instance.challenge == challenge
6505            })
6506            .map(|slot| slot.instance.clone())
6507    }
6508
6509    /// Takes the PIX ledger of `pseudonym` for a new initiation: the one `live` (the superseded local
6510    /// Session's own) carries, else the one parked in the retention cache, else a new one.
6511    ///
6512    /// A slot removed by [`remove_slot_if`] has parked its ledger before it left `sessions`, so a reader
6513    /// that sees no slot finds the parked ledger, and one that still sees the slot reads it as `live`
6514    /// (the same ledger the parked copy is, which this takes out). The cache entry is taken out, so a
6515    /// Session that is live holds its ledger alone; the claim parks it
6516    /// again if the initiation fails before a slot carries it. A ledger whose dimensions differ from the
6517    /// generator's current ones is replaced, and the generator's state for the pseudonym forgotten with
6518    /// it: neither describes the other any more.
6519    fn claim_pix_ledger(
6520        &self,
6521        pseudonym: HoprPseudonym,
6522        params: PixParams,
6523        live: Option<EntryPixLedger>,
6524    ) -> LedgerClaim {
6525        let parked = self.pix_ledgers.remove(&pseudonym);
6526        let ledger = match live.or(parked) {
6527            Some(ledger) if ledger.params() == Some(params) => ledger,
6528            replaced => {
6529                if replaced.is_some()
6530                    && let Some(toolbox) = self.pix_toolbox.get()
6531                {
6532                    toolbox.share_generator.forget(&pseudonym);
6533                }
6534                EntryPixLedger::new(params)
6535            }
6536        };
6537        LedgerClaim {
6538            ledger,
6539            cache: self.pix_ledgers.clone(),
6540            pseudonym,
6541            armed: true,
6542        }
6543    }
6544
6545    /// Forgets the share generator's state for `pseudonym` and leaves the claimed ledger unparked.
6546    ///
6547    /// Done under the pseudonym's SSA request lock, so a handler of a previous Session cannot recreate the
6548    /// generator state afterwards.
6549    async fn forget_pix_state(&self, pseudonym: HoprPseudonym, claim: &mut LedgerClaim) {
6550        let request_lock = self
6551            .ssa_request_locks
6552            .get_with(pseudonym, async { Arc::new(futures::lock::Mutex::new(())) })
6553            .await;
6554        let _guard = request_lock.lock().await;
6555        if let Some(toolbox) = self.pix_toolbox.get() {
6556            toolbox.share_generator.forget(&pseudonym);
6557        }
6558        // So a later use of the pseudonym also clears the refused attempt's SURBs from the Exit's quarantine.
6559        if let Some(admission) = self.surb_admission.get() {
6560            admission.advance_generation(&pseudonym);
6561        }
6562        claim.defuse();
6563    }
6564
6565    /// Initiates a new outgoing Session to `destination` with the given configuration.
6566    ///
6567    /// If the Session's counterparty does not respond within
6568    /// the [configured](SessionManagerConfig) period,
6569    /// this method returns [`TransportSessionError::Timeout`]. Until then it repeats an unanswered
6570    /// request, see [`initiation_resend_interval`](SessionManagerConfig::initiation_resend_interval).
6571    ///
6572    /// It will also fail if the instance has not been [started](SessionManager::start).
6573    pub async fn new_session(
6574        &self,
6575        destination: Address,
6576        target: SessionTarget,
6577        mut cfg: SessionClientConfig,
6578    ) -> errors::Result<HoprSession> {
6579        // Every PIX Session is resumable and no other is, whatever the caller passed.
6580        if cfg.capabilities.contains(Capability::UsePIX) {
6581            cfg.capabilities |= Capability::Resumable;
6582        } else {
6583            cfg.capabilities -= Capability::Resumable;
6584        }
6585
6586        // Evicts a slot that idled out but that the cache has not yet evicted, running its eviction
6587        // listener here and now: that is what parks an expired predecessor's PIX ledger before the
6588        // lookups below (see `remove_slot_if`), so a reconnect after an outage continues it.
6589        self.sessions.run_pending_tasks();
6590
6591        let mut msg_sender = self.msg_sender.get().cloned().ok_or(SessionManagerError::NotStarted)?;
6592
6593        let (tx_initiation_done, rx_initiation_done): (
6594            crossfire::MTx<crossfire::mpsc::One<_>>,
6595            crossfire::AsyncRx<crossfire::mpsc::One<_>>,
6596        ) = crossfire::mpsc::build(crossfire::mpsc::One::new());
6597
6598        let mut pix_params = None;
6599
6600        let mut additional_data = 0_u64;
6601
6602        // SURB balancer target announcement is encoded in the lower 32-bits of the options word.
6603        //
6604        // Only a target this Entry actually balances toward is announced. An Entry without a SURB
6605        // balancer (`surb_management` is `None`, as for a hoprd `responseBuffer` below two packets)
6606        // announces none, on this branch as on the `NoRateControl` one, and sends no keep-alives to
6607        // announce one later. It used to announce the balancer-rate fallback instead (the initial
6608        // return egress rate times the minimum buffer duration, 50 at the defaults), which the Exit
6609        // cannot tell from a real target of 50: it admitted a ring of 75 SURBs for it, and nothing
6610        // ever widened that ring. A zero is what lets the Exit tell, and give such a Session the full
6611        // ring (see `ring_surb_target` in `handle_incoming_session_initiation`).
6612        //
6613        // The Exit still needs a figure for its own balancer and fill reserve, and now takes it from
6614        // its own configuration. The initial egress rate is a constant (10) in the transport, but the
6615        // minimum buffer duration is an operator setting (`balancer_minimum_surb_buffer_duration`,
6616        // 5 s by default), so the Entry's and the Exit's could differ, and the Exit never had a reason
6617        // to prefer the Entry's. An Exit that predates this takes the same fallback on a zero.
6618        if !cfg.capabilities.contains(Capability::NoRateControl) {
6619            additional_data |= cfg
6620                .surb_management
6621                .map(|c| c.target_surb_buffer_size)
6622                .unwrap_or(0)
6623                .min(u32::MAX as u64);
6624        }
6625
6626        // PIX quota parameter announcement is encoded in the upper 32-bits of the options word.
6627        // Run these validations BEFORE reserving the initiation challenge slot so that a
6628        // repeated invalid request cannot exhaust all challenge slots.
6629        if cfg.capabilities.contains(Capability::UsePIX) {
6630            // PIX requires at least 1 intermediate hop on the return path so that PIX
6631            // shares can be encrypted with the first relayer's ticket-challenge solution
6632            // (`HalfKey`) and delivered via return-path SURBs. With 0 intermediate hops
6633            // (a direct Exit→Entry SURB), there is no relayer to provide the challenge
6634            // solution, so shares are never embedded — the ongoing PIX share delivery
6635            // mechanism is dead and the Exit's quota is never replenished.
6636            if cfg.return_path_options.count_hops() == 0 {
6637                return Err(SessionManagerError::Other(anyhow!(
6638                    "UsePIX requires at least 1 intermediate hop on the return path, got 0"
6639                ))
6640                .into());
6641            }
6642
6643            // Validate that PIX toolbox is available before advertising UsePIX
6644            let pix_toolbox = self
6645                .pix_toolbox
6646                .get()
6647                .ok_or_else(|| SessionManagerError::Other(anyhow!("UsePIX requested but no PIX toolbox installed")))?;
6648
6649            // The installed generator is what actually produces the shares that go on the wire, so
6650            // it — not the caller — is the source of the announced parameters. Letting a caller name
6651            // them instead would allow a Session to proceed while producing shares the Exit cannot
6652            // reconstruct, so the dimensions are not a per-Session choice at all: `UsePIX` is the
6653            // whole switch, and everything downstream (the per-SSA quota, and so the deposit amount
6654            // reported to the funding strategy in `AgreedSsaQuota`) is derived from what follows.
6655            // The same source for the dimensions and for the curve suite: `HoprPixSpec` is what the
6656            // installed generator is instantiated over, so the announced suite cannot disagree with
6657            // the one that will actually produce the shares.
6658            let gen_cfg = pix_toolbox.share_generator.config();
6659            let params = PixParams::try_from_config::<HoprPixSpec>(gen_cfg)
6660                .map_err(|error| SessionManagerError::Other(anyhow!("invalid PIX dimensions: {error}")))?;
6661
6662            pix_params = Some(params);
6663            additional_data = params.into_additional_data(additional_data as u32);
6664        }
6665
6666        // Only an Entry with a SURB balancer refills the SURBs that the receipts take
6667        let wants_forward_receipts = self.cfg.forward_receipts
6668            && self.forward_receipt_sink.get().is_some()
6669            && !cfg.capabilities.contains(Capability::NoRateControl)
6670            && cfg.surb_management.is_some()
6671            && matches!(cfg.forward_path_options, RoutingOptions::Hops(hops) if u32::from(hops) > 0);
6672
6673        // The pseudonym first, since the challenge is chosen per pseudonym (see
6674        // `SessionManager::next_challenge_after`).
6675        let pseudonym = cfg.pseudonym.unwrap_or(HoprPseudonym::random());
6676
6677        // Challenges for one pseudonym strictly increase: an Exit takes a held Session over only for
6678        // a challenge greater than the one it was established by, so that an attempt the client has
6679        // abandoned, delayed in the mixnet past a newer one, can never take over the newer one's Session.
6680        // The first challenge under a pseudonym is drawn from the lower half of the range, so that
6681        // increments cannot realistically wrap it. `insert_into_next_slot` claims the challenge
6682        // atomically, so no two in-flight initiations share one, and probes upward on a collision.
6683        //
6684        // The record of a Session that is still live is the slot's own (it only reaches the cache at
6685        // teardown), so a reconnect that replaces it reads the larger of the two. The slot is read first:
6686        // teardown parks the challenge in the cache before it removes the slot, so this order cannot miss both.
6687        let live_challenge = self
6688            .sessions
6689            .get(&pseudonym)
6690            .filter(|live| matches!(live.routing_opts, DestinationRouting::Forward { .. }))
6691            .map(|live| live.instance.challenge);
6692        let last_challenge = live_challenge.max(self.last_challenges.get(&pseudonym));
6693        let (challenge, _) = insert_into_next_slot(
6694            &self.session_initiations,
6695            |ch| next_challenge(last_challenge, ch),
6696            |_| tx_initiation_done,
6697            Some(self.cfg.maximum_sessions as u64),
6698        )
6699        .ok_or(SessionManagerError::NoChallengeSlots)?; // almost impossible with u64
6700        self.note_challenge(pseudonym, challenge);
6701
6702        trace!(challenge, ?cfg, "initiating session with config");
6703        // Atomically claim the pseudonym in `pending_outgoing` before the initiation is sent so
6704        // that a fast Exit's `SsaRequest` — which names the Session by this pseudonym, not by the
6705        // challenge — finds it at dispatch. The guard removes it on every path below that does not
6706        // reach `drop(_pending_guard)`: each early return, a dropped future, and the two
6707        // `allocate_session_slot` failures, which are keyed by the peer-supplied `session_id` and
6708        // so cannot clear it themselves.
6709        //
6710        // The claim, not a plain `insert`, because `moka`'s `insert` would silently overwrite an
6711        // existing reservation: two concurrent `new_session` calls under the same explicit
6712        // pseudonym would both hold a guard over one shared marker, and the first one to finish
6713        // would clear it while the other is still in flight — an `SsaRequest` for that initiation
6714        // would then fail the dispatch filter and be dropped as `StaleStartMessage`. Refusing the
6715        // overlapping initiation instead keeps each marker owned by exactly one attempt.
6716        //
6717        // The claim happens AFTER the challenge reservation above, so a failed claim must also
6718        // release that reservation: it was taken for an initiation that never starts, and leaving
6719        // it would shrink the initiation window for every later attempt.
6720        let token = PendingOutgoingToken::next();
6721        let claim_result = self.pending_outgoing.entry(pseudonym).and_compute_with(
6722            |entry: Option<moka::Entry<HoprPseudonym, PendingOutgoingToken>>| {
6723                if entry.is_none() {
6724                    moka::ops::compute::Op::Put(token)
6725                } else {
6726                    // Another initiation already holds this pseudonym.
6727                    moka::ops::compute::Op::Nop
6728                }
6729            },
6730        );
6731        if !matches!(claim_result, moka::ops::compute::CompResult::Inserted(_)) {
6732            self.session_initiations.remove(&challenge);
6733            return Err(SessionManagerError::Unacceptable(format!(
6734                "an outgoing Session initiation under pseudonym {pseudonym} is already in flight"
6735            ))
6736            .into());
6737        }
6738        let _pending_guard = PendingOutgoingGuard {
6739            pending: &self.pending_outgoing,
6740            pseudonym,
6741            token,
6742        };
6743
6744        // A live outgoing Session under this pseudonym is the predecessor of this one: a client
6745        // reconnecting under the pseudonym it chose. It is closed here, scoped to its own instance, so
6746        // that a close racing in from anywhere else cannot be mistaken for this Session's. Its PIX
6747        // ledger stays, which is what lets this Session continue the accounting. An Exit-side slot
6748        // under the pseudonym is not ours to replace and keeps failing as a loopback below.
6749        //
6750        // Before the capacity check: replacing a Session does not take another slot.
6751        let mut live_ledger = None;
6752        if let Some(live) = self.sessions.get(&pseudonym)
6753            && matches!(live.routing_opts, DestinationRouting::Forward { .. })
6754        {
6755            // Read before the close, which parks the ledger in the retention cache.
6756            live_ledger = live.instance.ledger();
6757            info!(%pseudonym, "closing the live Session this reconnect under the same pseudonym replaces");
6758            self.close_session_scoped(
6759                &pseudonym,
6760                ClosureReason::WriteClosed,
6761                CloseScope::Instance(&live.instance),
6762            );
6763        }
6764
6765        if self.cfg.maximum_sessions <= self.active_sessions.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
6766            self.session_initiations.remove(&challenge);
6767            return Err(SessionManagerError::TooManySessions.into());
6768        }
6769
6770        // Taken only once this initiation is certain to be sent: it may replace a ledger, and with it
6771        // the generator's state.
6772        let mut ledger_claim = pix_params.map(|params| self.claim_pix_ledger(pseudonym, params, live_ledger));
6773        let (current_ssa_state, returned_packets) = match &ledger_claim {
6774            Some(claim) => (claim.ledger.ssa_state.clone(), claim.ledger.returned_packets.clone()),
6775            None => Default::default(),
6776        };
6777
6778        // Built after the claim, which may have replaced a ledger and forgotten the generator's state. The
6779        // Entry offers to resume only when it still holds PIX state for the pseudonym.
6780        let resuming = cfg.capabilities.contains(Capability::UsePIX)
6781            && ledger_claim.as_ref().is_some_and(|claim| {
6782                claim.ledger.has_watermark()
6783                    || self
6784                        .pix_toolbox
6785                        .get()
6786                        .is_some_and(|toolbox| toolbox.share_generator.emission_progress(&pseudonym).is_some())
6787            });
6788        let mut additional_data = into_initiation_additional_data(additional_data, self.cfg.idle_timeout);
6789        if resuming {
6790            additional_data |= INITIATION_RESUME_ATTEMPT;
6791        }
6792        if wants_forward_receipts {
6793            additional_data |= FORWARD_RECEIPTS_REQUESTED;
6794        }
6795        let start_session_msg = HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(StartInitiation {
6796            challenge,
6797            target,
6798            capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities(cfg.capabilities),
6799            additional_data,
6800        });
6801
6802        let forward_routing = DestinationRouting::Forward {
6803            destination: Box::new(destination.into()),
6804            pseudonym: Some(pseudonym), // Session must use a fixed pseudonym already
6805            forward_options: cfg.forward_path_options.clone(),
6806            return_options: cfg.return_path_options.clone().into(),
6807        };
6808
6809        // Send the Session initiation message
6810        info!(challenge, %pseudonym, %destination, "new session request");
6811        send_via_msg_sender(
6812            &mut msg_sender,
6813            forward_routing.clone(),
6814            start_session_msg.clone(),
6815            "session request message",
6816        )
6817        .await
6818        .map_err(|error| {
6819            self.session_initiations.remove(&challenge);
6820            TransportSessionError::packet_sending(error)
6821        })?;
6822
6823        // The deadline is given by the number of hops requested, and is fixed once the request is out
6824        let started = Instant::now();
6825        let deadline = started
6826            + initiation_wait(
6827                self.cfg.initiation_timeout_base,
6828                cfg.forward_path_options.count_hops(),
6829                cfg.return_path_options.count_hops(),
6830            );
6831
6832        // Await session establishment response from the Exit node or timeout, repeating the request meanwhile
6833        trace!(challenge, "awaiting session establishment");
6834        let mut resends = 0_u32;
6835        let mut next_resend = self.next_initiation_resend(started, resends, deadline);
6836        let outcome = loop {
6837            let wake = next_resend.unwrap_or(deadline);
6838            let wait = hopr_utils::runtime::prelude::sleep(wake.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now()));
6839            futures::pin_mut!(wait);
6840            // `recv` is cancel-safe, so losing the race to the timer drops no answer.
6841            match futures::future::select(rx_initiation_done.recv(), wait).await {
6842                futures::future::Either::Left((Ok(Ok(est)), _)) => break Ok(Ok(Some(est))),
6843                futures::future::Either::Left((Ok(Err(error)), _)) => break Ok(Err(error)),
6844                futures::future::Either::Left((Err(_), _)) => break Ok(Ok(None)),
6845                futures::future::Either::Right(_) if next_resend.is_none() => break Err(()),
6846                futures::future::Either::Right(_) => {
6847                    let now = Instant::now();
6848                    if now >= deadline {
6849                        break Err(());
6850                    }
6851                    resends += 1;
6852                    info!(
6853                        challenge,
6854                        resend = resends,
6855                        of = self.cfg.max_initiation_resends,
6856                        "the Exit has not answered the session request — repeating it"
6857                    );
6858                    crate::counters::START_SESSION_RESENDS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
6859                    #[cfg(all(feature = "telemetry", not(test)))]
6860                    METRIC_START_SESSION_RESENT.increment();
6861                    // A new generation makes the Exit drop the stale SURBs, so its answer comes over this repeat's.
6862                    if let Some(admission) = self.surb_admission.get() {
6863                        admission.advance_generation(&pseudonym);
6864                    }
6865                    // Bounded by the remaining budget, so a slow repeat cannot push the attempt past the deadline.
6866                    match send_via_msg_sender(
6867                        &mut msg_sender,
6868                        forward_routing.clone(),
6869                        start_session_msg.clone(),
6870                        "repeated session request message",
6871                    )
6872                    .timeout(futures_time::time::Duration::from(deadline - now))
6873                    .await
6874                    {
6875                        Ok(Ok(())) => {}
6876                        Ok(Err(error)) => debug!(challenge, %error, "failed to repeat the session request"),
6877                        Err(_) => debug!(challenge, "repeating the session request ran into the deadline"),
6878                    }
6879                    next_resend = self.next_initiation_resend(started, resends, deadline);
6880                }
6881            }
6882        };
6883        match outcome {
6884            Ok(Ok(Some(est))) => {
6885                // Session has been established, construct it
6886                let session_id = est.session_id();
6887                let stream_base = est.stream_base();
6888                debug!(
6889                    challenge = est.orig_challenge(),
6890                    ?session_id,
6891                    ?stream_base,
6892                    "started a new session"
6893                );
6894
6895                // A Resumed reply names the Session the Entry asked about, nothing else.
6896                if stream_base.is_some() && session_id != pseudonym {
6897                    error!(%session_id, %pseudonym, "the Exit resumed a Session under another pseudonym");
6898                    return Err(SessionManagerError::Unacceptable(
6899                        "the Exit resumed a Session under a pseudonym this Entry did not ask about".into(),
6900                    )
6901                    .into());
6902                }
6903
6904                // A base the Exit and this Entry cannot number a stream from fails the establishment;
6905                // the ledger claim parks the ledger again on the way out.
6906                if let Some(base) = stream_base {
6907                    if base == 0 || base > MAX_STREAM_BASE {
6908                        error!(%session_id, base, "the Exit resumed the Session with an invalid stream base");
6909                        return Err(SessionManagerError::Unacceptable(format!(
6910                            "the Exit resumed the Session with stream base {base}, outside of 1..={MAX_STREAM_BASE}"
6911                        ))
6912                        .into());
6913                    }
6914                    // A raw Session has no frames to number.
6915                    if !cfg.capabilities.contains(Capability::Segmentation) {
6916                        error!(%session_id, base, "the Exit resumed a Session without segmentation");
6917                        return Err(SessionManagerError::Unacceptable(
6918                            "the Exit resumed a Session whose capabilities lack segmentation, which has no frame \
6919                             numbering"
6920                                .into(),
6921                        )
6922                        .into());
6923                    }
6924                    // Only the stateless socket numbers its stream from a base.
6925                    if cfg.capabilities.contains(Capability::RetransmissionAck)
6926                        || cfg.capabilities.contains(Capability::RetransmissionNack)
6927                    {
6928                        error!(%session_id, base, "the Exit resumed a Session with a stateful socket");
6929                        return Err(SessionManagerError::Unacceptable(
6930                            "the Exit resumed a Session whose capabilities select the stateful socket, which cannot \
6931                             number its stream from a base"
6932                                .into(),
6933                        )
6934                        .into());
6935                    }
6936                }
6937
6938                // The Exit resumed a Session that was not offered for resuming.
6939                if stream_base.is_some() && !resuming {
6940                    error!(%session_id, "the Exit resumed a Session this Entry did not offer to resume");
6941                    return Err(SessionManagerError::Unacceptable(
6942                        "the Exit resumed a Session this Entry did not offer to resume".into(),
6943                    )
6944                    .into());
6945                }
6946
6947                // A fresh Session answering a resume attempt, or a resumed one this Entry cannot continue (it needs
6948                // both the ledger's watermark and the generator's emission progress): the Exit lost the Session, or
6949                // this Entry lost half of its state. Nothing is allocated; the state is forgotten first so the
6950                // notice's SURBs carry no shares, and the Exit is told to close it.
6951                let both_halves = ledger_claim.as_ref().is_some_and(|claim| claim.ledger.has_watermark())
6952                    && self
6953                        .pix_toolbox
6954                        .get()
6955                        .is_some_and(|toolbox| toolbox.share_generator.emission_progress(&pseudonym).is_some());
6956                if resuming
6957                    && (stream_base.is_none() || !both_halves)
6958                    && let Some(claim) = ledger_claim.as_mut()
6959                {
6960                    warn!(%session_id, resumed = stream_base.is_some(), "the Exit's reply to a resume attempt cannot be honoured");
6961                    self.forget_pix_state(pseudonym, claim).await;
6962                    self.notify_session_error(
6963                        session_id,
6964                        ErrorIdentifier::SessionId(session_id),
6965                        forward_routing.clone(),
6966                        StartErrorReason::NotResumable,
6967                        "reply to a resume attempt that cannot be honoured",
6968                    )
6969                    .await;
6970                    return Err(TransportSessionError::Rejected(StartErrorReason::NotResumable));
6971                }
6972
6973                let (session_tx, session_rx) =
6974                    crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async::<ApplicationDataIn>(self.cfg.session_forward_capacity);
6975                let (session_rx, session_rx_ah) = hopr_utils::runtime::DropAbortable::new(session_rx.into_stream());
6976
6977                let mut abort_handles = AbortableList::default();
6978                abort_handles.insert(SessionHandles::Ingress, session_rx_ah);
6979
6980                // Created before the notifier so the notifier names *this* establishment: a close it
6981                // reports later is ignored once the pseudonym belongs to a successor.
6982                let instance = SlotInstance::new(challenge);
6983                instance.attach_challenge_home(self.last_challenges.clone());
6984                if let Some(claim) = &ledger_claim {
6985                    instance.attach_ledger(claim.ledger.clone(), self.pix_ledgers.clone());
6986                }
6987
6988                let notifier = self
6989                    .session_notifiers
6990                    .get()
6991                    .map(|(_, notifier)| {
6992                        let notifier = notifier.clone();
6993                        let instance = instance.clone();
6994                        Box::new(move |session_id: SessionId, reason: ClosureReason| {
6995                            let _ = notifier
6996                                .try_send((session_id, reason, instance))
6997                                .inspect_err(|error| error!(%session_id, %error, "failed to notify session closure"));
6998                        })
6999                    })
7000                    .ok_or(SessionManagerError::NotStarted)?;
7001
7002                // NOTE: the Exit node can have different `max_surb_buffer_size`
7003                // setting on the Session manager, so it does not make sense to cap it here
7004                // with our maximum value.
7005                if let Some(balancer_config) = cfg.surb_management {
7006                    let surb_estimator = AtomicSurbFlowEstimator::default();
7007                    let surbs_per_keep_alive = KeepAliveMessage::from(session_id).max_surbs()? as u32;
7008
7009                    // Sender responsible for keep-alive and Session data will be counting produced SURBs
7010                    let surb_estimator_clone = surb_estimator.clone();
7011                    let full_surb_scoring_sender =
7012                        msg_sender.with(move |(routing, data): (DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)| {
7013                            let produced = data.estimate_surbs_with_msg() as u64;
7014                            // Count how many SURBs we sent with each packet
7015                            surb_estimator_clone
7016                                .produced
7017                                .fetch_add(produced, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
7018                            #[cfg(feature = "telemetry")]
7019                            telemetry::record_session_surb_produced(&session_id, produced);
7020                            futures::future::ok::<_, S::Error>((routing, data))
7021                        });
7022
7023                    let surb_mgmt = Arc::new(BalancerStateValues::from(balancer_config));
7024                    // The counterparty's store is the same bounded ring buffer as ours, so its
7025                    // capacity bounds what our `produced - consumed` estimate can legitimately
7026                    // claim it is holding.
7027                    surb_mgmt.set_counterparty_buffer_capacity(self.cfg.maximum_surb_buffer_size as u64);
7028
7029                    // For standard Session data we first reduce the number of SURBs we want to produce,
7030                    // unless requested to always max them out
7031                    let max_surbs_in_packet = cfg.max_surbs_per_data_packet;
7032                    let surb_mgmt_for_tx = surb_mgmt.clone();
7033                    let egress_instance = instance.clone();
7034                    let egress_sessions = self.sessions.clone();
7035                    let egress_touch_period = self.cfg.idle_timeout / 4;
7036                    let reduced_surb_scoring_sender = full_surb_scoring_sender
7037                        .clone()
7038                        .sink_map_err(std::io::Error::other)
7039                        .with(
7040                            // NOTE: this is put in-front of the `full_surb_scoring_sender`,
7041                            // so that its estimate of SURBs gets automatically updated based on
7042                            // the `max_surbs_in_packets` set here.
7043                            move |(routing, mut data): (DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)| {
7044                                // Ahead of the count behind it: a Session whose slot is gone sends
7045                                // nothing, and produces no SURBs the Exit would answer on.
7046                                if egress_instance.is_superseded() {
7047                                    return futures::future::err(superseded_write_error());
7048                                }
7049                                egress_instance.touch_slot_on_write(&egress_sessions, &session_id, egress_touch_period);
7050                                cap_organic_surbs(&mut data, max_surbs_in_packet, &surb_mgmt_for_tx);
7051                                futures::future::ok::<_, std::io::Error>((routing, data))
7052                            },
7053                        );
7054
7055                    // Spawn the SURB-bearing keep alive stream towards the Exit. Suspended until the
7056                    // balancer below gives the controller a rate.
7057                    let ka_controller = RateController::new(0, Duration::from_secs(1));
7058                    let ka_abort_handle = utils::spawn_keep_alive_stream(
7059                        session_id,
7060                        full_surb_scoring_sender,
7061                        forward_routing.clone(),
7062                        if self.cfg.surb_target_notify {
7063                            SurbNotificationMode::Target
7064                        } else {
7065                            SurbNotificationMode::DoNotNotify
7066                        },
7067                        surb_mgmt.clone(),
7068                        &ka_controller,
7069                        // The Entry's balancer owns this stream outright and there is no second
7070                        // producer to arbitrate between, so every packet the rate limiter releases is
7071                        // one the balancer asked for.
7072                        || true,
7073                    );
7074                    abort_handles.insert(SessionHandles::KeepAlive, ka_abort_handle);
7075
7076                    // The Exit holds nothing yet, which is the state a wipe leaves it in: pace the
7077                    // first fill like the refill after one, or the PID commands its ceiling from the
7078                    // first tick and the flood loses the replies the verdicts are made of. The target
7079                    // is set from the configuration here, so this is the point it first is non-zero;
7080                    // the `BalancerTarget` keep-alive path is the Exit receiving the Entry's target,
7081                    // and does not arm anything.
7082                    // At least one keep-alive a second, so that a small target is not filled a SURB or
7083                    // two at a time and the Session left waiting for its first keep-alive.
7084                    surb_mgmt.set_pacing_floor(u64::from(surbs_per_keep_alive));
7085                    surb_mgmt.arm_refill_pacing();
7086
7087                    // Spawn the SURB balancer, which will decide on the initial SURB rate.
7088                    debug!(%session_id, ?balancer_config ,"spawning entry SURB balancer");
7089                    let balancer = SurbBalancer::new(
7090                        session_id,
7091                        // The setpoint and output limit is immediately reconfigured by the SurbBalancer
7092                        PidBalancerController::from_gains(PidControllerGains::from_env_or_default()),
7093                        surb_estimator.clone(),
7094                        // Convert the requested SURB rate to packets using the keep-alive's capacity.
7095                        SurbControllerWithCorrection(ka_controller, surbs_per_keep_alive),
7096                        surb_mgmt.clone(),
7097                    );
7098
7099                    let (level_stream, balancer_abort_handle) =
7100                        balancer.start_control_loop(self.cfg.balancer_sampling_interval);
7101                    abort_handles.insert(SessionHandles::Balancer, balancer_abort_handle);
7102
7103                    // Insert the slot before the SURB readiness wait so any echo packets that
7104                    // arrive during pre-loading are accepted rather than dropped as unknown.
7105                    // Early return from the wait below drops slot_guard uncommitted, which removes
7106                    // the slot and calls close_session → abort_all() on the spawned tasks.
7107                    let mut slot_guard = self
7108                        .allocate_session_slot(
7109                            session_id,
7110                            SessionSlot {
7111                                session_tx,
7112                                routing_opts: forward_routing.clone(),
7113                                abort_handles: Arc::new(parking_lot::Mutex::new(abort_handles)),
7114                                surb_mgmt: surb_mgmt.clone(),
7115                                surb_estimator: surb_estimator.clone(),
7116                                current_ssa_state,
7117                                // Entry side: the Exit is authoritative for the PIX lifecycle, so
7118                                // there is no supervisor here and nothing gates egress.
7119                                pix_supervisor: Default::default(),
7120                                pix_egress_gate: Default::default(),
7121                                pix_fill: Default::default(),
7122                                exit_loss_signal: Default::default(),
7123                                returned_packets: returned_packets.clone(),
7124                                // Nor does it hold reconstructor state: the live-cycle budget is
7125                                // charged by the side that reconstructs.
7126                                cycle_budget: None,
7127                                admission_token: Default::default(),
7128                                raised_surb_target: Default::default(),
7129                                forward_receipts: None,
7130                                exit_resume: Default::default(),
7131                                instance: instance.clone(),
7132                                opening: None,
7133                            },
7134                        )
7135                        .ok_or_else(|| {
7136                            // Session already exists; it means it is most likely a loopback attempt
7137                            error!(%session_id, "session already exists - loopback attempt");
7138                            // The slot will never exist for this pseudonym, so the pending-initiation
7139                            // marker must not outlive this attempt: leaving it would let later
7140                            // `SsaRequest`s for it pass the dispatch filter and park a handler waiting
7141                            // on a slot that never arrives. Dropped on the way out of the closure, the
7142                            // guard removes the marker keyed by the pseudonym it was inserted under.
7143                            SessionManagerError::Loopback
7144                        })?;
7145                    // From here the slot's teardown parks the ledger.
7146                    if let Some(claim) = ledger_claim.as_mut() {
7147                        claim.defuse();
7148                    }
7149                    // Its packets are recorded from now on, and those of a Session it replaces are forgotten
7150                    if wants_forward_receipts && let Some(sink) = self.forward_receipt_sink.get() {
7151                        let _ = instance.receipts.set(sink.clone());
7152                        sink.session_started(pseudonym, instance.id());
7153                    }
7154
7155                    // The slot now exists, so inbound traffic for this Session passes the dispatch
7156                    // filter on the session registry alone; the pending-initiation marker has served
7157                    // its purpose. Cleared here, before the SURB readiness wait below, which can take
7158                    // seconds, rather than after it.
7159                    drop(_pending_guard);
7160
7161                    // Prevent the slot from being evicted by time_to_idle while SURBs are
7162                    // pre-loading. Each `get()` call resets the idle timer; the task is
7163                    // aborted as soon as the readiness wait resolves.
7164                    let sessions_keepalive = self.sessions.clone();
7165                    let touch_period = (self.cfg.idle_timeout / 2).max(self.cfg.min_session_touch_period);
7166                    let slot_keepalive = AbortOnDrop::from(hopr_utils::runtime::prelude::spawn(async move {
7167                        loop {
7168                            hopr_utils::runtime::prelude::sleep(touch_period).await;
7169                            let _ = sessions_keepalive.get(&session_id);
7170                        }
7171                    }));
7172
7173                    // The session is ready once a quarter of the target is believed to be at the
7174                    // counterparty: that is the point the first replies can come home, and a quarter of
7175                    // the target is already several seconds of replies at any rate the balancer sustains.
7176                    // The first fill is paced at a fifth of the target a second, so this arrives after
7177                    // about 1.25 s whatever the target, where half the target took about 2.5 s.
7178                    //
7179                    // TODO: consider making this interactive = other party reports the exact level periodically
7180                    let wait_result = level_stream
7181                        .skip_while(|current_level| {
7182                            futures::future::ready(*current_level < balancer_config.target_surb_buffer_size / 4)
7183                        })
7184                        .next()
7185                        .timeout(futures_time::time::Duration::from(SESSION_READINESS_TIMEOUT))
7186                        .await;
7187                    drop(slot_keepalive);
7188                    if let Some(err) = instance.setup_failure() {
7189                        return Err(err);
7190                    }
7191                    match wait_result {
7192                        Ok(Some(surb_level)) => {
7193                            info!(%session_id, surb_level, "session is ready");
7194                        }
7195                        Ok(None) => {
7196                            return Err(
7197                                SessionManagerError::other(anyhow!("surb balancer was cancelled prematurely")).into(),
7198                            );
7199                        }
7200                        Err(_) => {
7201                            warn!(%session_id, "session didn't reach target SURB buffer size in time");
7202                        }
7203                    }
7204
7205                    #[cfg(all(feature = "telemetry", not(test)))]
7206                    METRIC_NUM_INITIATED_SESSIONS.increment();
7207
7208                    let surb_estimator_for_rx = surb_estimator.clone();
7209                    let session = HoprSession::new_with_surb_state(
7210                        session_id,
7211                        forward_routing,
7212                        HoprSessionConfig {
7213                            stream_base,
7214                            ..session_config_with(&self.cfg, cfg.capabilities, cfg.max_frames_behind_gap)
7215                        },
7216                        (
7217                            reduced_surb_scoring_sender,
7218                            session_rx.inspect(move |_| {
7219                                // The Exit's SURB signals are recorded in `dispatch_message`, upstream
7220                                // of this: they override the organic SURB gate, and a packet dropped
7221                                // before it reaches here would take the override with it.
7222
7223                                // Received packets = SURB consumption estimate
7224                                // The received packets always consume a single SURB.
7225                                surb_estimator_for_rx
7226                                    .consumed
7227                                    .fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
7228                                // Same event, separate counter, on purpose — see `returned_packets`.
7229                                returned_packets.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
7230                                #[cfg(feature = "telemetry")]
7231                                telemetry::record_session_surb_consumed(&session_id, 1);
7232                            }),
7233                        ),
7234                        Some(notifier),
7235                        // Entry (sending) side: give flow control the SURB balancer state as its
7236                        // anti-grief down-only ceiling, and the client's opt-in flow-control config.
7237                        Some(surb_mgmt.clone()),
7238                        cfg.flow_control,
7239                        None,
7240                    )?
7241                    .with_slot_instance(instance.id(), instance.refusal.clone());
7242
7243                    #[cfg(feature = "telemetry")]
7244                    initialize_session_telemetry(
7245                        session_id,
7246                        &self.cfg,
7247                        cfg.capabilities,
7248                        Some(&surb_estimator),
7249                        Some(&surb_mgmt),
7250                        instance.id(),
7251                    );
7252
7253                    // Admitted at the established point, not at allocation: this is the first moment
7254                    // the Session exists on our terms. `maximum_surb_buffer_size` is what this Entry
7255                    // announced as its target, so the store sizes the ring off the buffer we
7256                    // actually intend to fill.
7257                    if let Some(err) = instance.setup_failure() {
7258                        return Err(err);
7259                    }
7260                    commit_slot_guard(
7261                        &mut slot_guard,
7262                        &self.sessions,
7263                        session_id,
7264                        self.surb_admission.clone(),
7265                        self.cfg.maximum_surb_buffer_size,
7266                    );
7267                    Ok(session)
7268                } else {
7269                    // Routine for short-lived sessions (health checks, bridges); not a fault.
7270                    tracing::debug!(%session_id, "session ready without SURB balancing");
7271
7272                    // Counted here too, unlike `surb_estimator`: the PIX successor gate reads this,
7273                    // and a knob that binds on some Sessions and not others is how a deposit gate
7274                    // silently becomes a gate that never opens.
7275                    let returned_packets_for_rx = returned_packets.clone();
7276
7277                    // Disabled SURB management: a default state has a zero target, which reads as
7278                    // `is_disabled()` and so caps organic SURBs at one per packet — this branch's
7279                    // behaviour, expressed through the same policy the balancing branch uses rather
7280                    // than restated as a literal below.
7281                    let surb_mgmt: Arc<BalancerStateValues> = Default::default();
7282
7283                    // Insert the slot and obtain a guard that rolls it back if any
7284                    // subsequent setup step fails.
7285                    let mut slot_guard = self
7286                        .allocate_session_slot(
7287                            session_id,
7288                            SessionSlot {
7289                                session_tx,
7290                                routing_opts: forward_routing.clone(),
7291                                abort_handles: Arc::new(parking_lot::Mutex::new(abort_handles)),
7292                                surb_mgmt: surb_mgmt.clone(),
7293                                surb_estimator: Default::default(), // No SURB estimator needed
7294                                current_ssa_state,
7295                                // Entry side: the Exit is authoritative for the PIX lifecycle.
7296                                pix_supervisor: Default::default(),
7297                                pix_egress_gate: Default::default(),
7298                                pix_fill: Default::default(),
7299                                exit_loss_signal: Default::default(),
7300                                returned_packets,
7301                                // Nor does it hold reconstructor state: the live-cycle budget is
7302                                // charged by the side that reconstructs.
7303                                cycle_budget: None,
7304                                admission_token: Default::default(),
7305                                raised_surb_target: Default::default(),
7306                                forward_receipts: None,
7307                                exit_resume: Default::default(),
7308                                instance: instance.clone(),
7309                                opening: None,
7310                            },
7311                        )
7312                        .ok_or_else(|| {
7313                            // Session already exists; it means it is most likely a loopback attempt
7314                            error!(%session_id, "session already exists - loopback attempt");
7315                            // The slot will never exist for this pseudonym, so the pending-initiation
7316                            // marker must not outlive this attempt: leaving it would let later
7317                            // `SsaRequest`s for it pass the dispatch filter and park a handler waiting
7318                            // on a slot that never arrives. Dropped on the way out of the closure, the
7319                            // guard removes the marker keyed by the pseudonym it was inserted under.
7320                            SessionManagerError::Loopback
7321                        })?;
7322                    // From here the slot's teardown parks the ledger.
7323                    if let Some(claim) = ledger_claim.as_mut() {
7324                        claim.defuse();
7325                    }
7326
7327                    // The slot now exists, so inbound traffic for this Session passes the dispatch
7328                    // filter on the session registry alone; the pending-initiation marker has served
7329                    // its purpose.
7330                    drop(_pending_guard);
7331
7332                    #[cfg(all(feature = "telemetry", not(test)))]
7333                    METRIC_NUM_INITIATED_SESSIONS.increment();
7334
7335                    // For standard Session data we first reduce the number of SURBs we want to produce,
7336                    // unless requested to always max them out
7337                    let max_surbs_in_packet = cfg.max_surbs_per_data_packet;
7338                    let surb_mgmt_for_tx = surb_mgmt.clone();
7339                    let egress_instance = instance.clone();
7340                    let egress_sessions = self.sessions.clone();
7341                    let egress_touch_period = self.cfg.idle_timeout / 4;
7342                    let reduced_surb_sender = msg_sender.sink_map_err(std::io::Error::other).with(
7343                        move |(routing, mut data): (DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)| {
7344                            if egress_instance.is_superseded() {
7345                                return futures::future::err(superseded_write_error());
7346                            }
7347                            egress_instance.touch_slot_on_write(&egress_sessions, &session_id, egress_touch_period);
7348                            cap_organic_surbs(&mut data, max_surbs_in_packet, &surb_mgmt_for_tx);
7349                            futures::future::ok::<_, std::io::Error>((routing, data))
7350                        },
7351                    );
7352
7353                    let session = HoprSession::new(
7354                        session_id,
7355                        forward_routing,
7356                        HoprSessionConfig {
7357                            stream_base,
7358                            ..session_config_with(&self.cfg, cfg.capabilities, cfg.max_frames_behind_gap)
7359                        },
7360                        (
7361                            reduced_surb_sender,
7362                            session_rx.inspect(move |_| {
7363                                returned_packets_for_rx.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
7364                            }),
7365                        ),
7366                        Some(notifier),
7367                    )?
7368                    .with_slot_instance(instance.id(), instance.refusal.clone());
7369
7370                    #[cfg(feature = "telemetry")]
7371                    initialize_session_telemetry(session_id, &self.cfg, cfg.capabilities, None, None, instance.id());
7372
7373                    // Same admission point as the balanced branch above, with the same announced
7374                    // target: a Session without SURB balancing still holds a return path worth
7375                    // protecting.
7376                    if let Some(err) = instance.setup_failure() {
7377                        return Err(err);
7378                    }
7379                    commit_slot_guard(
7380                        &mut slot_guard,
7381                        &self.sessions,
7382                        session_id,
7383                        self.surb_admission.clone(),
7384                        self.cfg.maximum_surb_buffer_size,
7385                    );
7386                    Ok(session)
7387                }
7388            }
7389            Ok(Ok(None)) => {
7390                self.session_initiations.remove(&challenge);
7391                Err(SessionManagerError::other(anyhow!(
