20313    /// Verifies the `HoprStartProtocol::SessionError` match arm (line 689) in the
20314    /// `session_start_control_processor` task by calling `handle_session_error` directly.
20315    ///
20316    /// When a `SessionError` message is delivered while a `new_session` call is awaiting,
20317    /// `handle_session_error` retrieves the pending challenge from `session_initiations`,
20318    /// sends the error down the channel, and `new_session` propagates it as `Rejected`.
20319    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
20320    async fn handle_session_error_propagates_peer_rejection_to_pending_new_session() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
20321        let mgr: SessionManager<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>> =
20322            SessionManager::new(Default::default());
20323
20324        let mut transport = MockMsgSender::new();
20325        // new_session sends StartSession (succeeds), then waits for SessionEstablished.
20326        // We inject the error before it arrives.
20327        transport
20328            .expect_send_message()
20329            .returning(|_, _| futures::future::ok(()).boxed());
20330
20331        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
20332        let _notifications = tokio::spawn(async move {
20333            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
20334            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
20335        });
20336        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(transport);
20337        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, None)?;
20338        assert!(mgr.is_started());
20339
20340        // Spawn new_session so it is blocked waiting for the session establishment response.
20341        let mgr_clone = mgr.clone();
20342        let peer_address: Address = (&ChainKeypair::random()).into();
20343        let handle = tokio::spawn(async move {
20344            mgr_clone
20345                .new_session(
20346                    peer_address,
20347                    SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
20348                    SessionClientConfig {
20349                        surb_management: None,
20350                        ..Default::default()
20351                    },
20352                )
20353                .await
20354        });
20355
20356        // Give new_session time to insert the challenge into session_initiations.
20357        let challenge = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
20358            loop {
20359                if let Some((ch, _)) = mgr.session_initiations.iter().next() {
20360                    break *ch;
20361                }
20362                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
20363            }
20364        })
20365        .await
20366        .context("new_session did not insert a challenge into session_initiations")?;
20367
20368        // Inject the SessionError with the matching challenge before SessionEstablished arrives.
20369        let error_type = StartErrorType {
20370            identifier: ErrorIdentifier::Challenge(challenge),
20371            reason: StartErrorReason::NoSlotsAvailable,
20372        };
20373        // The error is challenge-identified, so the handler ignores the sender's pseudonym on this
20374        // arm; `new_session` picks a random one, and none is captured here.
20375        mgr.handle_session_error(HoprPseudonym::random(), error_type).await?;
20376
20377        // new_session must propagate the error as Rejected.
20378        let result = handle.await?;
20379        match result {
20380            Ok(_session) => panic!("expected rejection error, got session"),
20381            Err(e) => {
20382                assert!(matches!(
20383                    e,
20384                    TransportSessionError::Rejected(StartErrorReason::NoSlotsAvailable)
20385                ));
20386            }
20387        }
20388
20389        sender.close_channel();
20390        _handle.await??;
20391        Ok(())
20392    }

20467        // Cleanup: close sender and await handle
20468        sender.close_channel();
20469        _handle.await??;
20470
20471        Ok(())
20472    }
20473
20474    /// The node refuses a PIX Session it has no reconstructor memory left for, and does so before
20475    /// allocating anything.
20476    ///
20477    /// This is the bound `maximum_sessions` cannot express: a session slot is one slot whatever the
20478    /// peer offered, while the reconstructor state behind it is set by the peer's dimensions. Here
20479    /// `maximum_sessions` is wide open and the budget is exactly one Session's worth, so nothing but
20480    /// the budget can be doing the refusing.
20481    ///
20482    /// Refused, not queued: nothing later in establishment can give the memory back, and the peer is
20483    /// free to retry against another Exit.
20484    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
20485    async fn a_pix_session_over_the_live_cycle_budget_is_refused() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
20486        use hopr_utils::network_types::prelude::SealedHost;
20487
20488        // Four shares has only one legal dimension split: 2 polynomials at threshold 2. Using no
20489        // surplus makes this offer the worst-case reservation at its exact quota, so the configured
20490        // budget can honestly admit the whole range while still fitting exactly one such Session.
20491        let params = PixParams::try_new(2, 2, 0, LOCAL_PIX_SUITE)?;
20492        let quota = pix_params_to_quota(&params);
20493        let one_session = cycle_budget_for(&params, DEFAULT_SSAS_PER_SSA_REQUEST);
20494        assert_eq!(one_session, max_cycle_budget_for_quota(quota, 1));
20495
20496        let mgr: SessionManager<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>> =
20497            SessionManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
20498                maximum_sessions: 100,
20499                pix_config: IncomingSessionPixConfig {
20500                    quota_range: quota..=quota,
20501                    // Room for exactly one Session at these dimensions.
20502                    max_live_cycle_bytes: one_session,
20503                    ..Default::default()
20504                },
20505                ..Default::default()
20506            });
20507
20508        let ssa_gen_config = SsaGeneratorConfig {
20509            polynomials_per_ssa: 2,
20510            threshold: 2,
20511            surplus_shares: 0,
20512        };
20513        let (pix_toolbox, _pix_events_rx) = PixToolbox::new(
20514            SsaShareGenerator::new(ssa_gen_config).into(),
20515            SsaReconstructor::new(SsaReconstructorConfig::default()).into(),
20516        );
20517
20518        let mut transport = MockMsgSender::new();
20519        transport
20520            .expect_send_message()
20521            .returning(|_, _| futures::future::ok(()).boxed());
20522        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(transport);
20523        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
20524        let _notifications = tokio::spawn(async move {
20525            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
20526            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
20527        });
20528        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, Some(pix_toolbox), None)?;
20529
20530        let offer = |pseudonym| {
20531            (
20532                pseudonym,
20533                StartInitiation {
20534                    challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE,
20535                    target: SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse().unwrap())),
20536                    capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities(Capability::UsePIX.into()),
20537                    additional_data: into_initiation_additional_data(params.into_additional_data(0), Duration::ZERO),
20538                },
20539            )
20540        };
20541
20542        let (p1, req1) = offer(HoprPseudonym::random());
20543        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(p1, req1).await?;
20544        assert_eq!(1, mgr.num_active_sessions(), "the first PIX session must be admitted");
20545        assert_eq!(
20546            one_session,
20547            mgr.live_cycle_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
20548            "and must have charged exactly one session's worth"
20549        );
20550
20551        // The budget is spent, so this one is refused — handled internally as a `SessionError`,
20552        // hence `Ok` with no new slot.
20553        let (p2, req2) = offer(HoprPseudonym::random());
20554        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(p2, req2).await?;
20555        assert_eq!(
20556            1,
20557            mgr.num_active_sessions(),
20558            "a session over the live-cycle budget must not be admitted"
20559        );
20560        assert_eq!(
20561            one_session,
20562            mgr.live_cycle_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
20563            "and a refused session must not leave a reservation behind"
20564        );
20565
20566        // Closing the admitted session returns its share, and the next request fits again.
20567        assert!(mgr.close_session(&p1));
20568        assert_eq!(
20569            0,
20570            mgr.live_cycle_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
20571            "closing a session must return its reservation"
20572        );
20573
20574        let (p3, req3) = offer(HoprPseudonym::random());
20575        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(p3, req3).await?;
20576        assert_eq!(
20577            1,
20578            mgr.num_active_sessions(),
20579            "the freed budget must admit the next session"
20580        );
20581
20582        sender.close_channel();
20583        _handle.await??;
20584        Ok(())
20585    }
20586
20587    /// A Session is charged for the dimensions its *peer* offered, not for this node's defaults.
20588    ///
20589    /// The Exit accepts a range of dimensions, and the reconstructor state behind them differs by
20590    /// more than an order of magnitude across it. Charging a flat figure would either refuse small
20591    /// Sessions that fit easily or admit large ones that do not.
20592    #[test]
20593    fn the_live_cycle_reservation_scales_with_the_offered_dimensions() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
20594        let small = PixParams::try_new(1024, 64, 16, LOCAL_PIX_SUITE)?;
20595        let large = PixParams::try_new(8192, 64, 16, LOCAL_PIX_SUITE)?;
20596
20597        assert_eq!(
20598            8 * cycle_budget_for(&small, 1),
20599            cycle_budget_for(&large, 1),
20600            "eight times the polynomials must cost eight times the budget"
20601        );
20602        assert_eq!(
20603            3 * cycle_budget_for(&large, 1),
20604            cycle_budget_for(&large, 3),
20605            "and a batch of three must cost three times a batch of one"
20606        );
20607
20608        // The pipelining factor is in there once, and only once: a batch may have one successor
20609        // outstanding, not one per member.
20610        assert_eq!(
20611            MAX_OVERLAPPING_BATCHES * hopr_protocol_pix::peak_cycle_bytes::<HoprPixSpec>(&large),
20612            cycle_budget_for(&large, 1)
20613        );
20614
20615        // The clamp matches the one `SessionManager::new` applies, so a config that never went
20616        // through it cannot understate its own reservation.
20617        assert_eq!(cycle_budget_for(&large, 1), cycle_budget_for(&large, 0));
20618        assert_eq!(
20619            cycle_budget_for(&large, MAX_SSA_BATCH_SIZE),
20620            cycle_budget_for(&large, usize::MAX)
20621        );
20622
20623        Ok(())
20624    }
20625
20626    /// Runs an admission handler against `mgr`'s request channel for the duration of one test.
20627    ///
20628    /// Mirrors what `hopr-lib` spawns beside the session server, minus the concurrency: these tests
20629    /// drive one initiation at a time.
20630    fn spawn_admission_handler(
20631        handler: impl Fn(SessionAdmissionRequest) -> Result<SessionAdmissionDecision, String> + Send + 'static,
20632    ) -> (SessionAdmissionSink, tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>) {
20633        let (tx, mut rx) =
20634            futures::channel::mpsc::channel::<(SessionAdmissionRequest, crate::types::SessionAdmissionReply)>(4);
20635        let handle = tokio::task::spawn(async move {
20636            while let Some((request, reply)) = rx.next().await {
20637                let _ = reply.send(handler(request));
20638            }
20639        });
20640        (tx, handle)
20641    }
20642
20643    /// What [`started_manager_admitting_small_params`] hands back: the manager, its message sender
20644    /// and the task draining it, the first `SessionError` it replies with, and the incoming-session
20645    /// receiver — which the test must hold, since an admitted Session is published on it and a
20646    /// dropped receiver would turn every success into a send failure.
20647    type AdmissionFixture = (
20648        SessionManager<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>,
20649        UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>,
20650        tokio::task::JoinHandle<anyhow::Result<()>>,
20651        oneshot::Receiver<StartErrorType<SessionId>>,
20652        futures::channel::mpsc::Receiver<IncomingSession>,
20653    );
20654
20655    /// A started manager that accepts an Entry offering [`small_pix_params`], with `admission`
20656    /// installed as its session server, so that any refusal is attributable to the decision rather
20657    /// than to the dimensions or to a missing toolbox.
20658    fn started_manager_admitting_small_params(
20659        quota_range: std::ops::RangeInclusive<SsaQuota>,
20660        enforce_pix: bool,
20661        admission: Option<SessionAdmissionSink>,
20662    ) -> anyhow::Result<AdmissionFixture> {
20663        use hopr_protocol_pix::{SsaGeneratorConfig, SsaReconstructorConfig};
20664
20665        let mgr = SessionManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
20666            pix_config: IncomingSessionPixConfig {
20667                enforce_pix,
20668                quota_range,
20669                ..Default::default()
20670            },
20671            session_admission_timeout: Duration::from_millis(200),
20672            ..Default::default()
20673        });
20674
20675        let pix_toolbox = pix_toolbox_with_pool(
20676            SsaShareGenerator::new(SsaGeneratorConfig {
20677                polynomials_per_ssa: 2,
20678                threshold: 2,
20679                surplus_shares: TEST_SURPLUS_SHARES,
20680            })
20681            .into(),
20682            SsaReconstructor::new(SsaReconstructorConfig::default()).into(),
20683        );
20684
20685        let mut transport = MockMsgSender::new();
20686        let (err_tx, err_rx) = oneshot::channel();
20687        let err_tx = Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(Some(err_tx)));
20688        transport.expect_send_message().returning(move |_, data| {
20689            let err_tx = err_tx.clone();
20690            Box::pin(async move {
20691                if let Ok(HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(err)) =
20692                    HoprStartProtocol::decode(data.data.application_tag, &data.data.plain_text)
20693                    && let Some(tx) = err_tx.lock().unwrap().take()
20694                {
20695                    let _ = tx.send(err);
20696                }
20697                Ok(())
20698            })
20699        });
20700
20701        let (sender, handle) = mock_packet_planning(transport);
20702        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
20703        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, Some(pix_toolbox), admission)?;
20704
20705        Ok((mgr, sender, handle, err_rx, new_session_rx))
20706    }
20707
20708    /// An Entry offering [`small_pix_params`], i.e. an offer the fixture's node accepts.
20709    fn pix_offer() -> StartInitiation<SessionTarget, HoprSessionCapabilities> {
20710        StartInitiation {
20711            challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE,
20712            target: SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain(
20713                "127.0.0.1:80".parse().expect("test target must parse"),
20714            )),
20715            capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities(Capability::Segmentation | Capability::UsePIX),
20716            additional_data: small_pix_additional_data(),
20717        }
20718    }
20719
20720    /// The same target from an Entry that offered no incentivization at all.
20721    fn no_pix_offer() -> StartInitiation<SessionTarget, HoprSessionCapabilities> {
20722        StartInitiation {
20723            capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities(Capability::Segmentation.into()),
20724            additional_data: 0,
20725            ..pix_offer()
20726        }
20727    }
20728
20729    /// The quota an Entry offering [`small_pix_params`] asks for.
20730    fn small_params_quota() -> SsaQuota {
20731        pix_params_to_quota(&small_pix_params())
20732    }
20733
20734    /// A node's configured window is an envelope, not a default: a decision may take less of it, but
20735    /// asking for more of it than was configured — and validated, and preallocated against — leaves
20736    /// the envelope's own bounds in place.
20737    #[test]
20738    fn an_admission_decision_narrows_the_configured_quota_window_and_never_widens_it() {
20739        let cfg = IncomingSessionPixConfig {
20740            quota_range: 100..=200,
20741            ..Default::default()
20742        };
20743
20744        let narrowed = cfg.effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default().with_pix_quota_range(120..=180));
20745        assert_eq!(narrowed.quota_range, 120..=180);
20746
20747        let widened = cfg.effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default().with_pix_quota_range(1..=1000));
20748        assert_eq!(widened.quota_range, 100..=200, "neither bound may leave the envelope");
20749
20750        let one_end = cfg.effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default().with_pix_quota_range(150..=u64::MAX));
20751        assert_eq!(one_end.quota_range, 150..=200, "an open end leaves that bound alone");
20752
20753        let disjoint = cfg.effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default().with_pix_quota_range(500..=600));
20754        assert!(
20755            disjoint.quota_range.is_empty(),
20756            "a rule that does not overlap the envelope admits nothing, rather than silently picking one"
20757        );
20758    }
20759
20760    /// Unlike the quota window, `enforce_pix` is coupled to nothing validated at startup, so a
20761    /// decision simply replaces it — in either direction.
20762    #[test]
20763    fn an_admission_decision_overrides_enforce_pix_in_both_directions() {
20764        let strict = IncomingSessionPixConfig {
20765            enforce_pix: true,
20766            ..Default::default()
20767        };
20768        let lax = IncomingSessionPixConfig {
20769            enforce_pix: false,
20770            ..Default::default()
20771        };
20772
20773        assert!(strict.effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default()).enforce_pix);
20774        assert!(
20775            !strict
20776                .effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default().with_enforce_pix(false))
20777                .enforce_pix
20778        );
20779        assert!(!lax.effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default()).enforce_pix);
20780        assert!(
20781            lax.effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default().with_enforce_pix(true))
20782                .enforce_pix
20783        );
20784    }

20786    /// Runs an initiation through the same two steps admission does — read the offer off the wire,
20787    /// then judge it against the node's own terms. `None` is a refusal from either.
20788    fn decode_and_check(
20789        mgr: &SessionManager<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>,
20790        req: &StartInitiation<SessionTarget, HoprSessionCapabilities>,
20791    ) -> Option<(PixParams, usize)> {
20792        let policy = mgr.cfg.pix_config.effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default());
20793        decode_pix_offer(req)
20794            .ok()
20795            .and_then(|offered| mgr.check_pix_params(req.challenge, offered, &policy))
20796    }
20797
20798    /// The offer must reach the session server decoded, and the capability bits verbatim.
20799    ///
20800    /// Without it the server can only price a target blind: it names a window with no idea whether
20801    /// the peer is anywhere near it, and cannot hold a *dimension* to a floor, since the quota is
20802    /// their product and the same product admits many splits.
20803    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
20804    async fn the_admission_request_carries_the_decoded_offer_and_capability_bits() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
20805        let (seen_tx, seen_rx) = oneshot::channel();
20806        let seen_tx = Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(Some(seen_tx)));
20807        let (admission, handler) = spawn_admission_handler(move |request| {
20808            if let Some(tx) = seen_tx.lock().unwrap().take() {
20809                let _ = tx.send((request.capabilities, request.offered));
20810            }
20811            Ok(SessionAdmissionDecision::default())
20812        });
20813        let (mgr, sender, transport, _err_rx, _incoming) =
20814            started_manager_admitting_small_params(1..=small_params_quota(), false, Some(admission))?;
20815
20816        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(HoprPseudonym::random(), pix_offer())
20817            .await?;
20818
20819        let (capabilities, offered) = seen_rx.await.context("admission was never asked")?;
20820        let offered = offered.context("an offer was made, so one must have been reported")?;
20821
20822        let params = small_pix_params();
20823        assert_eq!(offered.parts_per_ssa, params.polys_per_ssa());
20824        assert_eq!(offered.shares_per_part, params.shares_per_poly());
20825        assert_eq!(
20826            offered.surplus_shares,
20827            params.surplus_shares(),
20828            "the surplus is priced in, so a server judging the quota needs it"
20829        );
20830        assert_eq!(offered.quota_per_ssa, small_params_quota());
20831        assert_eq!(
20832            capabilities,
20833            pix_offer().capabilities.0.bits(),
20834            "the capability bits travel as the peer sent them"
20835        );
20836
20837        sender.close_channel();
20838        transport.await??;
20839        handler.abort();
20840        Ok(())
20841    }
20842
20843    /// A peer offering nothing must be reported as offering nothing, not as offering zero: the two
20844    /// are different answers, and only one of them means "this Session is free if you allow it".
20845    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
20846    async fn a_peer_offering_no_incentivization_reports_no_offer() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
20847        let (seen_tx, seen_rx) = oneshot::channel();
20848        let seen_tx = Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(Some(seen_tx)));
20849        let (admission, handler) = spawn_admission_handler(move |request| {
20850            if let Some(tx) = seen_tx.lock().unwrap().take() {
20851                let _ = tx.send(request.offered);
20852            }
20853            Ok(SessionAdmissionDecision::default())
20854        });
20855        let (mgr, sender, transport, _err_rx, _incoming) =
20856            started_manager_admitting_small_params(1..=small_params_quota(), false, Some(admission))?;
20857
20858        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(HoprPseudonym::random(), no_pix_offer())
20859            .await?;
20860
20861        assert!(
20862            seen_rx.await.context("admission was never asked")?.is_none(),
20863            "no offer must read as no offer"
20864        );
20865
20866        sender.close_channel();
20867        transport.await??;
20868        handler.abort();
20869        Ok(())
20870    }

20872    /// An offer this node cannot read is refused before the session server is troubled with it: no
20873    /// decision could rescue it, and the round trip would be spent to reach the same answer.
20874    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
20875    async fn an_unreadable_offer_is_refused_without_asking_the_session_server() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
20876        let asked = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0));
20877        let asked_by_handler = asked.clone();
20878        let (admission, handler) = spawn_admission_handler(move |_| {
20879            asked_by_handler.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
20880            Ok(SessionAdmissionDecision::default())
20881        });
20882        let (mgr, sender, transport, err_rx, _incoming) =
20883            started_manager_admitting_small_params(1..=small_params_quota(), false, Some(admission))?;
20884
20885        // Zero polynomials is outside the protocol range, so unpacking refuses it outright.
20886        let unreadable = StartInitiation {
20887            additional_data: into_initiation_additional_data(
20888                ((LOCAL_PIX_SUITE as u64) << 62) | (128u64 << 40),
20889                Duration::ZERO,
20890            ),
20891            ..pix_offer()
20892        };
20893        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(HoprPseudonym::random(), unreadable)
20894            .await?;
20895
20896        let err = err_rx.await.context("send_message was never called")?;
20897        assert_eq!(err.reason, StartErrorReason::UnacceptablePixParams);
20898        assert_eq!(
20899            asked.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
20900            0,
20901            "an offer that cannot be read must not cost an admission round trip"
20902        );
20903        assert_eq!(mgr.num_active_sessions(), 0);
20904
20905        sender.close_channel();
20906        transport.await??;
20907        handler.abort();
20908        Ok(())
20909    }

20911    /// The feature itself: one Exit, one Entry offering the same thing, two targets, two answers.
20912    ///
20913    /// Every other test here fixes the decision and varies the offer; this one fixes the offer and
20914    /// varies the target, which is the only thing #8376 actually asks for.
20915    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
20916    async fn two_targets_on_one_exit_are_admitted_on_different_terms() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
20917        let free_target = SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("10.0.0.1:80".parse()?));
20918        let paid_target = SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("10.0.0.2:80".parse()?));
20919
20920        let free_for = free_target.clone();
20921        let (admission, handler) = spawn_admission_handler(move |request| {
20922            Ok(if request.target == free_for {
20923                SessionAdmissionDecision::default().with_enforce_pix(false)
20924            } else {
20925                SessionAdmissionDecision::default().with_enforce_pix(true)
20926            })
20927        });
20928
20929        // The node demands PIX; only the rule for `free_target` waives it.
20930        let (mgr, sender, transport, err_rx, _incoming) =
20931            started_manager_admitting_small_params(1..=small_params_quota(), true, Some(admission))?;
20932
20933        // Same Entry offer both times — no PIX at all.
20934        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(
20935            HoprPseudonym::random(),
20936            StartInitiation {
20937                target: free_target,
20938                ..no_pix_offer()
20939            },
20940        )
20941        .await?;
20942        assert_eq!(mgr.num_active_sessions(), 1, "the waived target must be served");
20943
20944        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(
20945            HoprPseudonym::random(),
20946            StartInitiation {
20947                target: paid_target,
20948                challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE + 1,
20949                ..no_pix_offer()
20950            },
20951        )
20952        .await?;
20953        assert_eq!(
20954            mgr.num_active_sessions(),
20955            1,
20956            "the second target must be refused, leaving only the first session"
20957        );
20958
20959        let err = err_rx.await.context("send_message was never called")?;
20960        assert_eq!(err.reason, StartErrorReason::UnacceptablePixParams);
20961        assert_eq!(
20962            err.identifier,
20963            ErrorIdentifier::Challenge(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1),
20964            "the refusal must name the second initiation, not the admitted first"
20965        );
20966
20967        sender.close_channel();
20968        transport.await??;
20969        handler.abort();
20970        Ok(())
20971    }
20972
20973    /// A queue with no reader is the third transient failure, beside the timeout and the dropped
20974    /// reply. It is `Busy` for the same reason: nothing about the target was decided.
20975    ///
20976    /// Reachable only because every request goes through one shared sender — sending through a
20977    /// fresh clone would hand each call its own guaranteed slot and the queue would never be full.
20978    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
20979    async fn a_full_admission_queue_refuses_the_session_as_busy() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
20980        // No receiver task at all, so nothing is ever drained. `_rx` is held rather than dropped:
20981        // a closed channel is a different failure from a full one.
20982        let (admission, _rx) =
20983            futures::channel::mpsc::channel::<(SessionAdmissionRequest, crate::types::SessionAdmissionReply)>(0);
20984
20985        let (mgr, sender, transport, err_rx, _incoming) =
20986            started_manager_admitting_small_params(1..=small_params_quota(), false, Some(admission))?;
20987
20988        // The first request takes the sender's guaranteed slot; the second finds the queue full.
20989        for challenge in [MIN_CHALLENGE, MIN_CHALLENGE + 1] {
20990            mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(
20991                HoprPseudonym::random(),
20992                StartInitiation {
20993                    challenge,
20994                    ..pix_offer()
20995                },
20996            )
20997            .await?;
20998        }
20999
21000        let err = err_rx.await.context("send_message was never called")?;
21001        assert_eq!(err.reason, StartErrorReason::Busy);
21002        assert_eq!(mgr.num_active_sessions(), 0);
21003
21004        sender.close_channel();
21005        transport.await??;
21006        Ok(())
21007    }

21009    /// With every admission permit taken, an initiation is refused `Busy` instead of reaching the
21010    /// server and parking there for its whole deadline.
21011    ///
21012    /// Deterministic by construction: the permits are held directly, so no timing is involved.
21013    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
21014    async fn admission_without_a_free_permit_is_refused_as_busy() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
21015        let (admission, mut rx) =
21016            futures::channel::mpsc::channel::<(SessionAdmissionRequest, crate::types::SessionAdmissionReply)>(16);
21017        let (mgr, sender, transport, err_rx, _incoming) =
21018            started_manager_admitting_small_params(1..=small_params_quota(), false, Some(admission))?;
21019
21020        // Hold every permit for the duration of the attempt.
21021        let held: Vec<_> = (0..START_SESSION_ADMISSION_CONCURRENCY)
21022            .map(|_| {
21023                mgr.admission_permits
21024                    .try_acquire()
21025                    .context("permits must be free at the start of the test")
21026            })
21027            .collect::<anyhow::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
21028
21029        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(
21030            HoprPseudonym::random(),
21031            StartInitiation {
21032                challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE,
21033                ..pix_offer()
21034            },
21035        )
21036        .await?;
21037
21038        let err = err_rx.await.context("the refusal never reached the entry")?;
21039        assert_eq!(err.reason, StartErrorReason::Busy);
21040        assert!(
21041            rx.try_recv().is_err(),
21042            "a refused initiation must not reach the session server"
21043        );
21044        assert_eq!(mgr.num_active_sessions(), 0);
21045
21046        drop(held);
21047        sender.close_channel();
21048        transport.await??;
21049        Ok(())
21050    }

21052    /// The empty-intersection case is a misconfiguration; this is the ordinary one. The narrowed

21060        });

21065        let effective = mgr
21066            .cfg
21067            .pix_config
21068            .effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default().with_pix_quota_range(quota + 1..=2 * quota));
21069        assert!(!effective.quota_range.is_empty(), "this case must not be the empty one");

21071        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(HoprPseudonym::random(), pix_offer())

21078        sender.close_channel();

21084    /// Narrowing does not only accept or reject — with dynamic batching it moves the batch the Exit
21085    /// asks for, which is what the Entry pays per deposit round trip.
21086    #[test]
21087    fn a_narrowed_window_can_change_the_selected_batch_size() {
21088        let cfg = IncomingSessionPixConfig {
21089            quota_range: 100..=400,
21090            supervision: SupervisorConfig {
21091                ssas_per_request: 4,
21092                allow_dynamic_ssa_batches: true,
21093                ..Default::default()
21094            },
21095            ..Default::default()
21096        };
21097
21098        // The node's own window accepts a single SSA of 100.
21099        assert_eq!(
21100            cfg.effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default())
21101                .ssa_batch_size_for_quota(100),
21102            Some(1)
21103        );
21104
21105        // Narrowed to a floor of 250, the smallest batch that reaches it is three.
21106        assert_eq!(
21107            cfg.effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default().with_pix_quota_range(250..=400))
21108                .ssa_batch_size_for_quota(100),
21109            Some(3)
21110        );
21111
21112        // Narrowed to a window every multiple of the offer jumps over — three total 300 and four
21113        // total 400, with nothing in between — so no batch fits and the Session is refused.
21114        assert_eq!(
21115            cfg.effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default().with_pix_quota_range(310..=390))
21116                .ssa_batch_size_for_quota(100),
21117            None
21118        );
21119    }

21121    /// Admission is an Exit-side question. An Entry establishing a Session decided its own target,
21122    /// so putting it to the local session server would be asking a node to vet itself.
21123    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
21124    async fn an_outgoing_session_is_never_put_to_the_admission_hook() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
21125        let asked = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0));
21126        let asked_by_handler = asked.clone();
21127        let (admission, handler) = spawn_admission_handler(move |_| {
21128            asked_by_handler.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
21129            Ok(SessionAdmissionDecision::default())
21130        });
21131
21132        let mgr = SessionManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
21133            initiation_timeout_base: Duration::from_millis(50),
21134            ..Default::default()
21135        });
21136
21137        let mut transport = MockMsgSender::new();
21138        transport
21139            .expect_send_message()
21140            .returning(|_, _| Box::pin(async { Ok(()) }));
21141        let (sender, transport_handle) = mock_packet_planning(transport);
21142        let (new_session_tx, _new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
21143        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, Some(admission))?;
21144
21145        // No peer answers, so this times out — which is fine: the assertion is about what was asked
21146        // before the attempt died, not about it succeeding.
21147        let _ = mgr
21148            .new_session(
21149                (&hopr_api::types::crypto::keypairs::ChainKeypair::random()).into(),
21150                SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
21151                SessionClientConfig {
21152                    pseudonym: Some(HoprPseudonym::random()),
21153                    capabilities: Capability::Segmentation.into(),
21154                    surb_management: None,
21155                    ..Default::default()
21156                },
21157            )
21158            .await;
21159
21160        assert_eq!(
21161            asked.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
21162            0,
21163            "an outgoing session must not consult the admission hook"
21164        );
21165
21166        sender.close_channel();
21167        transport_handle.await??;
21168        handler.abort();
21169        Ok(())
21170    }

21261    /// A manager with `budget` and no room for any Session, so every opening is refused; its sent
21262    /// messages arrive on the returned receiver.
21263    fn manager_refusing_every_opening(
21264        budget: Option<RefusalReplyBudget>,
21265        admission: Option<SessionAdmissionSink>,
21266    ) -> anyhow::Result<RefusingFixture> {

21271        });

21278    /// Delivers one opening from a fresh pseudonym, as the packet pipeline would.
21279    fn open_session(
21280        mgr: &RecordingManager,
21281        offer: StartInitiation<SessionTarget, HoprSessionCapabilities>,
21282    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
21283        let result = mgr.dispatch_message(
21284            HoprPseudonym::random(),
21285            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(offer))?,
21286        )?;
21287        anyhow::ensure!(matches!(result, DispatchResult::Processed), "dispatched as {result:?}");
21288        Ok(())

21291    /// Waits until this thread's emission probe has counted `at_least` of `series`.
21292    async fn probe_reaches(series: &str, at_least: i64) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
21293        use crate::supervision::telemetry::probe;
21294
21295        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
21296            while probe::get(series) < at_least {
21297                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5)).await;
21298            }
21299        })
21300        .await
21301        .with_context(|| format!("{series} stayed at {}, short of {at_least}", probe::get(series)))
21302    }
21303
21304    /// Takes the `SessionError`s sent so far.
21305    fn drain_session_errors(
21306        sent: &mut futures::channel::mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>,
21307    ) -> anyhow::Result<Vec<StartErrorType<SessionId>>> {
21308        let mut errors = Vec::new();
21309        while let Ok((_, data)) = sent.try_recv() {
21310            match HoprStartProtocol::decode(data.data.application_tag, &data.data.plain_text)? {
21311                HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(error) => errors.push(error),
21312                other => anyhow::bail!("expected a SessionError, got {other:?}"),
21313            }
21314        }
21315        Ok(errors)
21316    }

21318    /// A flood of refused openings is answered once per token, not once per opening.
21319    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
21320    async fn a_start_session_flood_is_answered_only_within_the_refusal_budget() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
21321        use crate::{counters::start_refusal_reply_drop_count, supervision::telemetry::probe};
21322
21323        probe::reset();
21324        let drops_before = start_refusal_reply_drop_count();
21325        let refusals_before = crate::counters::start_refusal_count();
21326        let (mgr, mut sent, _new_sessions, _handles) = manager_refusing_every_opening(
21327            Some(RefusalReplyBudget {
21328                burst: 3,
21329                refill_period: Duration::from_secs(3600),
21330            }),
21331            None,
21332        )?;
21333
21334        for _ in 0..10 {
21335            open_session(&mgr, no_pix_offer())?;
21336        }
21337        probe_reaches("exit_control/refusal_no_session_slot/plain/dropped_budget", 7).await?;
21338        probe_reaches("exit_control/refusal_no_session_slot/plain/sent", 3).await?;
21339
21340        let errors = drain_session_errors(&mut sent)?;
21341        assert_eq!(3, errors.len(), "only the budget's burst is answered");
21342        assert!(errors.iter().all(|e| e.reason == StartErrorReason::NoSlotsAvailable));
21343        assert_eq!(3, probe::get("exit_control/refusal_no_session_slot/plain/sent"));
21344        assert_eq!(
21345            7,
21346            probe::get("exit_control/refusal_no_session_slot/plain/dropped_budget")
21347        );
21348        assert!(start_refusal_reply_drop_count() >= drops_before + 7);
21349        // Dropped refusals count too. `>=` because the counter is process-wide.
21350        assert!(crate::counters::start_refusal_count() >= refusals_before + 10);
21351        Ok(())
21352    }

21515            }
21516        });
21517        let (mgr, sender, transport, err_rx, _incoming) =
21518            started_manager_admitting_small_params(1..=small_params_quota(), false, Some(admission))?;
21519
21520        let mut offer = pix_offer();
21521        offer.additional_data |= INITIATION_RESUME_ATTEMPT;
21522        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
21523        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(pseudonym, offer).await?;
21524
21525        let err = timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), err_rx)
21526            .await
21527            .context("the refusal was not sent in time")?
21528            .context("send_message was never called")?;
21529        assert_eq!(err.reason, StartErrorReason::NotResumable);
21530        assert_eq!(0, asked.load(Ordering::Relaxed), "the session server must not be asked");
21531        assert_eq!(0, mgr.num_active_sessions());
21532        assert!(mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).is_none(), "no slot");
21533
21534        sender.close_channel();
21535        transport.await??;
21536        handler.abort();
21537        Ok(())
21538    }

21586    /// A server that does not answer must not become a server that admits everything: the Session is
21587    /// refused, and as `Busy` rather than `TargetNotAdmitted`, since nothing about the target was

21594        let handler = tokio::task::spawn(async move {

21610
21611        sender.close_channel();
21612        transport.await??;
21613        handler.abort();
21614        Ok(())
21615    }

21670    /// The request the session server is handed must name the target it is being asked about, or the
21671    /// hook cannot do the one job it exists for.
21672    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
21673    async fn the_admission_request_carries_the_session_target() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
21674        let (seen_tx, seen_rx) = oneshot::channel();
21675        let seen_tx = Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(Some(seen_tx)));
21676        let (admission, handler) = spawn_admission_handler(move |request| {
21677            if let Some(tx) = seen_tx.lock().unwrap().take() {
21678                let _ = tx.send((request.session_id, request.target.clone()));
21679            }
21680            Ok(SessionAdmissionDecision::default())
21681        });
21682        let (mgr, sender, transport, _err_rx, _incoming) =
21683            started_manager_admitting_small_params(1..=small_params_quota(), false, Some(admission))?;
21684
21685        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
21686        let offer = pix_offer();
21687        let expected_target = offer.target.clone();
21688        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(pseudonym, offer).await?;
21689
21690        let (seen_id, seen_target) = seen_rx.await.context("admission was never asked")?;
21691        assert_eq!(seen_target, expected_target);
21692        assert_eq!(seen_id, pseudonym, "the request must name the session it would become");
21693
21694        sender.close_channel();
21695        transport.await??;
21696        handler.abort();
21697        Ok(())
21698    }

21717    /// Dynamic admission chooses the least expensive batch that brings the Entry's total offer into
21718    /// the accepted range. A cap is still a cap: it may leave the offer unsatisfiable, and checked
21719    /// multiplication must make an overflowing candidate a refusal rather than a wrapped match.
21720    #[test]
21721    fn dynamic_ssa_batches_choose_the_smallest_satisfying_batch() {
21722        // Through `effective_for` with an empty decision, which is the no-session-server path and
21723        // so yields exactly the node's configured policy.
21724        let config = |quota_range, ssas_per_request| {
21725            IncomingSessionPixConfig {
21726                quota_range,
21727                supervision: SupervisorConfig {
21728                    ssas_per_request,
21729                    allow_dynamic_ssa_batches: true,
21730                    ..Default::default()
21731                },
21732                ..Default::default()
21733            }
21734            .effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default())
21735        };
21736
21737        assert_eq!(Some(1), config(100..=350, 4).ssa_batch_size_for_quota(100));
21738        assert_eq!(Some(3), config(250..=350, 4).ssa_batch_size_for_quota(100));
21739        assert_eq!(None, config(250..=350, 2).ssa_batch_size_for_quota(100));
21740        assert_eq!(
21741            None,
21742            config(150..=175, 4).ssa_batch_size_for_quota(100),
21743            "the first multiple jumps over the range and every later one is larger"
21744        );
21745        assert_eq!(None, config(100..=350, 4).ssa_batch_size_for_quota(400));
21746        assert_eq!(
21747            None,
21748            config(u64::MAX..=u64::MAX, 2).ssa_batch_size_for_quota(u64::MAX / 2 + 1),
21749            "an overflowing batch quota must not wrap into the accepted range"
21750        );
21751    }
21752
21753    /// Disabling dynamic admission restores both halves of the old contract: only the per-SSA quota
21754    /// is compared with `quota_range`, and an accepted offer uses the configured batch exactly.
21755    #[test]
21756    fn disabling_dynamic_ssa_batches_preserves_fixed_batch_admission() {
21757        let fixed = |quota_range| {
21758            IncomingSessionPixConfig {
21759                quota_range,
21760                supervision: SupervisorConfig {
21761                    ssas_per_request: 3,
21762                    allow_dynamic_ssa_batches: false,
21763                    ..Default::default()
21764                },
21765                ..Default::default()
21766            }
21767            .effective_for(&SessionAdmissionDecision::default())
21768        };
21769
21770        assert_eq!(
21771            None,
21772            fixed(250..=350).ssa_batch_size_for_quota(100),
21773            "fixed mode must not rescue a sub-range SSA even when three of them total 300"
21774        );
21775        assert_eq!(
21776            Some(3),
21777            fixed(100..=100).ssa_batch_size_for_quota(100),
21778            "an individually accepted SSA must retain the configured exact batch"
21779        );
21780    }

21782    /// Admission reserves against the batch it selected for this Session, not the configured dynamic
21783    /// ceiling. Otherwise a ceiling of nine would charge every already-satisfactory one-SSA offer as
21784    /// nine and silently divide the number of Sessions the Exit can admit.
21785    #[test]
21786    fn live_cycle_reservation_uses_the_selected_batch_size() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
21787        let params = small_pix_params();

21791            SessionManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
21792                pix_config: IncomingSessionPixConfig {
21793                    max_live_cycle_bytes: expected,
21794                    supervision: SupervisorConfig {
21795                        ssas_per_request: 4,
21796                        ..Default::default()
21797                    },
21798                    ..Default::default()
21799                },
21800                ..Default::default()
21801            });

21804            .reserve_cycle_budget(&params, selected_batch)
21805            .context("the selected batch should fit exactly")?;

21807        drop(reservation);

21810        Ok(())

21863    /// Verifies the early `TooManySessions` return at the top of `new_session` (line 767).

21935    /// Verifies that `session_initiations` is cleaned up when `new_session` fails to
21936    /// send the StartSession message (e.g. the underlying channel is closed).
21937    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
21938    async fn new_session_removes_challenge_on_send_failure() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
21939        let mgr: SessionManager<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>> =
21940            SessionManager::new(Default::default());
21941
21942        // Create a channel whose receiver is dropped immediately.  When the mock
21943        // transport tries to `send` over this channel the call will return an error,
21944        // which propagates up through `send_via_msg_sender` as
21945        // `TransportSessionError::packet_sending`.
21946        let (tx, rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
21947        drop(rx);
21948
21949        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
21950        let _notifications = tokio::spawn(async move {
21951            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
21952            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
21953        });
21954        mgr.start(tx, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
21955        assert!(mgr.is_started());
21956
21957        // Verify that sending fails because the receiver is gone.
21958        let result = mgr
21959            .new_session(
21960                Address::from(&ChainKeypair::random()),
21961                SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
21962                SessionClientConfig {
21963                    surb_management: None,
21964                    ..Default::default()
21965                },
21966            )
21967            .await;
21968
21969        assert!(result.is_err());
21970        assert_eq!(mgr.num_active_sessions(), 0);
21971        // The challenge must have been removed from `session_initiations` even
21972        // though the send failed.
21973        assert_eq!(
21974            mgr.session_initiations.entry_count(),
21975            0,
21976            "session_initiations was not cleaned up after send failure"
21977        );
21978
21979        Ok(())
21980    }

21982    /// Verifies that `session_initiations` is cleaned up when the session initiation
21983    /// times out waiting for a response (neither `SessionEstablished` nor
21984    /// `SessionError` arrives).
21985    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
21986    async fn new_session_removes_challenge_on_timeout() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
21987        let cfg = SessionManagerConfig {

21989            ..Default::default()
21990        };

21993        let bob_mgr = SessionManager::new(Default::default());

21996

21998        let bob_transport = MockMsgSender::new();
21999
22000        // Alice sends the StartSession message; Bob never responds.
22001        alice_transport
22002            .expect_send_message()
22003            .once()
22004            .returning(|_, _| futures::future::ok(()).boxed());
22005
22006        let (alice_sender, _alice_handle) = mock_packet_planning(alice_transport);
22007        let (new_session_tx_alice, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
22008        alice_mgr.start(alice_sender.clone(), new_session_tx_alice, None, None)?;
22009        assert!(alice_mgr.is_started());
22010
22011        let (bob_sender, _bob_handle) = mock_packet_planning(bob_transport);
22012        let (new_session_tx_bob, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
22013        bob_mgr.start(bob_sender.clone(), new_session_tx_bob, None, None)?;

22016        // Record how many entries are in `session_initiations` before the call.
22017        assert_eq!(alice_mgr.session_initiations.entry_count(), 0);
22018
22019        let result = alice_mgr
22020            .new_session(
22021                bob_peer,
22022                SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),

22034        // The pending challenge must have been removed from `session_initiations`
22035        // after the timeout error propagated.
22036        assert_eq!(

22038            0,
22039            "session_initiations was not cleaned up after timeout"

22054    /// The manager sink type used by the dispatch drop tests, which never open a session and so
22055    /// never exercise the sink — its concrete type only needs to be nameable.
22056    #[cfg(test)]
22057    type TestManager =
22058        SessionManager<futures::channel::mpsc::UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>;
22059
22060    // Test B (fully deregistered): a data packet for a session id absent from the registry is a
22061    // benign, quiet drop counted as UnknownData — NOT an error, and NOT one ERROR log per packet.
22062    // Under the old behaviour this returned `Err(UnknownData)` and the caller logged it at ERROR,
22063    // which is what produced the per-packet spam during the incident.
22064    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
22065    async fn dispatching_to_an_unregistered_session_should_be_a_quiet_counted_drop() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
22066        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
22067
22068        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
22069        let before = crate::counters::session_unknown_data_drop_count();
22070
22071        // N packets → N drops, each an Ok(Dropped(Unregistered)), no panic, no unbounded error.
22072        const N: usize = 5;
22073        for _ in 0..N {
22074            let result = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_data_packet(b"test data")?);
22075            assert!(
22076                matches!(result, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::Unregistered))),
22077                "unregistered-session packet must be a benign Dropped(Unregistered), got {result:?}"
22078            );
22079        }
22080
22081        // Counter advanced by at least N (>= rather than == because it is a process-global atomic
22082        // other tests in this binary may also touch).
22083        assert!(crate::counters::session_unknown_data_drop_count() >= before + N);
22084
22085        Ok(())
22086    }
22087
22088    // Test A (primary regression): a data packet for a session whose data sink has been dropped
22089    // while the slot is still registered must be dropped quietly as SinkClosed — NOT an error.
22090    // This is the "sending on a disconnected channel" ERROR from the incident. The bad-behaviour
22091    // assertion is the silent-vs-loud distinction: the result is Ok(Dropped(SinkClosed)), not Err,
22092    // and specifically not SinkFull (which would misattribute a teardown as backpressure).
22093    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
22094    async fn dispatching_to_a_session_whose_sink_closed_should_be_a_quiet_counted_drop() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
22095        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
22096
22097        // `pre_populate_session` registers the slot and immediately drops its receiver, so the
22098        // sink is closed while the slot is still present — exactly the incident's race.
22099        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
22100        mgr.pre_populate_session(pseudonym, DestinationRouting::Return(pseudonym.into()));
22101
22102        let before = crate::counters::session_inbox_closed_drop_count();
22103        let result = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_data_packet(b"after teardown")?);
22104
22105        assert!(
22106            matches!(result, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::SinkClosed))),
22107            "closed-sink packet must be a benign Dropped(SinkClosed), not an error or SinkFull, got {result:?}"
22108        );
22109        assert!(crate::counters::session_inbox_closed_drop_count() > before);
22110
22111        Ok(())
22112    }
22113
22114    // Genuine backpressure (inbox full, reader alive but not keeping up) is distinct from a
22115    // teardown: it is Dropped(SinkFull) and counted in SESSION_INBOX_DROPS, not the closed counter.
22116    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
22117    async fn dispatching_to_a_full_session_inbox_should_be_a_backpressure_drop() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
22118        // Capacity 1 so a single unread packet fills the inbox deterministically.
22119        let cfg = SessionManagerConfig {
22120            session_forward_capacity: 1,
22121            ..Default::default()
22122        };
22123        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(cfg);
22124
22125        // Keep the receiver alive but never read it, so the channel is open but saturates.
22126        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
22127        let _rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(pseudonym, DestinationRouting::Return(pseudonym.into()));
22128
22129        // First packet fills the single slot and is accepted.
22130        let accepted = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_data_packet(b"fills the slot")?);
22131        assert!(
22132            matches!(accepted, Ok(DispatchResult::Processed)),
22133            "first packet should be accepted, got {accepted:?}"
22134        );
22135
22136        // Second packet finds the inbox full → backpressure drop.
22137        let before = crate::counters::session_inbox_drop_count();
22138        let overflow = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_data_packet(b"overflows")?);
22139        assert!(
22140            matches!(overflow, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::SinkFull))),
22141            "overflow packet must be a Dropped(SinkFull) backpressure drop, got {overflow:?}"
22142        );
22143        assert!(crate::counters::session_inbox_drop_count() > before);
22144
22145        Ok(())
22146    }

22148    /// A packet reporting that some of the SURBs it carried were dropped on arrival.
22149    /// An Entry-side slot whose organic SURB gate is closed: a target of 100 against a believed
22150    /// level of 200. Anything that reopens it in the tests below did so on the counterparty's word.
22151    fn entry_slot_with_closed_gate(
22152        mgr: &TestManager,
22153        pseudonym: HoprPseudonym,
22154    ) -> anyhow::Result<crossfire::AsyncRx<crossfire::mpsc::Array<ApplicationDataIn>>> {
22155        let rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(
22156            pseudonym,
22157            DestinationRouting::Forward {
22158                destination: Box::new(Address::from(&ChainKeypair::random()).into()),
22159                pseudonym: Some(pseudonym),
22160                forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(1.try_into()?),
22161                return_options: None,
22162            },
22163        );
22164
22165        let slot = mgr
22166            .sessions
22167            .get(&pseudonym)
22168            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("slot must exist"))?;
22169        slot.surb_mgmt.update(&SurbBalancerConfig {
22170            target_surb_buffer_size: 100,
22171            ..Default::default()
22172        });
22173        slot.surb_mgmt
22174            .buffer_level
22175            .store(200, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
22176        anyhow::ensure!(
22177            0 == slot.surb_mgmt.organic_surbs_per_packet(),
22178            "precondition: the gate must start closed"
22179        );
22180
22181        Ok(rx)
22182    }
22183
22184    /// The organic SURB cap the slot's gate currently answers.
22185    fn organic_surbs(mgr: &TestManager, pseudonym: HoprPseudonym) -> Option<usize> {
22186        mgr.sessions
22187            .get(&pseudonym)
22188            .map(|slot| slot.surb_mgmt.organic_surbs_per_packet())
22189    }
22190
22191    /// The Exit → Entry return-SURB credit the slot has accumulated, which the successor gate is
22192    /// denominated in.
22193    fn returned_packets_of(mgr: &TestManager, pseudonym: HoprPseudonym) -> u64 {
22194        mgr.sessions
22195            .get(&pseudonym)
22196            .expect("slot must exist")
22197            .returned_packets
22198            .load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed)
22199    }

22201    fn session_packet_signalling(signals: PacketSignals) -> anyhow::Result<ApplicationDataIn> {
22202        let mut data = session_data_packet(b"reply")?;
22203        data.packet_info.signals_from_sender = signals;
22204        Ok(data)
22205    }
22206
22207    fn keep_alive_packet_signalling(
22208        session_id: SessionId,
22209        signals: PacketSignals,
22210    ) -> anyhow::Result<ApplicationDataIn> {
22211        Ok(ApplicationDataIn {
22212            data: ApplicationData::try_from(HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(KeepAliveMessage {
22213                session_id,
22214                flags: KeepAliveFlag::BalancerState.into(),
22215                additional_data: 0,
22216            }))?,
22217            packet_info: IncomingPacketInfo {
22218                signals_from_sender: signals,
22219                ..Default::default()
22220            },
22221        })
22222    }

22224    /// The regression: a packet dropped for local backpressure still carries what the counterparty
22225    /// said about its own SURB supply. Recorded only once the Session reads the packet, that word is
22226    /// lost exactly when the inbox is saturated — leaving organic production shut off on an estimate
22227    /// the counterparty has just contradicted, and with nothing else able to reopen it.
22228    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
22229    async fn distress_should_be_recorded_even_when_the_packet_is_dropped() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
22230        // Capacity 1, so the second packet deterministically finds the inbox full.
22231        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
22232            session_forward_capacity: 1,
22233            ..Default::default()
22234        });
22235        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
22236        let _rx = entry_slot_with_closed_gate(&mgr, pseudonym)?;
22237
22238        // Fill the single slot; nothing reads it.
22239        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_packet_signalling(PacketSignals::default())?)?;
22240
22241        let dropped = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_packet_signalling(PacketSignal::SurbDistress.into())?)?;
22242        assert!(
22243            matches!(dropped, DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::SinkFull)),
22244            "the fixture must actually drop this packet, got {dropped:?}"
22245        );
22246        assert_eq!(
22247            Some(1),
22248            organic_surbs(&mgr, pseudonym),
22249            "a dropped packet still spoke for the counterparty"
22250        );
22251
22252        Ok(())
22253    }
22254
22255    /// Keep-alives are all a Session that has stopped exchanging data still sends, and they reach
22256    /// `handle_keep_alive` stripped of their packet info — so before this was recorded at dispatch,
22257    /// a quiet counterparty could not report distress at all.
22258    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
22259    async fn distress_should_be_recorded_from_a_keep_alive() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
22260        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
22261        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
22262        let _rx = entry_slot_with_closed_gate(&mgr, pseudonym)?;
22263
22264        // The manager is not started, so the Start-protocol worker rejects this after the signal has
22265        // been taken from it. That is the property under test: the record does not depend on
22266        // anything downstream succeeding.
22267        let _ = mgr.dispatch_message(
22268            pseudonym,
22269            keep_alive_packet_signalling(pseudonym, PacketSignal::OutOfSurbs.into())?,
22270        );
22271
22272        assert_eq!(Some(1), organic_surbs(&mgr, pseudonym));
22273
22274        Ok(())
22275    }
22276
22277    /// An Exit → Entry Start packet consumes a return SURB whatever it decodes to and wherever it
22278    /// is admitted, so the credit that denominates the successor gate must be paid before the
22279    /// decode and the admission filter, not after them. A packet the filter rejects has already
22280    /// spent the SURB — under-crediting it can make the gate refuse the next `RequestSsa` and the
22281    /// Session close with `CommitmentTimeout`.
22282    ///
22283    /// ## Steps
22284    /// 1. An Entry-side (`Forward`) slot is pre-populated with its gate closed.
22285    /// 2. A `KeepAlive` naming another Session — the filter's mismatched-pseudonym drop — must still credit
22286    ///    `returned_packets` by one.
22287    /// 3. A Start-tagged packet that fails to decode must credit it by one too.
22288    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
22289    async fn a_start_packet_the_filter_drops_should_still_credit_the_returned_packets() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
22290        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
22291        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
22292        let _rx = entry_slot_with_closed_gate(&mgr, pseudonym)?;
22293        let before = returned_packets_of(&mgr, pseudonym);
22294
22295        // The manager is not started, but that only matters past the filter; this one is dropped at
22296        // the filter itself, for naming a Session the pseudonym it arrives under does not own.
22297        let dropped = mgr.dispatch_message(
22298            pseudonym,
22299            keep_alive_packet_signalling(HoprPseudonym::random(), PacketSignals::default())?,
22300        )?;
22301        assert!(
22302            matches!(dropped, DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage)),
22303            "the fixture must actually drop this packet at the filter, got {dropped:?}"
22304        );
22305        assert_eq!(
22306            before + 1,
22307            returned_packets_of(&mgr, pseudonym),
22308            "a packet the filter drops has already consumed its return SURB"
22309        );
22310
22311        Ok(())
22312    }
22313
22314    /// The undecodable half of the same regression: the decode runs after the credit, so a
22315    /// Start-tagged packet that fails to parse must still have credited the return SURB it spent —
22316    /// and must be a quiet counted drop, since anyone can send one for free.
22317    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
22318    async fn an_undecodable_start_packet_should_still_credit_the_returned_packets() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
22319        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
22320        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
22321        let _rx = entry_slot_with_closed_gate(&mgr, pseudonym)?;
22322        let before = returned_packets_of(&mgr, pseudonym);
22323        let malformed_before = crate::counters::session_malformed_start_message_count();
22324
22325        // Start-protocol tag, but a payload that parses to no Start-protocol message.
22326        let mut undecodable = session_data_packet(b"not a start message")?;
22327        undecodable.data.application_tag = HoprStartProtocol::START_PROTOCOL_MESSAGE_TAG;
22328
22329        let result = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, undecodable);
22330        assert!(
22331            matches!(result, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::MalformedStartMessage))),
22332            "a Start-tagged packet that fails to decode must be a quiet drop, got {result:?}"
22333        );
22334        assert!(
22335            crate::counters::session_malformed_start_message_count() > malformed_before,
22336            "the malformed Start message must be counted"
22337        );
22338        assert_eq!(
22339            before + 1,
22340            returned_packets_of(&mgr, pseudonym),
22341            "a packet that cannot be decoded has already consumed its return SURB"
22342        );
22343
22344        Ok(())
22345    }

22347    /// A full Start queue is backpressure, not a fault: it must be a quiet counted drop rather than
22348    /// the per-packet `ERROR` the transport logs for a dispatch `Err`.
22349    ///
22350    /// Deterministic only on the default current-thread runtime: the filling loop has no `.await`,
22351    /// so the processor task is never polled and the queue cannot drain underneath it.
22352    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
22353    async fn a_full_start_queue_should_be_a_backpressure_drop() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
22354        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
22355            maximum_sessions: 1,
22356            ..Default::default()
22357        });
22358
22359        // No Session is admitted here, so the notifier is never used; holding the receiver keeps
22360        // it from being seen as closed.
22361        let (new_session_tx, _new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
22362        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(MockMsgSender::new());
22363        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, None)?;
22364
22365        // Fill the control lane to its capacity without letting the processor drain it: a keep-alive
22366        // for a registered Session is the cheapest control message that reaches `try_send`.
22367        let capacity = start_control_channel_capacity(&mgr.cfg);
22368        let live = HoprPseudonym::random();
22369        let _rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(live, DestinationRouting::Return(live.into()));
22370
22371        let drops_before = crate::counters::start_control_send_drop_count();
22372        let mut saw_full = false;
22373        // Cheapest way through `try_send` without letting the processor drain: a keep-alive for a
22374        // registered Session. Fill the queue, then drop until the rate-limited WARN is due.
22375        for _ in 0..(capacity + FULL_QUEUE_WARN_INTERVAL + 1) {
22376            let outcome = mgr.dispatch_message(live, keep_alive_packet_signalling(live, PacketSignals::default())?)?;
22377            saw_full |= matches!(outcome, DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StartQueueFull));
22378            if saw_full && crate::counters::start_control_send_drop_count().is_multiple_of(FULL_QUEUE_WARN_INTERVAL) {
22379                break;
22380            }
22381        }
22382
22383        assert!(
22384            saw_full,
22385            "filling the Start queue past its capacity must produce a quiet StartQueueFull drop"
22386        );
22387        assert!(
22388            crate::counters::start_control_send_drop_count() > drops_before,
22389            "a queue-full drop must be counted"
22390        );
22391
22392        sender.close_channel();
22393        Ok(())
22394    }

22396    /// Every Start-lane result reaches `report_start_result`, which must swallow the deliberate
22397    /// `NotAdmitted` refusals quietly and log anything else as an error.

22399    fn start_results_are_reported_quietly_for_deliberate_refusals() {
22400        report_start_result(Ok(()));
22401        report_start_result(Err(SessionManagerError::NotAdmitted("early".into()).into()));
22402        report_start_result(Err(TransportSessionError::Timeout));
22403    }

22405    /// The WARN is due on the first drop of each interval, and only then.

22419            !is_full_queue_warn_due(FULL_QUEUE_WARN_INTERVAL - 1),

22444    /// A closed Start queue means the manager is shutting down, which is a real fault: `Err`, and
22445    /// counted, but never a silent drop.
22446    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
22447    async fn a_closed_start_queue_is_an_error_not_a_drop() -> anyhow::Result<()> {

22453        // `Disconnected`.

22459        let result = mgr.dispatch_message(live, keep_alive_packet_signalling(live, PacketSignals::default())?);

22463        );
22464        assert!(
22465            crate::counters::start_protocol_send_drop_count() > drops_before,
22466            "a closed-queue failure must still be counted"
22467        );

22469        Ok(())
22470    }

22545    #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)]
22546    async fn start_protocol_worker_should_preserve_session_ancestry_without_reentering_the_parent() -> anyhow::Result<()>
22547    {
22548        use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
22549
22550        use test_log::tracing_subscriber::{
22551            self as subscriber, filter::LevelFilter, layer::SubscriberExt, registry::LookupSpan,
22552        };
22553        use tracing::instrument::WithSubscriber;
22554
22555        struct WorkerEvents {
22556            events: tokio::sync::mpsc::UnboundedSender<Vec<(&'static str, tracing::span::Id)>>,
22557            session_enters: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
22558        }
22559
22560        impl<S: tracing::Subscriber + for<'a> LookupSpan<'a>> subscriber::Layer<S> for WorkerEvents {
22561            fn on_enter(&self, id: &tracing::span::Id, ctx: subscriber::layer::Context<'_, S>) {
22562                if ctx.span(id).is_some_and(|span| span.name() == "session") {
22563                    self.session_enters.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
22564                }
22565            }
22566
22567            fn on_event(&self, event: &tracing::Event<'_>, ctx: subscriber::layer::Context<'_, S>) {
22568                if *event.metadata().level() != tracing::Level::ERROR {
22569                    return;
22570                }
22571                let Some(scope) = ctx.event_scope(event) else {
22572                    return;
22573                };
22574                let ancestry = scope
22575                    .from_root()
22576                    .map(|span| (span.name(), span.id()))
22577                    .collect::<Vec<_>>();
22578                // Capture the worker's result event after the individual handler has returned.
22579                if ancestry
22580                    .last()
22581                    .is_some_and(|(name, _)| *name == "session.start_protocol")
22582                {
22583                    let _ = self.events.send(ancestry);
22584                }
22585            }
22586        }
22587
22588        let (events_tx, mut events_rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel();
22589        let session_enters = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
22590        let subscriber = subscriber::registry()
22591            .with(WorkerEvents {
22592                events: events_tx,
22593                session_enters: session_enters.clone(),
22594            })
22595            .with(LevelFilter::DEBUG);
22596        async {
22597            let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
22598            let (sender, _outgoing) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
22599            let handles = mgr.start(sender, futures::sink::drain(), None, None)?;
22600            let mut expected_roots = Vec::new();
22601            let mut session_receivers = Vec::new();
22602            for _ in 0..2 {
22603                let id = HoprPseudonym::random();
22604                session_receivers.push(mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(
22605                    id,
22606                    DestinationRouting::Forward {
22607                        destination: Box::new(Address::from(&ChainKeypair::random()).into()),
22608                        pseudonym: Some(id),
22609                        forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(1.try_into()?),
22610                        return_options: None,
22611                    },
22612                ));
22613                let session = tracing::debug_span!("session", session_id = %id);
22614                assert!(session.id().is_some(), "fixture needs an active session span");
22615                // Without a PIX toolbox, the actual SSA handler returns UnsupportedMessage.
22616                // Its worker then emits an error directly within session.start_protocol.
22617                let packet = ssa_request_packet(id)?;
22618                assert!(matches!(
22619                    session.in_scope(|| mgr.dispatch_message(id, packet))?,
22620                    DispatchResult::Processed
22621                ));
22622                expected_roots.push(session);
22623            }
22624            let received = timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
22625                let first = events_rx.recv().await.context("missing first worker event")?;
22626                let second = events_rx.recv().await.context("missing second worker event")?;
22627                anyhow::Ok([first, second])
22628            })
22629            .await;
22630            for handle in handles {
22631                handle.abort();
22632            }
22633            for ancestry in received.context("Start protocol worker did not process both messages")?? {
22634                assert_eq!(
22635                    ancestry.iter().map(|(name, _)| *name).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
22636                    ["session", "session.start_protocol"]
22637                );
22638                let root = &ancestry.first().context("missing session root")?.1;
22639                let index = expected_roots
22640                    .iter()
22641                    .position(|span| span.id().as_ref() == Some(root))
22642                    .context("worker event must retain its own dispatch session")?;
22643                expected_roots.remove(index);
22644            }
22645            assert!(expected_roots.is_empty());
22646            assert_eq!(
22647                session_enters.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
22648                2,
22649                "session roots should be entered only for dispatch, not again by the worker"
22650            );
22651            anyhow::Ok(())
22652        }
22653        .with_subscriber(subscriber)
22654        .await
22655    }
