22657    #[test]
22658    /// Both Start lanes retain the dispatch session span when their queues are drained.
22659    fn start_protocol_queue_should_retain_the_dispatch_context() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
22660        use anyhow::Context;
22661        use test_log::tracing_subscriber::{filter::LevelFilter, layer::SubscriberExt};
22662
22663        tracing::subscriber::with_default(
22664            test_log::tracing_subscriber::registry().with(LevelFilter::DEBUG),
22665            || -> anyhow::Result<()> {
22666                for opening in [false, true] {
22667                    let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
22668                    let (tx, rx) = crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async(1);
22669                    let lane = if opening {
22670                        &mgr.start_session_tx
22671                    } else {
22672                        &mgr.start_control_tx
22673                    };
22674                    lane.set(tx)
22675                        .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("installing test Start queue"))?;
22676                    let id = HoprPseudonym::random();
22677                    let _session_rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(
22678                        id,
22679                        DestinationRouting::Forward {
22680                            destination: Box::new(Address::from(&ChainKeypair::random()).into()),
22681                            pseudonym: Some(id),
22682                            forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(1.try_into()?),
22683                            return_options: None,
22684                        },
22685                    );
22686                    let packet = if opening {
22687                        start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(StartInitiation {
22688                            challenge: StartChallenge::MAX,
22689                            target: SessionTarget::UdpStream(hopr_utils::network_types::prelude::SealedHost::Plain(
22690                                std::net::SocketAddr::from(([127, 0, 0, 1], 1234)).into(),
22691                            )),
22692                            capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities::try_from(0u8)?,
22693                            additional_data: 0,
22694                        }))?
22695                    } else {
22696                        ssa_request_packet(id)?
22697                    };
22698                    let span = tracing::debug_span!("session", session_id = %id);
22699                    let expected = span.id();
22700                    {
22701                        let _entered = span.enter();
22702                        assert!(matches!(mgr.dispatch_message(id, packet)?, DispatchResult::Processed));
22703                    }
22704                    let (queued_id, _, _, _, queued_span) = rx.try_recv().context("receiving the Start message")?;
22705                    assert_eq!(queued_id, id);
22706                    assert_eq!(queued_span.id(), expected);
22707                }
22708                Ok(())
22709            },
22710        )
22711    }

22713    /// The benchmark queue uses real dispatch: independent bounded lanes, reusable drains and closed-queue errors.
22714    #[test]
22715    fn benchmark_start_queue_drains_both_lanes_and_preserves_backpressure() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
22716        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
22717        let mut drain = mgr.benchmark_start_queue(1)?;
22718        assert_eq!(drain(), 0);
22719        assert!(
22720            mgr.benchmark_start_queue(1).is_err(),
22721            "queues can only be installed once"
22722        );
22723        let id = HoprPseudonym::random();
22724        let _session_rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(
22725            id,
22726            DestinationRouting::Forward {
22727                destination: Box::new(Address::from(&ChainKeypair::random()).into()),
22728                pseudonym: Some(id),
22729                forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(1.try_into()?),
22730                return_options: None,
22731            },
22732        );
22733        let opening = || -> anyhow::Result<_> {
22734            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(StartInitiation {
22735                challenge: StartChallenge::MAX,
22736                target: SessionTarget::UdpStream(hopr_utils::network_types::prelude::SealedHost::Plain(
22737                    std::net::SocketAddr::from(([127, 0, 0, 1], 1234)).into(),
22738                )),
22739                capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities::try_from(0u8)?,
22740                additional_data: 0,
22741            }))
22742        };
22743        for _ in 0..2 {
22744            for packet in [opening()?, ssa_request_packet(id)?] {
22745                assert!(matches!(mgr.dispatch_message(id, packet)?, DispatchResult::Processed));
22746            }
22747            for packet in [opening()?, ssa_request_packet(id)?] {
22748                assert!(matches!(
22749                    mgr.dispatch_message(id, packet)?,
22750                    DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StartQueueFull)
22751                ));
22752            }
22753            assert_eq!(drain(), 2, "each lane contributes one message");
22754            assert_eq!(drain(), 0, "draining must remove messages exactly once");
22755        }
22756        drop(drain);
22757        assert!(mgr.dispatch_message(id, opening()?).is_err());
22758        assert!(mgr.dispatch_message(id, ssa_request_packet(id)?).is_err());
22759        Ok(())
22760    }

22762    /// A flood of `SsaRequest`s for pseudonyms this node never issued must be rejected at dispatch.
22763    ///
22764    /// Before the admission filter, every one of these reached the shared Start-protocol worker
22765    /// pool, where `handle_ssa_request` parked its handler for up to a second on a Session slot a
22766    /// random pseudonym never gets; ~110 concurrent requests occupied every handler and the bounded
22767    /// Start queue then dropped all traffic behind them — including the KeepAlives of live Sessions.
22768    ///
22769    /// ## Steps
22770    /// 1. A manager holds one live (pre-populated Forward) Session.
22771    /// 2. ~300 `SsaRequest`s are dispatched, each for a fresh random pseudonym.
22772    /// 3. Every one must come back `Dropped(StaleStartMessage)`, counted, and nothing may reach the bounded queue — the
22773    ///    send-drop counter must not move.
22774    /// 4. A `KeepAlive` for the live Session's own pseudonym must still be dispatched, proving the flood cannot have
22775    ///    starved real control traffic.
22776    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
22777    async fn a_flood_of_ssa_requests_for_unknown_pseudonyms_must_not_starve_a_live_session() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
22778        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
22779
22780        // No Session is admitted here, so the notifier is never used; holding the receiver keeps
22781        // it from being seen as closed.
22782        let (new_session_tx, _new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
22783        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(MockMsgSender::new());
22784        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, None)?;
22785
22786        let live_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
22787        let _rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(
22788            live_pseudonym,
22789            DestinationRouting::Forward {
22790                destination: Box::new(Address::from(&ChainKeypair::random()).into()),
22791                pseudonym: Some(live_pseudonym),
22792                forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(1.try_into()?),
22793                return_options: None,
22794            },
22795        );
22796
22797        let stale_before = crate::counters::session_stale_start_message_count();
22798        let send_drops_before = crate::counters::start_protocol_send_drop_count();
22799
22800        const FLOOD: usize = 300;
22801        for _ in 0..FLOOD {
22802            let stranger = HoprPseudonym::random();
22803            let result = mgr.dispatch_message(stranger, ssa_request_packet(stranger)?);
22804            assert!(
22805                matches!(result, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage))),
22806                "an SSA request for a pseudonym this node never issued must be dropped as stale, got {result:?}"
22807            );
22808        }
22809
22810        assert!(
22811            crate::counters::session_stale_start_message_count() >= stale_before + FLOOD,
22812            "every flooded request must be counted as a stale Start message"
22813        );
22814        assert_eq!(
22815            send_drops_before,
22816            crate::counters::start_protocol_send_drop_count(),
22817            "nothing may reach the bounded queue: the filter must run before try_send"
22818        );
22819
22820        // The live Session's control traffic must still be dispatched — the property the flood used
22821        // to destroy by filling the queue.
22822        let kept_alive = mgr.dispatch_message(
22823            live_pseudonym,
22824            keep_alive_packet_signalling(live_pseudonym, PacketSignals::default())?,
22825        );
22826        assert!(
22827            matches!(kept_alive, Ok(DispatchResult::Processed)),
22828            "the live Session's keep-alive must still get through, got {kept_alive:?}"
22829        );
22830        assert_eq!(
22831            send_drops_before,
22832            crate::counters::start_protocol_send_drop_count(),
22833            "the keep-alive must not have been dropped at try_send either"
22834        );
22835
22836        sender.close_channel();
22837        Ok(())
22838    }
22839
22840    /// A `StartSession` flood cannot fill the lane that live Sessions' control traffic uses.
22841    ///
22842    /// The test must actually saturate the session lane, and it must be the *session* lane: with
22843    /// `maximum_sessions: 1` the session lane holds `1 + START_PROTOCOL_CHANNEL_RESERVE` messages,
22844    /// far fewer than one shared lane would.
22845    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
22846    async fn a_start_session_flood_must_not_fill_the_control_lane() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
22847        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
22848            maximum_sessions: 1,
22849            ..Default::default()
22850        });
22851
22852        // No Session is admitted here, so the notifier is never used; holding the receiver keeps
22853        // it from being seen as closed.
22854        let (new_session_tx, _new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
22855        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(MockMsgSender::new());
22856        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, None)?;
22857
22858        let live = HoprPseudonym::random();
22859        let _rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(live, DestinationRouting::Return(live.into()));
22860
22861        // No `await` in this loop, so the session processor is never polled and its lane fills.
22862        let session_capacity = start_session_channel_capacity();
22863        let mut filled = false;
22864        for i in 0..(session_capacity + 1) {
22865            let initiator = HoprPseudonym::random();
22866            let outcome = mgr.dispatch_message(
22867                initiator,
22868                start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(StartInitiation {
22869                    challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE + i as u64,
22870                    target: SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
22871                    capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities::empty(),
22872                    additional_data: 0,
22873                }))?,
22874            )?;
22875            filled |= matches!(outcome, DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StartQueueFull));
22876        }
22877        assert!(
22878            filled,
22879            "the fixture must actually fill the session lane, or it proves nothing about the split"
22880        );
22881
22882        // The control lane must be untouched by that flood: it still has room for real traffic.
22883        let kept_alive = mgr.dispatch_message(live, keep_alive_packet_signalling(live, PacketSignals::default())?);
22884        assert!(
22885            matches!(kept_alive, Ok(DispatchResult::Processed)),
22886            "the live Session's keep-alive must still reach the control lane while the session lane is full, got \
22887             {kept_alive:?}"
22888        );
22889
22890        sender.close_channel();
22891        Ok(())
22892    }

22939    /// The filter must not be broader than the attack: an `SsaRequest` an Exit legitimately sends to
22940    /// its Entry is admitted, while the same request arriving on an Exit-side (Return) slot — which
22941    /// no compliant peer ever sends — is dropped as stale.
22942    ///
22943    /// ## Steps
22944    /// 1. A manager holds one Forward (outgoing/Entry-side) slot.
22945    /// 2. An `SsaRequest` naming it is admitted to the queue.
22946    /// 3. A second Return (incoming/Exit-side) slot; the same request naming it is dropped.
22947    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
22948    async fn an_ssa_request_for_an_outgoing_session_is_admitted_and_one_for_an_exit_slot_is_not() -> anyhow::Result<()>
22949    {
22950        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
22951
22952        // No Session is admitted here, so the notifier is never used; holding the receiver keeps
22953        // it from being seen as closed.
22954        let (new_session_tx, _new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
22955        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(MockMsgSender::new());
22956        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, None)?;
22957
22958        // Outgoing (Entry-side) slot: the Entry receives SSA commitments for it, so the request is
22959        // legitimate and must be admitted.
22960        let entry_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
22961        let _entry_rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(
22962            entry_pseudonym,
22963            DestinationRouting::Forward {
22964                destination: Box::new(Address::from(&ChainKeypair::random()).into()),
22965                pseudonym: Some(entry_pseudonym),
22966                forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(1.try_into()?),
22967                return_options: None,
22968            },
22969        );
22970        let admitted = mgr.dispatch_message(entry_pseudonym, ssa_request_packet(entry_pseudonym)?);
22971        assert!(
22972            matches!(admitted, Ok(DispatchResult::Processed)),
22973            "an SSA request for an outgoing Session must be admitted, got {admitted:?}"
22974        );
22975
22976        // Incoming (Exit-side) slot: nothing here ever receives an SSA commitment for one.
22977        let exit_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
22978        let _exit_rx =
22979            mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(exit_pseudonym, DestinationRouting::Return(exit_pseudonym.into()));
22980        let refused = mgr.dispatch_message(exit_pseudonym, ssa_request_packet(exit_pseudonym)?);
22981        assert!(
22982            matches!(refused, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage))),
22983            "an SSA request for an incoming Session must be dropped as stale, got {refused:?}"
22984        );
22985
22986        sender.close_channel();
22987        Ok(())
22988    }

22990    /// The filter's remaining arms: an `SsaCommit` is admitted only for a registered Session named
22991    /// under its own pseudonym, and a `SessionEstablished` or `SessionError(Challenge)` only for a
22992    /// challenge this node is still waiting on.
22993    ///
22994    /// ## Steps
22995    /// 1. A started manager holds one Return (Exit-side) slot, which is where `SsaCommit`s go, and two pending
22996    ///    initiation challenges — one per reply, so the handler consuming one cannot race the other's dispatch.
22997    /// 2. Each message naming state the node lacks is dropped as stale: an `SsaCommit` for an unregistered Session or
22998    ///    naming the slot under another pseudonym, and a `SessionEstablished` and a `SessionError` for a challenge
22999    ///    nobody issued.
23000    /// 3. Each message naming that state is admitted.
23001    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
23002    async fn ssa_commits_and_initiation_replies_are_admitted_only_for_local_state() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
23003        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
23004
23005        // No Session is admitted here, so the notifier is never used; holding the receiver keeps
23006        // it from being seen as closed.
23007        let (new_session_tx, _new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
23008        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(MockMsgSender::new());
23009        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, None)?;
23010
23011        let exit_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
23012        let _exit_rx =
23013            mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(exit_pseudonym, DestinationRouting::Return(exit_pseudonym.into()));
23014
23015        // Reserved the way `new_session` reserves them. The receivers are kept so that a reply the
23016        // handler forwards has somewhere to go.
23017        let established_challenge = MIN_CHALLENGE;
23018        let error_challenge = MIN_CHALLENGE + 1;
23019        let unknown_challenge = MIN_CHALLENGE + 2;
23020        let receivers = [established_challenge, error_challenge]
23021            .into_iter()
23022            .map(|challenge| {
23023                let (tx, rx): (
23024                    crossfire::MTx<crossfire::mpsc::One<_>>,
23025                    crossfire::AsyncRx<crossfire::mpsc::One<_>>,
23026                ) = crossfire::mpsc::build(crossfire::mpsc::One::new());
23027                mgr.session_initiations.insert(challenge, tx);
23028                rx
23029            })
23030            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
23031
23032        let identity = HoprPixGroupElement::try_from(
23033            hopr_protocol_pix::PixGroup::<HoprPixSpec>::default()
23034                .to_bytes()
23035                .as_ref(),
23036        )
23037        .ok()
23038        .context("identity element must be valid")?;
23039        // A non-constant term, so it is well-formed without a commitment proof.
23040        let ssa_commit = |session_id: SessionId| {
23041            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SsaCommit(SsaClientCommitmentMessage {
23042                session_id,
23043                ssa_index: SsaIndex::new(1).context("non-zero")?,
23044                coefficient_index: 1,
23045                commitment_proof: None,
23046                coefficient_commitments: [(0, identity)].into(),
23047            }))
23048        };
23049        // The filter keys both replies on the challenge alone, not on the pseudonym they arrive under.
23050        let replier = HoprPseudonym::random();
23051        let established = |orig_challenge: StartChallenge| {
23052            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SessionEstablished(StartEstablished {
23053                orig_challenge,
23054                session_id: replier,
23055            }))
23056        };
23057        let error = |challenge: StartChallenge| {
23058            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(StartErrorType {
23059                identifier: ErrorIdentifier::Challenge(challenge),
23060                reason: StartErrorReason::Unknown,
23061            }))
23062        };
23063
23064        let stranger = HoprPseudonym::random();
23065        for (case, pseudonym, packet) in [
23066            (
23067                "an SsaCommit for an unregistered Session",
23068                stranger,
23069                ssa_commit(stranger)?,
23070            ),
23071            (
23072                "an SsaCommit naming a registered Session under another pseudonym",
23073                stranger,
23074                ssa_commit(exit_pseudonym)?,
23075            ),
23076            (
23077                "a SessionEstablished for a challenge nobody issued",
23078                replier,
23079                established(unknown_challenge)?,
23080            ),
23081            (
23082                "a SessionError for a challenge nobody issued",
23083                replier,
23084                error(unknown_challenge)?,
23085            ),
23086        ] {
23087            let result = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet);
23088            assert!(
23089                matches!(result, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage))),
23090                "{case} must be dropped as stale, got {result:?}"
23091            );
23092        }
23093
23094        for (case, pseudonym, packet) in [
23095            (
23096                "an SsaCommit for a registered Session",
23097                exit_pseudonym,
23098                ssa_commit(exit_pseudonym)?,
23099            ),
23100            (
23101                "a SessionEstablished for a pending challenge",
23102                replier,
23103                established(established_challenge)?,
23104            ),
23105            (
23106                "a SessionError for a pending challenge",
23107                replier,
23108                error(error_challenge)?,
23109            ),
23110        ] {
23111            let result = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet);
23112            assert!(
23113                matches!(result, Ok(DispatchResult::Processed)),
23114                "{case} must be admitted, got {result:?}"
23115            );
23116        }
23117
23118        // Admission alone does not prove the background control worker delivered either reply.
23119        let established_reply = timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), receivers[0].recv())
23120            .await
23121            .context("establishment worker must deliver its reply")??;
23122        assert!(matches!(
23123            established_reply,
23124            Ok(InitiationReply::Established(StartEstablished { orig_challenge, session_id }))
23125                if orig_challenge == established_challenge && session_id == replier
23126        ));
23127        let error_reply = timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), receivers[1].recv())
23128            .await
23129            .context("error worker must deliver its reply")??;
23130        assert!(matches!(
23131            error_reply,
23132            Err(StartErrorType { identifier: ErrorIdentifier::Challenge(challenge), reason: StartErrorReason::Unknown })
23133                if challenge == error_challenge
23134        ));
23135        sender.close_channel();
23136        Ok(())
23137    }

23139    /// Keep-alives and post-establishment session errors naming another Session must be ignored.
23140    ///
23141    /// A sender names a Session both by the pseudonym it sends under and by the Session id inside
23142    /// the message; the two are the same on both sides of a real Session, so a mismatch means the
23143    /// sender is speaking about someone else's Session — only reachable if that id leaked. The
23144    /// dispatch filter rejects such a message outright, and the handlers refuse it again (point 4 of
23145    /// the fix) so the property does not rest on dispatch alone.
23146    ///
23147    /// ## Steps
23148    /// 1. Two Return slots A and B are pre-populated with known balancer targets.
23149    /// 2. A `KeepAlive { session_id: B }` arriving under A is refused — at dispatch, and again by the handler when
23150    ///    reached directly — and B's balancer target is untouched.
23151    /// 3. A `SessionError { identifier: SessionId(B) }` arriving under A is refused the same way, and B stays active.
23152    /// 4. Control: the same messages under B's own pseudonym do take effect.
23153    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
23154    async fn keep_alives_and_session_errors_naming_another_session_are_ignored() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
23155        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
23156
23157        // No Session is admitted here, so the notifier is never used; holding the receiver keeps
23158        // it from being seen as closed.
23159        let (new_session_tx, _new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
23160        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(MockMsgSender::new());
23161        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, None)?;
23162
23163        let a = HoprPseudonym::random();
23164        let b = HoprPseudonym::random();
23165        for pseudonym in [a, b] {
23166            let _rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(pseudonym, DestinationRouting::Return(pseudonym.into()));
23167            let slot = mgr
23168                .sessions
23169                .get(&pseudonym)
23170                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("slot for {pseudonym} must exist"))?;
23171            // Non-disabled balancer with a known target, so the KeepAlive branch is reachable.
23172            slot.surb_mgmt.update(&SurbBalancerConfig {
23173                target_surb_buffer_size: 100,
23174                ..Default::default()
23175            });
23176        }
23177
23178        let b_target_before = mgr
23179            .sessions
23180            .get(&b)
23181            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("slot for B must exist"))?
23182            .surb_mgmt
23183            .controller_bounds()
23184            .target();
23185
23186        let cross_keep_alive = KeepAliveMessage {
23187            session_id: b,
23188            flags: KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget.into(),
23189            additional_data: b_target_before + 1,
23190        };
23191
23192        // Through dispatch, the admission filter refuses it before any handler runs.
23193        let dispatched = mgr.dispatch_message(a, start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(cross_keep_alive.clone()))?);
23194        assert!(
23195            matches!(dispatched, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage))),
23196            "a keep-alive naming another session must be dropped at dispatch, got {dispatched:?}"
23197        );
23198
23199        // Point 4: the handler refuses it again even when reached directly, so the property does not
23200        // rest on the dispatch filter alone.
23201        mgr.handle_keep_alive(a, cross_keep_alive.clone())
23202            .await
23203            .context("the keep-alive handler must refuse quietly, not error")?;
23204        assert_eq!(
23205            b_target_before,
23206            mgr.sessions
23207                .get(&b)
23208                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("slot for B must exist"))?
23209                .surb_mgmt
23210                .controller_bounds()
23211                .target(),
23212            "a keep-alive naming another session must not move its balancer target"
23213        );
23214
23215        // The same for a post-establishment session error naming B.
23216        let cross_error = StartErrorType {
23217            identifier: ErrorIdentifier::SessionId(b),
23218            reason: StartErrorReason::Unknown,
23219        };
23220        let dispatched = mgr.dispatch_message(a, start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(cross_error.clone()))?);
23221        assert!(
23222            matches!(dispatched, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage))),
23223            "a session error naming another session must be dropped at dispatch, got {dispatched:?}"
23224        );
23225        mgr.handle_session_error(a, cross_error)
23226            .await
23227            .context("the session-error handler must refuse quietly, not error")?;
23228        assert!(
23229            mgr.active_sessions().contains(&b),
23230            "a session error naming another session must not close it"
23231        );
23232
23233        // Control: the same messages under B's own pseudonym do take effect. Dispatch hands the
23234        // message to the Start-protocol worker, so the effect is asynchronous and polled for.
23235        mgr.dispatch_message(
23236            b,
23237            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(KeepAliveMessage {
23238                session_id: b,
23239                flags: KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget.into(),
23240                additional_data: b_target_before + 2,
23241            }))?,
23242        )?;
23243        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), async {
23244            loop {
23245                let target = mgr
23246                    .sessions
23247                    .get(&b)
23248                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("slot for B must exist"))?
23249                    .surb_mgmt
23250                    .controller_bounds()
23251                    .target();
23252                if target == b_target_before + 2 {
23253                    return Ok::<(), anyhow::Error>(());
23254                }
23255                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
23256            }
23257        })
23258        .await
23259        .context("a correctly addressed keep-alive must still update the target")??;
23260
23261        mgr.dispatch_message(
23262            b,
23263            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(StartErrorType {
23264                identifier: ErrorIdentifier::SessionId(b),
23265                reason: StartErrorReason::Unknown,
23266            }))?,
23267        )?;
23268        let closed = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), async {
23269            loop {
23270                if !mgr.active_sessions().contains(&b) {
23271                    return;
23272                }
23273                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
23274            }
23275        })
23276        .await
23277        .context("a correctly addressed session error must close the session");
23278        closed?;
23279
23280        sender.close_channel();
23281        Ok(())
23282    }
23283
23284    /// Verifies that closing an existing session returns `true` and removes the session from the manager.
23285    ///
23286    /// ## Steps
23287    /// 1. A `SessionManager` is started with a mock transport that accepts one outbound message.
23288    /// 2. `handle_incoming_session_initiation` is called to create a session — one active session confirmed.
23289    /// 3. `close_session` is called with the session's pseudonym — returns `true`.
23290    /// 4. `num_active_sessions` is 0, confirming the session was fully removed.
23291    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
23292    async fn session_manager_should_return_true_when_closing_existing_session() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
23293        use hopr_utils::network_types::prelude::SealedHost;
23294
23295        let mgr: SessionManager<futures::channel::mpsc::UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>> =
23296            SessionManager::new(Default::default());
23297
23298        let mut transport = MockMsgSender::new();
23299        transport
23300            .expect_send_message()
23301            .once()
23302            .returning(|_, _| futures::future::ok(()).boxed());
23303
23304        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
23305        let _notifications = tokio::spawn(async move {
23306            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
23307            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
23308        });
23309        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(transport);
23310        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, None)?;
23311        assert!(mgr.is_started());
23312
23313        // Create a session
23314        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
23315        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(
23316            pseudonym,
23317            StartInitiation {
23318                challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE,
23319                target: SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
23320                capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities::empty(),
23321                additional_data: 0,
23322            },
23323        )
23324        .await?;
23325
23326        // Verify session exists
23327        assert_eq!(mgr.active_sessions().len(), 1);
23328        assert_eq!(mgr.num_active_sessions(), 1);
23329
23330        // Close the session - should return true
23331        let result = mgr.close_session(&pseudonym);
23332        assert!(result, "closing existing session should return true");
23333
23334        // Verify session is closed
23335        assert_eq!(mgr.active_sessions().len(), 0);
23336        assert_eq!(mgr.num_active_sessions(), 0);
23337
23338        // Cleanup: close sender and await handle
23339        sender.close_channel();
23340        _handle.await??;
23341
23342        Ok(())
23343    }

23446    /// Verifies that an Exit `KeepAlive` updates the SURB buffer level and counts as returned service.
23447    ///
23448    /// ## Steps
23449    /// 1. A session slot is manually inserted into Alice's manager with a known `SurbBalancerConfig` and an initial
23450    ///    buffer level of 100.
23451    /// 2. A `KeepAlive` message with `KeepAliveFlag::BalancerState` and `additional_data: 200` is constructed and
23452    ///    dispatched to Alice's manager via `dispatch_message`.
23453    /// 3. The manager processes the keep-alive asynchronously; the test polls until the slot's `buffer_level` reaches
23454    ///    200 (with a 1-second timeout).
23455    /// 4. The buffer level is confirmed to be 200 and the returned-packet counter advances once.
23456    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
23457    async fn session_manager_should_update_buffer_level_on_keep_alive_with_balancer_state_flag() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
23458        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
23459
23460        let alice_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
23461        let session_id = alice_pseudonym;
23462        let initial_buffer_level = 100u64;
23463        let new_buffer_level = 200u64;
23464
23465        let balancer_cfg = SurbBalancerConfig {
23466            target_surb_buffer_size: 1000,
23467            max_surbs_per_sec: 100,
23468            ..Default::default()
23469        };
23470
23471        let alice_mgr =
23472            SessionManager::<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>::new(Default::default());
23473
23474        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
23475        let (mock_sender, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
23476        let _ahs = alice_mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
23477        assert!(alice_mgr.is_started());
23478
23479        let (dummy_tx, _) = crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async::<ApplicationDataIn>(SESSION_FORWARD_CAPACITY);
23480        let peer_address: Address = (&ChainKeypair::random()).into();
23481        alice_mgr.sessions.insert(
23482            session_id,
23483            SessionSlot {
23484                session_tx: dummy_tx,
23485                routing_opts: DestinationRouting::Forward {
23486                    destination: Box::new(peer_address.into()),
23487                    pseudonym: Some(alice_pseudonym),
23488                    forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(hopr_api::types::primitive::bounded::BoundedSize::MIN),
23489                    return_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(hopr_api::types::primitive::bounded::BoundedSize::MIN).into(),
23490                },
23491                abort_handles: Default::default(),
23492                surb_mgmt: Arc::new(BalancerStateValues::from(balancer_cfg)),
23493                surb_estimator: Default::default(),
23494                current_ssa_state: Default::default(),
23495                pix_supervisor: Default::default(),
23496                pix_egress_gate: Default::default(),
23497                pix_fill: Default::default(),
23498                exit_loss_signal: Default::default(),
23499                returned_packets: Default::default(),
23500                cycle_budget: None,
23501                admission_token: Default::default(),
23502                raised_surb_target: Default::default(),
23503                forward_receipts: None,
23504                exit_resume: Default::default(),
23505                instance: SlotInstance::new(0),
23506                opening: None,
23507            },
23508        );
23509
23510        // Set initial buffer level
23511        let session_slot = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id).unwrap();
23512        session_slot
23513            .surb_mgmt
23514            .buffer_level
23515            .store(initial_buffer_level, Ordering::Relaxed);
23516        drop(session_slot);
23517
23518        // Verify initial buffer level
23519        let session_slot = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id).unwrap();
23520        assert_eq!(session_slot.surb_mgmt.buffer_level(), initial_buffer_level);
23521        drop(session_slot);
23522
23523        // Create keep-alive message with BalancerState flag
23524        let ka = KeepAliveMessage::<SessionId> {
23525            session_id,
23526            flags: KeepAliveFlag::BalancerState.into(),
23527            additional_data: new_buffer_level,
23528        };
23529        let app_data: ApplicationData = HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(ka).try_into()?;
23530        let app_data_in = ApplicationDataIn {
23531            data: app_data,
23532            packet_info: Default::default(),
23533        };
23534
23535        // Dispatch the keep-alive message
23536        alice_mgr.dispatch_message(alice_pseudonym, app_data_in)?;
23537
23538        // Poll until the background task has processed the keep-alive
23539        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
23540            loop {
23541                if let Some(slot) = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id)
23542                    && slot.surb_mgmt.buffer_level() == new_buffer_level
23543                {
23544                    break;
23545                }
23546                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
23547            }
23548        })
23549        .await
23550        .context("keep-alive BalancerState update timed out")?;
23551
23552        // Verify buffer level was updated
23553        let session_slot = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id).unwrap();
23554        assert_eq!(
23555            session_slot.surb_mgmt.buffer_level(),
23556            new_buffer_level,
23557            "buffer level should be updated via keep-alive with BalancerState flag"
23558        );
23559        assert_eq!(
23560            1,
23561            session_slot.returned_packets.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
23562            "an Exit keep-alive consumes a return SURB and must count toward the successor gate"
23563        );
23564        assert_eq!(
23565            1,
23566            session_slot.surb_mgmt.keep_alives_consumed(),
23567            "an Exit keep-alive must be counted as a keep-alive, not as a reply"
23568        );
23569
23570        Ok(())
23571    }

23573    /// Reading the admission token must not claim the cell.
23574    ///
23575    /// The Exit answers `SessionEstablished` before it commits, so a `BalancerTarget` keep-alive can
23576    /// be processed in that window. `claim_admission_token` exists for teardowns, which *claim* an
23577    /// empty cell by writing `NONE` into it — a keep-alive that did the same would make the
23578    /// establishment's own `set` fail, and its `commit` would then retire the admission it had just
23579    /// made. The Session's SURBs would land in the quarantine, which is exactly the unadmitted-Session
23580    /// failure the admission seam exists to prevent (hoprnet#8515).
23581    #[test]
23582    fn peeking_the_admission_token_must_leave_the_cell_for_the_commit() {
23583        let slot = {
23584            let (session_tx, _rx) = crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async::<ApplicationDataIn>(1);
23585            SessionSlot {
23586                session_tx,
23587                routing_opts: DestinationRouting::Return(SurbMatcher::Pseudonym(HoprPseudonym::random())),
23588                abort_handles: Default::default(),
23589                surb_mgmt: Default::default(),
23590                surb_estimator: Default::default(),
23591                current_ssa_state: Default::default(),
23592                pix_supervisor: Default::default(),
23593                pix_egress_gate: Default::default(),
23594                pix_fill: Default::default(),
23595                exit_loss_signal: Default::default(),
23596                returned_packets: Default::default(),
23597                cycle_budget: None,
23598                admission_token: Default::default(),
23599                raised_surb_target: Default::default(),
23600                forward_receipts: None,
23601                exit_resume: Default::default(),
23602                instance: SlotInstance::new(0),
23603                opening: None,
23604            }
23605        };
23606
23607        assert_eq!(
23608            AdmissionToken::NONE,
23609            slot.peek_admission_token(),
23610            "a slot nothing has admitted yet holds no token"
23611        );
23612
23613        // The cell is still empty, so the establishment's commit can still take it.
23614        let minted = AdmissionToken::from_raw(7);
23615        assert!(
23616            slot.admission_token.set(minted).is_ok(),
23617            "peeking must not have claimed the cell"
23618        );
23619        assert_eq!(minted, slot.peek_admission_token());
23620    }

23622    /// Verifies that a `KeepAlive` message with the `BalancerTarget` flag updates the session's
23623    /// target SURB buffer size in the manager.
23624    ///
23625    /// ## Steps
23626    /// 1. A session slot is manually inserted into Alice's manager with a known `SurbBalancerConfig` and
23627    ///    `target_surb_buffer_size: 1000`.
23628    /// 2. A `KeepAlive` message with `KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget` and `additional_data: 2000` is constructed and
23629    ///    dispatched via `dispatch_message`.
23630    /// 3. The manager processes the keep-alive asynchronously; the test polls until the slot's
23631    ///    `target_surb_buffer_size` reaches 2000 (with a 1-second timeout).
23632    /// 4. The target is confirmed to be 2000, proving the `BalancerTarget` flag updated it.
23633    /// 5. The slot now records that the Entry refills the Exit's stock, which arms the Exit's keep-alive reserve: only
23634    ///    an Entry's SURB balancer sends keep-alives.
23635    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
23636    async fn session_manager_should_update_target_on_keep_alive_with_balancer_target_flag() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
23637        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
23638
23639        let alice_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
23640        let session_id = alice_pseudonym;
23641        let initial_target = 1000u64;
23642        let new_target = 2000u64;
23643
23644        let balancer_cfg = SurbBalancerConfig {
23645            target_surb_buffer_size: initial_target,
23646            max_surbs_per_sec: 100,
23647            ..Default::default()
23648        };
23649
23650        let alice_mgr =
23651            SessionManager::<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>::new(Default::default());
23652
23653        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
23654        let (mock_sender, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
23655        let _ahs = alice_mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
23656        assert!(alice_mgr.is_started());
23657
23658        let (dummy_tx, _) = crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async::<ApplicationDataIn>(SESSION_FORWARD_CAPACITY);
23659        alice_mgr.sessions.insert(
23660            session_id,
23661            SessionSlot {
23662                session_tx: dummy_tx,
23663                routing_opts: DestinationRouting::Return(SurbMatcher::Pseudonym(alice_pseudonym)),
23664                abort_handles: Default::default(),
23665                surb_mgmt: Arc::new(BalancerStateValues::from(balancer_cfg)),
23666                surb_estimator: Default::default(),
23667                current_ssa_state: Default::default(),
23668                pix_supervisor: Default::default(),
23669                pix_egress_gate: Default::default(),
23670                pix_fill: Default::default(),
23671                exit_loss_signal: Default::default(),
23672                returned_packets: Default::default(),
23673                cycle_budget: None,
23674                admission_token: Default::default(),
23675                raised_surb_target: Default::default(),
23676                forward_receipts: None,
23677                exit_resume: Default::default(),
23678                instance: SlotInstance::new(0),
23679                opening: None,
23680            },
23681        );
23682
23683        // Verify initial target
23684        let session_slot = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id).unwrap();
23685        assert_eq!(
23686            session_slot.surb_mgmt.controller_bounds().target(),
23687            initial_target,
23688            "initial target should be set"
23689        );
23690        assert!(
23691            !session_slot.surb_mgmt.counterparty_refills(),
23692            "no keep-alive yet, so nothing shows the Entry refills"
23693        );
23694        drop(session_slot);
23695
23696        // Create keep-alive message with BalancerTarget flag
23697        let ka = KeepAliveMessage::<SessionId> {
23698            session_id,
23699            flags: KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget.into(),
23700            additional_data: new_target,
23701        };
23702        let app_data: ApplicationData = HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(ka).try_into()?;
23703        let app_data_in = ApplicationDataIn {
23704            data: app_data,
23705            packet_info: Default::default(),
23706        };
23707
23708        // Dispatch the keep-alive message
23709        alice_mgr.dispatch_message(alice_pseudonym, app_data_in)?;
23710
23711        // Poll until the background task has processed the keep-alive
23712        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
23713            loop {
23714                if let Some(slot) = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id)
23715                    && slot.surb_mgmt.target_surb_buffer_size.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == new_target
23716                {
23717                    break;
23718                }
23719                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
23720            }
23721        })
23722        .await
23723        .context("keep-alive BalancerTarget update timed out")?;
23724
23725        // Verify target was updated
23726        let session_slot = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id).unwrap();
23727        assert_eq!(
23728            session_slot.surb_mgmt.target_surb_buffer_size.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
23729            new_target,
23730            "target buffer size should be updated via keep-alive with BalancerTarget flag"
23731        );
23732        assert_eq!(
23733            0,
23734            session_slot.returned_packets.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
23735            "an Entry keep-alive received on the Exit must not count as returned Exit service"
23736        );
23737        assert!(
23738            session_slot.surb_mgmt.counterparty_refills(),
23739            "the Entry's keep-alive shows its balancer refills the Exit's stock"
23740        );
23741
23742        Ok(())
23743    }

23745    /// An incoming Session (the Exit), registered with the estimator its keep-alives book into. The manager
23746    /// is not started: the test does that, and keeps the handles for as long as it runs.
23747    fn exit_slot_for_keep_alives(
23748        pseudonym: HoprPseudonym,
23749    ) -> (
23750        SessionManager<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>,
23751        AtomicSurbFlowEstimator,
23752    ) {
23753        let mgr = SessionManager::<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>::new(Default::default());
23754        let estimator = AtomicSurbFlowEstimator::default();
23755        let (dummy_tx, _) = crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async::<ApplicationDataIn>(SESSION_FORWARD_CAPACITY);
23756        mgr.sessions.insert(
23757            pseudonym,
23758            SessionSlot {
23759                session_tx: dummy_tx,
23760                routing_opts: DestinationRouting::Return(SurbMatcher::Pseudonym(pseudonym)),
23761                abort_handles: Default::default(),
23762                surb_mgmt: Arc::new(BalancerStateValues::from(SurbBalancerConfig::default())),
23763                surb_estimator: estimator.clone(),
23764                current_ssa_state: Default::default(),
23765                pix_supervisor: Default::default(),
23766                pix_egress_gate: Default::default(),
23767                pix_fill: Default::default(),
23768                exit_loss_signal: Default::default(),
23769                returned_packets: Default::default(),
23770                cycle_budget: None,
23771                admission_token: Default::default(),
23772                raised_surb_target: Default::default(),
23773                forward_receipts: None,
23774                exit_resume: Default::default(),
23775                instance: SlotInstance::new(0),
23776                opening: None,
23777            },
23778        );
23779        (mgr, estimator)
23780    }

23782    /// Dispatches a keep-alive from the Entry whose packet stored `saved` SURBs and lost `evicted`. The
23783    /// SURBs are booked as it is dispatched; the rest of the keep-alive (that the Entry refills, and
23784    /// any target it announces) is handled asynchronously by the manager's Start protocol task.
23785    ///
23786    /// `flags` is what the Entry's balancer says: [`KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget`] is one that
23787    /// announces its target, and no flags one that has `surb_target_notify` off. It announces a target
23788    /// of zero either way, which changes nothing on the Exit.
23789    fn dispatch_entry_keep_alive(
23790        mgr: &SessionManager<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>,
23791        pseudonym: HoprPseudonym,
23792        flags: KeepAliveFlags,
23793        saved: usize,
23794        evicted: usize,
23795    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
23796        let keep_alive = KeepAliveMessage::<SessionId> {
23797            session_id: pseudonym,
23798            flags,
23799            additional_data: 0,
23800        };
23801        mgr.dispatch_message(
23802            pseudonym,
23803            ApplicationDataIn {
23804                data: HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(keep_alive).try_into()?,
23805                packet_info: IncomingPacketInfo {
23806                    num_saved_surbs: saved,
23807                    num_evicted_surbs: evicted,
23808                    ..Default::default()
23809                },
23810            },
23811        )?;
23812        Ok(())
23813    }
23814
23815    /// A keep-alive from the Entry delivers SURBs to the Exit just as a data packet does, and the Entry's
23816    /// balancer mints about as many of them in keep-alives as in data. What the packet did to the store
23817    /// is booked from the packet: the SURBs it carried, and the ones the store lost to it. The second is
23818    /// how the stock a newer SURB generation wiped reaches the Exit's level; a keep-alive that carried the
23819    /// first batch of the new generation used to leave it booked as still held.
23820    ///
23821    /// (The SURBs booked used to be the message's `max_surbs()`, how many fit beside it. That is what the
23822    /// sender was allowed to send, not what the store took.)
23823    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
23824    async fn a_keep_alive_should_book_the_surbs_its_packet_stored_and_the_ones_it_evicted() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
23825        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
23826
23827        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
23828        let (mgr, estimator) = exit_slot_for_keep_alives(pseudonym);
23829        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
23830        let (mock_sender, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
23831        let _ahs = mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
23832
23833        // The first batch of a newer generation: it wipes a stock of 7000 and stores its own two SURBs.
23834        dispatch_entry_keep_alive(&mgr, pseudonym, KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget.into(), 2, 7_000)?;
23835
23836        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
23837            while estimator.produced.load(Relaxed) == 0 {
23838                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
23839            }
23840        })
23841        .await
23842        .context("the keep-alive was never booked")?;
23843        assert_eq!(2, estimator.produced.load(Relaxed), "the SURBs the packet carried");
23844        assert_eq!(
23845            7_000,
23846            estimator.evicted.load(Relaxed),
23847            "the stock the store lost to it, which is what makes the wipe visible to the Exit's level"
23848        );
23849        Ok(())
23850    }
23851
23852    /// The same keep-alive on a store that lost nothing books no eviction.
23853    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
23854    async fn a_keep_alive_that_evicted_nothing_should_book_no_eviction() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
23855        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
23856
23857        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
23858        let (mgr, estimator) = exit_slot_for_keep_alives(pseudonym);
23859        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
23860        let (mock_sender, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
23861        let _ahs = mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
23862
23863        dispatch_entry_keep_alive(&mgr, pseudonym, KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget.into(), 2, 0)?;
23864
23865        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
23866            while estimator.produced.load(Relaxed) == 0 {
23867                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
23868            }
23869        })
23870        .await
23871        .context("the keep-alive was never booked")?;
23872        assert_eq!(2, estimator.produced.load(Relaxed));
23873        assert_eq!(0, estimator.evicted.load(Relaxed));
23874        Ok(())
23875    }

23877    /// An `SsaCommit` from the Entry delivers SURBs into the Exit's ring just as a keep-alive does, and
23878    /// is booked the same way. Booking only the keep-alives left these out of the Exit's level while
23879    /// the evictions they caused later were booked.
23880    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
23881    async fn an_ssa_commit_should_book_the_surbs_its_packet_stored() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
23882        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
23883
23884        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
23885        let (mgr, estimator) = exit_slot_for_keep_alives(pseudonym);
23886        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
23887        let (mock_sender, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
23888        let _ahs = mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
23889
23890        let identity = HoprPixGroupElement::try_from(
23891            hopr_protocol_pix::PixGroup::<HoprPixSpec>::default()
23892                .to_bytes()
23893                .as_ref(),
23894        )
23895        .ok()
23896        .context("identity element must be valid")?;
23897        let mut packet = start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SsaCommit(SsaClientCommitmentMessage {
23898            session_id: pseudonym,
23899            ssa_index: SsaIndex::new(1).context("non-zero")?,
23900            coefficient_index: 1,
23901            commitment_proof: None,
23902            coefficient_commitments: [(0, identity)].into(),
23903        }))?;
23904        packet.packet_info.num_saved_surbs = 2;
23905        packet.packet_info.num_evicted_surbs = 1;
23906        let carried = packet.num_surbs_with_msg() as u64;
23907        assert!(carried > 0, "fixture: the commitment must leave room for a SURB");
23908
23909        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet)?;
23910
23911        assert_eq!(
23912            carried,
23913            estimator.produced.load(Relaxed),
23914            "the SURBs the commitment's packet carried"
23915        );
23916        assert_eq!(1, estimator.evicted.load(Relaxed), "and the one the store lost to them");
23917        Ok(())
23918    }

23920    /// The SURBs are in the ring before the message is looked at, so a Start message the admission
23921    /// filter turns away is booked all the same: here a keep-alive that names another Session.
23922    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
23923    async fn a_start_message_the_admission_filter_drops_should_still_book_its_surbs() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
23924        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
23925
23926        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
23927        let (mgr, estimator) = exit_slot_for_keep_alives(pseudonym);
23928        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
23929        let (mock_sender, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
23930        let _ahs = mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
23931
23932        let mut packet = start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(KeepAliveMessage {
23933            session_id: HoprPseudonym::random(),
23934            flags: KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget.into(),
23935            additional_data: 0,
23936        }))?;
23937        packet.packet_info.num_saved_surbs = 2;
23938        let carried = packet.num_surbs_with_msg() as u64;
23939        assert!(carried > 0, "fixture: the keep-alive must leave room for a SURB");
23940
23941        let dispatched = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet);
23942        assert!(
23943            matches!(dispatched, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage))),
23944            "the filter must drop a keep-alive naming another session, got {dispatched:?}"
23945        );
23946        assert_eq!(
23947            carried,
23948            estimator.produced.load(Relaxed),
23949            "dropped, but its SURBs are in the ring"
23950        );
23951        Ok(())
23952    }

23954    /// The opening `StartSession` carries SURBs too. They reach the pseudonym's ring before the Session
23955    /// exists, and admission promotes them with it, so the new Session's estimate starts with them:
23956    /// without them it would start, and stay, below what the ring holds.
23957    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
23958    async fn the_opening_message_should_seed_the_exit_estimate() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
23959        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
23960
23961        let (mgr, _sender, _transport, _err_rx, _incoming) =
23962            started_manager_admitting_small_params(1..=small_params_quota(), false, None)?;
23963        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
23964
23965        let mut packet = start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(pix_offer()))?;
23966        packet.packet_info.num_saved_surbs = 2;
23967        let carried = packet.num_surbs_with_msg() as u64;
23968        assert!(carried > 0, "fixture: the opening must leave room for a SURB");
23969
23970        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet)?;
23971
23972        let produced = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
23973            loop {
23974                if let Some(slot) = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym) {
23975                    let produced = slot.surb_estimator.produced.load(Relaxed);
23976                    if produced > 0 {
23977                        return produced;
23978                    }
23979                }
23980                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
23981            }
23982        })
23983        .await
23984        .context("the opening's SURBs were never booked")?;
23985        assert_eq!(carried, produced, "the SURBs the opening's packet carried");
23986        Ok(())
23987    }
23988
23989    /// What the ring lost when the opening arrived is not the new Session's to book: its estimate never
23990    /// counted that stock, which a newer generation superseded from an earlier Session under the same
23991    /// pseudonym. Booked, it would start the estimate below the SURBs the opening brought, and the
23992    /// keep-alive reserve would hold data back with the ring holding them.
23993    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
23994    async fn an_opening_should_not_book_the_stock_it_superseded() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
23995        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
23996
23997        let (mgr, _sender, _transport, _err_rx, _incoming) =
23998            started_manager_admitting_small_params(1..=small_params_quota(), false, None)?;
23999        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
24000
24001        let mut packet = start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(pix_offer()))?;
24002        packet.packet_info.num_saved_surbs = 2;
24003        packet.packet_info.num_evicted_surbs = 40;
24004        let carried = packet.num_surbs_with_msg() as u64;
24005        assert!(carried > 0, "fixture: the opening must leave room for a SURB");
24006
24007        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet)?;
24008
24009        let (produced, evicted) = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
24010            loop {
24011                if let Some(slot) = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym) {
24012                    let produced = slot.surb_estimator.produced.load(Relaxed);
24013                    if produced > 0 {
24014                        return (produced, slot.surb_estimator.evicted.load(Relaxed));
24015                    }
24016                }
24017                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
24018            }
24019        })
24020        .await
24021        .context("the opening's SURBs were never booked")?;
24022        assert_eq!(carried, produced, "the SURBs the opening's packet carried");
24023        assert_eq!(0, evicted, "the superseded stock belonged to an earlier Session");
24024        Ok(())
24025    }

24027    /// An opening repeated for a Session that already exists is booked once, in dispatch. The Start
24028    /// task refuses it, and must not book it again: a wipe it reported would be subtracted twice.
24029    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
24030    async fn a_repeated_opening_should_be_booked_once() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
24031        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
24032
24033        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
24034        let (mgr, estimator) = exit_slot_for_keep_alives(pseudonym);
24035        let (new_session_tx, _new_sessions) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
24036        let (mock_sender, mut sent) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
24037        let _ahs = mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
24038
24039        // The pre-inserted slot has no `opening`, so this is not a recognised repeat and is refused as before.
24040        let mut packet = start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(no_pix_offer()))?;
24041        packet.packet_info.num_saved_surbs = 2;
24042        packet.packet_info.num_evicted_surbs = 1;
24043        let carried = packet.num_surbs_with_msg() as u64;
24044        assert!(carried > 0, "fixture: the opening must leave room for a SURB");
24045
24046        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet)?;
24047        // The refusal proves the Start task handled the duplicate. A second booking would come after it,
24048        // so the task is given a moment to finish before looking.
24049        let (_, refusal) = timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), sent.next())
24050            .await
24051            .context("the duplicate opening was never refused")?
24052            .context("the manager's sender closed before the refusal")?;
24053        assert!(
24054            crate::testing::msg_type(&refusal, StartProtocolDiscriminants::SessionError),
24055            "the Start task refuses the duplicate with a SessionError"
24056        );
24057        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
24058
24059        assert_eq!(carried, estimator.produced.load(Relaxed), "booked once");
24060        assert_eq!(1, estimator.evicted.load(Relaxed), "and its eviction once");
24061        Ok(())
24062    }

24064    /// A started PIX-capable Exit whose every sent message arrives on the returned receiver.
24065    fn exit_answering_repeats(
24066        admission: Option<SessionAdmissionSink>,
24067    ) -> anyhow::Result<(
24068        RecordingManager,
24069        Originated,
24070        futures::channel::mpsc::Receiver<IncomingSession>,
24071    )> {
24072        use hopr_protocol_pix::{SsaGeneratorConfig, SsaReconstructorConfig};
24073
24074        let mgr = RecordingManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
24075            pix_config: IncomingSessionPixConfig {
24076                quota_range: 1..=small_params_quota(),
24077                ..Default::default()
24078            },
24079            session_admission_timeout: Duration::from_secs(5),
24080            ..Default::default()
24081        });
24082        let pix_toolbox = pix_toolbox_with_pool(
24083            SsaShareGenerator::new(SsaGeneratorConfig {
24084                polynomials_per_ssa: 2,
24085                threshold: 2,
24086                surplus_shares: TEST_SURPLUS_SHARES,
24087            })
24088            .into(),
24089            SsaReconstructor::new(SsaReconstructorConfig::default()).into(),
24090        );
24091        let (mock_sender, sent) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
24092        let (new_session_tx, new_sessions) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(16);
24093        mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, Some(pix_toolbox), admission)?;
24094        Ok((mgr, sent, new_sessions))
24095    }

24097    /// Takes sent messages until one of kind `want` arrives; a `SessionError` on the way fails the test.
24098    async fn next_start_message(
24099        sent: &mut Originated,
24100        want: StartProtocolDiscriminants,
24101    ) -> anyhow::Result<HoprStartProtocol> {
24102        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
24103            while let Some((_, data)) = sent.next().await {
24104                let msg = HoprStartProtocol::decode(data.data.application_tag, &data.data.plain_text)?;
24105                if StartProtocolDiscriminants::from(msg.clone()) == want {
24106                    return Ok(msg);
24107                }
24108                anyhow::ensure!(
24109                    !matches!(msg, HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(_)),
24110                    "unexpected refusal: {msg:?}"
24111                );
24112            }
24113            anyhow::bail!("the manager's sender closed")
24114        })
24115        .await
24116        .with_context(|| format!("no {want:?} was sent"))?
24117    }
24118
24119    /// A repeated PIX opening that brought `saved` SURBs.
24120    fn repeated_start_packet(saved: usize) -> anyhow::Result<ApplicationDataIn> {
24121        let mut packet = start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(pix_offer()))?;
24122        packet.packet_info.num_saved_surbs = saved;
24123        Ok(packet)
24124    }

24126    /// Gives the Session a stock of SURBs to answer over, which its own control traffic would otherwise use up.
24127    fn give_surb_stock(mgr: &RecordingManager, pseudonym: HoprPseudonym) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
24128        let slot = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("the session slot must exist")?;
24129        slot.surb_estimator.produced.fetch_add(100, Ordering::Relaxed);
24130        Ok(())
24131    }

24133    /// Waits until the Exit has released its claim on `pseudonym`'s opening, i.e. the handler is done.
24134    async fn opening_released(mgr: &RecordingManager, pseudonym: HoprPseudonym) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
24135        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
24136            while mgr.incoming_openings.contains_key(&pseudonym) {
24137                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2)).await;
24138            }
24139        })
24140        .await
24141        .context("the opening's claim was never released")
24142    }

24144    /// Everything sent that is a `SessionError` or a `SessionEstablished`, after letting the Exit settle.
24145    async fn settled_answers(sent: &mut Originated) -> Vec<HoprStartProtocol> {
24146        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
24147        let mut answers = Vec::new();
24148        while let Ok((_, data)) = sent.try_recv() {
24149            if let Ok(msg @ (HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(_) | HoprStartProtocol::SessionEstablished(_))) =
24150                HoprStartProtocol::decode(data.data.application_tag, &data.data.plain_text)
24151            {
24152                answers.push(msg);
24153            }
24154        }
24155        answers
24156    }

24158    /// A repeated `StartSession` for an established Session gets one more `SessionEstablished` and nothing else.
24159    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
24160    async fn a_repeated_start_session_is_answered_with_session_established() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
24161        use crate::supervision::telemetry::probe;
24162
24163        probe::reset();
24164        let asked = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0));
24165        let (admission, handler) = spawn_admission_handler({
24166            let asked = asked.clone();
24167            move |_| {
24168                asked.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
24169                Ok(SessionAdmissionDecision::default())
24170            }
24171        });
24172        let (mgr, mut sent, _incoming) = exit_answering_repeats(Some(admission))?;
24173        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
24174
24175        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(pix_offer()))?)?;
24176        next_start_message(&mut sent, StartProtocolDiscriminants::SessionEstablished).await?;
24177        opening_released(&mgr, pseudonym).await?;
24178        give_surb_stock(&mgr, pseudonym)?;
24179        let reserved = mgr.live_cycle_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
24180        assert!(reserved > 0, "fixture: a PIX Session holds cycle budget");
24181        let _ = settled_answers(&mut sent).await;
24182
24183        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(pix_offer()))?)?;
24184        let HoprStartProtocol::SessionEstablished(est) =
24185            next_start_message(&mut sent, StartProtocolDiscriminants::SessionEstablished).await?
24186        else {
24187            anyhow::bail!("not a SessionEstablished");
24188        };
24189        assert_eq!((MIN_CHALLENGE, pseudonym), (est.orig_challenge, est.session_id));
24190        opening_released(&mgr, pseudonym).await?;
24191
24192        assert!(
24193            settled_answers(&mut sent).await.is_empty(),
24194            "no second answer and no refusal"
24195        );
24196        assert_eq!(1, asked.load(Ordering::Relaxed), "the session server is asked once");
24197        assert_eq!(
24198            reserved,
24199            mgr.live_cycle_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
24200            "no further budget"
24201        );
24202        assert_eq!(1, mgr.num_active_sessions());
24203        assert_eq!(1, probe::get("exit_control/session_established/pix/sent"));
24204        assert_eq!(1, probe::get("exit_control/session_established_replay/pix/sent"));
24205        assert_eq!(0, probe::get("exit_control/refusal_no_session_slot/pix/sent"));
24206        handler.abort();
24207        Ok(())
24208    }

24213    {

24218        next_start_message(&mut sent, StartProtocolDiscriminants::SessionEstablished).await?;
24219        opening_released(&mgr, pseudonym).await?;

24221        mgr.dispatch_message(
24222            pseudonym,

24225                ..pix_offer()

24241        assert_eq!(ErrorIdentifier::Challenge(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1), refusal.identifier);
24242        assert_eq!(StartErrorReason::NoSlotsAvailable, refusal.reason);
24243        Ok(())

24246    /// A repeat that arrives while the original is still being admitted is dropped; the original answers.
24247    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
24248    async fn a_repeat_arriving_while_the_original_is_admitted_is_dropped() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
24249        let (admission_tx, mut admission_rx) =
24250            futures::channel::mpsc::channel::<(SessionAdmissionRequest, crate::types::SessionAdmissionReply)>(4);
24251        let (release_tx, release_rx) = oneshot::channel::<()>();
24252        let handler = tokio::spawn(async move {
24253            if let Some((_, reply)) = admission_rx.next().await {
24254                let _ = release_rx.await;
24255                let _ = reply.send(Ok(SessionAdmissionDecision::default()));
24256            }
24257        });
24258        let (mgr, mut sent, _incoming) = exit_answering_repeats(Some(admission_tx))?;
24259        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
24260        let repeats_before = crate::counters::START_SESSION_REPEATS_RECEIVED.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
24261
24262        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(pix_offer()))?)?;
24263        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
24264            while !mgr.incoming_openings.contains_key(&pseudonym) {
24265                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2)).await;
24266            }
24267        })
24268        .await
24269        .context("the original was never claimed")?;
24270        let mut repeat = repeated_start_packet(3)?;
24271        repeat.packet_info.num_evicted_surbs = 2;
24272        let carried = repeat.num_surbs_with_msg() as u64;
24273        assert!(carried > 0, "fixture: the repeat must leave room for a SURB");
24274        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, repeat)?;
24275        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
24276            while crate::counters::START_SESSION_REPEATS_RECEIVED.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == repeats_before {
24277                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2)).await;
24278            }
24279        })
24280        .await
24281        .context("the repeat was never handled")?;
24282        release_tx
24283            .send(())
24284            .map_err(|_| anyhow!("the admission handler is gone"))?;
24285
24286        next_start_message(&mut sent, StartProtocolDiscriminants::SessionEstablished).await?;
24287        opening_released(&mgr, pseudonym).await?;
24288        let answers = settled_answers(&mut sent).await;
24289        assert!(
24290            answers.is_empty(),
24291            "exactly one SessionEstablished and no SessionError, got {answers:?}"
24292        );
24293        assert_eq!(1, mgr.num_active_sessions());
24294        let slot = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("the session slot must exist")?;
24295        assert_eq!(
24296            carried,
24297            slot.surb_estimator.produced.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
24298            "the repeat's SURBs are booked once the Session exists"
24299        );
24300        assert_eq!(
24301            2,
24302            slot.surb_estimator.evicted.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
24303            "and so are the SURBs it wiped"
24304        );
24305        handler.abort();
24306        Ok(())
24307    }

24309    /// A repeat that finds the original already booked, but its claim not yet released, is booked directly.
24310    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
24311    async fn a_repeat_after_the_original_booked_is_booked_directly() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
24312        let (mgr, mut sent, _incoming) = exit_answering_repeats(None)?;
24313        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
24314        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(pix_offer()))?)?;
24315        next_start_message(&mut sent, StartProtocolDiscriminants::SessionEstablished).await?;
24316        opening_released(&mgr, pseudonym).await?;
24317
24318        // The window between the original's booking and the release of its claim.
24319        mgr.incoming_openings.insert(
24320            pseudonym,
24321            Arc::new(InFlightOpening {
24322                challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE,
24323                pending: parking_lot::Mutex::new(None),
24324            }),
24325        );
24326        let slot = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("the session slot must exist")?;
24327        let before = slot.surb_estimator.produced.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
24328        // Handed to the lane directly: what dispatch could not book for want of a slot.
24329        let lane = mgr.start_session_tx.get().context("the manager must be started")?;
24330        lane.try_send((
24331            pseudonym,
24332            HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(pix_offer()),
24333            Default::default(),
24334            SurbsStored { saved: 3, evicted: 1 },
24335            tracing::Span::none(),
24336        ))
24337        .map_err(|error| anyhow!("the lane refused the repeat: {error}"))?;
24338
24339        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
24340            while slot.surb_estimator.produced.load(Ordering::Relaxed) < before + 3 {
24341                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2)).await;
24342            }
24343        })
24344        .await
24345        .context("the repeat's SURBs were never booked")?;
24346        assert_eq!(1, slot.surb_estimator.evicted.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
24347        mgr.incoming_openings.invalidate(&pseudonym);
24348        Ok(())
24349    }

24383    /// SURBs a repeat carries onto a replay's claim are booked with the replay's, and later ones go straight to the
24384    /// slot.
24385    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
24386    async fn surbs_carried_onto_a_replays_claim_are_booked_with_it() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
24387        let (mgr, mut sent, _incoming) = exit_answering_repeats(None)?;
24388        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
24389        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(pix_offer()))?)?;
24390        next_start_message(&mut sent, StartProtocolDiscriminants::SessionEstablished).await?;
24391        opening_released(&mgr, pseudonym).await?;
24392        let slot = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("the session slot must exist")?;
24393        let estimator = &slot.surb_estimator;
24394        let booked = || {
24395            (
24396                estimator.produced.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
24397                estimator.evicted.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
24398            )
24399        };
24400        let (produced, evicted) = booked();
24401        let claim = InFlightOpening {
24402            challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE,
24403            pending: parking_lot::Mutex::new(Some(SurbsStored::default())),
24404        };
24405
24406        // A second repeat lands on the replay's claim while the replay is in flight: carried, not booked.
24407        mgr.carry_or_book_repeat_surbs(&claim, &pseudonym, SurbsStored { saved: 3, evicted: 1 });
24408        assert_eq!((produced, evicted), booked());
24409
24410        // The replay books its own and the carried counts together.
24411        book_replay_surbs(&claim, &slot, &pseudonym, SurbsStored { saved: 2, evicted: 0 });
24412        assert_eq!((produced + 5, evicted + 1), booked());
24413
24414        // Once drained, a later repeat books directly.
24415        mgr.carry_or_book_repeat_surbs(&claim, &pseudonym, SurbsStored { saved: 4, evicted: 0 });
24416        assert_eq!((produced + 9, evicted + 1), booked());
24417        Ok(())
24418    }
