26316    // Four tests lived here, all asserting how many `SsaRequest` messages an `SsaAlmostRecovered` or
26317    // `SsaRecovered` event produced: `exit_requests_new_ssa_after_almost_recovered_event`,
26318    // `exit_ignores_stale_ssa_almost_recovered_event`,
26319    // `exit_handles_concurrent_almost_and_full_recovery_for_same_ssa` and
26320    // `exit_requests_new_ssa_on_recovery_when_not_already_pipelined`.
26321    //
26322    // That decision is the supervisor's now, and each of them has a direct counterpart against the
26323    // state machine: `almost_recovered_while_recovering_requests_next_once`,
26324    // `almost_recovered_while_awaiting_deposit_defers_request`,
26325    // `recovered_with_prior_early_event_does_not_fallback` and
26326    // `recovered_without_prior_early_event_falls_back_to_request`. Reaching the same logic through
26327    // an event channel, an action channel and a spawned driver only added scheduling noise — and
26328    // three of the four asserted a pipelining that no longer happens on an unfunded SSA, which is
26329    // the deliberate change: the Exit does not commit to another SSA before the current one is paid
26330    // for.
26331    //
26332    // What those tests did cover that the state machine cannot is the wiring itself, in both
26333    // directions. Actions reaching the wire is `the_opening_ssa_request_follows_session_established`
26334    // below; events reaching the supervisor is `session_is_closed_on_the_first_unverifiable_share`.
26335
26336    /// Verifies that the supervisor's opening `RequestSsa` reaches the wire, and does so *after* the
26337    /// `SessionEstablished` that publishes the Session.
26338    ///
26339    /// The ordering is why the supervisor is spawned where it is. An `SsaRequest` arriving first
26340    /// would reference a Session the Entry has not been told exists.
26341    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
26342    async fn the_opening_ssa_request_follows_session_established() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
26343        use std::sync::Arc;
26344
26345        use hopr_protocol_pix::{SsaGeneratorConfig, SsaReconstructorConfig};
26346        use hopr_protocol_start::StartInitiation;
26347
26348        let pix_toolbox = pix_toolbox_with_pool(
26349            SsaShareGenerator::new(SsaGeneratorConfig {
26350                polynomials_per_ssa: 2,
26351                threshold: 2,
26352                surplus_shares: 1,
26353            })
26354            .into(),
26355            SsaReconstructor::new(SsaReconstructorConfig::default()).into(),
26356        );
26357
26358        let mgr = SessionManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
26359            pix_config: IncomingSessionPixConfig {
26360                quota_range: 0..=1024 * 1024 * 1024,
26361                ..Default::default()
26362            },
26363            ..Default::default()
26364        });
26365
26366        // Records the kind of every outbound Start message, in order.
26367        let sent = Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(Vec::<&'static str>::new()));
26368        let sent_clone = sent.clone();
26369        let mut bob_transport = MockMsgSender::new();
26370        bob_transport.expect_send_message().returning(move |_, data| {
26371            let sent_clone = sent_clone.clone();
26372            Box::pin(async move {
26373                match HoprStartProtocol::decode(data.data.application_tag, &data.data.plain_text) {
26374                    Ok(HoprStartProtocol::SessionEstablished(_)) => sent_clone.lock().unwrap().push("established"),
26375                    Ok(HoprStartProtocol::SsaRequest(req)) => {
26376                        assert_eq!(
26377                            req.dimensions().expect("SsaRequest params must be in range"),
26378                            PixParams::try_new(2, 2, TEST_SURPLUS_SHARES, LOCAL_PIX_SUITE).expect("valid"),
26379                            "SsaRequest must carry the negotiated dimensions, surplus included"
26380                        );
26381                        assert_eq!(
26382                            req.commitments.keys().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
26383                            [SsaIndex::MIN],
26384                            "the opening request must commit to the first SSA index"
26385                        );
26386                        sent_clone.lock().unwrap().push("ssa_request");
26387                    }
26388                    _ => {}
26389                }
26390                Ok(())
26391            })
26392        });
26393
26394        let (bob_sender, bob_handle) = mock_packet_planning(bob_transport);
26395        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
26396        let _notifications = tokio::spawn(async move {
26397            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
26398            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
26399        });
26400        mgr.start(bob_sender.clone(), new_session_tx, Some(pix_toolbox), None)?;
26401
26402        let alice_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
26403        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(
26404            alice_pseudonym,
26405            StartInitiation {
26406                challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE,
26407                target: SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
26408                capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities(Capability::UsePIX.into()),
26409                additional_data: small_pix_additional_data(),
26410            },
26411        )
26412        .await?;
26413
26414        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
26415            while sent.lock().unwrap().len() < 2 {
26416                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
26417            }
26418        })
26419        .await
26420        .context("the supervisor's opening SsaRequest never reached the wire")?;
26421
26422        assert_eq!(
26423            sent.lock().unwrap().as_slice(),
26424            ["established", "ssa_request"],
26425            "the Entry must learn the Session exists before it is asked to commit to an SSA"
26426        );
26427
26428        bob_sender.close_channel();
26429        bob_handle.await??;
26430        Ok(())
26431    }

26433    /// A pool that does not supply deposit data must take the Session with it, and name itself.
26434    ///
26435    /// The data only ever travels in the `SsaRequest` that carries the commitments, so an Entry that
26436    /// needs it and does not get it cannot ask for it later — it would simply never deposit, and the
26437    /// Session would die on the Exit's own commitment deadline, blamed on the peer. Failing here
26438    /// costs one Session that was not going to work, and points at the local pool instead: the Entry
26439    /// is told `UnacceptablePixParams`, a permanent reason, rather than the supervisor's generic
26440    /// `Unknown`, and this node records [`ClosureReason::MissingDepositData`] rather than `PixFailure`. A pool
26441    /// that is merely slow is told `Busy` instead, see the `request_deposit_data` tests below.
26442    ///
26443    /// The event stream is dropped rather than left unanswered, which reaches the same failure
26444    /// through the listener check instead of [`DEPOSIT_DATA_REQUEST_TIMEOUT`] — the same error, the
26445    /// same close, three seconds sooner. What the collection itself does with a pool that answers
26446    /// badly is covered by the `request_deposit_data` tests below.
26447    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
26448    async fn missing_deposit_data_closes_the_session_and_names_the_pool() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
26449        use std::sync::Arc;
26450
26451        use hopr_protocol_pix::{SsaGeneratorConfig, SsaReconstructorConfig};
26452        use hopr_protocol_start::StartInitiation;
26453
26454        // Deliberately *not* `pix_toolbox_with_pool`: nothing answers, which is the case under test.
26455        let (pix_toolbox, pix_events) = PixToolbox::new(
26456            SsaShareGenerator::new(SsaGeneratorConfig {
26457                polynomials_per_ssa: 2,
26458                threshold: 2,
26459                surplus_shares: 1,
26460            })
26461            .into(),
26462            SsaReconstructor::new(SsaReconstructorConfig::default()).into(),
26463        );
26464        drop(pix_events);
26465
26466        let mgr = SessionManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
26467            pix_config: IncomingSessionPixConfig {
26468                quota_range: 0..=1024 * 1024 * 1024,
26469                ..Default::default()
26470            },
26471            ..Default::default()
26472        });
26473
26474        // Records the kind of every outbound Start message, with the reason of any SessionError.
26475        let sent = Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(Vec::<String>::new()));
26476        let sent_clone = sent.clone();
26477        let mut bob_transport = MockMsgSender::new();
26478        bob_transport.expect_send_message().returning(move |_, data| {
26479            let sent_clone = sent_clone.clone();
26480            Box::pin(async move {
26481                match HoprStartProtocol::decode(data.data.application_tag, &data.data.plain_text) {
26482                    Ok(HoprStartProtocol::SessionEstablished(_)) => {
26483                        sent_clone.lock().unwrap().push("established".into())
26484                    }
26485                    Ok(HoprStartProtocol::SsaRequest(_)) => sent_clone.lock().unwrap().push("ssa_request".into()),
26486                    Ok(HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(err)) => {
26487                        sent_clone.lock().unwrap().push(format!("error:{}", err.reason))
26488                    }
26489                    _ => {}
26490                }
26491                Ok(())
26492            })
26493        });
26494
26495        let (bob_sender, bob_handle) = mock_packet_planning(bob_transport);
26496        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
26497        let _notifications = tokio::spawn(async move {
26498            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
26499            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
26500        });
26501        mgr.start(bob_sender.clone(), new_session_tx, Some(pix_toolbox), None)?;
26502
26503        let alice_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
26504        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(
26505            alice_pseudonym,
26506            StartInitiation {
26507                challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE,
26508                target: SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
26509                capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities(Capability::UsePIX.into()),
26510                additional_data: small_pix_additional_data(),
26511            },
26512        )
26513        .await?;
26514
26515        timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
26516            while mgr.num_active_sessions() > 0 {
26517                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
26518            }
26519        })
26520        .await
26521        .context("the Session must not survive a pool that cannot supply deposit data")?;
26522
26523        let sent = sent.lock().unwrap().clone();
26524        assert!(
26525            !sent.iter().any(|m| m == "ssa_request"),
26526            "no SsaRequest may go on the wire without the deposit data it has to carry, got {sent:?}"
26527        );
26528        assert!(
26529            sent.iter()
26530                .any(|m| m == &format!("error:{}", StartErrorReason::UnacceptablePixParams)),
26531            "the Entry must be told with a permanent reason, got {sent:?}"
26532        );
26533
26534        bob_sender.close_channel();
26535        bob_handle.await??;
26536        Ok(())
26537    }

26539    // `pipelined_ssa_preserves_earlier_deposit_deadline` lived here. It asserted that
26540    // `PixKillSwitch(1)` and `PixKillSwitch(2)` were independent entries in the `AbortableList`,
26541    // which is no longer a thing the manager can observe: per-SSA deadlines belong to the
26542    // supervisor. The invariant moved with them, to
26543    // `supervision::supervisor::tests::pipelining_a_second_ssa_leaves_the_first_ones_deadlines_alone`,
26544    // where it can compare the deadline instants rather than just the presence of two handles.
26545
26546    /// Verifies that an explicit `close_session` leaves no reconstructor state behind for an SSA
26547    /// cycle that was still in flight.
26548    ///
26549    /// Retirement used to be an explicit sweep over every index the Session had ever used; it is
26550    /// now a consequence of aborting the action driver, which drops the guards it holds. This
26551    /// exercises one cycle because that is all a mock transport can get in flight — pipelining a
26552    /// second needs a funded first, and funding arrives from the chain. The multi-cycle case is
26553    /// covered where the guards are: `protocols/pix`'s guard tests and the supervisor's own suite.
26554    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
26555    async fn close_session_retires_in_flight_ssa_cycles() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
26556        let pix_toolbox = pix_toolbox_with_pool(
26557            SsaShareGenerator::new(SsaGeneratorConfig {
26558                polynomials_per_ssa: 2,
26559                threshold: 2,
26560                surplus_shares: 1,
26561            })
26562            .into(),
26563            SsaReconstructor::new(SsaReconstructorConfig::default()).into(),
26564        );
26565        let mgr = SessionManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
26566            pix_config: IncomingSessionPixConfig {
26567                quota_range: 0..=1024 * 1024 * 1024,
26568                ..Default::default()
26569            },
26570            ..Default::default()
26571        });
26572        let mut bob_transport = MockMsgSender::new();
26573        bob_transport
26574            .expect_send_message()
26575            .returning(|_, _| Box::pin(async { Ok(()) }));
26576        let (bob_sender, bob_handle) = mock_packet_planning(bob_transport);
26577        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
26578        let _notifications = tokio::spawn(async move {
26579            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
26580            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
26581        });
26582        mgr.start(bob_sender.clone(), new_session_tx, Some(pix_toolbox), None)?;
26583
26584        let alice_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
26585        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(
26586            alice_pseudonym,
26587            StartInitiation {
26588                challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE,
26589                target: SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
26590                capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities(Capability::UsePIX.into()),
26591                additional_data: small_pix_additional_data(),
26592            },
26593        )
26594        .await?;
26595
26596        // Grab a reference to the reconstructor before close_session consumes the slot.
26597        let pix_toolbox_ref = mgr.pix_toolbox.get().unwrap().clone();
26598        let share_processor = pix_toolbox_ref.share_processor;
26599
26600        let ssa1 = SsaId::new(alice_pseudonym, SsaIndex::MIN);
26601
26602        // Precondition: the first cycle's builder exists, so the assertion below proves actual
26603        // retirement rather than the absence of a builder that was never created. The supervisor's
26604        // opening `RequestSsa` reaches the driver asynchronously, so this waits rather than assumes.
26605        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
26606            while !share_processor.contains_builder(&ssa1) {
26607                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
26608            }
26609        })
26610        .await
26611        .context("the opening SSA request never registered a builder")?;
26612
26613        mgr.close_session(&alice_pseudonym);
26614
26615        // Aborting the driver drops the `SsaCommitmentGuard`s it owns, which releases each SSA's
26616        // reconstructor state. The abort takes effect at the next scheduling point, hence the wait.
26617        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
26618            while share_processor.contains_builder(&ssa1) {
26619                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
26620            }
26621        })
26622        .await
26623        .context("close_session left the in-flight SSA's reconstructor state behind")?;
26624
26625        bob_sender.close_channel();
26626        bob_handle.await??;
26627        Ok(())
26628    }

26690                capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities(Capability::UsePIX.into()),
26691                additional_data: small_pix_additional_data(),
26692            },
26693        )
26694        .await?;
26695
26696        let session_id = alice_pseudonym;
26697
26698        // Server sends dimensions of (10, 10) while we offered (2, 2) — should be rejected.
26699        let result = mgr
26700            .handle_ssa_request(
26701                alice_pseudonym,
26702                SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(
26703                    session_id,
26704                    PixParams::try_new(10, 10, 0, LOCAL_PIX_SUITE)?,
26705                    BTreeMap::new(),
26706                    [],
26707                ),
26708            )
26709            .await;
26710
26711        bob_sender.close_channel();
26712        bob_handle.await??;
26713
26714        assert!(result.is_err());
26715        assert!(matches!(
26716            result.unwrap_err(),
26717            TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::Unacceptable(_))
26718        ));
26719
26720        Ok(())
26721    }

26723    /// The default live-cycle budget must admit at least as many PIX Sessions as a node manages by
26724    /// default, or the Session limit stops being the first one reached and the documented default
26725    /// no longer holds.
26726    ///
26727    /// The per-Session figure is what admission reserves at the default batch of one, not the bare
26728    /// peak of one cycle: `cycle_budget_for` multiplies by `MAX_OVERLAPPING_BATCHES`.
26729    #[test]
26730    fn default_live_cycle_budget_admits_the_default_managed_session_count() {
26731        // Default of `maximum_managed_sessions` in `hopr-transport`'s `HoprProtocolConfig`, which is
26732        // not visible from this crate; keep in step with it.
26733        const DEFAULT_MANAGED_SESSIONS: u64 = 100;
26734
26735        let per_session = cycle_budget_for(&DEFAULT_PIX_PARAMS, 1);
26736        let budget = IncomingSessionPixConfig::default().max_live_cycle_bytes;
26737
26738        assert!(
26739            budget / per_session >= DEFAULT_MANAGED_SESSIONS,
26740            "a {budget}-byte budget at {per_session} bytes per Session admits {} Sessions, fewer than the \
26741             {DEFAULT_MANAGED_SESSIONS} a node manages by default",
26742            budget / per_session
26743        );
26744    }
26745
26746    /// The Entry must not admit a successor before a default Exit could possibly have produced its
26747    /// early-recovery request.
26748    ///
26749    /// Recovery is counted in completed polynomials, while emission is windowed. Every fully drained
26750    /// window before the one containing the 85% boundary has already emitted both threshold and
26751    /// surplus shares. Dividing 85% by the global surplus factor therefore underestimates the
26752    /// boundary. At the deployed split (`DEFAULT_PIX_PARAMS`, whose factor is 3.47x) the first
26753    /// possible early signal is about 83% through emission, not 24.5%; those figures belong to that
26754    /// split and move with it.
26755    ///
26756    /// The gate compares against `min_emission_for_early_recovery` directly, so this test recomputes
26757    /// the boundary independently — from the same first principles, but without calling the function
26758    /// under test — and checks the two agree. A shared helper would agree with itself.
26759    #[test]
26760    fn successor_gate_waits_until_default_early_recovery_can_be_reached() {
26761        let params = DEFAULT_PIX_PARAMS;
26762        let polys = params.polys_per_ssa() as u64;
26763        let threshold = params.shares_per_poly() as u64;
26764        let surplus = params.surplus_shares() as u64;
26765        let window = (hopr_protocol_pix::SHARE_EMISSION_WINDOW as u64).min(polys);
26766        // The floor, because that is what the gate is computed at — see
26767        // `MIN_EARLY_RECOVERY_THRESHOLD`. The default must not sit below it, or a stock Exit would
26768        // ask before a stock Entry admits.
26769        let early = hopr_protocol_pix::MIN_EARLY_RECOVERY_THRESHOLD;
26770        assert!(
26771            SsaReconstructorConfig::default().early_recovery_threshold >= early,
26772            "the shipped default must be admissible under the protocol floor it is gated against"
26773        );
26774        let needed = (early * polys as f64).ceil() as u64;
26775
26776        // `needed` lies in this window. Earlier windows are fully exhausted, including surplus;
26777        // inside this one, `threshold - 1` complete passes and `in_window` shares of the threshold
26778        // pass are the absolute minimum that can have been emitted before those polynomials recover.
26779        let prior_windows = (needed - 1) / window;
26780        let prior_polys = prior_windows * window;
26781        let current_width = window.min(polys - prior_polys);
26782        let in_window = needed - prior_polys;
26783        let minimum_emitted = prior_polys * (threshold + surplus) + (threshold - 1) * current_width + in_window;
26784        let minimum_fraction = minimum_emitted as f64 / (polys * (threshold + surplus)) as f64;
26785
26786        let gate = hopr_protocol_pix::min_emission_for_early_recovery(&params, early);
26787        assert_eq!(
26788            minimum_emitted,
26789            gate,
26790            "the successor gate opens at {} shares ({:.1}% of emission) against an independently derived earliest \
26791             honest request of {minimum_emitted} ({:.1}%); any shortfall permits a hostile Exit to solicit a deposit \
26792             before it is earned",
26793            gate,
26794            gate as f64 / (polys * (threshold + surplus)) as f64 * 100.0,
26795            minimum_fraction * 100.0,
26796        );
26797
26798        // And the estimate this replaced is demonstrably below it, so the test would have caught it.
26799        assert!(
26800            ((early / 1.5) * (polys * (threshold + surplus)) as f64) < gate as f64,
26801            "the surplus-factor estimate must sit below the real boundary"
26802        );
26803    }
26804
26805    /// Dimensions wide enough that the protocol floor and a stricter local threshold disagree.
26806    ///
26807    /// At `small_pix_params`' two polynomials, `ceil(0.85 x 2)` and `ceil(1.0 x 2)` are both 2, so
26808    /// every threshold in range produces the same boundary and a test built on them cannot tell which
26809    /// one the gate used. Eight separates them: 7 polynomials against 8.
26810    fn wide_pix_params() -> PixParams {
26811        PixParams::try_new(8, 2, TEST_SURPLUS_SHARES, LOCAL_PIX_SUITE).expect("test dimensions must be valid")
26812    }

26814    /// What a fixture's transport has been asked to put on the wire.
26815    #[derive(Default)]
26816    struct WireRecord {
26817        sent: parking_lot::Mutex<Vec<StartProtocolDiscriminants>>,
26818    }
26819
26820    impl WireRecord {
26821        /// How many Start messages of `kind` have been sent so far.
26822        fn count(&self, kind: StartProtocolDiscriminants) -> usize {
26823            self.sent.lock().iter().filter(|sent| **sent == kind).count()
26824        }
26825    }

26827    /// Builds an Entry-side manager serving `params`, with the reconstructor at `early_threshold`.

26846    /// [`entry_with_pix_session`], whose transport also records what it is asked to send.

26849    /// must emit neither a `ReadyToDeposit` nor a second `SsaCommit` burst, and only the transport
26850    /// can say the second part of that.
26851    #[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]
26852    async fn entry_with_recorded_pix_session(
26853        params: PixParams,

26857        SessionManager<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>,
26858        Arc<SsaShareGenerator<HoprPixSpec>>,
26859        HoprPseudonym,

26867    /// [`entry_with_recorded_pix_session`], whose manager sends through `wrap(sender)` instead of the
26868    /// plain channel sender.
26869    ///
26870    /// For the tests that need the Entry's transport to fail *selectively*: a channel sender can only
26871    /// fail by being closed, and it never recovers. The returned sender is the unwrapped one, so
26872    /// the test can still close the channel and join the forwarding task.
26873    #[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]
26874    async fn entry_with_wrapped_sender<S>(
26875        params: PixParams,
26876        early_threshold: f64,
26877        wire: Arc<WireRecord>,
26878        wrap: impl FnOnce(UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>) -> S,
26879    ) -> anyhow::Result<(
26880        SessionManager<S>,
26881        Arc<SsaShareGenerator<HoprPixSpec>>,
26882        HoprPseudonym,
26883        impl futures::Stream<Item = HoprSessionOutPixEvent> + Unpin,
26884        UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>,
26885        tokio::task::JoinHandle<anyhow::Result<()>>,
26886    )>
26887    where
26888        S: futures::Sink<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)> + Clone + Send + Sync + Unpin + 'static,
26889        S::Error: std::error::Error + Send + Sync + Clone + 'static,
26890    {
26891        use hopr_protocol_start::StartInitiation;
26892
26893        let generator = Arc::new(SsaShareGenerator::new(SsaGeneratorConfig {
26894            polynomials_per_ssa: params.polys_per_ssa(),
26895            threshold: params.shares_per_poly(),
26896            surplus_shares: params.surplus_shares(),
26897        }));
26898        let (pix_toolbox, pix_events) = PixToolbox::new(
26899            generator.clone(),
26900            SsaReconstructor::new(SsaReconstructorConfig {
26901                early_recovery_threshold: early_threshold,
26902                ..Default::default()
26903            })
26904            .into(),
26905        );
26906        // This fixture's manager plays both halves, so its own Exit side opens a cycle and blocks on
26907        // the deposit pool. Answered on the way through, leaving the stream the caller reads — which
26908        // is the deposits — as it was.
26909        let pix_events = crate::testing::answering_deposit_pool(pix_events, |_| Vec::new());
26910
26911        let mgr = SessionManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
26912            pix_config: IncomingSessionPixConfig {
26913                quota_range: 0..=1024 * 1024 * 1024,
26914                ..Default::default()
26915            },
26916            ..Default::default()
26917        });
26918
26919        let mut bob_transport = MockMsgSender::new();
26920        bob_transport.expect_send_message().returning(move |_, data| {
26921            let wire = wire.clone();
26922            Box::pin(async move {
26923                let Ok(message) = HoprStartProtocol::decode(data.data.application_tag, &data.data.plain_text) else {
26924                    return Ok(());
26925                };
26926                wire.sent.lock().push(StartProtocolDiscriminants::from(message));
26927                Ok(())
26928            })
26929        });
26930        let (bob_sender, bob_handle) = mock_packet_planning(bob_transport);
26931        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
26932        tokio::spawn(async move {
26933            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
26934            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
26935        });
26936        mgr.start(wrap(bob_sender.clone()), new_session_tx, Some(pix_toolbox), None)?;
26937
26938        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
26939        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(
26940            pseudonym,
26941            StartInitiation {
26942                challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE,
26943                target: SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
26944                capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities(Capability::UsePIX.into()),
26945                additional_data: into_initiation_additional_data(params.into_additional_data(0), Duration::ZERO),
26946            },
26947        )
26948        .await?;
26949
26950        Ok((mgr, generator, pseudonym, pix_events, bob_sender, bob_handle))
26951    }

26953    /// One SSA commitment at `index`, from the identity element the Exit-side point is not checked
26954    /// against here.
26955    fn ssa_request_for(index: u32) -> std::collections::BTreeMap<SsaIndex, HoprPixGroupElement> {
26956        let identity = HoprPixGroupElement::try_from(
26957            hopr_protocol_pix::PixGroup::<HoprPixSpec>::default()
26958                .to_bytes()
26959                .as_ref(),
26960        )
26961        .expect("identity element must be valid");
26962        std::collections::BTreeMap::from([(SsaIndex::new(index).expect("non-zero"), identity)])
26963    }
26964
26965    /// Drains whatever the PIX event stream has ready, counting the deposits among it.
26966    ///
26967    /// Only [`ReadyToDeposit`](HoprSessionOutPixEvent::ReadyToDeposit) is counted: an Exit sharing
26968    /// this stream also asks its pool for deposit data on it, and every caller here is asking how
26969    /// many cycles were opened, not how many messages went by.
26970    async fn drain_pix_events(events: &mut (dyn futures::Stream<Item = HoprSessionOutPixEvent> + Unpin)) -> usize {
26971        let mut seen = 0;
26972        // A bounded wait rather than `now_or_never`: these fixtures answer the Exit half's
26973        // deposit-data requests on a forwarding task, so an event that has already been produced may
26974        // not have crossed it yet. The wait is only paid once, when the stream has gone quiet.
26975        while let Ok(Some(event)) = timeout(Duration::from_millis(50), events.next()).await {
26976            if matches!(event, HoprSessionOutPixEvent::ReadyToDeposit(_)) {
26977                seen += 1;
26978            }
26979        }
26980        seen
26981    }
26982
26983    /// Credits `count` Exit → Entry packets to the Session, as its receive path would.
26984    ///
26985    /// These fixtures build their slot through `handle_incoming_session_initiation`, whose receive
26986    /// path counts the *outgoing* direction, so the Entry-side counter the successor gate reads has
26987    /// to be driven by hand. `returned_packets_are_counted_on_the_entry_receive_path` is what pins
26988    /// that a real Entry Session advances it; here it only has to move.
26989    fn credit_returned_packets<S>(mgr: &SessionManager<S>, pseudonym: &HoprPseudonym, count: u64)
26990    where
26991        S: futures::Sink<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)> + Clone + Send + Sync + Unpin + 'static,
26992        S::Error: std::error::Error + Send + Sync + 'static,
26993    {
26994        mgr.sessions
26995            .get(pseudonym)
26996            .expect("session must exist")
26997            .returned_packets
26998            .fetch_add(count, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
26999    }
27000
27001    /// Packets the successor gate requires before it will admit a batch beyond `watermark`.
27002    ///
27003    /// Mirrors `handle_ssa_request`'s boundary rather than calling it, so that a change to the
27004    /// boundary has to be restated here — a helper shared with the code under test would agree with
27005    /// itself whatever either of them did. The bar set below that boundary is
27006    /// [`successor_required_packets`] itself, which
27007    /// `the_successor_bar_is_a_lower_confidence_bound_on_honest_arrivals` pins against values computed
27008    /// independently.
27009    fn required_returned_packets(params: &PixParams, watermark: u32) -> u64 {
27010        let min_emitted =
27011            hopr_protocol_pix::min_emission_for_early_recovery(params, hopr_protocol_pix::MIN_EARLY_RECOVERY_THRESHOLD);
27012        let shares_per_cycle = params.polys_per_ssa() as u64 * params.emitted_shares_per_poly() as u64;
27013        let target = (watermark as u64 - 1) * shares_per_cycle + min_emitted;
27014        successor_required_packets(target, params.tolerated_share_loss())
27015    }
27016
27017    /// The successor gate must open at the protocol floor, not at the local reconstructor's threshold.
27018    ///
27019    /// The value that decides when a correct Exit asks for its next batch is the *peer's*
27020    /// `early_recovery_threshold`, and it does not travel on the wire. Deriving the boundary from the
27021    /// Entry's own copy meant two individually valid configurations could not communicate: an Exit
27022    /// configured lower sent its request before the gate opened and the Entry dropped it silently.
27023    /// Before the Exit re-sent an unanswered successor request that was fatal — the Session died on
27024    /// `max_ssa_delivery_time` waiting for a commitment that had been deliberately refused, visible on
27025    /// neither node as a configuration error. It is now a stream of refusals until emission catches
27026    /// up, which is why the boundary still has to be the floor's: a gate on the local value would
27027    /// refuse a conforming Exit for longer than it needs to.
27028    ///
27029    /// So the gate is computed at [`hopr_protocol_pix::MIN_EARLY_RECOVERY_THRESHOLD`], which
27030    /// `validate_pix_supervision` holds every Exit to. This fixture puts the local reconstructor at
27031    /// `1.0` — the strictest end of the range — and asks at exactly the floor's boundary. A gate built
27032    /// on the local value wants one more share and refuses.
27033    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
27034    async fn successor_gate_opens_at_the_protocol_floor_not_the_local_threshold() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
27035        let params = wide_pix_params();
27036        let (mgr, generator, pseudonym, mut pix_events, bob_sender, bob_handle) =
27037            entry_with_pix_session(params, 1.0).await?;
27038
27039        mgr.handle_ssa_request(
27040            pseudonym,
27041            SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(1), []),
27042        )
27043        .await
27044        .context("the opening batch must be accepted")?;
27045        assert_eq!(1, drain_pix_events(&mut pix_events).await);
27046
27047        // Fully served, so that the emission boundary is the only thing this test can be measuring.
27048        credit_returned_packets(&mgr, &pseudonym, required_returned_packets(&params, 1));
27049
27050        let at_floor = hopr_protocol_pix::min_emission_for_early_recovery(
27051            &params,
27052            hopr_protocol_pix::MIN_EARLY_RECOVERY_THRESHOLD,
27053        );
27054        let at_local = hopr_protocol_pix::min_emission_for_early_recovery(&params, 1.0);
27055        assert!(
27056            at_floor < at_local,
27057            "the fixture must separate the two boundaries, got {at_floor} and {at_local}"
27058        );
27059
27060        // One share short of the floor's boundary, the request is early under either reading.
27061        for sent in 1..at_floor as u32 {
27062            generator.next_share(&pseudonym, &sent.to_be_bytes())?;
27063        }
27064        let err = mgr
27065            .handle_ssa_request(
27066                pseudonym,
27067                SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(2), []),
27068            )
27069            .await
27070            .expect_err("a request one share below the boundary must be refused");
27071        assert!(
27072            matches!(err, TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::NotAdmitted(_))),
27073            "expected NotAdmitted, got {err:?}"
27074        );
27075        assert_eq!(0, drain_pix_events(&mut pix_events).await);
27076
27077        // On the boundary itself it is admitted — and would not be if the gate read the local 1.0.
27078        generator.next_share(&pseudonym, &at_floor.to_be_bytes())?;
27079        assert_eq!(
27080            at_floor,
27081            generator
27082                .emission_progress(&pseudonym)
27083                .expect("committed")
27084                .front_emitted,
27085            "the fixture must stand exactly on the floor's boundary"
27086        );
27087        mgr.handle_ssa_request(
27088            pseudonym,
27089            SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(2), []),
27090        )
27091        .await
27092        .context("a request at the protocol floor must be accepted whatever the local threshold is")?;
27093        assert_eq!(1, drain_pix_events(&mut pix_events).await);
27094
27095        bob_sender.close_channel();
27096        bob_handle.await??;
27097        Ok(())
27098    }
27099
27100    /// A successor request arriving after the generator's state was discarded must be refused.
27101    ///
27102    /// The gate only applies where there is emission progress to measure, and absent progress is
27103    /// otherwise the ordinary opening batch. But the generator keeps its per-pseudonym state in a
27104    /// cache with an idle retention refreshed by share *emission*, so a Session kept alive while the
27105    /// Entry emits nothing outlives it — and the successor gate is then not relaxed but deleted, along
27106    /// with the monotonic index the discarded entry carried. An Exit that arranges that farms one
27107    /// unearned deposit per retention period, which is the exposure the gate exists to close.
27108    ///
27109    /// `forget` reaches the same state the retention would, deliberately: an evicted entry and an
27110    /// explicitly dropped one are indistinguishable from the outside, which is precisely why the fact
27111    /// that a batch *was* committed has to be held somewhere that lives as long as the Session.
27112    ///
27113    /// The opening request in this test is the other half of the property — absent state with nothing
27114    /// committed is still admitted, or no PIX Session could ever start.
27115    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
27116    async fn an_ssa_request_against_discarded_generator_state_is_refused_and_closes_the_session() -> anyhow::Result<()>
27117    {
27118        let params = small_pix_params();
27119        let (mgr, generator, pseudonym, mut pix_events, bob_sender, bob_handle) =
27120            entry_with_pix_session(params, SsaReconstructorConfig::default().early_recovery_threshold).await?;
27121
27122        mgr.handle_ssa_request(
27123            pseudonym,
27124            SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(1), []),
27125        )
27126        .await
27127        .context("the opening batch must be accepted")?;
27128        assert_eq!(1, drain_pix_events(&mut pix_events).await);
27129        assert_eq!(vec![pseudonym], mgr.active_sessions());
27130
27131        generator.forget(&pseudonym);
27132        assert!(
27133            generator.emission_progress(&pseudonym).is_none(),
27134            "the fixture must reproduce the state an idle eviction leaves behind"
27135        );
27136
27137        let err = mgr
27138            .handle_ssa_request(
27139                pseudonym,
27140                SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(2), []),
27141            )
27142            .await
27143            .expect_err("a successor request against discarded generator state must be refused");
27144        assert!(
27145            matches!(
27146                err,
27147                TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::Unacceptable(_))
27148            ),
27149            "expected Unacceptable, got {err:?}"
27150        );
27151        assert_eq!(
27152            0,
27153            drain_pix_events(&mut pix_events).await,
27154            "a refused request must not emit a single ReadyToDeposit"
27155        );
27156        assert!(
27157            mgr.active_sessions().is_empty(),
27158            "the Entry can no longer emit shares for the cycles it committed to, so leaving the Session open only \
27159             makes the Exit wait out its commitment deadline"
27160        );
27161
27162        bob_sender.close_channel();
27163        bob_handle.await??;
27164        Ok(())
27165    }
27166
27167    /// Emission is not service: a successor must be refused until the Exit has returned data.
27168    ///
27169    /// This is H6, and it is the case the emission half of the gate cannot see. `emission_progress`
27170    /// counts shares this node handed to its own packet pipeline — a consumption `create_surb_for_path`
27171    /// does not even roll back when the rest of the packet build fails. An Exit that requests, is
27172    /// funded and then returns nothing still walks that counter forward for as long as the Entry keeps
27173    /// sending, so on its own it prices deposits against work the Entry did to itself.
27174    ///
27175    /// The fixture therefore satisfies the emission half completely and the returned half not at all.
27176    /// Before this gate existed the request below was admitted and a second deposit instruction went
27177    /// out for it.
27178    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
27179    async fn entry_refuses_a_successor_the_exit_has_not_paid_for_with_returned_data() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
27180        let params = wide_pix_params();
27181        let (mgr, generator, pseudonym, mut pix_events, bob_sender, bob_handle) =
27182            entry_with_pix_session(params, SsaReconstructorConfig::default().early_recovery_threshold).await?;
27183
27184        mgr.handle_ssa_request(
27185            pseudonym,
27186            SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(1), []),
27187        )
27188        .await
27189        .context("the opening batch must be accepted")?;
27190        assert_eq!(1, drain_pix_events(&mut pix_events).await);
27191
27192        // Emit the whole cycle: the emission half of the gate is now satisfied several times over,
27193        // and it is the only half that would have been consulted before.
27194        for sent in 1..=(params.polys_per_ssa() as u32 * params.emitted_shares_per_poly() as u32) {
27195            generator.next_share(&pseudonym, &sent.to_be_bytes())?;
27196        }
27197        let progress = generator.emission_progress(&pseudonym).expect("committed");
27198        assert!(
27199            progress.is_serving_last_committed()
27200                && progress.front_emitted
27201                    >= hopr_protocol_pix::min_emission_for_early_recovery(
27202                        &params,
27203                        hopr_protocol_pix::MIN_EARLY_RECOVERY_THRESHOLD
27204                    ),
27205            "the fixture must satisfy the emission half outright, or it is not testing the other one"
27206        );
27207
27208        let err = mgr
27209            .handle_ssa_request(
27210                pseudonym,
27211                SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(2), []),
27212            )
27213            .await
27214            .expect_err("a successor must not be funded before the Exit has returned anything");
27215        assert!(
27216            matches!(err, TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::NotAdmitted(_))),
27217            "expected NotAdmitted, got {err:?}"
27218        );
27219        assert_eq!(
27220            0,
27221            drain_pix_events(&mut pix_events).await,
27222            "a refused successor must not emit a single ReadyToDeposit"
27223        );
27224        assert_eq!(
27225            vec![pseudonym],
27226            mgr.active_sessions(),
27227            "an under-served request is refused, not fatal — the Exit may still earn the batch it holds"
27228        );
27229
27230        // And the same request is admitted the moment the service exists.
27231        credit_returned_packets(&mgr, &pseudonym, required_returned_packets(&params, 1));
27232        mgr.handle_ssa_request(
27233            pseudonym,
27234            SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(2), []),
27235        )
27236        .await
27237        .context("a successor must be admitted once the Exit has returned what it owes")?;
27238        assert_eq!(1, drain_pix_events(&mut pix_events).await);
27239
27240        bob_sender.close_channel();
27241        bob_handle.await??;
27242        Ok(())
27243    }
27244
27245    /// An Exit that has returned nothing is refused immediately, not held.
27246    ///
27247    /// The deferral below the boundary exists for reordering, and it holds a bounded
27248    /// `for_each_concurrent` slot and the per-pseudonym request lock while it runs. That is only safe
27249    /// because it is entered exclusively for a *near miss*: an Exit which has returned nothing at all
27250    /// must cost nothing at all to refuse, or "ask early and say nothing" becomes a way to park one of
27251    /// this node's Start-protocol slots per Session it holds.
27252    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
27253    async fn an_unserved_successor_is_refused_without_waiting() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
27254        let params = wide_pix_params();
27255        let (mgr, generator, pseudonym, mut pix_events, bob_sender, bob_handle) =
27256            entry_with_pix_session(params, SsaReconstructorConfig::default().early_recovery_threshold).await?;
27257
27258        mgr.handle_ssa_request(
27259            pseudonym,
27260            SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(1), []),
27261        )
27262        .await
27263        .context("the opening batch must be accepted")?;
27264        assert_eq!(1, drain_pix_events(&mut pix_events).await);
27265
27266        for sent in 1..=(params.polys_per_ssa() as u32 * params.emitted_shares_per_poly() as u32) {
27267            generator.next_share(&pseudonym, &sent.to_be_bytes())?;
27268        }
27269
27270        let started = std::time::Instant::now();
27271        let err = mgr
27272            .handle_ssa_request(
27273                pseudonym,
27274                SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(2), []),
27275            )
27276            .await
27277            .expect_err("an unserved successor must be refused");
27278        let elapsed = started.elapsed();
27279
27280        assert!(
27281            matches!(err, TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::NotAdmitted(_))),
27282            "expected NotAdmitted, got {err:?}"
27283        );
27284        assert!(
27285            elapsed * 4 < SSA_SUCCESSOR_SERVICE_WAIT,
27286            "refusing an Exit that returned nothing took {elapsed:?}, which is within reach of the \
27287             {SSA_SUCCESSOR_SERVICE_WAIT:?} near-miss wait — it must not have entered it at all"
27288        );
27289
27290        bob_sender.close_channel();
27291        bob_handle.await??;
27292        Ok(())
27293    }
27294
27295    /// Before a Session's slot exists, at most one request for it waits for the slot; any other is
27296    /// refused at once rather than parking a second shared Start handler.
27297    ///
27298    /// The dispatch filter admits every request naming a pending initiation, and the wait comes
27299    /// before the request lock, so without this whoever holds SURBs for the pseudonym could occupy
27300    /// every handler for the length of the wait — the symptom the request lock closes once the slot
27301    /// exists.
27302    ///
27303    /// ## Steps
27304    /// 1. A pseudonym is pending as an outgoing initiation, and has no slot yet.
27305    /// 2. A first request waits for the slot.
27306    /// 3. A second request for the same pseudonym is refused as `Unacceptable` without waiting.
27307    /// 4. Control: the first was waiting, not refused — it gives up as `NonExistingSession` when no slot comes — and
27308    ///    once it has left, the next request waits too rather than being refused.
27309    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
27310    async fn a_second_ssa_request_for_a_pending_session_is_refused_without_waiting_for_its_slot() -> anyhow::Result<()>
27311    {
27312        let params = wide_pix_params();
27313        let (mgr, _generator, _pseudonym, _pix_events, bob_sender, bob_handle) =
27314            entry_with_pix_session(params, SsaReconstructorConfig::default().early_recovery_threshold).await?;
27315
27316        let pending = HoprPseudonym::random();
27317        mgr.pending_outgoing.insert(pending, PendingOutgoingToken::next());
27318        let request = move || SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pending, params, ssa_request_for(1), []);
27319        let is_waiting = || {
27320            mgr.slot_allocated
27321                .lock()
27322                .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
27323                .get(&pending)
27324                .is_some_and(|waiters| waiters.iter().any(|w| !w.is_canceled()))
27325        };
27326
27327        let first = tokio::spawn({
27328            let mgr = mgr.clone();
27329            async move { mgr.handle_ssa_request(pending, request()).await }
27330        });
27331        timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
27332            while !is_waiting() {
27333                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5)).await;
27334            }
27335        })
27336        .await
27337        .context("the first request must wait for the pending Session's slot")?;
27338
27339        let refused = timeout(Duration::from_millis(250), mgr.handle_ssa_request(pending, request()))
27340            .await
27341            .context("a second request must not wait for the slot as well")?;
27342        assert!(
27343            matches!(
27344                refused,
27345                Err(TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::Unacceptable(_)))
27346            ),
27347            "expected Unacceptable, got {refused:?}"
27348        );
27349
27350        let first = first.await?;
27351        assert!(
27352            matches!(
27353                first,
27354                Err(TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::NonExistingSession))
27355            ),
27356            "the first request must have waited and given up on the slot, got {first:?}"
27357        );
27358
27359        let next = mgr.handle_ssa_request(pending, request()).await;
27360        assert!(
27361            matches!(
27362                next,
27363                Err(TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::NonExistingSession))
27364            ),
27365            "once the first request has left, the next one must wait rather than be refused, got {next:?}"
27366        );
27367
27368        bob_sender.close_channel();
27369        bob_handle.await??;
27370        Ok(())
27371    }
27372
27373    /// A request that arrives just ahead of the packets that earned it is waited for, not refused.
27374    ///
27375    /// A conforming Exit asks the instant its reconstructor crosses the threshold, and that request
27376    /// travels the same mixed path as the returned packets which unlocked the shares — so it can
27377    /// overtake the last few of them. Refusing it is not free, although the Exit re-sends: the next
27378    /// re-send is a whole `ssa_request_resend_interval` away, and a request that is only a few packets
27379    /// behind would have been admitted at once. The gate therefore absorbs the reordering rather than
27380    /// treating it as under-service.
27381    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
27382    async fn a_near_miss_successor_waits_for_the_packets_still_in_flight() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
27383        let params = wide_pix_params();
27384        let (mgr, generator, pseudonym, mut pix_events, bob_sender, bob_handle) =
27385            entry_with_pix_session(params, SsaReconstructorConfig::default().early_recovery_threshold).await?;
27386
27387        mgr.handle_ssa_request(
27388            pseudonym,
27389            SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(1), []),
27390        )
27391        .await
27392        .context("the opening batch must be accepted")?;
27393        assert_eq!(1, drain_pix_events(&mut pix_events).await);
27394
27395        for sent in 1..=(params.polys_per_ssa() as u32 * params.emitted_shares_per_poly() as u32) {
27396            generator.next_share(&pseudonym, &sent.to_be_bytes())?;
27397        }
27398
27399        // One packet short: the request is in flight ahead of the last one that earned it.
27400        let required = required_returned_packets(&params, 1);
27401        assert!(required > 1, "the fixture needs room to be one short");
27402        credit_returned_packets(&mgr, &pseudonym, required - 1);
27403
27404        // The straggler lands while the request is already being evaluated.
27405        let mgr_clone = mgr.clone();
27406        let late = tokio::spawn(async move {
27407            tokio::time::sleep(SSA_SUCCESSOR_SERVICE_POLL).await;
27408            credit_returned_packets(&mgr_clone, &pseudonym, 1);
27409        });
27410
27411        mgr.handle_ssa_request(
27412            pseudonym,
27413            SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(2), []),
27414        )
27415        .await
27416        .context("a request one packet ahead of its own service must be waited for, not refused")?;
27417        assert_eq!(1, drain_pix_events(&mut pix_events).await);
27418        late.await?;
27419
27420        bob_sender.close_channel();
27421        bob_handle.await??;
27422        Ok(())
27423    }

27425    /// Service rendered before the first commitment does not pay for the first successor.

27428    /// shares — and the Exit may legitimately be served up to `max_predeposit_packets` of them before
27429    /// any deposit exists. Crediting that prefix would let an Exit bank unpaid service against the
27430    /// first cycle it *is* paid for, which is the one window in a Session's life where the gate has no
27431    /// prior cycle to measure against.
27432    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
27433    async fn service_returned_before_the_first_commitment_is_not_credited() -> anyhow::Result<()> {

27440        credit_returned_packets(&mgr, &pseudonym, required * 10);
27441
27442        mgr.handle_ssa_request(
27443            pseudonym,
27444            SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(1), []),
27445        )
27446        .await
27447        .context("the opening batch must be accepted")?;
27448        assert_eq!(1, drain_pix_events(&mut pix_events).await);
27449
27450        for sent in 1..=(params.polys_per_ssa() as u32 * params.emitted_shares_per_poly() as u32) {
27451            generator.next_share(&pseudonym, &sent.to_be_bytes())?;
27452        }
27453
27454        let err = mgr
27455            .handle_ssa_request(
27456                pseudonym,
27457                SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, params, ssa_request_for(2), []),
27458            )
27459            .await
27460            .expect_err("pre-commitment service must not pay for the first successor");
27461        assert!(
27462            matches!(err, TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::NotAdmitted(_))),
27463            "expected NotAdmitted, got {err:?}"
27464        );
27465        assert_eq!(0, drain_pix_events(&mut pix_events).await);
27466
27467        bob_sender.close_channel();
27468        bob_handle.await??;
27469        Ok(())
27470    }
