32211        estimator.produced.fetch_add(10, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
32212
32213        let closed = ServiceGate::new(10, 10);
32214        closed.poison();
32215        assert!(
32216            offer_counted_packet(&closed, &estimator)?.await.is_err(),
32217            "a poisoned gate must refuse"
32218        );
32219        assert_eq!(
32220            10,
32221            estimator.saturating_diff(),
32222            "the refused packet's SURB is back in the held count"
32223        );
32224
32225        // Strict prepay: the packet parks, and poisoning fails the park.
32226        let gate = ServiceGate::new(0, 10);

32228        assert!(
32229            futures::poll!(&mut parked).is_pending(),
32230            "the packet must park rather than resolve"
32231        );

32233
32234        gate.poison();
32235        assert!(parked.await.is_err(), "poisoning must fail the park");
32236        assert_eq!(10, estimator.saturating_diff(), "the failed packet's SURB is back too");
32237        Ok(())

32304
32305    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
32306    // The action driver's decision to re-send an SSA request
32307    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
32308
32309    /// A request as the driver would have stored it after sending.
32310    ///
32311    /// Any Start message will do: the decision only ever hands back a reference to what was stored,
32312    /// and the tests tell it apart from a copy by address.
32313    fn stored_request(session_id: HoprPseudonym) -> HoprStartProtocol {
32314        HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(KeepAliveMessage {
32315            session_id,
32316            flags: KeepAliveFlag::BalancerState.into(),
32317            additional_data: 0,
32318        })
32319    }
32320
32321    /// A reconstructor with a pending Exit registration for each of `indices`, as a sent request leaves it.
32322    fn reconstructor_awaiting(
32323        pseudonym: HoprPseudonym,
32324        indices: &[u32],
32325    ) -> anyhow::Result<(SsaReconstructor<HoprPixSpec>, Vec<SsaId<HoprPseudonym>>)> {
32326        let reconstructor = SsaReconstructor::<HoprPixSpec>::new(SsaReconstructorConfig::default());
32327        let ssa_ids = indices
32328            .iter()
32329            .map(|&index| {
32330                let ssa_id = SsaId::new(pseudonym, SsaIndex::new(index).context("SSA indices are non-zero")?);
32331                reconstructor.new_exit_commitment(ssa_id, small_pix_params())?;
32332                Ok(ssa_id)
32333            })
32334            .collect::<anyhow::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
32335        Ok((reconstructor, ssa_ids))
32336    }
32337
32338    /// Delivers the whole constant-term set of `ssa_id`, which is what an Entry's answer is.
32339    ///
32340    /// The dummy constant terms sum to the identity, whose discrete logarithm is zero, so an honest
32341    /// proof of knowledge over it is constructible — the same filler the commitment tests use.
32342    fn complete_commitment(
32343        reconstructor: &SsaReconstructor<HoprPixSpec>,
32344        ssa_id: SsaId<HoprPseudonym>,
32345    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
32346        use hopr_protocol_pix::{Field, PixGroup, PixScalar, PolynomialIndex, SsaCommitmentProof};
32347
32348        let zero = <PixScalar<HoprPixSpec> as Field>::ZERO;
32349        let proof = SsaCommitmentProof::<HoprPixSpec>::prove(&ssa_id, &zero, &PixGroup::<HoprPixSpec>::default())
32350            .context("the identity proof must be constructible")?;
32351        let polys = small_pix_params().polys_per_ssa() as PolynomialIndex;
32352        let state = reconstructor.insert_coefficient_commitments(
32353            ssa_id,
32354            0,
32355            Some(proof),
32356            (0..polys).map(|poly| (poly, PixGroup::<HoprPixSpec>::default().to_bytes())),
32357        )?;
32358        anyhow::ensure!(state.is_verifiable, "the fixture must have completed the commitment");
32359        Ok(())
32360    }
32361
32362    /// A pending batch is re-sent as the stored message itself, not as a rebuilt one.
32363    ///
32364    /// Identity matters here: a rebuilt request would carry new Exit secrets, which the reconstructor
32365    /// refuses as a duplicate of the pending commitment, and the deposit pool answers a batch once.
32366    #[test]
32367    fn a_pending_batch_is_resent_as_the_stored_message() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
32368        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
32369        let (reconstructor, ssa_ids) = reconstructor_awaiting(pseudonym, &[1, 2])?;
32370        let last_request = (ssa_ids.clone(), stored_request(pseudonym));
32371
32372        match resend_payload(Some(&last_request), &ssa_ids, &reconstructor) {
32373            ResendDecision::Send(message) => assert!(
32374                std::ptr::eq(message, &last_request.1),
32375                "the stored message must go out, not a copy of it"
32376            ),
32377            refusal => anyhow::bail!("a pending batch must be re-sent, got {refusal:?}"),
32378        }
32379        Ok(())
32380    }
32381
32382    /// Ids that are not exactly the stored batch are refused, and before any registration is consulted.
32383    ///
32384    /// The reconstructor here holds no registrations at all, so a mismatch that was decided *after*
32385    /// reading them would come out as `RegistrationGone`.
32386    #[test]
32387    fn a_resend_of_anything_but_the_last_batch_sent_is_refused() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
32388        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
32389        let ids = |indices: &[u32]| -> anyhow::Result<Vec<SsaId<HoprPseudonym>>> {
32390            indices
32391                .iter()
32392                .map(|&index| Ok(SsaId::new(pseudonym, SsaIndex::new(index).context("non-zero")?)))
32393                .collect()
32394        };
32395        let reconstructor = SsaReconstructor::<HoprPixSpec>::new(SsaReconstructorConfig::default());
32396        let last_request = (ids(&[3, 4])?, stored_request(pseudonym));
32397
32398        for (label, asked) in [
32399            ("an earlier batch", ids(&[1, 2])?),
32400            ("a prefix of the batch", ids(&[3])?),
32401            ("a superset of the batch", ids(&[3, 4, 5])?),
32402            ("the batch in another order", ids(&[4, 3])?),
32403            ("another Session's batch", {
32404                let other = HoprPseudonym::random();
32405                vec![
32406                    SsaId::new(other, SsaIndex::new(3).context("non-zero")?),
32407                    SsaId::new(other, SsaIndex::new(4).context("non-zero")?),
32408                ]
32409            }),
32410        ] {
32411            assert!(
32412                matches!(
32413                    resend_payload(Some(&last_request), &asked, &reconstructor),
32414                    ResendDecision::NotLastRequest
32415                ),
32416                "{label} is not the last request sent"
32417            );
32418        }
32419
32420        assert!(
32421            matches!(
32422                resend_payload(None, &last_request.0, &reconstructor),
32423                ResendDecision::NotLastRequest
32424            ),
32425            "with nothing stored there is nothing to send"
32426        );
32427        Ok(())
32428    }
32429
32430    /// A member whose registration is gone refuses the whole batch, wherever it stands in it.
32431    ///
32432    /// Gone is retired or idled out. Either way the Entry's answer would reach an Exit with nothing to
32433    /// match it against, so asking for it again can only waste a SURB.
32434    #[test]
32435    fn a_resend_with_a_missing_registration_is_refused() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
32436        for retired_position in [0, 1] {
32437            let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
32438            let (reconstructor, ssa_ids) = reconstructor_awaiting(pseudonym, &[1, 2])?;
32439            let last_request = (ssa_ids.clone(), stored_request(pseudonym));
32440            assert!(
32441                matches!(
32442                    resend_payload(Some(&last_request), &ssa_ids, &reconstructor),
32443                    ResendDecision::Send(_)
32444                ),
32445                "the control: before the retirement the batch is sent"
32446            );
32447
32448            reconstructor.retire_ssa(ssa_ids[retired_position]);
32449            assert!(
32450                matches!(
32451                    resend_payload(Some(&last_request), &ssa_ids, &reconstructor),
32452                    ResendDecision::RegistrationGone
32453                ),
32454                "a batch whose member {retired_position} was retired must not be re-sent"
32455            );
32456        }
32457        Ok(())
32458    }
32459
32460    /// A member whose commitment is complete is no reason to refuse the batch.
32461    ///
32462    /// The supervisor re-sends the whole batch for as long as *any* member has heard nothing, and the
32463    /// Entry publishes a batch one member after another, so a complete first member beside a second
32464    /// that never arrived is exactly the state a publication cut at a member boundary leaves. The
32465    /// Entry's repeat branch publishes only the members it still owes, so sending the whole batch costs
32466    /// nothing for the one that is done, short of a repeat late enough to mean a burst was lost.
32467    #[test]
32468    fn a_resend_goes_out_while_any_member_is_still_waiting() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
32469        for completed_position in [0, 1] {
32470            let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
32471            let (reconstructor, ssa_ids) = reconstructor_awaiting(pseudonym, &[1, 2])?;
32472            let last_request = (ssa_ids.clone(), stored_request(pseudonym));
32473
32474            complete_commitment(&reconstructor, ssa_ids[completed_position])?;
32475            assert!(
32476                matches!(
32477                    resend_payload(Some(&last_request), &ssa_ids, &reconstructor),
32478                    ResendDecision::Send(_)
32479                ),
32480                "member {completed_position} is complete and the other is not, so the batch is sent whole"
32481            );
32482        }
32483        Ok(())
32484    }
32485
32486    /// A batch whose every member is complete is refused: the Entry has answered in full.
32487    ///
32488    /// What the supervisor may still have queued is a tick that raced the last answer, and it must find
32489    /// nothing to send.
32490    #[test]
32491    fn a_resend_for_a_batch_complete_in_full_is_refused() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
32492        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
32493        let (reconstructor, ssa_ids) = reconstructor_awaiting(pseudonym, &[1, 2])?;
32494        let last_request = (ssa_ids.clone(), stored_request(pseudonym));
32495
32496        for ssa_id in &ssa_ids {
32497            complete_commitment(&reconstructor, *ssa_id)?;
32498        }
32499        assert!(
32500            matches!(
32501                resend_payload(Some(&last_request), &ssa_ids, &reconstructor),
32502                ResendDecision::CommitmentComplete
32503            ),
32504            "a batch whose every member completed must not be re-sent"
32505        );
32506        Ok(())
32507    }
32508
32509    /// A missing registration decides before completeness does, whichever member is which.
32510    #[test]
32511    fn a_missing_registration_outweighs_a_complete_one() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
32512        for (retired_position, completed_position) in [(0, 1), (1, 0)] {
32513            let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
32514            let (reconstructor, ssa_ids) = reconstructor_awaiting(pseudonym, &[1, 2])?;
32515            let last_request = (ssa_ids.clone(), stored_request(pseudonym));
32516
32517            complete_commitment(&reconstructor, ssa_ids[completed_position])?;
32518            reconstructor.retire_ssa(ssa_ids[retired_position]);
32519            assert!(
32520                matches!(
32521                    resend_payload(Some(&last_request), &ssa_ids, &reconstructor),
32522                    ResendDecision::RegistrationGone
32523                ),
32524                "member {retired_position} is gone and member {completed_position} is complete"
32525            );
32526        }
32527        Ok(())
32528    }

32530    /// Retiring any member of the stored batch forgets the request, and retiring anything else does not.
32531    #[test]
32532    fn retiring_a_member_forgets_the_stored_request() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
32533        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
32534        let id = |index: u32| -> anyhow::Result<SsaId<HoprPseudonym>> {
32535            Ok(SsaId::new(pseudonym, SsaIndex::new(index).context("non-zero")?))
32536        };
32537        let batch = vec![id(3)?, id(4)?];
32538
32539        for member in &batch {
32540            let mut last_request = Some((batch.clone(), stored_request(pseudonym)));
32541            forget_request_of(&mut last_request, member);
32542            assert!(
32543                last_request.is_none(),
32544                "{member} is a member, so the request goes with it"
32545            );
32546        }
32547
32548        let mut last_request = Some((batch.clone(), stored_request(pseudonym)));
32549        forget_request_of(&mut last_request, &id(2)?);
32550        forget_request_of(&mut last_request, &id(5)?);
32551        forget_request_of(
32552            &mut last_request,
32553            &SsaId::new(HoprPseudonym::random(), SsaIndex::new(3).context("non-zero")?),
32554        );
32555        assert_eq!(
32556            Some(&batch),
32557            last_request.as_ref().map(|(ids, _)| ids),
32558            "the retirement of an earlier batch, a later one or another Session's must not drop it"
32559        );
32560
32561        let mut nothing = None;
32562        forget_request_of(&mut nothing, &batch[0]);
32563        assert!(nothing.is_none(), "forgetting nothing leaves nothing");
32564        Ok(())
32565    }

32571    /// One percent of the target, at least 32, and never more than a quarter of it.
32572    #[test]
32573    fn the_keep_alive_reserve_should_be_one_percent_of_the_target_and_never_more_than_a_quarter() {
32574        for (target, reserve, why) in [
32575            (19_264, 192, "production target: one percent"),
32576            (2_400, 32, "test-scale target: the floor"),
32577            (3_200, 32, "one percent is the floor exactly"),
32578            (10_000, 100, "one percent above the floor"),
32579            (128, 32, "smallest target the floor fits in a quarter of"),
32580            (40, 10, "a shallow buffer keeps three quarters for data"),
32581            (0, 0, "no buffer, no reserve"),
32582        ] {
32583            assert_eq!(reserve, keep_alive_surb_reserve(target), "{why}");
32584        }
32585    }

32587    fn data_packet() -> anyhow::Result<EgressItem> {
32588        Ok((
32589            DestinationRouting::Return(HoprPseudonym::random().into()),
32590            ApplicationDataOut::with_no_packet_info(ApplicationData::new(
32591                SESSION_APPLICATION_TAG,
32592                b"payload".as_slice(),
32593            )?),
32594        ))
32595    }
32596
32597    /// The Exit must not spend its last SURBs on data: they are what its keep-alives, level reports
32598    /// and distress signals go out on. At the reserve the sink holds the packet, and it counts it
32599    /// against the stock only when it goes on; once the stock is above the reserve again it goes.
32600    ///
32601    /// The hold is measured here too, on a Session with no PIX gate at all (`None`): the issue's
32602    /// point that the metric covers rate-controlled Sessions without PIX, which is what makes it
32603    /// distinct from `hopr_pix_gate_blocks_total`.
32604    #[tokio::test]
32605    async fn data_should_be_held_back_while_the_surb_stock_sits_at_the_keep_alive_reserve() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
32606        use crate::supervision::telemetry::probe;
32607
32608        probe::reset();
32609        let (tx, mut forwarded) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded::<EgressItem>();
32610        let estimator = AtomicSurbFlowEstimator::default();
32611        let balancer = balancer_with_target(3_200);
32612        let reserve = current_keep_alive_surb_reserve(&balancer);
32613        assert_eq!(32, reserve);
32614        estimator.produced.store(reserve, Ordering::Relaxed);
32615
32616        let mut sink = Box::pin(exit_data_egress(
32617            tx.sink_map_err(std::io::Error::other),
32618            HoprPseudonym::random(),
32619            estimator.clone(),
32620            balancer,
32621            None,
32622            true,
32623            SlotInstance::new(0),
32624        ));
32625        let item = data_packet()?;
32626        let sending = tokio::spawn(async move { sink.send(item).await });
32627
32628        assert!(
32629            timeout(
32630                Duration::from_millis(3 * SURB_RESERVE_POLL.as_millis() as u64),
32631                forwarded.next()
32632            )
32633            .await
32634            .is_err(),
32635            "a stock at the reserve must not send data"
32636        );
32637        assert_eq!(0, estimator.estimate_surbs_consumed(), "a held packet consumes nothing");
32638        assert!(!sending.is_finished());
32639        assert_eq!(
32640            1,
32641            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/episodes/false"),
32642            "a Session without PIX still records its hold"
32643        );
32644        assert_eq!(
32645            0,
32646            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/observations/false"),
32647            "the hold is open while the packet waits"
32648        );
32649
32650        // A level report or a refill brings one more SURB than the reserve.
32651        estimator.produced.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
32652        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), forwarded.next())
32653            .await
32654            .context("the packet must go once the stock is above the reserve")?
32655            .context("the sink must have forwarded it")?;
32656        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), sending).await???;
32657        assert_eq!(1, estimator.estimate_surbs_consumed());
32658        assert_eq!(
32659            1,
32660            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/observations/false"),
32661            "the release closes the one hold this packet opened"
32662        );
32663        Ok(())
32664    }
32665
32666    /// A write parked in the SURB-reserve hold fails once its instance is superseded, while the stock stays low.
32667    #[tokio::test]
32668    async fn a_held_write_fails_once_its_instance_is_superseded() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
32669        let (tx, mut forwarded) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded::<EgressItem>();
32670        let estimator = AtomicSurbFlowEstimator::default();
32671        let balancer = balancer_with_target(3_200);
32672        estimator
32673            .produced
32674            .store(current_keep_alive_surb_reserve(&balancer), Ordering::Relaxed);
32675        let instance = SlotInstance::new(0);
32676
32677        let mut sink = Box::pin(exit_data_egress(
32678            tx.sink_map_err(std::io::Error::other),
32679            HoprPseudonym::random(),
32680            estimator.clone(),
32681            balancer,
32682            None,
32683            true,
32684            instance.clone(),
32685        ));
32686        let item = data_packet()?;
32687        let sending = tokio::spawn(async move { sink.send(item).await });
32688
32689        tokio::time::sleep(3 * SURB_RESERVE_POLL).await;
32690        assert!(!sending.is_finished(), "the write is parked in the hold");
32691
32692        instance.supersede();
32693        let result = timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), sending)
32694            .await
32695            .context("a superseded write must not stay parked")??;
32696        assert!(result.is_err(), "the superseded write fails");
32697        assert!(forwarded.try_recv().is_err(), "nothing was forwarded");
32698        assert_eq!(0, estimator.estimate_surbs_consumed());
32699        Ok(())
32700    }

32702    /// The common case: above the reserve nothing waits, and the packet is booked as it was.

32705        let (tx, mut forwarded) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded::<EgressItem>();

32733    /// Data the Exit sends is counted with the refund of its SURB, as every return packet is: a packet
32734    /// the gate refuses gives its SURB back at once, and one the sink forwards carries the refund on, for
32735    /// routing resolution to give back if it finds no SURB.
32736    #[tokio::test]
32737    async fn data_the_exit_sends_should_carry_the_refund_of_its_surb() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
32738        let estimator = AtomicSurbFlowEstimator::default();
32739        estimator.produced.store(40, Ordering::Relaxed);
32740
32741        let closed = ServiceGate::new(10, 10);
32742        closed.poison();
32743        let (tx, _never_forwarded) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded::<EgressItem>();
32744        let mut refused = Box::pin(exit_data_egress(
32745            tx.sink_map_err(std::io::Error::other),
32746            HoprPseudonym::random(),
32747            estimator.clone(),
32748            balancer_with_target(3_200),
32749            Some(closed),
32750            true,
32751            SlotInstance::new(0),
32752        ));
32753        assert!(
32754            timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), refused.send(data_packet()?))
32755                .await
32756                .context("a closed gate answers at once")?
32757                .is_err(),
32758            "a closed gate must refuse"
32759        );
32760        assert_eq!(
32761            40,
32762            estimator.saturating_diff(),
32763            "the refused packet's SURB is back in the held count"
32764        );
32765
32766        let (tx, mut forwarded) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded::<EgressItem>();
32767        let mut sink = Box::pin(exit_data_egress(
32768            tx.sink_map_err(std::io::Error::other),
32769            HoprPseudonym::random(),
32770            estimator.clone(),
32771            balancer_with_target(3_200),
32772            None,
32773            true,
32774            SlotInstance::new(0),
32775        ));
32776        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), sink.send(data_packet()?))
32777            .await
32778            .context("above the reserve the packet must not wait")??;
32779        let (_, data) = forwarded.try_recv().ok().context("the sink must have forwarded it")?;
32780        assert!(data.surb_refund.is_counted(), "a forwarded packet carries its refund");
32781        assert_eq!(
32782            39,
32783            estimator.saturating_diff(),
32784            "and is counted until it takes its SURB"
32785        );
32786        data.surb_refund.give_back();
32787        assert_eq!(
32788            40,
32789            estimator.saturating_diff(),
32790            "a packet that finds no SURB gives it back"
32791        );
32792        Ok(())
32793    }

32825    /// The Exit's state for a Session whose Entry asks for `target` and has shown, by a keep-alive, that
32826    /// it refills the Exit's stock.
32827    fn balancer_with_target(target: u64) -> Arc<BalancerStateValues> {
32828        let balancer = Arc::new(BalancerStateValues::new(SurbBalancerConfig {
32829            target_surb_buffer_size: target,
32830            ..Default::default()
32831        }));
32832        balancer.note_counterparty_refills();
32833        balancer
32834    }

32836    /// An Entry without a SURB balancer announces no target, so the Exit's balancer runs at its own fallback
32837    /// (50 at the defaults, a reserve of 12; an Entry that predates this announces the same figure itself).
32838    /// Such an Entry attaches one SURB to each data packet and sends no keep-alives: nothing would raise the
32839    /// stock above the reserve. Until a keep-alive shows the Entry refills, the Exit sends at any stock.
32840    #[tokio::test]
32841    async fn data_should_not_be_held_for_an_entry_that_has_not_shown_it_refills() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
32842        let (tx, mut forwarded) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded::<EgressItem>();
32843        let estimator = AtomicSurbFlowEstimator::default();
32844        estimator.produced.store(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
32845        let balancer = Arc::new(BalancerStateValues::new(SurbBalancerConfig {
32846            target_surb_buffer_size: 50,
32847            ..Default::default()
32848        }));
32849        assert_eq!(12, current_keep_alive_surb_reserve(&balancer));
32850
32851        let session_id = HoprPseudonym::random();
32852        let mut sink = Box::pin(exit_data_egress(
32853            tx.sink_map_err(std::io::Error::other),
32854            session_id,
32855            estimator.clone(),
32856            balancer.clone(),
32857            None,
32858            true,
32859            SlotInstance::new(0),
32860        ));
32861        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), sink.send(data_packet()?))
32862            .await
32863            .context("the reply must not wait for a stock the Entry will never send")??;
32864        assert!(
32865            forwarded.try_recv().is_ok(),
32866            "forwarded on the one SURB the request brought"
32867        );
32868
32869        balancer.note_counterparty_refills();
32870        assert!(
32871            hold_for_surb_reserve(session_id, &estimator, &balancer, false, &SlotInstance::new(0)).is_some(),
32872            "once the Entry refills, a stock at the reserve holds data again"
32873        );
32874        Ok(())

32940            None,
32941            true,
32942            SlotInstance::new(0),
32943        ));
32944        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), sink.send(data_packet()?))
32945            .await
32946            .context("above the reserve the packet must not wait")??;
32947        assert!(forwarded.try_recv().is_ok(), "forwarded");
32948        assert_eq!(0, probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/episodes/false"), "nothing was held");
32949        assert_eq!(
32950            0,
32951            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/observations/false"),
32952            "and nothing was timed"
32953        );
32954        Ok(())
32955    }

32957    /// A PIX Session's hold is labelled `pix=true`, and a session with no gate `pix=false`: the label
32958    /// comes from the egress gate the Session was built with, so an operator can tell a PIX Session's
32959    /// hold from the non-PIX backpressure a rate-controlled Session relies on.
32960    #[tokio::test]
32961    async fn a_hold_is_labelled_by_whether_the_session_runs_pix() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
32962        use crate::supervision::telemetry::probe;
32963
32964        probe::reset();
32965        let estimator = AtomicSurbFlowEstimator::default();
32966        let balancer = balancer_with_target(3_200);
32967        estimator.produced.store(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
32968
32969        // The flag is all that distinguishes them here: the hold itself does not depend on the gate.
32970        let pix = hold_for_surb_reserve(
32971            HoprPseudonym::random(),
32972            &estimator,
32973            &balancer,
32974            true,
32975            &SlotInstance::new(0),
32976        )
32977        .context("the stock is below the reserve")?;
32978        let plain = hold_for_surb_reserve(
32979            HoprPseudonym::random(),
32980            &estimator,
32981            &balancer,
32982            false,
32983            &SlotInstance::new(0),
32984        )
32985        .context("the stock is below the reserve")?;
32986        drop((pix, plain));
32987
32988        assert_eq!(
32989            1,
32990            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/episodes/true"),
32991            "a Session with an egress gate is labelled `pix=true`"
32992        );
32993        assert_eq!(
32994            1,
32995            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/observations/true"),
32996            "and its duration lands on the same label"
32997        );
32998        assert_eq!(
32999            1,
33000            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/episodes/false"),
33001            "a Session without one is labelled `pix=false`"
33002        );
33003        assert_eq!(
33004            1,
33005            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/observations/false"),
33006            "and likewise for its duration"
33007        );
33008        Ok(())
33009    }

33011    /// The egress path takes the label from the gate it was given: a Session that carries one is
33012    /// `pix=true`, the same Session without one is `pix=false`. This is the single site that derives
33013    /// it, so a wrong derivation would mislabel every hold.
33014    #[tokio::test]
33015    async fn exit_data_egress_labels_the_hold_from_its_gate() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
33016        use crate::supervision::telemetry::probe;
33017
33018        probe::reset();
33019        let estimator = AtomicSurbFlowEstimator::default();
33020        let balancer = balancer_with_target(3_200);
33021        // At the reserve, so the packet is held; one more SURB releases it.
33022        estimator
33023            .produced
33024            .store(current_keep_alive_surb_reserve(&balancer), Ordering::Relaxed);
33025
33026        // An unfunded-but-admitting gate: the first packet is served from the predeposit budget.
33027        let gate = ServiceGate::new(10, 10);
33028        let (tx, _forwarded) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded::<EgressItem>();
33029        let mut with_pix = Box::pin(exit_data_egress(
33030            tx.sink_map_err(std::io::Error::other),
33031            HoprPseudonym::random(),
33032            estimator.clone(),
33033            balancer.clone(),
33034            Some(gate),
33035            true,
33036            SlotInstance::new(0),
33037        ));
33038        let item = data_packet()?;
33039        let sending = tokio::spawn(async move { with_pix.send(item).await });
33040        // Give the spawned send a turn so the hold episode is created before the stock rises.
33041        tokio::time::sleep(SURB_RESERVE_POLL / 4).await;
33042        // The hold is open: one episode on the `true` label, none on `false`.
33043        assert_eq!(
33044            1,
33045            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/episodes/true"),
33046            "a Session with a gate must label its hold `pix=true`"
33047        );
33048        assert_eq!(0, probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/episodes/false"));
33049
33050        // Refill so the packet goes on and the spawn finishes.
33051        estimator.produced.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
33052        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), sending).await???;
33053        assert_eq!(
33054            1,
33055            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/observations/true"),
33056            "and close it on the same label"
33057        );
33058        Ok(())
33059    }

33061    /// A packet held across many polling intervals is one episode, not one per poll: the counter
33062    /// measures held packets, and the duration is recorded once when the hold ends.
33063    #[tokio::test]
33064    async fn a_held_packet_creates_one_hold_episode_and_one_duration() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
33065        use crate::supervision::telemetry::probe;
33066
33067        probe::reset();
33068        let estimator = AtomicSurbFlowEstimator::default();
33069        let balancer = balancer_with_target(3_200);
33070        estimator
33071            .produced
33072            .store(current_keep_alive_surb_reserve(&balancer), Ordering::Relaxed);
33073
33074        let mut hold = hold_for_surb_reserve(
33075            HoprPseudonym::random(),
33076            &estimator,
33077            &balancer,

33080        )
33081        .context("a stock at the reserve must hold the packet")?;
33082        assert_eq!(
33083            1,
33084            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/episodes/false"),

33086        );

33090            timeout(
33091                Duration::from_millis(3 * SURB_RESERVE_POLL.as_millis() as u64),
33092                &mut hold
33093            )
33094            .await
33095            .is_err(),
33096            "the hold must not resolve while the stock is at the reserve"
33097        );
33098        assert_eq!(
33099            1,
33100            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/episodes/false"),
33101            "still one episode, not one per poll"

33104            0,
33105            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/observations/false"),
33106            "an open hold is not timed yet"

33109        // The Entry refills the stock, and the hold releases.
33110        estimator.produced.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);

33112            .await
33113            .context("the hold must resolve once the stock is above the reserve")?;

33115            1,
33116            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/episodes/false"),
33117            "release is not a second episode"

33121            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/observations/false"),
33122            "the release records the duration exactly once"
33123        );

33205    /// The recorded duration is the real elapsed time, not a count dressed up as one: a clock taken
33206    /// at the wrong point, or one that never advances, would pass every count-only assertion.
33207    ///
33208    /// Asserted from below rather than as an exact figure, because the wall clock is what is being
33209    /// measured: a hold kept open for several polling intervals must report at least that long.
33210    #[tokio::test]
33211    async fn a_hold_episode_reports_the_time_it_was_actually_held() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
33212        use crate::supervision::telemetry::probe;
33213
33214        probe::reset();
33215        let estimator = AtomicSurbFlowEstimator::default();
33216        let balancer = balancer_with_target(3_200);
33217        estimator.produced.store(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
33218
33219        let mut hold = hold_for_surb_reserve(
33220            HoprPseudonym::random(),
33221            &estimator,
33222            &balancer,
33223            false,
33224            &SlotInstance::new(0),
33225        )
33226        .context("the stock is below the reserve")?;
33227
33228        // Three polling intervals, timed here as well as inside the episode.
33229        let began = Instant::now();
33230        assert!(
33231            timeout(
33232                Duration::from_millis(3 * SURB_RESERVE_POLL.as_millis() as u64),
33233                &mut hold
33234            )
33235            .await
33236            .is_err(),
33237            "the hold must stay open while nothing refills the stock"
33238        );
33239        let observed_here_ms = began.elapsed().as_millis() as i64;
33240
33241        drop(hold);
33242        let reported_ms = probe::get("surb_reserve_hold_seconds/false");
33243        assert!(
33244            reported_ms >= observed_here_ms,
33245            "the episode must report at least the time it was held ({observed_here_ms} ms), got {reported_ms} ms"
33246        );
33247        assert!(
33248            reported_ms >= SURB_RESERVE_POLL.as_millis() as i64,
33249            "one polling interval is the floor: a clock that never ran would report ~0, got {reported_ms} ms"
33250        );
33251        assert_eq!(
33252            1,
33253            probe::get("surb_reserve_holds/observations/false"),
33254            "and it is still one observation"
33255        );
33256        Ok(())
33257    }

33312    // Forward receipts
33313
33314    /// What a receipt reported: (pseudonym, seq, first seq, tags).
33315    type ReportedReceipt = (HoprPseudonym, u32, u32, Vec<u32>);
33316
33317    #[derive(Default)]
33318    struct RecordingSink(parking_lot::Mutex<Vec<ReportedReceipt>>);
33319
33320    impl ForwardReceiptSink for RecordingSink {
33321        fn receipts(&self, pseudonym: HoprPseudonym, seq: u32, first_seq: u32, tags: &[u32]) {
33322            self.0.lock().push((pseudonym, seq, first_seq, tags.to_vec()));
33323        }
33324    }

33326    /// The `StartSession` an Entry sends, for a config that sets `forward_receipts` and optionally installs a sink.
33327    async fn start_session_sent_by_entry(
33328        forward_receipts: bool,
33329        with_sink: bool,
33330        client: SessionClientConfig,
33331    ) -> anyhow::Result<StartInitiation<SessionTarget, HoprSessionCapabilities>> {
33332        let mgr = SessionManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
33333            initiation_timeout_base: Duration::from_millis(100),
33334            idle_timeout: Duration::from_secs(120),
33335            forward_receipts,
33336            ..Default::default()
33337        });
33338        if with_sink {
33339            assert!(mgr.set_forward_receipt_sink(Arc::new(RecordingSink::default())));
33340        }
33341
33342        let sent: Arc<parking_lot::Mutex<Vec<StartInitiation<SessionTarget, HoprSessionCapabilities>>>> =
33343            Default::default();
33344        let captured = sent.clone();
33345        let mut transport = MockMsgSender::new();
33346        transport
33347            .expect_send_message()
33348            .once()
33349            .withf(move |_, data| msg_type(data, StartProtocolDiscriminants::StartSession))
33350            .returning(move |_, data| {
33351                if let Ok(StartProtocol::StartSession(init)) =
33352                    HoprStartProtocol::decode(data.data.application_tag, &data.data.plain_text)
33353                {
33354                    captured.lock().push(init);
33355                }
33356                Box::pin(async { Ok(()) })
33357            });
33358        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
33359        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(transport);
33360        mgr.start(sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
33361
33362        let peer: Address = (&ChainKeypair::random()).into();
33363        let _ = mgr
33364            .new_session(
33365                peer,
33366                SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
33367                SessionClientConfig {
33368                    pseudonym: HoprPseudonym::random().into(),
33369                    ..client
33370                },
33371            )
33372            .await;
33373
33374        let mut sent = sent.lock();
33375        anyhow::ensure!(sent.len() == 1, "exactly one StartSession must have been sent");
33376        Ok(sent.remove(0))
33377    }

33448    /// Another Session taking the pseudonym of one that has ended: the manager's end of a pseudonym
33449    /// reuse, with the predecessor's `HoprSession` still in hand.
33450    async fn exit_successor_on(
33451        mgr: &RecordingManager,
33452        incoming: &mut futures::channel::mpsc::Receiver<IncomingSession>,
33453        pseudonym: HoprPseudonym,
33454    ) -> anyhow::Result<IncomingSession> {

33456            pseudonym,

33458                challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE + 1,
33459                target: SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
33460                capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities(Capabilities::empty()),
33461                additional_data: 0,
33462            },
33463        )
33464        .await?;

33466            .await
33467            .context("the successor must be handed to the application")?

33471    /// A close reported by a torn-down Session object, in each way one can arrive, must leave the
33472    /// Session that has since taken its pseudonym untouched.
33473    ///
33474    /// ## Steps
33475    /// 1. An Exit Session is established and its `HoprSession` kept; the Session is then closed.
33476    /// 2. A successor is established under the same pseudonym.
33477    /// 3. The predecessor reports `WriteClosed` and `EmptyRead` through the closure channel, reads to its end of stream
33478    ///    (which reports `EmptyRead` on its own), and is closed by its instance id, as its configurator would.
33479    /// 4. The successor's slot is the one it was, not superseded and still counted; closing it by its own instance id
33480    ///    then works.
33481    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
33482    async fn a_late_close_of_a_torn_down_instance_leaves_its_successor_alone() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
33483        use futures::AsyncReadExt;
33484
33485        let (mgr, _msg_rx, mut incoming, pseudonym) =
33486            exit_session_originating_keep_alives(Default::default(), None).await?;
33487        let mut predecessor = timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), incoming.next())
33488            .await
33489            .context("the Exit must hand over its Session")?
33490            .context("the incoming channel must stay open")?;
33491        let old_instance = mgr
33492            .sessions
33493            .get(&pseudonym)
33494            .context("the first slot must exist")?
33495            .instance
33496            .clone();
33497        assert_eq!(predecessor.session.slot_instance(), Some(old_instance.id()));
33498
33499        assert!(mgr.close_session(&pseudonym));
33500        assert!(wait_for_no_active_sessions(&mgr).await);
33501        assert!(
33502            old_instance.is_superseded(),
33503            "a torn-down slot's instance is superseded"
33504        );
33505
33506        let successor = exit_successor_on(&mgr, &mut incoming, pseudonym).await?;
33507        let new_instance = mgr
33508            .sessions
33509            .get(&pseudonym)
33510            .context("the successor's slot must exist")?
33511            .instance
33512            .clone();
33513        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&old_instance, &new_instance));
33514        assert_ne!(old_instance.id(), new_instance.id());
33515        assert_eq!(successor.session.slot_instance(), Some(new_instance.id()));
33516
33517        let (_, closures) = mgr.session_notifiers.get().context("the manager is started")?.clone();
33518        for reason in [ClosureReason::WriteClosed, ClosureReason::EmptyRead] {
33519            assert!(
33520                closures.try_send((pseudonym, reason, old_instance.clone())).is_ok(),
33521                "{reason:?} must be accepted by the channel"
33522            );
33523        }
33524        // The predecessor's own object reports the same way once it is read to its end.
33525        let mut buf = [0u8; 16];
33526        let read = timeout(Duration::from_millis(500), predecessor.session.read(&mut buf))
33527            .await
33528            .context("the predecessor's read must end")??;
33529        assert_eq!(0, read, "the predecessor must read to its end");
33530        assert!(
33531            !mgr.close_session_instance(&pseudonym, old_instance.id()),
33532            "a configurator of the predecessor must not close the successor"
33533        );
33534        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
33535
33536        let current = mgr
33537            .sessions
33538            .get(&pseudonym)
33539            .context("the successor must survive the predecessor's late closes")?;
33540        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&current.instance, &new_instance));
33541        assert!(!new_instance.is_superseded());
33542        assert_eq!(mgr.num_active_sessions(), 1);
33543
33544        assert!(mgr.close_session_instance(&pseudonym, new_instance.id()));
33545        assert!(wait_for_no_active_sessions(&mgr).await);
33546        Ok(())
33547    }

33549    /// A configurator of a predecessor Session cannot read, update or ping the successor that took its pseudonym.
33550    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
33551    async fn instance_scoped_configurator_operations_do_not_reach_another_instance() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
33552        let (mgr, mut msg_rx, mut incoming, pseudonym) =
33553            exit_session_originating_keep_alives(Default::default(), None).await?;
33554        let _predecessor = timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), incoming.next())
33555            .await
33556            .context("the Exit must hand over its Session")?
33557            .context("the incoming channel must stay open")?;
33558        let old_id = mgr
33559            .sessions
33560            .get(&pseudonym)
33561            .context("the first slot must exist")?
33562            .instance
33563            .id();
33564        assert!(mgr.close_session(&pseudonym));
33565        assert!(wait_for_no_active_sessions(&mgr).await);
33566
33567        let _successor = exit_successor_on(&mgr, &mut incoming, pseudonym).await?;
33568        let new_id = mgr
33569            .sessions
33570            .get(&pseudonym)
33571            .context("the successor's slot must exist")?
33572            .instance
33573            .id();
33574        assert_ne!(old_id, new_id);
33575
33576        let before = mgr.get_surb_balancer_config(&pseudonym)?;
33577        let current = mgr.get_surb_balancer_config_instance(&pseudonym, new_id)?;
33578        assert_eq!(current, before, "the current instance reads its own config");
33579
33580        let new_cfg = SurbBalancerConfig {
33581            target_surb_buffer_size: 12_345,
33582            ..Default::default()
33583        };
33584        assert!(matches!(
33585            mgr.get_surb_balancer_config_instance(&pseudonym, old_id),
33586            Err(TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::NonExistingSession))
33587        ));
33588        assert!(matches!(
33589            mgr.update_surb_balancer_config_instance(&pseudonym, old_id, new_cfg),
33590            Err(TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::NonExistingSession))
33591        ));
33592        assert_eq!(
33593            mgr.get_surb_balancer_config(&pseudonym)?,
33594            before,
33595            "a stale update must leave the successor's config unchanged"
33596        );
33597
33598        // On the current instance the call reaches the slot (and is judged on its own merits).
33599        let on_current = mgr.update_surb_balancer_config_instance(&pseudonym, new_id, new_cfg);
33600        assert!(
33601            !matches!(
33602                on_current,
33603                Err(TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::NonExistingSession))
33604            ),
33605            "the current instance must be found, got {on_current:?}"
33606        );
33607        if before.is_some() {
33608            assert_eq!(mgr.get_surb_balancer_config(&pseudonym)?, Some(new_cfg));
33609        }
33610
33611        // Ping: stale sends nothing, current sends one manual keep-alive back over the reply route.
33612        while msg_rx.try_recv().is_ok() {}
33613        assert!(matches!(
33614            mgr.ping_session_instance(&pseudonym, old_id).await,
33615            Err(TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::NonExistingSession))
33616        ));
33617        // The Exit also sends keep-alives of its own, so only manual pings are counted, each with its route.
33618        let manual_pings = |sent: Vec<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>| {
33619            sent.into_iter()
33620                .filter(|(_, d)| {
33621                    matches!(
33622                        HoprStartProtocol::decode(d.data.application_tag, &d.data.plain_text),
33623                        Ok(StartProtocol::KeepAlive(KeepAliveMessage { flags, .. })) if flags.contains(KeepAliveFlag::ManualPing)
33624                    )
33625                })
33626                .map(|(routing, _)| {
33627                    matches!(&routing, DestinationRouting::Return(SurbMatcher::Pseudonym(p)) if p == &pseudonym)
33628                })
33629                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
33630        };
33631        assert!(
33632            manual_pings(originated_during(&mut msg_rx, Duration::from_millis(200)).await).is_empty(),
33633            "a stale ping must send nothing"
33634        );
33635        mgr.ping_session_instance(&pseudonym, new_id).await?;
33636        assert_eq!(
33637            vec![true],
33638            manual_pings(originated_during(&mut msg_rx, Duration::from_millis(500)).await),
33639            "a ping on the current instance must send one manual keep-alive, back over the reply route"
33640        );
33641        assert!(mgr.close_session_instance(&pseudonym, new_id));
33642        Ok(())
33643    }

33672        });
33673
33674        let start = timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), msg_rx.next())
33675            .await
33676            .context("the Entry must send its StartSession")?
33677            .context("the sender must stay open")?;
33678        let Ok(StartProtocol::StartSession(initiation)) =
33679            HoprStartProtocol::decode(start.1.data.application_tag, &start.1.data.plain_text)
33680        else {

33689        )?;
33690        let session = timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), opening)

33694        let stale = current + 1_000_000;

33696        let before = mgr.get_surb_balancer_config(&pseudonym)?;

33718        assert_eq!(

33720                .map(|c| c.target_surb_buffer_size),

33723
33724        while msg_rx.try_recv().is_ok() {}

33792    async fn an_entry_session_that_keeps_writing_should_not_be_idle_evicted() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
33793        let idle_timeout = Duration::from_millis(400);
33794        let mgr = RecordingManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
33795            idle_timeout,
33796            ..Default::default()
33797        });
33798        let (msg_tx, mut msg_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
33799        let (new_session_tx, _new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(4);
33800        mgr.start(msg_tx, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
33801
33802        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
33803        let opening = tokio::spawn({
33804            let mgr = mgr.clone();
33805            async move {
33806                mgr.new_session(
33807                    (&ChainKeypair::random()).into(),
33808                    SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
33809                    SessionClientConfig {
33810                        capabilities: Capabilities::empty(),
33811                        pseudonym: pseudonym.into(),
33812                        surb_management: None,
33813                        ..Default::default()
33814                    },
33815                )
33816                .await
33817                .map_err(anyhow::Error::from)
33818            }
33819        });
33820
33821        let start = timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), msg_rx.next())
33822            .await
33823            .context("the Entry must send its StartSession")?
33824            .context("the sender must stay open")?;
33825        let Ok(StartProtocol::StartSession(initiation)) =
33826            HoprStartProtocol::decode(start.1.data.application_tag, &start.1.data.plain_text)
33827        else {
33828            anyhow::bail!("the first message must be a StartSession");
33829        };
33830        mgr.dispatch_message(
33831            pseudonym,
33832            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SessionEstablished(StartEstablished {
33833                orig_challenge: initiation.challenge,
33834                session_id: pseudonym,
33835            }))?,
33836        )?;
33837        let mut session = timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), opening)
33838            .await
33839            .context("the Entry must establish")???;
33840
33841        // Write for several idle timeouts; nothing is ever read back.
33842        let until = tokio::time::Instant::now() + idle_timeout * 5;
33843        while tokio::time::Instant::now() < until {
33844            session.write_all(&[7u8; 600]).await?;
33845            session.flush().await?;
33846            // `contains_key` does not refresh the idle timer, so only the writes can keep the slot.
33847            mgr.sessions.run_pending_tasks();
33848            assert!(
33849                mgr.sessions.contains_key(&pseudonym),
33850                "a writing Entry must keep its slot"
33851            );
33852            tokio::time::sleep(idle_timeout / 20).await;
33853        }
33854
33855        // Once it stops, the slot goes after the idle timeout.
33856        let mut evicted = false;
33857        for _ in 0..50 {
33858            tokio::time::sleep(idle_timeout / 10).await;
33859            mgr.sessions.run_pending_tasks();
33860            if !mgr.sessions.contains_key(&pseudonym) {
33861                evicted = true;
33862                break;
33863            }
33864        }
33865        assert!(
33866            evicted,
33867            "an Entry that stopped writing must be evicted after its idle timeout"
33868        );
33869        Ok(())
33870    }

33965    /// The Exit's egress refuses a superseded instance before counting, and a writer parked on the gate
33966    /// when the instance is superseded is refused once the gate admits it, giving its SURB back.
33967    #[tokio::test]
33968    async fn the_exit_egress_refuses_a_superseded_instance_before_and_after_the_gate() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
33969        let estimator = AtomicSurbFlowEstimator::default();
33970        estimator.produced.store(40, Ordering::Relaxed);
33971
33972        let instance = SlotInstance::new(MIN_CHALLENGE);
33973        let gate = ServiceGate::new(0, 10);
33974        let (tx, mut forwarded) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded::<EgressItem>();
33975        let mut sink = Box::pin(exit_data_egress(
33976            tx.sink_map_err(std::io::Error::other),
33977            HoprPseudonym::random(),
33978            estimator.clone(),
33979            balancer_with_target(3_200),
33980            Some(gate.clone()),
33981            false,
33982            instance.clone(),
33983        ));
33984
33985        // Parked on the exhausted budget: the SURB is counted while the send waits.
33986        let mut parked = Box::pin(sink.send(data_packet()?));
33987        assert!(
33988            futures::poll!(parked.as_mut()).is_pending(),
33989            "the exhausted gate must park the write"
33990        );
33991        assert_eq!(39, estimator.saturating_diff(), "the parked packet's SURB is counted");
33992
33993        // Superseded while it waits; then funded.
33994        instance.supersede();
33995        gate.release_service();
33996        let outcome = timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), parked)
33997            .await
33998            .context("the parked write must resolve")?;
33999        assert_eq!(
34000            Some(std::io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe),
34001            outcome.as_ref().err().map(std::io::Error::kind),
34002            "a permit granted to a superseded instance must not let the packet through"
34003        );
34004        assert!(forwarded.try_recv().is_err(), "nothing may be forwarded");
34005        assert_eq!(
34006            40,
34007            estimator.saturating_diff(),
34008            "the cut packet's SURB is back in the held count"
34009        );
34010
34011        // And a fresh write on the superseded instance is refused before anything is counted.
34012        let counted = (estimator.estimate_surbs_consumed(), estimator.estimate_surbs_refunded());
34013        let (tx, mut forwarded) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded::<EgressItem>();
34014        let mut sink = Box::pin(exit_data_egress(
34015            tx.sink_map_err(std::io::Error::other),
34016            HoprPseudonym::random(),
34017            estimator.clone(),
34018            balancer_with_target(3_200),
34019            None,
34020            false,
34021            instance,
34022        ));
34023        assert!(sink.send(data_packet()?).await.is_err());
34024        assert!(forwarded.try_recv().is_err());
34025        assert_eq!(
34026            counted,
34027            (estimator.estimate_surbs_consumed(), estimator.estimate_surbs_refunded()),
34028            "the refused write neither books nor refunds a SURB"
34029        );
34030        Ok(())
34031    }

34033    /// A guard's rollback removes its own slot and nobody else's.
34034    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
34035    async fn a_guard_rollback_removes_only_its_own_slot() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
34036        let session_id = HoprPseudonym::random();
34037        let mgr = SessionManager::<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>::new(Default::default());
34038
34039        let first = unregistered_slot(session_id);
34040        let first_guard = mgr
34041            .allocate_session_slot(session_id, first.clone())
34042            .context("the first slot must be allocated")?;
34043
34044        // The first establishment is torn down by someone else, and a successor takes the pseudonym.
34045        let removed = remove_slot_if(&mgr.sessions, &session_id, |slot| {
34046            Arc::ptr_eq(&slot.admission_token, &first.admission_token)
34047        });
34048        assert!(removed.is_some());
34049        mgr.active_sessions.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
34050        let successor = unregistered_slot(session_id);
34051        let mut successor_guard = mgr
34052            .allocate_session_slot(session_id, successor.clone())
34053            .context("the successor must be allocated")?;
34054        successor_guard.commit(None, None, 0);
34055
34056        // The first guard, never committed, rolls back now: the successor must stay.
34057        drop(first_guard);
34058        let kept = mgr.sessions.get(&session_id).context("the successor must survive")?;
34059        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&kept.admission_token, &successor.admission_token));
34060        assert_eq!(mgr.num_active_sessions(), 1);
34061
34062        // Control: a guard whose slot is current does remove it.
34063        let other_id = HoprPseudonym::random();
34064        let guard = mgr
34065            .allocate_session_slot(other_id, unregistered_slot(other_id))
34066            .context("allocation must succeed")?;
34067        assert!(mgr.sessions.get(&other_id).is_some());
34068        drop(guard);
34069        assert!(
34070            mgr.sessions.get(&other_id).is_none(),
34071            "an uncommitted guard removes its own slot"
34072        );
34073        Ok(())
34074    }

34076    /// A PIX driver of a torn-down Session, which still holds that Session's control plane, can neither
34077    /// silence the fill of a fresh Session under the same pseudonym nor close it.
34078    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
34079    async fn a_stale_pix_driver_cannot_touch_a_fresh_session_under_the_same_pseudonym() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
34080        let params = fill_pix_params();
34081        let (mgr, _msg_rx, pseudonym) = recovering_exit_pix_session(
34082            Capabilities::empty(),
34083            Some(Duration::from_secs(1)),
34084            crate::supervision::PixFillConfig {
34085                min_surb_reserve: 1,
34086                drain_after_close: false,
34087                ..Default::default()
34088            },
34089            None,
34090        )
34091        .await?;
34092        let old = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("the first slot must exist")?;
34093        let stale_plane = old.pix_supervisor.clone();
34094        let old_instance = old.instance.clone();
34095        drop(old);
34096
34097        assert!(mgr.close_session(&pseudonym));
34098        assert!(wait_for_no_active_sessions(&mgr).await);
34099
34100        // The fixture's incoming-session receiver is gone, so the successor's hand-over goes to a drain.
34101        {
34102            let (notifier, _) = mgr.session_notifiers.get().context("the manager is started")?;
34103            *notifier.lock().await =
34104                Box::pin(futures::sink::drain::<IncomingSession>().sink_map_err(SessionManagerError::other));
34105        }
34106        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(
34107            pseudonym,
34108            StartInitiation {
34109                challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE + 1,
34110                target: SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
34111                capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities(Capabilities::empty() | Capability::UsePIX),
34112                additional_data: into_initiation_additional_data(params.into_additional_data(0), Duration::ZERO),
34113            },
34114        )
34115        .await?;
34116        let fresh = mgr
34117            .sessions
34118            .get(&pseudonym)
34119            .context("the successor's slot must exist")?;
34120        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&fresh.pix_supervisor, &stale_plane));
34121        let fill = fresh
34122            .pix_fill
34123            .get()
34124            .context("an Exit PIX Session has a fill control")?
34125            .clone();
34126        fill.set_fill(FillRate::per_second(7));
34127        let before = fill.effective_rate();
34128
34129        assert!(mgr.slot_of_control_plane(&pseudonym, &stale_plane).is_none());
34130        mgr.stop_pix_fill(&pseudonym, &stale_plane);
34131        assert_eq!(
34132            before,
34133            fill.effective_rate(),
34134            "the stale driver must not silence the fresh fill"
34135        );
34136
34137        for scope in [
34138            CloseScope::ControlPlane(&stale_plane),
34139            CloseScope::Instance(&old_instance),
34140        ] {
34141            assert!(
34142                !mgr.close_session_scoped(&pseudonym, ClosureReason::MissingDepositData, scope),
34143                "a stale scope must not close the fresh Session"
34144            );
34145        }
34146        let still = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("the fresh Session must survive")?;
34147        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&still.instance, &fresh.instance));
34148
34149        // Control: the fresh Session's own control plane does act.
34150        mgr.stop_pix_fill(&pseudonym, &fresh.pix_supervisor);
34151        assert_ne!(before, fill.effective_rate(), "its own driver silences its own fill");
34152        assert!(mgr.close_session_scoped(
34153            &pseudonym,
34154            ClosureReason::MissingDepositData,
34155            CloseScope::ControlPlane(&fresh.pix_supervisor)
34156        ));
34157        Ok(())
34158    }

34160    /// A slot removed through `remove_slot_if` is superseded, and its control plane torn down, by the
34161    /// time the removal returns.
34162    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
34163    async fn a_slot_removed_by_remove_slot_if_is_already_superseded() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
34164        let session_id = HoprPseudonym::random();
34165        let mgr = SessionManager::<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>::new(Default::default());
34166        let slot = unregistered_slot(session_id);
34167        let _guard = mgr
34168            .allocate_session_slot(session_id, slot.clone())
34169            .context("the slot must be allocated")?;
34170
34171        // A refused predicate leaves everything as it was.
34172        assert!(remove_slot_if(&mgr.sessions, &session_id, |_| false).is_none());
34173        assert!(!slot.instance.is_superseded());
34174        assert!(!slot.pix_supervisor.is_torn_down());
34175
34176        let removed = remove_slot_if(&mgr.sessions, &session_id, |_| true).context("the slot must be removed")?;
34177        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&removed.instance, &slot.instance));
34178        assert!(slot.instance.is_superseded(), "superseded inside the removal");
34179        assert!(slot.pix_supervisor.is_torn_down(), "the control plane is flagged too");
34180        Ok(())
34181    }
