34183    /// A PIX driver of a torn-down Session reports nothing to, and re-sends nothing into, a successor
34184    /// under the same pseudonym.
34185    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
34186    async fn a_stale_pix_driver_reports_and_resends_nothing_for_a_successor() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
34187        let (mgr, mut msg_rx, pseudonym) = recovering_exit_pix_session(
34188            Capabilities::empty(),
34189            None,
34190            crate::supervision::PixFillConfig::default(),
34191            None,
34192        )
34193        .await?;
34194        // The fixture's own Session is replaced by a stand-in "old" one with its own control plane and a
34195        // supervisor this test owns, so the driver's events do not reach the fixture's real supervisor.
34196        let real = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("the first slot must exist")?;
34197        assert!(mgr.close_session(&pseudonym));
34198        assert!(wait_for_no_active_sessions(&mgr).await);
34199        let mut old = real.clone();
34200        old.pix_supervisor = Default::default();
34201        let (old_handle, old_commands) = SessionPixSupervisorHandle::observable();
34202        let _ = old.pix_supervisor.set(old_handle);
34203        old.abort_handles = Default::default();
34204        old.admission_token = Default::default();
34205        old.instance = SlotInstance::new(1);
34206        let mut old_guard = mgr
34207            .allocate_session_slot(pseudonym, old.clone())
34208            .context("the old slot must be allocated")?;
34209        old_guard.commit(None, None, 0);
34210        let ssa_requests = |sent: &[(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)]| {
34211            sent.iter()
34212                .filter(|(_, data)| {
34213                    matches!(
34214                        HoprStartProtocol::decode(data.data.application_tag, &data.data.plain_text),
34215                        Ok(StartProtocol::SsaRequest(_))
34216                    )
34217                })
34218                .count()
34219        };
34220        let _ = originated_during(&mut msg_rx, Duration::from_millis(200)).await;
34221
34222        // A driver on the old slot that is not among its handles, so the teardown leaves it lingering.
34223        // While the Session is live its request goes out, giving the driver something to re-send.
34224        let (action_tx, action_rx) = crossfire::mpsc::bounded_async::<SessionPixAction>(8);
34225        let _driver = mgr.spawn_pix_action_driver(
34226            pseudonym,
34227            &old,
34228            action_rx,
34229            DestinationRouting::Return(SurbMatcher::Pseudonym(pseudonym)),
34230        );
34231        let ssa_id = SsaId::new(pseudonym, SsaIndex::new(2).context("index two is non-zero")?);
34232        action_tx
34233            .send(SessionPixAction::RequestSsa {
34234                ssa_ids: vec![ssa_id],
34235                params: fill_pix_params(),
34236            })
34237            .await
34238            .map_err(|_| anyhow!("the driver must accept the action"))?;
34239        let sent = originated_during(&mut msg_rx, Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
34240        assert_eq!(
34241            1,
34242            ssa_requests(&sent),
34243            "the live driver sends its request, got {sent:?}"
34244        );
34245
34246        assert!(mgr.close_session(&pseudonym));
34247        assert!(wait_for_no_active_sessions(&mgr).await);
34248        assert!(
34249            old.pix_supervisor.is_torn_down(),
34250            "the teardown flags the control plane"
34251        );
34252
34253        // The successor has a supervisor handle whose commands this test can see.
34254        let mut successor = unregistered_slot(pseudonym);
34255        let (handle, successor_commands) = SessionPixSupervisorHandle::observable();
34256        let _ = successor.pix_supervisor.set(handle);
34257        successor.instance = SlotInstance::new(2);
34258        mgr.sessions.insert(pseudonym, successor);
34259        let _ = originated_during(&mut msg_rx, Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
34260
34261        // Its own slot gone, the driver's failure goes nowhere near the successor; nor does a re-send.
34262        let ssa_id_3 = SsaId::new(pseudonym, SsaIndex::new(3).context("index three is non-zero")?);
34263        action_tx
34264            .send(SessionPixAction::RequestSsa {
34265                ssa_ids: vec![ssa_id_3],
34266                params: fill_pix_params(),
34267            })
34268            .await
34269            .map_err(|_| anyhow!("the driver must accept the action"))?;
34270        action_tx
34271            .send(SessionPixAction::ResendSsaRequest { ssa_ids: vec![ssa_id] })
34272            .await
34273            .map_err(|_| anyhow!("the driver must accept the action"))?;
34274        // The driver handles actions in order, so a failed `RequestSsa` queued after the re-send shows
34275        // that the re-send was handled too.
34276        let ssa_id_4 = SsaId::new(pseudonym, SsaIndex::new(4).context("index four is non-zero")?);
34277        action_tx
34278            .send(SessionPixAction::RequestSsa {
34279                ssa_ids: vec![ssa_id_4],
34280                params: fill_pix_params(),
34281            })
34282            .await
34283            .map_err(|_| anyhow!("the driver must accept the action"))?;
34284
34285        // Wait for the stale driver's failed `RequestSsa` results for both `ssa_id_3` and `ssa_id_4`, which it
34286        // reports to its own supervisor. Other commands, such as the `SsaRequestSent` left from the live
34287        // phase, are skipped. The driver handles actions in order, so `ssa_id_4`'s failure proves the
34288        // re-send before it was handled. The timeout only bounds a failure.
34289        let (mut seen_3, mut seen_4) = (false, false);
34290        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(10), async {
34291            while !(seen_3 && seen_4) {
34292                let command = old_commands
34293                    .recv()
34294                    .await
34295                    .map_err(|_| anyhow!("the old supervisor's channel closed"))?;
34296                if let Some(ids) = command.failed_request_ssa_ids() {
34297                    seen_3 |= ids == [ssa_id_3];
34298                    seen_4 |= ids == [ssa_id_4];
34299                }
34300            }
34301            anyhow::Ok(())
34302        })
34303        .await
34304        .context("the stale driver must report its failed requests to its own supervisor")??;
34305
34306        let sent = originated_during(&mut msg_rx, Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
34307        assert!(
34308            sent.is_empty(),
34309            "no SSA request may be sent for the successor, got {sent:?}"
34310        );
34311        assert!(
34312            successor_commands.try_recv().is_err(),
34313            "the successor's supervisor must hear nothing from the stale driver"
34314        );
34315        assert!(mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).is_some(), "the successor must survive");
34316        Ok(())
34317    }
34318
34319    // -- Entry PIX continuity: a reconnect under the same pseudonym. --
34320
34321    /// What the stub Exit of a [`ReconnectRig`] answers to a `StartSession`.
34322    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
34323    enum StubReply {
34324        /// `SessionEstablished`: a fresh Session.
34325        Established,
34326        /// `SessionResumed` with the given stream base.
34327        Resumed(u32),
34328        /// A `SessionError` with the given reason, naming the initiation's challenge.
34329        Refused(StartErrorReason),
34330        /// `SessionResumed` with the given stream base, naming a Session other than the requested one.
34331        ResumedOther(u32),
34332    }
34333
34334    /// An Entry whose generator and ledger are the manager's own, and whose Exit is a stub that
34335    /// answers every `StartSession` as set by [`ReconnectRig::reply_with`] (`SessionEstablished` by default).
34336    struct ReconnectRig {
34337        mgr: RecordingManager,
34338        generator: Arc<SsaShareGenerator<HoprPixSpec>>,
34339        events: std::pin::Pin<Box<dyn futures::Stream<Item = HoprSessionOutPixEvent> + Send>>,
34340        wire: Arc<WireRecord>,
34341        params: PixParams,
34342        reply: Arc<parking_lot::Mutex<StubReply>>,
34343        /// The `additional_data` of every `StartSession` the Entry sent.
34344        initiations: Arc<parking_lot::Mutex<Vec<u128>>>,
34345        /// The capabilities of every `StartSession` the Entry sent.
34346        capabilities: Arc<parking_lot::Mutex<Vec<Capabilities>>>,
34347        /// The `SessionError`s the Entry sent.
34348        session_errors: Arc<parking_lot::Mutex<Vec<StartErrorType<SessionId>>>>,
34349        /// The frame ID of every Session segment the Entry sent.
34350        session_frames: Arc<parking_lot::Mutex<Vec<u32>>>,
34351        _stub_exit: AbortOnDrop,
34352    }
34353
34354    async fn reconnect_rig(params: PixParams, cfg: SessionManagerConfig) -> anyhow::Result<ReconnectRig> {
34355        reconnect_rig_retaining(params, cfg, PIX_LEDGER_IDLE_RETENTION).await
34356    }
34357
34358    /// [`reconnect_rig`] with the retention of parked ledgers shortened to `retention`.
34359    async fn reconnect_rig_retaining(
34360        params: PixParams,
34361        cfg: SessionManagerConfig,
34362        retention: Duration,
34363    ) -> anyhow::Result<ReconnectRig> {
34364        let generator = Arc::new(SsaShareGenerator::new(SsaGeneratorConfig {
34365            polynomials_per_ssa: params.polys_per_ssa(),
34366            threshold: params.shares_per_poly(),
34367            surplus_shares: params.surplus_shares(),
34368        }));
34369        let (pix_toolbox, events) =
34370            PixToolbox::new(generator.clone(), SsaReconstructor::new(Default::default()).into());
34371        let mut mgr = RecordingManager::new(cfg);
34372        // Before the manager is cloned into its tasks.
34373        mgr.pix_ledgers = moka::sync::Cache::builder()
34374            .max_capacity(64)
34375            .time_to_idle(retention)
34376            .build();
34377        mgr.last_challenges = moka::sync::Cache::builder()
34378            .max_capacity(64)
34379            .time_to_idle(retention)
34380            .build();
34381        let (msg_tx, mut msg_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
34382        let (new_session_tx, _new_sessions) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(4);
34383        mgr.start(msg_tx, new_session_tx, Some(pix_toolbox), None)?;
34384
34385        let wire = Arc::new(WireRecord::default());
34386        let reply = Arc::new(parking_lot::Mutex::new(StubReply::Established));
34387        let initiations = Arc::new(parking_lot::Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
34388        let capabilities = Arc::new(parking_lot::Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
34389        let session_errors = Arc::new(parking_lot::Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
34390        let session_frames = Arc::new(parking_lot::Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
34391        let stub_exit = hopr_utils::runtime::prelude::spawn({
34392            let mgr = mgr.clone();
34393            let wire = wire.clone();
34394            let reply = reply.clone();
34395            let initiations = initiations.clone();
34396            let capabilities = capabilities.clone();
34397            let session_errors = session_errors.clone();
34398            let session_frames = session_frames.clone();
34399            async move {
34400                while let Some((routing, data)) = msg_rx.next().await {
34401                    let Ok(message) = HoprStartProtocol::decode(data.data.application_tag, &data.data.plain_text)
34402                    else {
34403                        if let Some(segment) = hopr_protocol_session::types::SessionMessage::<
34404                            { ApplicationData::PAYLOAD_SIZE },
34405                        >::try_from(data.data.plain_text.as_ref())
34406                        .ok()
34407                        .and_then(|message| message.try_as_segment())
34408                        {
34409                            session_frames.lock().push(segment.frame_id);
34410                        }
34411                        continue;
34412                    };
34413                    wire.sent.lock().push(StartProtocolDiscriminants::from(&message));
34414                    if let StartProtocol::SessionError(error) = &message {
34415                        session_errors.lock().push(error.clone());
34416                    }
34417                    if let (StartProtocol::StartSession(init), DestinationRouting::Forward { pseudonym: Some(p), .. }) =
34418                        (message, routing)
34419                    {
34420                        initiations.lock().push(init.additional_data);
34421                        capabilities.lock().push(init.capabilities.0);
34422                        let answer = match *reply.lock() {
34423                            StubReply::Established => HoprStartProtocol::SessionEstablished(StartEstablished {
34424                                orig_challenge: init.challenge,
34425                                session_id: p,
34426                            }),
34427                            StubReply::Resumed(stream_base) => HoprStartProtocol::SessionResumed(StartResumed {
34428                                orig_challenge: init.challenge,
34429                                session_id: p,
34430                                stream_base,
34431                            }),
34432                            StubReply::ResumedOther(stream_base) => HoprStartProtocol::SessionResumed(StartResumed {
34433                                orig_challenge: init.challenge,
34434                                session_id: HoprPseudonym::random(),
34435                                stream_base,
34436                            }),
34437                            StubReply::Refused(reason) => HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(StartErrorType {
34438                                identifier: ErrorIdentifier::Challenge(init.challenge),
34439                                reason,
34440                            }),
34441                        };
34442                        if let Ok(packet) = start_packet(answer) {
34443                            let _ = mgr.dispatch_message(p, packet);
34444                        }
34445                    }
34446                }
34447            }
34448        });
34449        Ok(ReconnectRig {
34450            mgr,
34451            generator,
34452            events: Box::pin(events),
34453            wire,
34454            params,
34455            reply,
34456            initiations,
34457            capabilities,
34458            session_errors,
34459            session_frames,
34460            _stub_exit: stub_exit.into(),
34461        })
34462    }
34463
34464    fn entry_cfg(capabilities: Capabilities, pseudonym: Option<HoprPseudonym>) -> SessionClientConfig {
34465        SessionClientConfig {
34466            capabilities,
34467            pseudonym,
34468            surb_management: None,
34469            // PIX needs a relayer on the return path.
34470            return_path_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(1.try_into().expect("valid hop count")),
34471            ..Default::default()
34472        }
34473    }
34474
34475    /// A stream base of the size the Exit adds above the predecessor's highest frame.
34476    const TEST_STREAM_BASE: u32 = 1 << 16;
34477
34478    impl ReconnectRig {
34479        /// Sets what the stub Exit answers to the next `StartSession`s.
34480        fn reply_with(&self, reply: StubReply) {
34481            *self.reply.lock() = reply;
34482        }
34483
34484        /// The ledger parked in the retention cache for `pseudonym`, if any.
34485        fn parked_ledger(&self, pseudonym: &HoprPseudonym) -> Option<EntryPixLedger> {
34486            self.mgr.pix_ledgers.run_pending_tasks();
34487            self.mgr.pix_ledgers.get(pseudonym)
34488        }
34489
34490        async fn connect(&self, cfg: SessionClientConfig) -> anyhow::Result<HoprSession> {
34491            timeout(
34492                Duration::from_secs(5),
34493                self.mgr.new_session(
34494                    (&ChainKeypair::random()).into(),
34495                    SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
34496                    cfg,
34497                ),
34498            )
34499            .await
34500            .context("the stub Exit must establish the Session")?
34501            .map_err(anyhow::Error::from)
34502        }
34503
34504        async fn connect_pix(&self, pseudonym: Option<HoprPseudonym>) -> anyhow::Result<HoprSession> {
34505            self.connect(entry_cfg(Capability::UsePIX | Capability::Segmentation, pseudonym))
34506                .await
34507        }
34508
34509        /// The Exit asking for the SSA batch starting at `index`.
34510        async fn request(&self, pseudonym: HoprPseudonym, index: u32) -> errors::Result<()> {
34511            self.mgr
34512                .handle_ssa_request(
34513                    pseudonym,
34514                    SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(pseudonym, self.params, ssa_request_for(index), []),
34515                )
34516                .await
34517        }
34518
34519        /// Opens a PIX Session under `pseudonym` with a fresh Exit and commits its opening batch, so the
34520        /// Entry holds ledger and generator state for the pseudonym. Leaves the stub answering `SessionEstablished`.
34521        async fn hold_state(&self, pseudonym: HoprPseudonym) -> anyhow::Result<HoprSession> {
34522            self.reply_with(StubReply::Established);
34523            let session = self.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await?;
34524            self.request(pseudonym, 1).await.context("the opening batch")?;
34525            self.emit_cycle(&pseudonym)?;
34526            Ok(session)
34527        }
34528
34529        /// Whether the last `StartSession` the Entry sent marked a resume attempt.
34530        fn last_attempt(&self) -> anyhow::Result<bool> {
34531            self.initiations
34532                .lock()
34533                .last()
34534                .copied()
34535                .map(announced_resume_attempt)
34536                .context("no StartSession was sent")
34537        }
34538
34539        /// The capabilities of the last `StartSession` the Entry sent.
34540        fn last_capabilities(&self) -> anyhow::Result<Capabilities> {
34541            self.capabilities
34542                .lock()
34543                .last()
34544                .copied()
34545                .context("no StartSession was sent")
34546        }
34547
34548        fn emit_cycle(&self, pseudonym: &HoprPseudonym) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
34549            for sent in 1..=(self.params.polys_per_ssa() as u32 * self.params.emitted_shares_per_poly() as u32) {
34550                self.generator.next_share(pseudonym, &sent.to_be_bytes())?;
34551            }
34552            Ok(())
34553        }
34554
34555        fn watermark(&self, pseudonym: &HoprPseudonym) -> Option<SsaIndex> {
34556            self.mgr
34557                .sessions
34558                .get(pseudonym)?
34559                .current_ssa_state
34560                .get()?
34561                .committed_watermark()
34562        }
34563
34564        async fn deposits(&mut self) -> usize {
34565            drain_pix_events(&mut self.events).await
34566        }
34567    }
34568
34569    /// Reconnecting under a pseudonym with the Exit continuing: the Entry judges the next request on
34570    /// the served count and watermark the predecessor left, instead of on a fresh ledger that has
34571    /// neither.
34572    ///
34573    /// ## Steps
34574    /// 1. A Session under a random pseudonym is opened, the opening batch committed, and the cycle emitted.
34575    /// 2. A new Session is opened under that pseudonym, explicitly. It takes over the ledger.
34576    /// 3. A request for SSA 2 is refused as under-served, and the Session lives.
34577    /// 4. The returned packets arrive on the new Session, and the same request is admitted.
34578    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
34579    async fn a_reconnect_with_a_continuing_exit_is_judged_on_the_carried_ledger() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
34580        let mut rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
34581        let first = rig.connect_pix(None).await?;
34582        let pseudonym = *first.id();
34583        rig.request(pseudonym, 1).await.context("the opening batch")?;
34584        assert_eq!(1, rig.deposits().await);
34585        rig.emit_cycle(&pseudonym)?;
34586        let old_instance = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.clone();
34587
34588        rig.reply_with(StubReply::Resumed(TEST_STREAM_BASE));
34589        let second = rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await?;
34590        assert!(old_instance.is_superseded(), "the predecessor is closed");
34591        assert_ne!(first.slot_instance(), second.slot_instance());
34592        assert_eq!(
34593            Some(SsaIndex::MIN),
34594            rig.watermark(&pseudonym),
34595            "the successor starts on the ledger of the predecessor"
34596        );
34597
34598        let err = rig
34599            .request(pseudonym, 2)
34600            .await
34601            .expect_err("nothing has been served against the batch yet");
34602        assert!(
34603            matches!(err, TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::NotAdmitted(_))),
34604            "expected an under-served refusal, got {err:?}"
34605        );
34606        assert_eq!(vec![pseudonym], rig.mgr.active_sessions(), "refusing is not fatal");
34607        assert_eq!(0, rig.deposits().await);
34608
34609        credit_returned_packets(&rig.mgr, &pseudonym, required_returned_packets(&rig.params, 1));
34610        rig.request(pseudonym, 2).await.context("served, so admitted")?;
34611        assert_eq!(1, rig.deposits().await);
34612        Ok(())
34613    }

34636    /// `SessionResumed` keeps the ledger and the generator and hands the base to the socket.
34637    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
34638    async fn a_resumed_session_keeps_the_ledger_and_numbers_its_stream_from_the_base() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
34639        let mut rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
34640        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
34641        let first = rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await?;
34642        assert_eq!(None, first.config().stream_base);
34643        rig.request(pseudonym, 1).await?;
34644        assert_eq!(1, rig.deposits().await);
34645        rig.emit_cycle(&pseudonym)?;
34646        let ledger = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.ledger();
34647        let ledger = ledger.context("an Entry slot carries its ledger")?;
34648
34649        rig.reply_with(StubReply::Resumed(TEST_STREAM_BASE));
34650        // Segmented and stateless, the one socket that numbers its frames from a base.
34651        let mut second = rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await?;
34652        assert_eq!(Some(TEST_STREAM_BASE), second.config().stream_base);
34653        rig.session_frames.lock().clear();
34654        second.write_all(b"first frame").await?;
34655        second.flush().await?;
34656        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
34657            while rig.session_frames.lock().is_empty() {
34658                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
34659            }
34660        })
34661        .await
34662        .context("the first frame was not sent")?;
34663        assert_eq!(
34664            Some(TEST_STREAM_BASE),
34665            rig.session_frames.lock().first().copied(),
34666            "the first emitted frame carries the base"
34667        );
34668        assert_eq!(Some(SsaIndex::MIN), rig.watermark(&pseudonym), "the ledger is kept");
34669        assert!(
34670            rig.generator.emission_progress(&pseudonym).is_some(),
34671            "the generator is kept"
34672        );
34673        let carried = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.ledger();
34674        assert!(
34675            Arc::ptr_eq(
34676                &ledger.ssa_state,
34677                &carried.context("the successor carries a ledger")?.ssa_state
34678            ),
34679            "the same ledger"
34680        );
34681        Ok(())
34682    }

34856    /// `new_session` under a pseudonym with a live local Session closes it: the predecessor cannot
34857    /// write, its late close is ignored, and the successor is the only Session left.
34858    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
34859    async fn a_new_session_under_a_live_pseudonym_closes_the_old_one() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
34860        let rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
34861        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
34862        let mut first = rig.connect(entry_cfg(Capabilities::empty(), Some(pseudonym))).await?;
34863        let old_instance = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.clone();
34864
34865        let second = rig.connect(entry_cfg(Capabilities::empty(), Some(pseudonym))).await?;
34866        let new_instance = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.clone();
34867        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&old_instance, &new_instance));
34868        assert!(old_instance.is_superseded());
34869        assert!(!new_instance.is_superseded());
34870        assert_eq!(second.slot_instance(), Some(new_instance.id()));
34871        assert_eq!(1, rig.mgr.num_active_sessions());
34872        let outcome = async {
34873            first.write_all(&[1u8; 600]).await?;
34874            first.flush().await
34875        }
34876        .await;
34877        assert!(outcome.is_err(), "the closed Session must not be able to send");
34878
34879        let (_, closures) = rig.mgr.session_notifiers.get().context("started")?.clone();
34880        for reason in [ClosureReason::WriteClosed, ClosureReason::EmptyRead] {
34881            assert!(closures.try_send((pseudonym, reason, old_instance.clone())).is_ok());
34882        }
34883        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
34884        let current = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("the successor must survive")?;
34885        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&current.instance, &new_instance));
34886        assert_eq!(1, rig.mgr.num_active_sessions());
34887        Ok(())
34888    }

34890    /// Superseding is not a new Session as far as the cap goes, and an Exit-side slot is not ours to
34891    /// replace.
34892    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
34893    async fn superseding_works_at_capacity_and_leaves_an_exit_slot_alone() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
34894        let rig = reconnect_rig(
34895            small_pix_params(),

34897                maximum_sessions: 1,
34898                ..Default::default()
34899            },
34900        )
34901        .await?;

34904        assert_eq!(1, rig.mgr.num_active_sessions());
34905
34906        let _second = rig
34907            .connect(entry_cfg(Capabilities::empty(), Some(pseudonym)))
34908            .await
34909            .context("replacing the Session under a pseudonym needs no free slot")?;

34911
34912        let err = rig
34913            .connect(entry_cfg(Capabilities::empty(), None))

34917            matches!(
34918                err.downcast_ref::<TransportSessionError>(),
34919                Some(TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::TooManySessions))
34920            ),
34921            "got {err:?}"
34922        );
34923
34924        // An Exit-side slot under the pseudonym stays, and the initiation fails as a loopback.
34925        let rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
34926        let exit_side = HoprPseudonym::random();
34927        rig.mgr
34928            .pre_populate_session(exit_side, DestinationRouting::Return(exit_side.into()));
34929        let before = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&exit_side).context("slot")?.instance.clone();

34934        );

34936        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&before, &after.instance));

34941    /// Every PIX `StartSession` carries `Resumable`, a non-PIX one does not, and no bit above the idle timeout
34942    /// is set on a first connect.
34943    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
34944    async fn every_pix_initiation_carries_resumable() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
34945        let rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
34946        let _plain = rig.connect(entry_cfg(Capabilities::empty(), None)).await?;
34947        assert!(!rig.last_capabilities()?.contains(Capability::Resumable));
34948        let _pix = rig.connect_pix(None).await?;
34949        assert!(rig.last_capabilities()?.contains(Capability::Resumable));
34950        let sent = rig.initiations.lock().clone();
34951        assert_eq!(2, sent.len());
34952        for additional_data in sent {
34953            assert!(!announced_resume_attempt(additional_data), "{additional_data:#x}");
34954            assert_eq!(0, additional_data & (0xffff_ffffu128 << 32), "{additional_data:#x}");
34955        }
34956        Ok(())
34957    }
34958
34959    #[test]
34960    fn the_resume_attempt_bit_is_bit_33_and_leaves_the_other_fields_alone() {
34961        assert_eq!(1u128 << 33, INITIATION_RESUME_ATTEMPT);
34962        let reserved = 0xffff_ffffu128 << 32;
34963        for (options, idle) in [(0u64, Duration::ZERO), (0xdead_beef_0000_0001, Duration::from_secs(90))] {
34964            let data = into_initiation_additional_data(options, idle);
34965            assert!(!announced_resume_attempt(data));
34966            assert_eq!(0, data & reserved, "bits 32..64 stay clear");
34967            let attempt = data | INITIATION_RESUME_ATTEMPT;
34968            assert!(announced_resume_attempt(attempt));
34969            assert_eq!(options, initiation_options(attempt));
34970            assert_eq!((!idle.is_zero()).then_some(idle), announced_idle_timeout(attempt));
34971        }
34972        assert!(!announced_resume_attempt(0));
34973        assert!(!announced_resume_attempt(!INITIATION_RESUME_ATTEMPT));
34974        assert!(announced_resume_attempt(INITIATION_RESUME_ATTEMPT));
34975    }

34977    /// A base the socket cannot number a stream from, or a stateful socket, fails the establishment
34978    /// cleanly: no Session, no slot, no pending state, and the ledger is parked for a retry.
34979    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
34980    async fn an_invalid_resume_fails_the_establishment_cleanly() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
34981        let rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
34982        for (case, reply, capabilities) in [
34983            (
34984                "a zero base",
34985                StubReply::Resumed(0),
34986                Capabilities::from(Capability::Segmentation),
34987            ),
34988            (
34989                "a base above the maximum",
34990                StubReply::Resumed(MAX_STREAM_BASE + 1),
34991                Capabilities::from(Capability::Segmentation),
34992            ),
34993            (
34994                "a raw Session",
34995                StubReply::Resumed(TEST_STREAM_BASE),
34996                Capabilities::empty(),
34997            ),
34998            (
34999                "a stateful socket",
35000                StubReply::Resumed(TEST_STREAM_BASE),
35001                Capability::Segmentation | Capability::RetransmissionAck,
35002            ),
35003            (
35004                "a stateful socket with retransmission nacks",
35005                StubReply::Resumed(TEST_STREAM_BASE),
35006                Capability::Segmentation | Capability::RetransmissionNack,
35007            ),
35008        ] {
35009            let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
35010            // The Entry holds state for the pseudonym, so the reconnect is a resume attempt.
35011            rig.reply_with(StubReply::Established);
35012            let _first = rig
35013                .connect(entry_cfg(capabilities | Capability::UsePIX, Some(pseudonym)))
35014                .await?;
35015            rig.request(pseudonym, 1).await?;
35016            rig.reply_with(reply);
35017            let err = rig
35018                .connect(entry_cfg(capabilities | Capability::UsePIX, Some(pseudonym)))
35019                .await
35020                .expect_err(case);
35021            assert!(rig.last_attempt()?, "{case}: a resume attempt");
35022            assert!(
35023                matches!(
35024                    err.downcast_ref::<TransportSessionError>(),
35025                    Some(TransportSessionError::Manager(SessionManagerError::Unacceptable(_)))
35026                ),
35027                "{case}: got {err:?}"
35028            );
35029            assert!(rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).is_none(), "{case}: no slot");
35030            assert_eq!(0, rig.mgr.num_active_sessions(), "{case}");
35031            rig.mgr.session_initiations.run_pending_tasks();
35032            assert_eq!(
35033                0,
35034                rig.mgr.session_initiations.entry_count(),
35035                "{case}: no pending initiation"
35036            );
35037            rig.mgr.pending_outgoing.run_pending_tasks();
35038            assert_eq!(0, rig.mgr.pending_outgoing.entry_count(), "{case}: no pending claim");
35039            assert!(
35040                rig.parked_ledger(&pseudonym).is_some(),
35041                "{case}: the ledger is parked for a retry"
35042            );
35043        }
35044
35045        // The boundary values are valid.
35046        for base in [1, MAX_STREAM_BASE] {
35047            let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
35048            let _first = rig.hold_state(pseudonym).await?;
35049            rig.reply_with(StubReply::Resumed(base));
35050            let session = rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await?;
35051            assert_eq!(Some(base), session.config().stream_base);
35052        }
35053        Ok(())
35054    }

35056    /// The resume attempt is marked exactly when the Entry holds PIX state for the pseudonym, and a caller
35057    /// cannot set `Resumable` on a non-PIX Session.
35058    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
35059    async fn the_resume_attempt_follows_the_pix_state() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
35060        let rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
35061        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
35062
35063        // A first connect holds no state.
35064        let _first = rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await?;
35065        assert!(!rig.last_attempt()?, "first connect");
35066
35067        // A ledger watermark alone: offered, though the Entry cannot continue on half its state.
35068        rig.request(pseudonym, 1).await?;
35069        rig.generator.forget(&pseudonym);
35070        rig.reply_with(StubReply::Resumed(TEST_STREAM_BASE));
35071        assert!(rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await.is_err());
35072        assert!(rig.last_attempt()?, "ledger watermark");
35073        assert!(rig.last_capabilities()?.contains(Capability::UsePIX));
35074
35075        // A non-PIX connect never attempts one.
35076        rig.reply_with(StubReply::Established);
35077        let _plain = rig.connect(entry_cfg(Capabilities::empty(), Some(pseudonym))).await?;
35078        assert!(rig.last_capabilities()?.is_empty(), "non-PIX connect");
35079        assert!(!rig.last_attempt()?, "non-PIX connect");
35080
35081        // Generator state alone: a ledger without a watermark.
35082        let generator_only = HoprPseudonym::random();
35083        let _session = rig.connect_pix(Some(generator_only)).await?;
35084        rig.request(generator_only, 1).await?;
35085        rig.emit_cycle(&generator_only)?;
35086        rig.mgr.close_session(&generator_only);
35087        let fresh = EntryPixLedger::new(rig.params);
35088        rig.mgr.pix_ledgers.insert(generator_only, fresh);
35089        assert!(rig.generator.emission_progress(&generator_only).is_some());
35090        rig.reply_with(StubReply::Resumed(TEST_STREAM_BASE));
35091        assert!(rig.connect_pix(Some(generator_only)).await.is_err());
35092        assert!(rig.last_attempt()?, "generator-only state");
35093
35094        // A ledger of other dimensions is replaced together with the generator's state.
35095        let replaced = HoprPseudonym::random();
35096        let _held = rig.hold_state(replaced).await?;
35097        rig.mgr.close_session(&replaced);
35098        let other = PixParams::try_new(
35099            rig.params.polys_per_ssa() + 1,
35100            rig.params.shares_per_poly(),
35101            rig.params.surplus_shares(),
35102            LOCAL_PIX_SUITE,
35103        )?;
35104        rig.mgr.pix_ledgers.insert(replaced, EntryPixLedger::new(other));
35105        rig.reply_with(StubReply::Established);
35106        let _fresh = rig.connect_pix(Some(replaced)).await?;
35107        assert!(!rig.last_attempt()?, "a replaced ledger starts over");
35108        assert!(rig.generator.emission_progress(&replaced).is_none());
35109
35110        // A PIX Session is resumable even if the caller did not say so, and a non-PIX one never is.
35111        rig.reply_with(StubReply::Established);
35112        let session = rig
35113            .connect(entry_cfg(Capability::UsePIX.into(), Some(HoprPseudonym::random())))
35114            .await?;
35115        assert!(rig.last_capabilities()?.contains(Capability::Resumable));
35116        assert!(session.config().capabilities.contains(Capability::Resumable));
35117        let session = rig
35118            .connect(entry_cfg(Capability::Resumable.into(), Some(HoprPseudonym::random())))
35119            .await?;
35120        assert!(!rig.last_capabilities()?.contains(Capability::Resumable));
35121        assert!(!session.config().capabilities.contains(Capability::Resumable));
35122        Ok(())
35123    }

35125    /// An Exit that refuses a resume with `NotResumable`: the Entry forgets the pseudonym's PIX state,
35126    /// parks no ledger, and the next connect under it starts over.
35127    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
35128    async fn a_not_resumable_refusal_forgets_the_pseudonym() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
35129        let mut rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
35130        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
35131        let _first = rig.hold_state(pseudonym).await?;
35132        assert_eq!(1, rig.deposits().await);
35133        let held_challenge = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.challenge;
35134
35135        rig.reply_with(StubReply::Refused(StartErrorReason::NotResumable));
35136        let err = rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await.expect_err("refused");
35137        assert!(rig.last_attempt()?);
35138        assert!(
35139            matches!(
35140                err.downcast_ref::<TransportSessionError>(),
35141                Some(TransportSessionError::Rejected(StartErrorReason::NotResumable))
35142            ),
35143            "got {err:?}"
35144        );
35145        assert!(
35146            rig.generator.emission_progress(&pseudonym).is_none(),
35147            "generator forgotten"
35148        );
35149        assert!(rig.parked_ledger(&pseudonym).is_none(), "no ledger is parked");
35150        assert!(rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).is_none());
35151
35152        // The challenge of the refused attempt is kept, so that challenges keep increasing.
35153        rig.mgr.last_challenges.run_pending_tasks();
35154        let kept = rig
35155            .mgr
35156            .last_challenges
35157            .get(&pseudonym)
35158            .context("the last challenge is kept")?;
35159        assert!(kept > held_challenge, "{kept} must be above {held_challenge}");
35160
35161        // The next connect is a first one: not an attempt, and its opening batch commits SSA 1.
35162        rig.reply_with(StubReply::Established);
35163        let _next = rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await?;
35164        assert!(rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.challenge > kept);
35165        assert!(!rig.last_attempt()?);
35166        assert_eq!(None, rig.watermark(&pseudonym));
35167        rig.request(pseudonym, 1).await?;
35168        assert_eq!(1, rig.deposits().await);
35169        assert_eq!(Some(SsaIndex::MIN), rig.watermark(&pseudonym));
35170        Ok(())
35171    }

35173    /// Forgetting the pseudonym's PIX state after a `NotResumable` refusal also starts a new SURB generation for it.
35174    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
35175    async fn a_not_resumable_refusal_starts_a_new_surb_generation() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
35176        struct Generations(parking_lot::Mutex<Vec<SessionId>>);
35177        impl SurbAdmissionControl for Generations {
35178            fn admit(&self, _: &SessionId, _: usize) -> AdmissionToken {
35179                AdmissionToken::NONE
35180            }
35181
35182            fn retire(&self, _: &SessionId, _: AdmissionToken) {}
35183
35184            fn advance_generation(&self, pseudonym: &SessionId) {
35185                self.0.lock().push(*pseudonym);
35186            }
35187        }
35188
35189        let rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
35190        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
35191        let _first = rig.hold_state(pseudonym).await?;
35192        let generations = Arc::new(Generations(Default::default()));
35193        assert!(rig.mgr.set_surb_admission(generations.clone()));
35194        assert!(generations.0.lock().is_empty());
35195
35196        rig.reply_with(StubReply::Refused(StartErrorReason::NotResumable));
35197        rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await.expect_err("refused");
35198        assert_eq!(vec![pseudonym], *generations.0.lock());
35199        Ok(())
35200    }

35202    /// A fresh `SessionEstablished` answering a resume attempt is refused: the Exit is told to close its
35203    /// Session, no slot exists, and the state is forgotten, so a concurrent opening request deposits nothing.
35204    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
35205    async fn a_fresh_session_answering_a_resume_attempt_is_refused() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
35206        let mut rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
35207        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
35208        let _first = rig.hold_state(pseudonym).await?;
35209        assert_eq!(1, rig.deposits().await);
35210        let held_challenge = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.challenge;
35211
35212        let (connected, concurrent) = tokio::join!(rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)), rig.request(pseudonym, 1));
35213        let err = connected.expect_err("a fresh Session cannot answer a resume attempt");
35214        assert!(rig.last_attempt()?);
35215        assert!(
35216            matches!(
35217                err.downcast_ref::<TransportSessionError>(),
35218                Some(TransportSessionError::Rejected(StartErrorReason::NotResumable))
35219            ),
35220            "got {err:?}"
35221        );
35222        assert!(concurrent.is_err(), "no slot to deposit for");
35223        assert_eq!(
35224            vec![StartErrorType {
35225                identifier: ErrorIdentifier::SessionId(pseudonym),
35226                reason: StartErrorReason::NotResumable,
35227            }],
35228            rig.session_errors.lock().clone()
35229        );
35230        assert!(rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).is_none(), "no slot");
35231        assert_eq!(0, rig.mgr.num_active_sessions());
35232        assert!(rig.generator.emission_progress(&pseudonym).is_none(), "state forgotten");
35233        assert!(rig.parked_ledger(&pseudonym).is_none());
35234        assert_eq!(0, rig.deposits().await, "the opening request deposited nothing");
35235        rig.mgr.last_challenges.run_pending_tasks();
35236        assert!(
35237            rig.mgr
35238                .last_challenges
35239                .get(&pseudonym)
35240                .context("the last challenge is kept")?
35241                > held_challenge,
35242            "the challenge of the defensive refusal is kept"
35243        );
35244        Ok(())
35245    }

35267    /// The ledger stays in the slot for the whole life of the Session, and its retention starts at
35268    /// the teardown: a Session that outlives the retention still finds its ledger after it ends, a
35269    /// reconnect continues it, and a parked ledger expires after the retention.
35270    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
35271    async fn ledger_retention_starts_at_teardown() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
35272        let retention = Duration::from_millis(400);
35273        let mut rig = reconnect_rig_retaining(small_pix_params(), Default::default(), retention).await?;
35274        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
35275        let _first = rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await?;
35276        rig.request(pseudonym, 1).await?;
35277        assert_eq!(1, rig.deposits().await);
35278
35279        // The Session outlives the retention twice over.
35280        tokio::time::sleep(retention * 2).await;
35281        assert_eq!(
35282            Some(SsaIndex::MIN),
35283            rig.watermark(&pseudonym),
35284            "still live, still accounted"
35285        );
35286        assert!(rig.mgr.close_session(&pseudonym));
35287        assert!(
35288            rig.parked_ledger(&pseudonym).is_some(),
35289            "the retention starts at the teardown"
35290        );
35291
35292        // A reconnect inside the retention continues it.
35293        rig.reply_with(StubReply::Resumed(TEST_STREAM_BASE));
35294        let _second = rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await?;
35295        assert_eq!(Some(SsaIndex::MIN), rig.watermark(&pseudonym));
35296        assert!(
35297            rig.parked_ledger(&pseudonym).is_none(),
35298            "a live Session holds its ledger alone"
35299        );
35300
35301        // A reconnect that supersedes the live Session takes the ledger from it.
35302        let _third = rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await?;
35303        assert_eq!(Some(SsaIndex::MIN), rig.watermark(&pseudonym));
35304
35305        // The retention, once the last Session is gone, runs out.
35306        assert!(rig.mgr.close_session(&pseudonym));
35307        assert!(rig.parked_ledger(&pseudonym).is_some());
35308        tokio::time::sleep(retention * 2).await;
35309        assert!(rig.parked_ledger(&pseudonym).is_none(), "the parked ledger expired");
35310        Ok(())
35311    }
35312
35313    /// The last challenge of a pseudonym lives with the Session while it is live, and its retention starts at
35314    /// the teardown: a Session that outlives the retention still has its challenge counted when the pseudonym is
35315    /// reused, and the record expires only after the teardown.
35316    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
35317    async fn the_last_challenge_retention_starts_at_teardown() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
35318        let retention = Duration::from_millis(400);
35319        let rig = reconnect_rig_retaining(small_pix_params(), Default::default(), retention).await?;
35320        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
35321        let last = |rig: &ReconnectRig| {
35322            rig.mgr.last_challenges.run_pending_tasks();
35323            rig.mgr.last_challenges.get(&pseudonym)
35324        };
35325
35326        let _first = rig.connect(entry_cfg(Capabilities::empty(), Some(pseudonym))).await?;
35327        let first_challenge = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.challenge;
35328
35329        // The Session outlives the retention twice over, and nothing reads the record meanwhile.
35330        tokio::time::sleep(retention * 2).await;
35331        assert_eq!(None, last(&rig), "nothing keeps the initiation-time record alive");
35332
35333        // A reconnect that replaces the live Session still draws a challenge above it.
35334        let _second = rig.connect(entry_cfg(Capabilities::empty(), Some(pseudonym))).await?;
35335        let second_challenge = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.challenge;
35336        assert!(
35337            second_challenge > first_challenge,
35338            "{second_challenge} must be above {first_challenge}"
35339        );
35340
35341        // The teardown records the Session's challenge, and the retention runs from there.
35342        tokio::time::sleep(retention * 2).await;
35343        assert!(rig.mgr.close_session(&pseudonym));
35344        assert_eq!(Some(second_challenge), last(&rig), "recorded at teardown");
35345        tokio::time::sleep(retention * 2).await;
35346        assert_eq!(None, last(&rig), "expired after the retention");
35347        Ok(())
35348    }
35349
35350    /// The challenge is parked with the ledger, inside the removal of the slot: a reconnect that no longer
35351    /// finds the slot finds the record, even after a Session long enough for the initiation-time record to
35352    /// have expired, and even before the rest of the teardown has run.
35353    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
35354    async fn the_last_challenge_is_parked_in_the_same_step_that_removes_the_slot() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
35355        let retention = Duration::from_millis(400);
35356        let rig = reconnect_rig_retaining(small_pix_params(), Default::default(), retention).await?;
35357        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
35358        let last = |rig: &ReconnectRig| {
35359            rig.mgr.last_challenges.run_pending_tasks();
35360            rig.mgr.last_challenges.get(&pseudonym)
35361        };
35362
35363        let _first = rig.connect(entry_cfg(Capabilities::empty(), Some(pseudonym))).await?;
35364        let challenge = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.challenge;
35365        tokio::time::sleep(retention * 2).await;
35366        assert_eq!(
35367            None,
35368            last(&rig),
35369            "the initiation-time record expired under the live Session"
35370        );
35371
35372        let slot = remove_slot_if(&rig.mgr.sessions, &pseudonym, |_| true).context("the slot is removed")?;
35373        assert_eq!(Some(challenge), last(&rig), "parked before the release ran");
35374
35375        // The release that follows parks nothing again.
35376        rig.mgr.last_challenges.invalidate(&pseudonym);
35377        release_session_slot(
35378            pseudonym,
35379            slot,
35380            ClosureReason::WriteClosed,
35381            None,
35382            Duration::ZERO,
35383            AdmissionToken::NONE,
35384        );
35385        assert_eq!(None, last(&rig), "a slot parks its records once");
35386        Ok(())
35387    }

35389    /// Every teardown parks the ledger: the idle-eviction path and the instance-scoped close.
35390    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
35391    async fn every_teardown_parks_the_ledger() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
35392        let rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
35393
35394        let scoped = HoprPseudonym::random();
35395        let session = rig.connect_pix(Some(scoped)).await?;
35396        let instance_id = session.slot_instance().context("instance")?;
35397        assert!(rig.parked_ledger(&scoped).is_none());
35398        assert!(rig.mgr.close_session_instance(&scoped, instance_id));
35399        assert!(rig.parked_ledger(&scoped).is_some(), "scoped close");
35400
35401        // Supersede: the predecessor parks, the successor takes it back out.
35402        let superseded = HoprPseudonym::random();
35403        let _a = rig.connect_pix(Some(superseded)).await?;
35404        let predecessor = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&superseded).context("slot")?.instance.clone();
35405        let _b = rig.connect_pix(Some(superseded)).await?;
35406        assert!(predecessor.is_superseded());
35407        let live = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&superseded).context("slot")?.instance.ledger();
35408        let live = live.context("ledger")?;
35409        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(
35410            &live.ssa_state,
35411            &predecessor.ledger().context("ledger")?.ssa_state
35412        ));
35413        Ok(())
35414    }

35437    /// A post-establishment `SessionError` naming a challenge closes the Session that challenge opened and
35438    /// nothing else; a stale challenge is dropped.
35439    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
35440    async fn a_challenge_scoped_session_error_closes_only_the_matching_instance() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
35441        let rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
35442        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
35443        let _first = rig.connect(entry_cfg(Capabilities::empty(), Some(pseudonym))).await?;
35444        let first_challenge = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.challenge;
35445        let _second = rig.connect(entry_cfg(Capabilities::empty(), Some(pseudonym))).await?;
35446        let second = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.clone();
35447        assert_ne!(first_challenge, second.challenge);
35448
35449        let error = |challenge: StartChallenge| StartErrorType {
35450            identifier: ErrorIdentifier::Challenge(challenge),
35451            reason: StartErrorReason::Unknown,
35452        };
35453
35454        // At dispatch, a challenge of a Session that is gone names no local state.
35455        let stale = rig.mgr.dispatch_message(
35456            pseudonym,
35457            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(error(first_challenge)))?,
35458        );
35459        assert!(
35460            matches!(stale, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage))),
35461            "got {stale:?}"
35462        );
35463        // And the handler itself, given one anyway, leaves the Session alone.
35464        rig.mgr.handle_session_error(pseudonym, error(first_challenge)).await?;
35465        let alive = rig
35466            .mgr
35467            .sessions
35468            .get(&pseudonym)
35469            .context("the stale challenge must not close it")?;
35470        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&alive.instance, &second));
35471        // Nor does one under another pseudonym.
35472        rig.mgr
35473            .handle_session_error(HoprPseudonym::random(), error(second.challenge))
35474            .await?;
35475        assert!(rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).is_some());
35476
35477        let accepted = rig.mgr.dispatch_message(
35478            pseudonym,
35479            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(error(second.challenge)))?,
35480        );
35481        assert!(matches!(accepted, Ok(DispatchResult::Processed)), "got {accepted:?}");
35482        assert!(
35483            wait_for_no_active_sessions(&rig.mgr).await,
35484            "the matching instance is closed"
35485        );
35486        assert!(second.is_superseded());
35487        Ok(())
35488    }

35490    /// An Entry that balances SURBs, so that its setup outlasts the Exit's reply.
35491    fn balanced_entry_cfg(pseudonym: HoprPseudonym) -> SessionClientConfig {
35492        SessionClientConfig {
35493            surb_management: Some(SurbBalancerConfig {
35494                target_surb_buffer_size: 100,
35495                max_surbs_per_sec: 100,
35496                ..Default::default()
35497            }),
35498            ..entry_cfg(Capability::Segmentation.into(), Some(pseudonym))
35499        }

35502    /// The Session slot of `pseudonym` once it exists and its setup has not finished.
35503    async fn slot_instance_in_setup(
35504        mgr: &RecordingManager,
35505        pseudonym: &HoprPseudonym,
35506    ) -> anyhow::Result<Arc<SlotInstance>> {
35507        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
35508            loop {
35509                if let Some(slot) = mgr.sessions.get(pseudonym)
35510                    && !slot.instance.is_established()
35511                {
35512                    break slot.instance.clone();
35513                }
35514                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5)).await;
35515            }
35516        })
35517        .await
35518        .context("the slot never appeared")
35519    }

35521    /// An error naming the challenge of a Session that is still being set up closes it and fails
35522    /// `new_session` with the Exit's reason, instead of returning a socket for a closed Session.
35523    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
35524    async fn an_exit_error_during_setup_fails_new_session_with_the_exits_reason() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
35525        let rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
35526        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();

35531                pseudonym,

35538                matches!(dispatched, Ok(DispatchResult::Processed)),

35544        let instance = injected?;
35545        let err = connected.expect_err("the Exit closed the Session during its setup");
35546        assert!(
35547            matches!(
35548                err.downcast_ref::<TransportSessionError>(),
35549                Some(TransportSessionError::Rejected(StartErrorReason::NotResumable))
35550            ),
35551            "got {err:?}"
35552        );

35554        assert!(rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).is_none(), "no slot is left");

35572                    StartErrorType {
35573                        identifier: ErrorIdentifier::SessionId(pseudonym),
35574                        reason: StartErrorReason::UnacceptablePixParams,
35575                    },
35576                )
35577                .await?;
35578            Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(instance)
35579        };
35580        let (connected, injected) = tokio::join!(rig.connect(balanced_entry_cfg(pseudonym)), injector);
35581        let instance = injected?;
35582        let err = connected.expect_err("the Exit closed the Session during its setup");
35583        assert!(
35584            matches!(
35585                err.downcast_ref::<TransportSessionError>(),
35586                Some(TransportSessionError::Rejected(StartErrorReason::UnacceptablePixParams))
35587            ),
35588            "got {err:?}"
35589        );
35590        assert!(instance.is_superseded());
35591        assert!(rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).is_none(), "no slot is left");
35592        Ok(())
35593    }

35595    /// A reconnect under the same pseudonym that replaces a Session still waiting for its SURBs fails that
35596    /// setup with `Closed`, and leaves the replacement in place, instead of returning a dead Session.
35597    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
35598    async fn a_setup_replaced_by_a_reconnect_fails_closed() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
35599        let rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
35600        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
35601
35602        let first = rig.mgr.new_session(
35603            (&ChainKeypair::random()).into(),
35604            SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
35605            balanced_entry_cfg(pseudonym),
35606        );
35607        let reconnect = async {
35608            // No SURB flow, so the first setup stays in its readiness wait until the reconnect replaces it.
35609            let slot = timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
35610                loop {
35611                    if let Some(slot) = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym)
35612                        && !slot.instance.is_established()
35613                    {
35614                        break slot;
35615                    }
35616                    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5)).await;
35617                }
35618            })
35619            .await
35620            .context("the slot never appeared")?;
35621            let second = rig
35622                .connect(entry_cfg(Capability::Segmentation.into(), Some(pseudonym)))
35623                .await?;
35624            assert!(slot.instance.is_superseded(), "the reconnect replaced the first setup");
35625            // The teardown already ended the wait by stopping the balancer; lift the level in case it did not.
35626            slot.surb_estimator
35627                .produced
35628                .fetch_add(1000, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
35629            Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>((slot.instance.clone(), second))
35630        };
35631        let (first, reconnected) = timeout(Duration::from_secs(8), futures::future::join(first, reconnect))
35632            .await
35633            .context("the first setup never finished")?;
35634        let (first_instance, _second) = reconnected?;
35635
35636        assert!(
35637            matches!(first, Err(TransportSessionError::Closed)),
35638            "got {:?}",
35639            first.as_ref().map(|_| ())
35640        );
35641        let slot = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("the second Session's slot")?;
35642        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&slot.instance, &first_instance));
35643        assert!(!slot.instance.is_superseded());
35644        assert_eq!(1, rig.mgr.num_active_sessions());
35645        Ok(())
35646    }

35791    /// Refusing an SSA request closes the Session the request was for, not a successor that took its pseudonym.
35792    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
35793    async fn refusing_an_ssa_request_leaves_a_successor_alone() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
35794        let rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
35795        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
35796        let _first = rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await?;
35797        let slot = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?;
35798        let (routing, predecessor) = (slot.routing_opts.clone(), slot.instance.clone());
35799
35800        let _second = rig.connect_pix(Some(pseudonym)).await?;
35801        let successor = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.instance.clone();
35802        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&predecessor, &successor));
35803
35804        rig.mgr.refuse_ssa_request(pseudonym, routing, &predecessor).await;
35805        assert!(
35806            rig.mgr
35807                .sessions
35808                .get(&pseudonym)
35809                .is_some_and(|slot| Arc::ptr_eq(&slot.instance, &successor)),
35810            "the successor survives"
35811        );
35812        assert!(!successor.is_superseded());
35813        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200)).await;
35814        assert!(
35815            rig.session_errors.lock().is_empty(),
35816            "no notice goes out for a predecessor, which would have the Exit close the successor"
35817        );
35818
35819        // The control: for the current instance the Session is closed and the Exit is told.
35820        let current_routing = rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.routing_opts.clone();
35821        rig.mgr.refuse_ssa_request(pseudonym, current_routing, &successor).await;
35822        assert!(
35823            rig.mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).is_none(),
35824            "the current Session is closed"
35825        );
35826        assert!(
35827            eventually(Duration::from_secs(2), || {
35828                matches!(
35829                    rig.session_errors.lock()[..],
35830                    [StartErrorType {
35831                        identifier: ErrorIdentifier::SessionId(_),
35832                        reason: StartErrorReason::UnacceptablePixParams,
35833                    }]
35834                )
35835            })
35836            .await,
35837            "the Exit is told once, by the session id"
35838        );
35839        Ok(())
35840    }
