35869    // -- Detach and takeover of a paid Exit PIX Session. --
35870
35871    /// What [`paid_exit`] builds the Exit from.
35872    struct PaidExitOptions {
35873        /// The node's `resume_window`.
35874        resume_window: Duration,
35875        capabilities: Capabilities,
35876        fill: crate::supervision::PixFillConfig,
35877        admission: Option<Arc<dyn SurbAdmissionControl>>,
35878        /// Whether the first cycle is funded. When not, the Entry is marked as having answered the
35879        /// commitment request, which is the other thing that makes a Session worth keeping.
35880        fund: bool,
35881        idle_timeout: Option<Duration>,
35882        max_predeposit_packets: Option<u64>,
35883        /// Whether the Entry's requests carry `Capability::Resumable`.
35884        resume_capable: bool,
35885        /// The session server's admission channel, if the test drives it.
35886        session_admission: Option<SessionAdmissionSink>,
35887        /// Bits OR-ed into the `additional_data` of the Entry's requests.
35888        additional_bits: u128,
35889    }
35890
35891    impl Default for PaidExitOptions {
35892        fn default() -> Self {
35893            Self {
35894                resume_window: Duration::from_secs(60),
35895                // A takeover is for frame-based Sessions only.
35896                capabilities: Capability::Segmentation.into(),
35897                // The reserve out of the way and drain on, so a close with SURBs in stock drains.
35898                fill: crate::supervision::PixFillConfig {
35899                    min_surb_reserve: 1,
35900                    ..Default::default()
35901                },
35902                admission: None,
35903                fund: true,
35904                idle_timeout: None,
35905                max_predeposit_packets: None,
35906                resume_capable: true,
35907                session_admission: None,
35908                additional_bits: 0,
35909            }
35910        }
35911    }
35912
35913    /// An Exit-side PIX Session that has been paid for, with everything a reconnecting Entry meets.
35914    struct PaidExit {
35915        mgr: RecordingManager,
35916        msg_rx: Originated,
35917        incoming: futures::channel::mpsc::Receiver<IncomingSession>,
35918        pseudonym: HoprPseudonym,
35919        params: PixParams,
35920        capabilities: Capabilities,
35921        /// Whether the Entry's requests carry `Capability::Resumable`.
35922        resume_capable: bool,
35923        /// When set, the session server closes the next `IncomingSession` the moment it is handed to it.
35924        close_on_delivery: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool>,
35925        /// When set, the session server writes on every `IncomingSession` the moment it is handed to it.
35926        write_on_delivery: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool>,
35927        /// Bits OR-ed into the `additional_data` of the Entry's requests.
35928        additional_bits: u128,
35929    }
35930
35931    /// A session server's admission handler that counts its requests and can hold the next one.
35932    #[derive(Clone, Default)]
35933    struct GatedAdmission {
35934        requests: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize>,
35935        hold_next: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool>,
35936        release: Arc<tokio::sync::Notify>,
35937        /// Whether decisions narrow the quota range to one above the fixture's offer.
35938        narrow_quota: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool>,
35939    }
35940
35941    impl GatedAdmission {
35942        fn sink(&self) -> SessionAdmissionSink {
35943            let (tx, mut rx) =
35944                futures::channel::mpsc::channel::<(SessionAdmissionRequest, crate::types::SessionAdmissionReply)>(4);
35945            let this = self.clone();
35946            tokio::spawn(async move {
35947                while let Some((_request, reply)) = rx.next().await {
35948                    this.requests.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
35949                    let hold = this.hold_next.swap(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
35950                    let release = this.release.clone();
35951                    let narrow = this.narrow_quota.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
35952                    // Answered off the loop, so that a held request does not hold the ones behind it.
35953                    tokio::spawn(async move {
35954                        if hold {
35955                            release.notified().await;
35956                        }
35957                        let decision = if narrow {
35958                            let above = pix_params_to_quota(&fill_pix_params()) + 1;
35959                            SessionAdmissionDecision::default().with_pix_quota_range(above..=u64::MAX)
35960                        } else {
35961                            SessionAdmissionDecision::default()
35962                        };
35963                        let _ = reply.send(Ok(decision));
35964                    });
35965                }
35966            });
35967            tx
35968        }
35969
35970        fn requests(&self) -> usize {
35971            self.requests.load(Ordering::SeqCst)
35972        }
35973    }
35974
35975    /// Brings up a PIX Exit Session and funds its first cycle, returning it with the first `IncomingSession`.
35976    ///
35977    /// As [`recovering_exit_pix_session_with`] does, only the Entry half is simulated: the supervisor is
35978    /// driven through the events a real commitment and deposit would produce, and the SURB stock a
35979    /// real Entry would have supplied is booked. What runs for real is everything below the
35980    /// supervisor: the action driver, the gate, the fill, the keep-alive stream, the data plane.
35981    async fn paid_exit(options: PaidExitOptions) -> anyhow::Result<(PaidExit, IncomingSession)> {
35982        let params = fill_pix_params();
35983        let mgr = RecordingManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
35984            surb_balance_notify_period: Some(KEEP_ALIVE_PERIOD),
35985            surb_resolution_wait: Duration::from_millis(100),
35986            // Fast enough that a test's writer, not the limiter, sets the organic rate.
35987            initial_return_session_egress_rate: 1000,
35988            idle_timeout: options
35989                .idle_timeout
35990                .unwrap_or_else(|| SessionManagerConfig::default().idle_timeout),
35991            pix_config: IncomingSessionPixConfig {
35992                quota_range: 0..=pix_params_to_quota(&params),
35993                resume_window: options.resume_window,
35994                supervision: SupervisorConfig {
35995                    max_recovery_idle: Duration::from_secs(31),
35996                    max_recovery_time: Duration::from_secs(40),
35997                    fill: options.fill,
35998                    max_predeposit_packets: options
35999                        .max_predeposit_packets
36000                        .unwrap_or(SupervisorConfig::default().max_predeposit_packets),
36001                    ..Default::default()
36002                },
36003                ..Default::default()
36004            },
36005            ..Default::default()
36006        });
36007        if let Some(admission) = options.admission {
36008            assert!(mgr.set_surb_admission(admission));
36009        }
36010
36011        let (msg_tx, msg_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
36012        let (new_session_tx, incoming) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(8);
36013        // The session server: hands the Session on, or ends it first when the test asks it to.
36014        let close_on_delivery = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false));
36015        let server_flag = close_on_delivery.clone();
36016        let write_on_delivery = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false));
36017        let write_flag = write_on_delivery.clone();
36018        let session_server = futures::sink::unfold(new_session_tx, move |mut tx, mut incoming: IncomingSession| {
36019            let server_flag = server_flag.clone();
36020            let write_flag = write_flag.clone();
36021            async move {
36022                if write_flag.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst) {
36023                    use futures::AsyncWriteExt;
36024                    let _ = incoming.session.write_all(b"written on delivery").await;
36025                    let _ = incoming.session.flush().await;
36026                }
36027                if server_flag.swap(false, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst) {
36028                    use futures::AsyncWriteExt;
36029                    let _ = incoming.session.close().await;
36030                }
36031                tx.send(incoming).await?;
36032                Ok::<_, futures::channel::mpsc::SendError>(tx)
36033            }
36034        });
36035        mgr.start(
36036            msg_tx,
36037            session_server,
36038            Some(pix_toolbox_with_pool(
36039                Arc::new(SsaShareGenerator::new(SsaGeneratorConfig {
36040                    polynomials_per_ssa: params.polys_per_ssa(),
36041                    threshold: params.shares_per_poly(),
36042                    surplus_shares: params.surplus_shares(),
36043                })),
36044                SsaReconstructor::new(SsaReconstructorConfig::default()).into(),
36045            )),
36046            options.session_admission,
36047        )?;
36048
36049        let mut paid = PaidExit {
36050            mgr: mgr.clone(),
36051            msg_rx,
36052            incoming,
36053            pseudonym: HoprPseudonym::random(),
36054            params,
36055            capabilities: if options.resume_capable {
36056                options.capabilities | Capability::UsePIX | Capability::Resumable
36057            } else {
36058                options.capabilities | Capability::UsePIX
36059            },
36060            resume_capable: options.resume_capable,
36061            close_on_delivery,
36062            write_on_delivery,
36063            additional_bits: options.additional_bits,
36064        };
36065        let mut first = None;
36066
36067        // The establishment is a fresh Session: not an attempt.
36068        let establishment = paid.request_with(MIN_CHALLENGE, paid.params, paid.capabilities, false)?;
36069        paid.mgr
36070            .handle_incoming_session_initiation(paid.pseudonym, establishment)
36071            .await?;
36072        first.replace(paid.next_session().await?);
36073
36074        let slot = paid.slot()?;
36075        slot.surb_mgmt.note_counterparty_refills();
36076        slot.surb_estimator
36077            .produced
36078            .fetch_add(100_000, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
36079
36080        if options.fund {
36081            let supervisor = slot.pix_supervisor.get().context("a PIX session has a supervisor")?;
36082            let ssa_id = SsaId::new(paid.pseudonym, SsaIndex::new(1).context("index one is non-zero")?);
36083            for event in [
36084                SessionPixEvent::SsaRequestSent(ssa_id),
36085                SessionPixEvent::CommitmentVerified(ssa_id),
36086                SessionPixEvent::DepositConfirmed {
36087                    ssa_id,
36088                    amount: hopr_api::HoprBalance::new_base(1000),
36089                },
36090            ] {
36091                supervisor
36092                    .send_event(event)
36093                    .await
36094                    .map_err(|()| anyhow!("the supervisor stopped accepting events"))?;
36095            }
36096            let gate = slot
36097                .pix_egress_gate
36098                .get()
36099                .cloned()
36100                .context("a PIX session has a gate")?;
36101            timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
36102                while !gate.ever_funded() {
36103                    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
36104                }
36105            })
36106            .await
36107            .context("the first cycle must be funded")?;
36108        } else {
36109            slot.exit_resume
36110                .entry_answered
36111                .store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
36112        }
36113        drop(slot);
36114
36115        // Whatever the establishment put on the wire.
36116        let _ = originated_during(&mut paid.msg_rx, Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
36117        Ok((paid, first.context("the first session was handed over")?))
36118    }
36119
36120    impl PaidExit {
36121        fn slot(&self) -> anyhow::Result<SessionSlot> {
36122            self.mgr
36123                .sessions
36124                .get(&self.pseudonym)
36125                .context("the session slot must exist")
36126        }
36127
36128        fn instance(&self) -> anyhow::Result<Arc<SlotInstance>> {
36129            Ok(self.slot()?.instance.clone())
36130        }
36131
36132        fn gate(&self) -> anyhow::Result<Arc<ServiceGate>> {
36133            self.slot()?
36134                .pix_egress_gate
36135                .get()
36136                .cloned()
36137                .context("a PIX session has a gate")
36138        }
36139
36140        fn fill(&self) -> anyhow::Result<Arc<PixFillControl>> {
36141            self.slot()?
36142                .pix_fill
36143                .get()
36144                .cloned()
36145                .context("a PIX session has a fill control")
36146        }
36147
36148        /// The `StartSession` of an Entry reconnecting under this pseudonym: it asks to resume.
36149        fn request(
36150            &self,
36151            challenge: StartChallenge,
36152        ) -> anyhow::Result<StartInitiation<SessionTarget, HoprSessionCapabilities>> {
36153            self.request_with(challenge, self.params, self.capabilities, true)
36154        }
36155
36156        fn request_with(
36157            &self,
36158            challenge: StartChallenge,
36159            params: PixParams,
36160            capabilities: Capabilities,
36161            resume: bool,
36162        ) -> anyhow::Result<StartInitiation<SessionTarget, HoprSessionCapabilities>> {
36163            let mut capabilities = capabilities;
36164            if !self.resume_capable {
36165                capabilities -= Capability::Resumable;
36166            }
36167            let mut additional_data =
36168                into_initiation_additional_data(params.into_additional_data(0), Duration::ZERO) | self.additional_bits;
36169            if resume {
36170                additional_data |= INITIATION_RESUME_ATTEMPT;
36171            }
36172            Ok(StartInitiation {
36173                challenge,
36174                target: SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
36175                capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities(capabilities),
36176                additional_data,
36177            })
36178        }
36179
36180        async fn reconnect(&self, challenge: StartChallenge) -> errors::Result<()> {
36181            let request = self.request(challenge).expect("the request builds");
36182            self.mgr
36183                .handle_incoming_session_initiation(self.pseudonym, request)
36184                .await
36185        }
36186
36187        /// An Entry connecting afresh under this pseudonym: not an attempt, so never a takeover.
36188        async fn start_fresh(&self, challenge: StartChallenge) -> errors::Result<()> {
36189            let request = self
36190                .request_with(challenge, self.params, self.capabilities, false)
36191                .expect("the request builds");
36192            self.mgr
36193                .handle_incoming_session_initiation(self.pseudonym, request)
36194                .await
36195        }
36196
36197        async fn next_session(&mut self) -> anyhow::Result<IncomingSession> {
36198            timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), self.incoming.next())
36199                .await
36200                .context("the session must be handed to the application")?
36201                .context("the incoming channel must stay open")
36202        }
36203
36204        /// The data plane of `instance` ending, as its `HoprSession` would report it.
36205        fn end_data_plane(&self, instance: &Arc<SlotInstance>, reason: ClosureReason) -> bool {
36206            self.mgr
36207                .close_session_scoped(&self.pseudonym, reason, CloseScope::Instance(instance))
36208        }
36209
36210        /// Drains what the Exit has originated for a moment, sorted into what a test asks about.
36211        async fn originated(&mut self, window: Duration) -> Originations {
36212            let mut seen = Originations::default();
36213            for (routing, data) in originated_during(&mut self.msg_rx, window).await {
36214                if data.data.application_tag == SESSION_APPLICATION_TAG {
36215                    seen.data += 1;
36216                    continue;
36217                }
36218                match HoprStartProtocol::decode(data.data.application_tag, &data.data.plain_text) {
36219                    Ok(HoprStartProtocol::SessionEstablished(_)) => seen.established += 1,
36220                    Ok(HoprStartProtocol::SessionResumed(resumed)) => {
36221                        seen.resumed.push(resumed);
36222                        seen.order.push("SessionResumed");
36223                    }
36224                    Ok(HoprStartProtocol::SsaRequest(_)) => {
36225                        seen.ssa_requests += 1;
36226                        seen.order.push("SsaRequest");
36227                    }
36228                    Ok(HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(error)) => {
36229                        seen.errors.push(error.reason);
36230                        seen.error_identifiers.push(error.identifier);
36231                    }
36232                    Ok(HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(_)) => {
36233                        if matches!(routing, DestinationRouting::Return(_)) {
36234                            seen.keep_alives += 1
36235                        }
36236                    }
36237                    _ => {}
36238                }
36239            }
36240            seen
36241        }
36242    }
36243
36244    /// What the Exit sent over a window.
36245    #[derive(Debug, Default)]
36246    struct Originations {
36247        established: usize,
36248        /// Every `SessionResumed` sent.
36249        resumed: Vec<StartResumed<SessionId>>,
36250        /// The identifier of every `SessionError` sent, in the order of `errors`.
36251        error_identifiers: Vec<ErrorIdentifier<SessionId>>,
36252        ssa_requests: usize,
36253        /// `SessionResumed` and `SsaRequest` messages in the order they were sent.
36254        order: Vec<&'static str>,
36255        keep_alives: usize,
36256        data: usize,
36257        errors: Vec<StartErrorReason>,
36258    }
36259
36260    /// Waits until `condition` holds, for up to `within`.
36261    async fn eventually(within: Duration, mut condition: impl FnMut() -> bool) -> bool {
36262        timeout(within, async {
36263            while !condition() {
36264                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
36265            }
36266        })
36267        .await
36268        .is_ok()
36269    }
36270
36271    fn has_handle(slot: &SessionSlot, handle: SessionHandles) -> bool {
36272        slot.abort_handles.lock().contains(&handle)
36273    }
36274
36275    /// A data plane that ends on a paid Session detaches it: the gate, the supervisor, the fill and
36276    /// the keep-alive stream carry on, and the supervisor is told nothing.
36277    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
36278    async fn a_paid_session_whose_data_plane_ends_is_detached_and_keeps_its_control_plane() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
36279        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;
36280        let instance = exit.instance()?;
36281        let (gate, fill) = (exit.gate()?, exit.fill()?);
36282
36283        assert!(
36284            exit.end_data_plane(&instance, ClosureReason::EmptyRead),
36285            "the close is answered"
36286        );
36287
36288        let slot = exit.slot()?;
36289        assert!(slot.is_detached(), "the slot is detached");
36290        assert!(
36291            Arc::ptr_eq(&slot.instance, &instance),
36292            "the instance is the same until taken over"
36293        );
36294        assert!(instance.is_superseded(), "the old plane's writers are cut off");
36295        assert!(!gate.is_poisoned(), "the gate is not poisoned");
36296        assert!(
36297            !fill.is_draining(),
36298            "no SessionClosed reached the supervisor, which would have started a drain"
36299        );
36300        assert!(
36301            has_handle(&slot, SessionHandles::ResumeWindow),
36302            "the window's timer is armed"
36303        );
36304        assert!(!has_handle(&slot, SessionHandles::Ingress), "the ingress is aborted");
36305        for kept in [
36306            SessionHandles::PixActionDriver,
36307            SessionHandles::KeepAlive,
36308            SessionHandles::Balancer,
36309        ] {
36310            assert!(has_handle(&slot, kept), "{kept} must stay up while detached");
36311        }
36312        assert_eq!(1, exit.mgr.num_active_sessions());
36313
36314        // The second end of the same data plane is no news: still detached, still one timer.
36315        assert!(exit.end_data_plane(&instance, ClosureReason::WriteClosed));
36316        assert!(exit.slot()?.is_detached());
36317        assert_eq!(1, exit.mgr.num_active_sessions());
36318
36319        // And the Session still lives on its control plane: its keep-alive stream runs.
36320        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(2500)).await;
36321        assert!(seen.keep_alives > 0, "a detached Session still reports: {seen:?}");
36322        Ok(())
36323    }
36324
36325    /// The same, reached the way production reaches it: through the closure channel and its consumer.
36326    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
36327    async fn the_closure_consumer_detaches_a_paid_session() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
36328        let (exit, first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;
36329        let instance = exit.instance()?;
36330        let (_, closures) = exit
36331            .mgr
36332            .session_notifiers
36333            .get()
36334            .context("the manager is started")?
36335            .clone();
36336
36337        // The client ending the stream is an `EmptyRead` of the Session object.
36338        assert!(
36339            closures
36340                .try_send((exit.pseudonym, ClosureReason::EmptyRead, instance))
36341                .is_ok()
36342        );
36343        assert!(
36344            eventually(Duration::from_secs(2), || exit
36345                .slot()
36346                .is_ok_and(|slot| slot.is_detached()))
36347            .await,
36348            "an ended stream must detach the slot"
36349        );
36350        assert!(!exit.gate()?.is_poisoned());
36351        drop(first);
36352        Ok(())
36353    }

36372    /// Fill keeps going out while detached, at the rate the supervisor plans for the funded cycle.
36373    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
36374    async fn the_fill_keeps_going_out_while_detached() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
36375        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;
36376        let instance = exit.instance()?;
36377        assert!(exit.end_data_plane(&instance, ClosureReason::EmptyRead));
36378
36379        // One sampling interval for the planner, then a window long enough that the notification
36380        // alone could not account for what is counted (see `a_funded_idle_pix_session_is_filled_by_the_exit`).
36381        let _ramp = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(1500)).await;
36382        let window = Duration::from_millis(1500);
36383        let promote_every = KEEP_ALIVE_PERIOD - MAX_WAIT_CHUNK.min(KEEP_ALIVE_PERIOD / 2);
36384        let notify_only = (window.as_secs_f64() / promote_every.as_secs_f64()).ceil() as usize;
36385        let seen = exit.originated(window).await;
36386        assert!(
36387            seen.keep_alives > notify_only,
36388            "{} keep-alive(s) over {window:?} while detached: no more than the notification alone ({notify_only})",
36389            seen.keep_alives
36390        );
36391        assert!(exit.slot()?.is_detached());
36392        Ok(())
36393    }

36545    #[case::nothing_paid_for(Duration::from_secs(60), ClosureReason::EmptyRead, true, false)]
36546    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]

36603    /// What a successful takeover leaves in place and what it replaces; shared by live and detached.
36604    #[rstest]
36605    #[case::of_a_live_slot(false)]
36606    #[case::of_a_detached_slot(true)]
36607    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
36608    async fn a_reconnecting_entry_takes_over_its_paid_session(#[case] detach_first: bool) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
36609        use futures::AsyncReadExt;
36610
36611        let admission = RecordingAdmission::default();
36612        let (mut exit, mut old) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
36613            admission: Some(Arc::new(admission.clone())),
36614            ..Default::default()
36615        })
36616        .await?;
36617        let before = exit.slot()?;
36618        let old_instance = before.instance.clone();
36619        let live_cycle_bytes = exit.mgr.live_cycle_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
36620        let token = before.peek_admission_token();
36621        assert_ne!(AdmissionToken::NONE, token, "the first Session is admitted");
36622        if detach_first {
36623            assert!(exit.end_data_plane(&old_instance, ClosureReason::EmptyRead));
36624            assert!(exit.slot()?.is_detached());
36625        }
36626        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
36627
36628        exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
36629        let mut new = exit.next_session().await?;
36630
36631        // The control plane is the one that was there.
36632        let after = exit.slot()?;
36633        assert!(
36634            Arc::ptr_eq(
36635                before.pix_egress_gate.get().context("gate")?,
36636                after.pix_egress_gate.get().context("gate")?
36637            ),
36638            "same gate"
36639        );
36640        assert!(
36641            Arc::ptr_eq(&before.pix_supervisor, &after.pix_supervisor),
36642            "same supervisor"
36643        );
36644        assert!(
36645            Arc::ptr_eq(
36646                before.pix_fill.get().context("fill")?,
36647                after.pix_fill.get().context("fill")?
36648            ),
36649            "same fill"
36650        );
36651        assert!(
36652            Arc::ptr_eq(&before.admission_token, &after.admission_token),
36653            "same admission cell"
36654        );
36655        assert_eq!(token, after.peek_admission_token(), "same admission token");
36656        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&before.abort_handles, &after.abort_handles), "same tasks");
36657        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&before.surb_mgmt, &after.surb_mgmt), "same balancer state");
36658        assert_eq!(
36659            live_cycle_bytes,
36660            exit.mgr.live_cycle_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
36661            "no budget reserved twice"
36662        );
36663        assert_eq!(1, exit.mgr.num_active_sessions(), "still one session");
36664        assert!(!after.is_detached());
36665        assert!(!exit.gate()?.is_poisoned());
36666        assert!(exit.gate()?.ever_funded());
36667
36668        // The data plane is the new one.
36669        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&after.instance, &old_instance));
36670        assert!(after.instance.is_established());
36671        assert!(!after.instance.is_superseded());
36672        assert!(old_instance.is_superseded());
36673        assert_eq!(new.session.slot_instance(), Some(after.instance.id()));
36674        assert!(has_handle(&after, SessionHandles::Ingress));
36675        assert!(!has_handle(&after, SessionHandles::ResumeWindow));
36676
36677        // Only `SessionResumed` is sent, not `SessionEstablished`, and no opening request that would reset the
36678        // Entry. Its base is above everything the predecessor's stream used.
36679        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
36680        assert_eq!(0, seen.established, "{seen:?}");
36681        assert_eq!(1, seen.resumed.len(), "{seen:?}");
36682        assert_eq!(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1, seen.resumed[0].orig_challenge);
36683        assert_eq!(exit.pseudonym, seen.resumed[0].session_id);
36684        assert_eq!(
36685            STREAM_BASE_MARGIN, seen.resumed[0].stream_base,
36686            "above an idle predecessor's stream"
36687        );
36688        assert_eq!(Some(seen.resumed[0].stream_base), new.session.config().stream_base);
36689        assert_eq!(0, seen.ssa_requests, "a takeover never sends an SsaRequest: {seen:?}");
36690        assert!(seen.errors.is_empty(), "{seen:?}");
36691
36692        // The old reader gets EOF and the old writer errors.
36693        let mut buf = [0u8; 8];
36694        let read = timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), old.session.read(&mut buf))
36695            .await
36696            .context("the old reader must not hang")?;
36697        assert!(matches!(read, Ok(0) | Err(_)), "the old reader ends, got {read:?}");
36698        let write = async {
36699            old.session.write_all(b"too late").await?;
36700            old.session.flush().await
36701        }
36702        .await;
36703        assert!(write.is_err(), "the old writer must error");
36704
36705        // New data flows both ways.
36706        let result = exit.mgr.dispatch_message(
36707            exit.pseudonym,
36708            stream_segment(STREAM_BASE_MARGIN, false, b"hello again")?,
36709        )?;
36710        assert_eq!(DispatchResult::Processed, result);
36711        let mut got = [0u8; 11];
36712        timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), new.session.read_exact(&mut got))
36713            .await
36714            .context("the new plane must read")??;
36715        assert_eq!(b"hello again", &got);
36716        new.session.write_all(b"and back").await?;
36717        new.session.flush().await?;
36718        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
36719        assert!(seen.data >= 1, "the new plane writes through the kept gate: {seen:?}");
36720
36721        // The ring was never retired, and nothing else was admitted.
36722        assert_eq!(1, admission.admitted(&exit.pseudonym));
36723        assert_eq!(0, admission.retired(&exit.pseudonym));
36724        Ok(())
36725    }

36727    /// The successor's first replies are served from SURBs already in the ring: the takeover books
36728    /// none of its own and wipes none.
36729    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
36730    async fn the_successors_first_replies_ride_the_predecessors_surbs() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
36731        let (mut exit, _old) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
36732            // One packet per write.
36733            capabilities: Capability::Segmentation | Capability::NoDelay,
36734            ..Default::default()
36735        })
36736        .await?;
36737        let before = exit.slot()?;
36738        let produced = before.surb_estimator.produced.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
36739        let consumed = before.surb_estimator.consumed.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
36740
36741        exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
36742        let mut new = exit.next_session().await?;
36743        let slot = exit.slot()?;
36744        assert_eq!(
36745            produced,
36746            slot.surb_estimator.produced.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
36747            "a takeover wipes no SURB and books none"
36748        );
36749        let held = slot.surb_estimator.saturating_diff();
36750        assert!(
36751            held > 10_000,
36752            "the stock the predecessor built up is still there: {held}"
36753        );
36754
36755        for _ in 0..5 {
36756            new.session.write_all(b"reply").await?;
36757        }
36758        new.session.flush().await?;
36759        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
36760        assert!(seen.data >= 5, "{seen:?}");
36761        assert!(
36762            slot.surb_estimator.consumed.load(Ordering::Relaxed) >= consumed + 5,
36763            "the replies consumed SURBs of the existing stock"
36764        );
36765        Ok(())
36766    }

36841    /// Each reason a held slot may not be taken over: a duplicate of the establishing request is refused as an
36842    /// occupied pseudonym is (`NoSlotsAvailable`), any other failed resume as `NotResumable`; the held slot is
36843    /// untouched.
36844    #[rstest]
36845    #[case::the_same_challenge(Refuse::SameChallenge)]
36846    #[case::other_dimensions(Refuse::OtherParams)]
36847    #[case::other_capabilities(Refuse::OtherCapabilities)]
36848    #[case::nothing_paid_for(Refuse::NothingPaid)]
36849    #[case::poisoned(Refuse::Poisoned)]
36850    #[case::draining(Refuse::Draining)]
36851    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
36852    async fn a_request_that_may_not_take_over_is_refused_and_leaves_the_slot_alone(
36853        #[case] why: Refuse,
36854    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
36855        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
36856            fund: !matches!(why, Refuse::NothingPaid),
36857            ..Default::default()
36858        })
36859        .await?;
36860        if matches!(why, Refuse::NothingPaid) {
36861            exit.slot()?
36862                .exit_resume
36863                .entry_answered
36864                .store(false, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
36865        }
36866        let before = exit.slot()?;
36867        match why {
36868            Refuse::Poisoned => exit.gate()?.poison(),
36869            Refuse::Draining => assert!(exit.fill()?.enter_drain()),
36870            _ => {}
36871        }
36872        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
36873
36874        let request = match why {
36875            Refuse::SameChallenge => exit.request(MIN_CHALLENGE)?,
36876            Refuse::OtherParams => exit.request_with(
36877                MIN_CHALLENGE + 1,
36878                PixParams::try_new(50, 2, TEST_SURPLUS_SHARES, LOCAL_PIX_SUITE)?,
36879                exit.capabilities,
36880                true,
36881            )?,
36882            Refuse::OtherCapabilities => exit.request_with(
36883                MIN_CHALLENGE + 1,
36884                exit.params,
36885                exit.capabilities | Capability::NoDelay,
36886                true,
36887            )?,
36888            _ => exit.request(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1)?,
36889        };
36890        exit.mgr
36891            .handle_incoming_session_initiation(exit.pseudonym, request)
36892            .await?;
36893
36894        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
36895        let expected = if matches!(why, Refuse::SameChallenge) {
36896            StartErrorReason::NoSlotsAvailable
36897        } else {
36898            StartErrorReason::NotResumable
36899        };
36900        assert_eq!(vec![expected], seen.errors, "{seen:?}");
36901        assert_eq!(0, seen.established);
36902        assert!(
36903            exit.incoming.try_recv().is_err(),
36904            "no session is handed to the application"
36905        );
36906
36907        let after = exit.mgr.sessions.get(&exit.pseudonym).context("the held slot stays")?;
36908        assert!(
36909            Arc::ptr_eq(&after.instance, &before.instance),
36910            "the slot is the one that was held"
36911        );
36912        assert!(!after.instance.is_superseded(), "the held session is untouched");
36913        assert_eq!(1, exit.mgr.num_active_sessions());
36914        if matches!(why, Refuse::Draining) {
36915            assert!(exit.fill()?.is_draining(), "the drain is undisturbed");
36916        }
36917        Ok(())
36918    }
36919
36920    #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
36921    enum Refuse {
36922        SameChallenge,
36923        OtherParams,
36924        OtherCapabilities,
36925        OlderChallenge,
36926        OtherBehaviourBits,
36927        NothingPaid,
36928        Poisoned,
36929        Draining,
36930    }

36932    /// The slot-level rules that a request cannot reach: another batch size, an unestablished or
36933    /// outgoing slot.
36934    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
36935    async fn the_eligibility_rules_of_a_held_slot() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
36936        let (exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;
36937        let slot = exit.slot()?;
36938        let terms = slot.exit_resume.terms.get().context("an Exit slot records its terms")?;
36939        let (batch, caps) = (terms.ssas_per_request, terms.capabilities);
36940
36941        assert_eq!(
36942            None,
36943            slot.takeover_refusal(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1, &exit.params, batch, caps, 0)
36944        );
36945        assert!(
36946            slot.takeover_refusal(MIN_CHALLENGE, &exit.params, batch, caps, 0)
36947                .is_some(),
36948            "the same challenge"
36949        );
36950        assert!(
36951            slot.takeover_refusal(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1, &exit.params, batch + 1, caps, 0)
36952                .is_some(),
36953            "another batch size"
36954        );
36955        assert!(
36956            slot.takeover_refusal(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1, &exit.params, batch, caps | Capability::NoDelay, 0)
36957                .is_some(),
36958            "other capabilities"
36959        );
36960
36961        let unestablished = SessionSlot {
36962            instance: SlotInstance::new(MIN_CHALLENGE),
36963            ..slot.clone()
36964        };
36965        assert!(
36966            unestablished
36967                .takeover_refusal(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1, &exit.params, batch, caps, 0)
36968                .is_some(),
36969            "not established"
36970        );
36971
36972        let outgoing = SessionSlot {
36973            routing_opts: DestinationRouting::Forward {
36974                destination: Box::new(Address::from(&ChainKeypair::random()).into()),
36975                pseudonym: Some(exit.pseudonym),
36976                forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(1.try_into()?),
36977                return_options: None,
36978            },
36979            ..slot.clone()
36980        };
36981        assert!(
36982            outgoing
36983                .takeover_refusal(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1, &exit.params, batch, caps, 0)
36984                .is_some(),
36985            "an Entry slot"
36986        );
36987        Ok(())
36988    }

36990    /// Two reconnects at once: exactly one takes the Session over.
36991    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
36992    async fn of_two_concurrent_takeovers_exactly_one_wins() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
36993        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;
36994        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
36995
36996        let (a, b) = tokio::join!(exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1), exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 2));
36997        a?;
36998        b?;
36999
37000        // Either interleaving is a valid serial order: one request took the Session over and the other
37001        // was refused as it raced it, or the second took over the first's successor. Every request is
37002        // answered once, and one plane is live.
37003        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
37004        assert_eq!(
37005            2,
37006            seen.resumed.len() + seen.errors.len(),
37007            "every request is answered: {seen:?}"
37008        );
37009        assert_eq!(
37010            0, seen.established,
37011            "a takeover is answered by SessionResumed: {seen:?}"
37012        );
37013        assert!(!seen.resumed.is_empty(), "{seen:?}");
37014        // A request that lost the race inside the takeover is `Busy`; one that arrived after a higher challenge
37015        // had taken over is an older attempt and `NotResumable`.
37016        assert!(
37017            seen.errors
37018                .iter()
37019                .all(|e| matches!(e, StartErrorReason::Busy | StartErrorReason::NotResumable)),
37020            "{seen:?}"
37021        );
37022        assert_eq!(1, exit.mgr.num_active_sessions());
37023        let winner = exit.instance()?;
37024        assert!([MIN_CHALLENGE + 1, MIN_CHALLENGE + 2].contains(&winner.challenge));
37025        assert!(!winner.is_superseded());
37026        assert!(!exit.slot()?.is_detached());
37027
37028        // Only a plane that won its swap is delivered.
37029        let mut live = 0;
37030        while let Ok(session) = exit.incoming.try_recv() {
37031            if session.session.slot_instance() == Some(winner.id()) {
37032                live += 1;
37033            }
37034        }
37035        assert_eq!(1, live, "exactly one session object is the live one");
37036        Ok(())
37037    }
37038
37039    /// A takeover racing the end of the window (the real timer, at offsets around its firing) or an
37040    /// operator close: whichever the slot's compute orders first wins, and no outcome leaves a live
37041    /// plane on a closed slot, or two live planes. An operator close always ends the Session; every
37042    /// plane that is not the current one is cut off.
37043    #[rstest]
37044    #[case::the_window_ending(Rival::WindowEnds)]
37045    #[case::an_operator_close(Rival::OperatorClose)]
37046    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37047    async fn a_takeover_racing_a_close_leaves_a_consistent_slot(#[case] rival: Rival) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37048        use futures::AsyncReadExt;
37049
37050        const WINDOW: Duration = Duration::from_millis(200);
37051        for (round, offset_ms) in [0u64, 60, 120, 170, 190, 200, 210, 230].into_iter().enumerate() {
37052            let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
37053                resume_window: WINDOW,
37054                fill: crate::supervision::PixFillConfig {
37055                    min_surb_reserve: 1,
37056                    drain_after_close: false,
37057                    ..Default::default()
37058                },
37059                ..Default::default()
37060            })
37061            .await?;
37062            let original = exit.instance()?;
37063            assert!(exit.end_data_plane(&original, ClosureReason::EmptyRead));
37064            let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(20)).await;
37065
37066            match rival {
37067                Rival::WindowEnds => {
37068                    // The timer is the rival: the request arrives `offset_ms` into the window.
37069                    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(offset_ms)).await;
37070                    exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
37071                }
37072                Rival::OperatorClose => {
37073                    let takeover = exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1);
37074                    let close = async {
37075                        tokio::task::yield_now().await;
37076                        exit.mgr.close_session(&exit.pseudonym);
37077                    };
37078                    let (taken, ()) = tokio::join!(takeover, close);
37079                    taken?;
37080                }
37081            }
37082            tokio::time::sleep(WINDOW * 2).await;
37083
37084            let current = exit.mgr.sessions.get(&exit.pseudonym);
37085            match (&current, rival) {
37086                (Some(_), Rival::OperatorClose) => panic!("round {round}: an operator close always ends the Session"),
37087                (Some(slot), Rival::WindowEnds) => {
37088                    assert!(
37089                        !slot.is_detached() && !slot.instance.is_superseded() && slot.instance.is_established(),
37090                        "round {round} (offset {offset_ms} ms): the surviving slot is a live, attached one"
37091                    );
37092                }
37093                (None, _) => assert_eq!(0, exit.mgr.num_active_sessions(), "round {round}"),
37094            }
37095
37096            // Every delivered plane that is not the current one is cut off: it cannot write.
37097            while let Ok(mut delivered) = exit.incoming.try_recv() {
37098                let is_current = current
37099                    .as_ref()
37100                    .is_some_and(|slot| delivered.session.slot_instance() == Some(slot.instance.id()));
37101                if !is_current {
37102                    let write = async {
37103                        delivered.session.write_all(b"cut").await?;
37104                        delivered.session.flush().await
37105                    }
37106                    .await;
37107                    assert!(
37108                        write.is_err(),
37109                        "round {round}: a plane that is not current must be cut off"
37110                    );
37111                    let mut buf = [0u8; 4];
37112                    let read = timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), delivered.session.read(&mut buf)).await;
37113                    assert!(
37114                        matches!(read, Ok(Ok(0)) | Ok(Err(_))),
37115                        "round {round}: and its reader ends"
37116                    );
37117                }
37118            }
37119        }
37120        Ok(())
37121    }
37122
37123    #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
37124    enum Rival {
37125        WindowEnds,
37126        OperatorClose,
37127    }
37128
37129    /// A timer of a window that a takeover has ended must not act on the successor, even when the
37130    /// successor is detached again by then: the first timer would fire at 1.5 s, the second window's own
37131    /// at about 2.2 s, and the Session must be still waiting in between.
37132    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37133    async fn a_stale_window_timer_cannot_end_a_successors_window() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37134        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
37135            resume_window: Duration::from_millis(1500),
37136            ..Default::default()
37137        })
37138        .await?;
37139        let first = exit.instance()?;
37140        let started = tokio::time::Instant::now();
37141        assert!(exit.end_data_plane(&first, ClosureReason::EmptyRead));
37142
37143        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(700)).await;
37144        exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
37145        let _new = exit.next_session().await?;
37146        let second = exit.instance()?;
37147        assert!(exit.end_data_plane(&second, ClosureReason::EmptyRead));
37148        assert!(exit.slot()?.is_detached());
37149
37150        // What the first timer would do, were it alive: its scope is the first instance, which the
37151        // slot no longer is.
37152        assert!(
37153            !exit.mgr.close_session_scoped(
37154                &exit.pseudonym,
37155                ClosureReason::EmptyRead,
37156                CloseScope::DetachedInstance(&first)
37157            ),
37158            "the first window's close finds nothing it admits"
37159        );
37160        assert!(exit.slot()?.is_detached());
37161
37162        // Past the first window's end, before the second's.
37163        tokio::time::sleep_until(started + Duration::from_millis(1800)).await;
37164        assert!(
37165            exit.slot()?.is_detached() && !exit.fill()?.is_draining(),
37166            "the first window's timer must not end the second window"
37167        );
37168        assert!(
37169            eventually(Duration::from_secs(4), || exit
37170                .fill()
37171                .is_ok_and(|fill| fill.is_draining()))
37172            .await,
37173            "the second window ends on its own timer"
37174        );
37175        Ok(())
37176    }
37177
37178    /// After the window has closed the slot a reconnect finds nothing to take over: a fresh Session.
37179    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37180    async fn a_reconnect_after_the_window_closed_the_slot_opens_a_fresh_session() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37181        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
37182            idle_timeout: Some(Duration::from_millis(1500)),
37183            resume_window: Duration::from_millis(400),
37184            fill: crate::supervision::PixFillConfig {
37185                min_surb_reserve: 1,
37186                drain_after_close: false,
37187                ..Default::default()
37188            },
37189            ..Default::default()
37190        })
37191        .await?;
37192        let old_plane = exit.slot()?.pix_supervisor.clone();
37193        let instance = exit.instance()?;
37194        assert!(exit.end_data_plane(&instance, ClosureReason::EmptyRead));
37195        assert!(wait_for_no_active_sessions(&exit.mgr).await);
37196
37197        exit.start_fresh(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
37198        let _fresh = exit.next_session().await?;
37199        let slot = exit.slot()?;
37200        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&old_plane, &slot.pix_supervisor), "a fresh control plane");
37201        assert!(!slot.exit_resume.entry_answered.load(Ordering::Acquire));
37202        assert!(
37203            !slot.pix_egress_gate.get().context("gate")?.ever_funded(),
37204            "and nothing paid for"
37205        );
37206        Ok(())
37207    }

37209    /// A failed answer to a takeover detaches the new instance; it does not destroy the funded cycle.
37210    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37211    async fn a_failed_session_established_send_detaches_rather_than_destroying_the_cycle() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37212        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;
37213        let before = exit.slot()?;
37214        // Nothing can be sent from here on.
37215        exit.msg_rx.close();
37216
37217        let outcome = exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await;
37218        assert!(outcome.is_err(), "the answer could not be sent");
37219
37220        let slot = exit.slot().context("the slot must survive the failed answer")?;
37221        assert!(slot.is_detached(), "the new instance is detached");
37222        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&slot.instance, &before.instance), "it is the new instance");
37223        assert!(slot.instance.is_superseded());
37224        assert!(!exit.gate()?.is_poisoned(), "the funded cycle is not destroyed");
37225        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&slot.pix_supervisor, &before.pix_supervisor));
37226        assert!(has_handle(&slot, SessionHandles::ResumeWindow));
37227        assert!(
37228            exit.gate()?.data_plane_detached(),
37229            "successor requests stay deferred, none can precede an answer"
37230        );
37231        assert!(
37232            exit.incoming.try_recv().is_err(),
37233            "the session server is handed nothing of an unanswered takeover"
37234        );
37235        Ok(())
37236    }

37238    /// A writer parked on the gate when the Session is taken over is not released onto the new plane.
37239    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37240    async fn a_writer_parked_on_the_gate_is_not_released_onto_the_new_plane() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37241        // Unfunded, with a single predeposit packet: the second packet of the old plane parks.
37242        let (mut exit, mut old) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
37243            fund: false,
37244            max_predeposit_packets: Some(1),
37245            ..Default::default()
37246        })
37247        .await?;
37248        let gate = exit.gate()?;
37249        let old_instance = exit.instance()?;
37250
37251        let parked = tokio::spawn(async move {
37252            for _ in 0..3 {
37253                old.session.write_all(b"old plane").await?;
37254                old.session.flush().await?;
37255            }
37256            std::io::Result::Ok(())
37257        });
37258        assert!(
37259            eventually(Duration::from_secs(3), || gate.served_total() >= 1).await,
37260            "the first packet is served from the predeposit"
37261        );
37262        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200)).await;
37263        assert!(!parked.is_finished(), "the next write is parked on the exhausted gate");
37264        let sent_before = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
37265
37266        exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
37267        let _new = exit.next_session().await?;
37268        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
37269
37270        // The gate is funded: the parked writer is admitted, and must be refused all the same.
37271        gate.release_service();
37272        let outcome = timeout(Duration::from_secs(3), parked)
37273            .await
37274            .context("the writer must end")??;
37275        assert!(outcome.is_err(), "the old writer errors");
37276        assert!(old_instance.is_superseded());
37277        let after = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
37278        assert_eq!(
37279            0, after.data,
37280            "nothing of the old plane is sent after the takeover: {after:?} (before: {sent_before:?})"
37281        );
37282        Ok(())
37283    }

37285    /// After a takeover with data flowing, the planned fill backs off: `organic` rises on the same gate.
37286    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37287    async fn after_a_takeover_with_data_flowing_the_planned_fill_backs_off() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37288        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;
37289        let instance = exit.instance()?;
37290        let fill = exit.fill()?;
37291        let rate = |fill: &PixFillControl| {
37292            let state = fill.state.lock();
37293            state.fill.packets as f64 / state.fill.per.as_secs_f64()
37294        };
37295        assert!(exit.end_data_plane(&instance, ClosureReason::EmptyRead));
37296
37297        // Detached and idle: nothing is served, so the planner raises the fill toward what the cycle needs.
37298        assert!(
37299            eventually(Duration::from_secs(6), || rate(&fill) > 2.0).await,
37300            "the fill rises while detached, was {}",
37301            rate(&fill)
37302        );
37303        let detached_rate = rate(&fill);
37304
37305        exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
37306        let mut new = exit.next_session().await?;
37307        let writer = tokio::spawn(async move {
37308            // Far more than the fill needs, so that the organic traffic covers the requirement.
37309            for _ in 0..600 {
37310                if new.session.write_all(b"data").await.is_err() || new.session.flush().await.is_err() {
37311                    break;
37312                }
37313                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
37314            }
37315        });
37316        assert!(
37317            eventually(Duration::from_secs(10), || rate(&fill) < detached_rate / 2.0).await,
37318            "the planned fill ({}) must back off from {detached_rate} once data flows through the kept gate",
37319            rate(&fill)
37320        );
37321        writer.abort();
37322        Ok(())
37323    }

37325    /// A Session frame of the stream, as the Entry's socket would send it.
37326    fn stream_segment(frame_id: u32, terminating: bool, payload: &[u8]) -> anyhow::Result<ApplicationDataIn> {
37327        use hopr_protocol_session::types::{Segment, SeqIndicator, SessionMessage};
37328
37329        Ok(ApplicationDataIn {
37330            data: ApplicationData::new(
37331                SESSION_APPLICATION_TAG,
37332                SessionMessage::<{ ApplicationData::PAYLOAD_SIZE }>::Segment(Segment {
37333                    frame_id,
37334                    seq_idx: 0,
37335                    seq_flags: SeqIndicator::new_with_flags(1, terminating),
37336                    data: payload.to_vec().into_boxed_slice(),
37337                })
37338                .into_encoded()
37339                .into_vec(),
37340            )?,
37341            packet_info: Default::default(),
37342        })
37343    }

37345    /// The data plane of an Exit's Session shares progress counters with the manager, which a takeover reads.
37346    #[rstest]
37347    #[case::received(true)]
37348    #[case::sent(false)]
37349    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37350    async fn a_capable_entrys_takeover_is_answered_with_a_base_above_the_predecessors_frames(
37351        #[case] received: bool,
37352    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37353        use futures::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
37354
37355        let (mut exit, mut old) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
37356            // One frame per write.
37357            capabilities: Capability::Segmentation | Capability::NoDelay,
37358            ..Default::default()
37359        })
37360        .await?;
37361        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
37362
37363        let highest = if received {
37364            // The Entry's frames 1 to 7, of which the reader takes in what is in order.
37365            for id in 1..=7u32 {
37366                exit.mgr
37367                    .dispatch_message(exit.pseudonym, stream_segment(id, false, b"x")?)?;
37368            }
37369            let mut got = [0u8; 7];
37370            timeout(Duration::from_secs(3), old.session.read_exact(&mut got)).await??;
37371            7
37372        } else {
37373            for _ in 0..9 {
37374                old.session.write_all(b"y").await?;
37375                old.session.flush().await?;
37376            }
37377            9
37378        };
37379        let progress = exit.instance()?.stream_progress.get().cloned().context("progress")?;
37380        assert_eq!(highest, progress.highest_received().max(progress.highest_sent()));
37381
37382        exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
37383        let mut new = exit.next_session().await?;
37384        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
37385        assert_eq!(0, seen.established, "{seen:?}");
37386        assert_eq!(1, seen.resumed.len(), "{seen:?}");
37387        let base = seen.resumed[0].stream_base;
37388        assert_eq!(highest + STREAM_BASE_MARGIN, base);
37389        assert_eq!(Some(base), new.session.config().stream_base);
37390
37391        // The successor's frames number from the base: the first one it sends carries it.
37392        new.session.write_all(b"z").await?;
37393        new.session.flush().await?;
37394        let progress = exit.instance()?.stream_progress.get().cloned().context("progress")?;
37395        assert_eq!(base, progress.highest_sent());
37396        Ok(())
37397    }

37399    /// A repeat of a resume attempt whose takeover is done is answered with the same `SessionResumed`, over a
37400    /// counted SURB, and not with a `SessionEstablished` the Entry would refuse.
37401    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37402    async fn a_repeated_resume_attempt_is_answered_with_the_same_session_resumed() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37403        use crate::supervision::telemetry::probe;
37404
37405        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;
37406        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
37407        probe::reset();
37408
37409        exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
37410        let _second = exit.next_session().await?;
37411        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(200)).await;
37412        assert_eq!(1, seen.resumed.len(), "{seen:?}");
37413        let base = seen.resumed[0].stream_base;
37414        let consumed = exit.slot()?.surb_estimator.consumed.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
37415
37416        let repeat = HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(exit.request(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1)?);
37417        exit.mgr.dispatch_message(exit.pseudonym, start_packet(repeat)?)?;
37418        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
37419        assert_eq!(0, seen.established, "{seen:?}");
37420        assert!(seen.errors.is_empty(), "{seen:?}");
37421        assert_eq!(1, seen.resumed.len(), "{seen:?}");
37422        assert_eq!(
37423            (MIN_CHALLENGE + 1, exit.pseudonym, base),
37424            (
37425                seen.resumed[0].orig_challenge,
37426                seen.resumed[0].session_id,
37427                seen.resumed[0].stream_base
37428            )
37429        );
37430        assert_eq!(
37431            consumed + 1,
37432            exit.slot()?.surb_estimator.consumed.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
37433            "the replay is counted as a used SURB"
37434        );
37435        assert_eq!(1, probe::get("exit_control/session_established_replay/pix/sent"));
37436        assert_eq!(1, exit.mgr.num_active_sessions());
37437        Ok(())
37438    }

37440    /// A repeat of a resume attempt whose takeover could not deliver its plane is not confirmed: the instance is
37441    /// detached, so the repeat is refused as a duplicate, which the Entry retries with a new challenge.
37442    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37443    async fn a_repeat_of_a_resume_attempt_whose_takeover_failed_is_not_confirmed() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37444        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;

37448        exit.incoming.close();

37450        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;

37452            exit.slot()?.is_detached(),

37457        exit.mgr.dispatch_message(exit.pseudonym, start_packet(repeat)?)?;

37460            seen.resumed.is_empty(),
37461            "a detached instance is not confirmed: {seen:?}"
37462        );

37468    /// A repeat of a resume attempt that arrives while its takeover is still being admitted is dropped: no `Busy`,
37469    /// no second takeover, and the one answer is the original's.
37470    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37471    async fn a_repeat_of_a_resume_attempt_during_its_takeover_is_dropped() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37472        let gated = GatedAdmission::default();
37473        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
37474            session_admission: Some(gated.sink()),
37475            ..Default::default()
37476        })
37477        .await?;
37478        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
37479        let before = gated.requests();
37480
37481        gated.hold_next.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
37482        let attempt = HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(exit.request(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1)?);
37483        exit.mgr
37484            .dispatch_message(exit.pseudonym, start_packet(attempt.clone())?)?;
37485        timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
37486            while gated.requests() == before {
37487                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5)).await;
37488            }
37489        })
37490        .await
37491        .context("the takeover never asked the session server")?;
37492        exit.mgr.dispatch_message(exit.pseudonym, start_packet(attempt)?)?;
37493        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
37494        assert!(seen.errors.is_empty(), "the repeat is dropped, not refused: {seen:?}");
37495        assert_eq!(
37496            before + 1,
37497            gated.requests(),
37498            "the repeat does not start a second takeover"
37499        );
37500
37501        gated.release.notify_one();
37502        let _second = exit.next_session().await?;
37503        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
37504        assert_eq!(1, seen.resumed.len(), "{seen:?}");
37505        assert!(seen.errors.is_empty(), "{seen:?}");
37506        assert_eq!(0, seen.established, "{seen:?}");
37507        assert!(!exit.instance()?.is_superseded());
37508        Ok(())
37509    }

37554    /// A resume attempt with nothing held, or with takeover switched off, is refused before anything is
37555    /// allocated or reserved.
37556    #[rstest]
37557    #[case::nothing_held(false)]
37558    #[case::window_zero(true)]
37559    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37560    async fn a_resume_request_that_cannot_resume_allocates_nothing(#[case] window_zero: bool) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37561        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
37562            resume_window: if window_zero {
37563                Duration::ZERO
37564            } else {
37565                Duration::from_secs(60)
37566            },
37567            ..Default::default()
37568        })
37569        .await?;
37570        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
37571        // With the window at zero the request targets the held pseudonym; otherwise one that holds nothing.
37572        let other = HoprPseudonym::random();
37573        let target = if window_zero { exit.pseudonym } else { other };
37574        let cycle_bytes = exit.mgr.live_cycle_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
37575        let held_before = exit.mgr.sessions.get(&exit.pseudonym).map(|s| s.instance.clone());
37576

37580        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
37581        assert_eq!(vec![StartErrorReason::NotResumable], seen.errors, "{seen:?}");
37582        assert_eq!(0, seen.established + seen.resumed.len(), "{seen:?}");
37583        assert!(
37584            exit.incoming.try_recv().is_err(),
37585            "nothing is handed to the session server"
37586        );
37587        assert!(
37588            exit.mgr.sessions.get(&other).is_none(),
37589            "no slot for the unheld pseudonym"
37590        );
37591        assert_eq!(1, exit.mgr.num_active_sessions());
37592        assert_eq!(
37593            cycle_bytes,
37594            exit.mgr.live_cycle_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
37595            "nothing reserved"
37596        );
37597        let held_after = exit.mgr.sessions.get(&exit.pseudonym).map(|s| s.instance.clone());
37598        assert!(match (held_before, held_after) {
37599            (Some(a), Some(b)) => Arc::ptr_eq(&a, &b),
37600            _ => false,
37601        });
37602        Ok(())
37603    }

37677    /// The base must stay within what a socket can number from, 2^31: the takeover is refused above it, and
37678    /// allowed up to and including it.
37679    #[rstest]
37680    #[case::at_the_limit(MAX_STREAM_BASE - STREAM_BASE_MARGIN, true)]
37681    #[case::above_the_limit(MAX_STREAM_BASE - STREAM_BASE_MARGIN + 1, false)]
37682    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37683    async fn a_base_above_the_maximum_refuses_the_takeover(
37684        #[case] predecessor_frame: u32,
37685        #[case] taken_over: bool,
37686    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37687        let (mut exit, _old) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;
37688        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
37689
37690        // The held Session's stream is at `predecessor_frame` (a frame id that far ahead cannot be fed
37691        // through a real socket, whose sequencer would walk the gap).
37692        let held = SlotInstance::new_with(MIN_CHALLENGE, true);
37693        held.mark_established();
37694        let _ = held
37695            .stream_progress
37696            .set(StreamProgress::starting_at(predecessor_frame, 0));
37697        exit.mgr.sessions.insert(
37698            exit.pseudonym,
37699            SessionSlot {
37700                instance: held.clone(),
37701                ..exit.slot()?
37702            },
37703        );
37704        assert_eq!(taken_over.then_some(MAX_STREAM_BASE), successor_stream_base(&held));
37705
37706        exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
37707        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
37708        if taken_over {
37709            assert_eq!(1, seen.resumed.len(), "{seen:?}");
37710            assert_eq!(MAX_STREAM_BASE, seen.resumed[0].stream_base);
37711        } else {
37712            assert_eq!(vec![StartErrorReason::NotResumable], seen.errors, "{seen:?}");
37713            assert_eq!(0, seen.resumed.len());
37714            assert!(
37715                exit.incoming.try_recv().is_err(),
37716                "nothing is handed to the application"
37717            );
37718            assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&exit.slot()?.instance, &held));
37719            assert!(!held.is_superseded());
37720        }
37721        Ok(())
37722    }

37768    /// A resume request that carries the challenge of the held instance is a duplicate: refused as an occupied
37769    /// pseudonym while that instance holds the slot, `NotResumable` once it is gone, and never a fresh Session.

37772    #[case::gone(false, StartErrorReason::NotResumable)]
37773    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37774    async fn a_duplicate_resume_request_never_allocates_a_session(
37775        #[case] held: bool,
37776        #[case] expected: StartErrorReason,
37777    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37778        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
37779            fill: crate::supervision::PixFillConfig {
37780                min_surb_reserve: 1,
37781                drain_after_close: false,
37782                ..Default::default()
37783            },
37784            ..Default::default()
37785        })
37786        .await?;
37787        let snapshot = exit.slot()?;
37788        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
37789        if !held {
37790            assert!(exit.mgr.close_session(&exit.pseudonym));
37791            exit.mgr.sessions.run_pending_tasks();
37792            assert!(exit.mgr.sessions.get(&exit.pseudonym).is_none());
37793            let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
37794        }
37795
37796        let request = exit.request(MIN_CHALLENGE)?;
37797        exit.mgr
37798            .refuse_duplicate_resume(
37799                exit.pseudonym,
37800                &request,
37801                DestinationRouting::Return(exit.pseudonym.into()),
37802                &snapshot,
37803            )
37804            .await?;
37805        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
37806        assert_eq!(vec![expected], seen.errors, "{seen:?}");
37807        assert_eq!(0, seen.established + seen.resumed.len(), "{seen:?}");
37808        assert_eq!(usize::from(held), exit.mgr.sessions.iter().count());
37809        Ok(())
37810    }

37845    /// Frames of the predecessor's stream, and its close marker, arriving after a takeover of a live Session
37846    /// do not touch the successor: every one of them is below the base.
37847    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
37848    async fn predecessor_frames_and_a_predecessor_fin_after_a_live_takeover_do_not_affect_the_successor()
37849    -> anyhow::Result<()> {
37850        use futures::AsyncReadExt;
37851
37852        let (mut exit, mut old) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;
37853        // The predecessor's stream is at frame 20.
37854        for id in 1..=20u32 {
37855            exit.mgr
37856                .dispatch_message(exit.pseudonym, stream_segment(id, false, b"o")?)?;
37857        }
37858        let mut got = [0u8; 20];
37859        timeout(Duration::from_secs(3), old.session.read_exact(&mut got)).await??;
37860        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
37861
37862        // A live takeover.
37863        exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
37864        let mut new = exit.next_session().await?;
37865        let base = exit
37866            .originated(Duration::from_millis(300))
37867            .await
37868            .resumed
37869            .first()
37870            .map(|resumed| resumed.stream_base)
37871            .context("a SessionResumed")?;
37872        assert_eq!(20 + STREAM_BASE_MARGIN, base);
37873
37874        // What the predecessor's stream still had in flight: frames above where it was, and its FIN, the
37875        // very ones a successor without a base would mistake for its own.
37876        for id in [21u32, 22, 23, 1, 5] {
37877            exit.mgr
37878                .dispatch_message(exit.pseudonym, stream_segment(id, false, b"stale")?)?;
37879        }
37880        exit.mgr
37881            .dispatch_message(exit.pseudonym, stream_segment(24, true, b"")?)?;
37882        exit.mgr
37883            .dispatch_message(exit.pseudonym, stream_segment(base - 1, true, b"")?)?;
37884        // The successor's own stream, from the base.
37885        exit.mgr
37886            .dispatch_message(exit.pseudonym, stream_segment(base, false, b"fresh")?)?;
37887        exit.mgr
37888            .dispatch_message(exit.pseudonym, stream_segment(base + 1, false, b"fresh")?)?;
37889
37890        let mut got = [0u8; 10];
37891        timeout(Duration::from_secs(3), new.session.read_exact(&mut got))
37892            .await
37893            .context("the successor must read its own stream, and only that")??;
37894        assert_eq!(b"freshfresh", &got);
37895        assert!(
37896            !exit.instance()?.is_superseded(),
37897            "the successor was not closed by a FIN"
37898        );
37899        Ok(())
37900    }

38102    /// A higher challenge takes a live or a detached slot over; an equal one is a duplicate and is
38103    /// refused as it always was; a lower one is an older attempt, `NotResumable`.
38104    #[rstest]
38105    #[case::live(false)]
38106    #[case::detached(true)]
38107    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
38108    async fn takeover_is_ordered_by_challenge(#[case] detached: bool) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
38109        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;
38110        let original = exit.instance()?;
38111        if detached {
38112            assert!(exit.end_data_plane(&original, ClosureReason::EmptyRead));
38113        }
38114        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
38115
38116        // Equal to the holder's own: the duplicate, refused.
38117        exit.reconnect(original.challenge).await?;
38118        // Lower than the holder's (a challenge of 0 is below any a Session was established by).
38119        exit.reconnect(original.challenge.saturating_sub(1)).await?;
38120        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
38121        assert_eq!(
38122            vec![StartErrorReason::NoSlotsAvailable, StartErrorReason::NotResumable],
38123            seen.errors,
38124            "{seen:?}"
38125        );
38126        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&exit.slot()?.instance, &original));
38127
38128        // Higher: taken over.
38129        exit.reconnect(original.challenge + 1).await?;
38130        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
38131        assert_eq!(1, seen.resumed.len(), "{seen:?}");
38132        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&exit.slot()?.instance, &original));
38133        Ok(())
38134    }

38212    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
38213    async fn a_successor_earned_while_detached_goes_out_after_the_takeover(#[case] detach: bool) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
38214        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;
38215        let supervisor = exit
38216            .slot()?
38217            .pix_supervisor
38218            .get()
38219            .cloned()
38220            .context("a PIX session has a supervisor")?;
38221        let first_cycle = SsaId::new(exit.pseudonym, SsaIndex::new(1).context("non-zero")?);
38222        if detach {
38223            let instance = exit.instance()?;

38227
38228        // The funded cycle earns its successor.
38229        supervisor
38230            .send_event(SessionPixEvent::AlmostRecovered(first_cycle))
38231            .await
38232            .map_err(|()| anyhow!("the supervisor stopped accepting events"))?;
38233
38234        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(1500)).await;
38235        if detach {
38236            assert_eq!(0, seen.ssa_requests, "no successor request while detached: {seen:?}");
38237            exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
38238            let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(2000)).await;
38239            assert_eq!(1, seen.resumed.len(), "{seen:?}");
38240            assert_eq!(
38241                1, seen.ssa_requests,
38242                "the deferred successor request goes out after the takeover: {seen:?}"
38243            );
38244            assert_eq!(
38245                vec!["SessionResumed", "SsaRequest"],
38246                seen.order,
38247                "SessionResumed precedes every SsaRequest"
38248            );
38249        } else {
38250            assert_eq!(
38251                1, seen.ssa_requests,
38252                "the control: an attached Session asks at once: {seen:?}"
38253            );
38254        }
38255        Ok(())
38256    }

38258    /// An Exit that predates the bit reads the options and the idle timeout from the other bits.
38259    #[test]
38260    fn the_forward_receipts_bit_should_not_change_what_an_old_exit_reads() {
38261        let options = 0xdead_beef_0123_4567u64;
38262        let idle = Duration::from_secs(120);
38263        let plain = into_initiation_additional_data(options, idle);
38264        let with_bit = plain | FORWARD_RECEIPTS_REQUESTED;
38265        assert_eq!(initiation_options(plain), initiation_options(with_bit));
38266        assert_eq!(announced_idle_timeout(plain), announced_idle_timeout(with_bit));
38267        assert_eq!(Some(idle), announced_idle_timeout(with_bit));

38270    /// An Exit Session whose Entry asks for forward receipts (`bit`), with the stock held at `stock` SURBs.
38271    async fn exit_session_for_receipts(
38272        forward_receipts: bool,
38273        bit: bool,
38274        entry_refills: bool,
38275        stock: u64,
38276    ) -> anyhow::Result<(
38277        RecordingManager,
38278        Originated,
38279        futures::channel::mpsc::Receiver<IncomingSession>,
38280        HoprPseudonym,
38281    )> {
38282        let mgr = RecordingManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
38283            forward_receipts,
38284            ..Default::default()
38285        });
38286        let (msg_tx, msg_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
38287        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(4);
38288        mgr.start(msg_tx, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
38289
38290        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
38291        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(
38292            pseudonym,
38293            StartInitiation {
38294                challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE,
38295                target: SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
38296                capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities(Capability::Segmentation.into()),
38297                additional_data: into_initiation_additional_data(64, Duration::ZERO)
38298                    | if bit { FORWARD_RECEIPTS_REQUESTED } else { 0 },
38299            },
38300        )
38301        .await?;
38302
38303        if entry_refills {
38304            dispatch_entry_keep_alive(&mgr, pseudonym, KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget.into(), 0, 0)?;
38305            wait_for_counterparty_refills(&mgr, &pseudonym).await?;
38306        }
38307        mgr.sessions
38308            .get(&pseudonym)
38309            .context("the session slot must exist")?
38310            .surb_estimator
38311            .produced
38312            .fetch_add(stock, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
38313        Ok((mgr, msg_rx, new_session_rx, pseudonym))
38314    }
