38316    /// Delivers `count` Session data packets with consecutive tags from `first`.
38317    fn deliver_tagged_data(
38318        mgr: &RecordingManager,
38319        pseudonym: HoprPseudonym,
38320        first: u32,
38321        count: u32,
38322    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
38323        for tag in first..first + count {
38324            mgr.dispatch_message(
38325                pseudonym,
38326                ApplicationDataIn {
38327                    data: ApplicationData::new(SESSION_APPLICATION_TAG, vec![0u8; 8])?,
38328                    packet_info: IncomingPacketInfo {
38329                        forward_receipt_tag: Some(tag),
38330                        ..Default::default()
38331                    },
38332                },
38333            )?;
38334        }
38335        Ok(())
38336    }
38337
38338    /// The forward receipts originated for `pseudonym` over `window`, as `(seq, tags, data)`.
38339    async fn receipts_during(
38340        rx: &mut Originated,
38341        pseudonym: HoprPseudonym,
38342        window: Duration,
38343    ) -> Vec<(u32, Vec<u32>, ApplicationDataOut)> {
38344        originated_during(rx, window)
38345            .await
38346            .into_iter()
38347            .filter(|(routing, _)| matches!(routing, DestinationRouting::Return(SurbMatcher::Pseudonym(p)) if *p == pseudonym))
38348            .filter_map(|(_, data)| {
38349                match HoprStartProtocol::decode(data.data.application_tag, &data.data.plain_text).ok()? {
38350                    StartProtocol::ForwardReceipts(m) => Some((m.seq, m.tags, data)),
38351                    _ => None,
38352                }
38353            })
38354            .collect()
38355    }

38357    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
38358    async fn an_exit_should_send_a_receipt_that_is_counted_and_refundable() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
38359        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
38360
38361        let (mgr, mut rx, _incoming, pseudonym) = exit_session_for_receipts(true, true, true, 1_000).await?;
38362        let estimator = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.surb_estimator.clone();
38363        let consumed = estimator.consumed.load(Relaxed);
38364
38365        deliver_tagged_data(&mgr, pseudonym, 100, 60)?;
38366        let receipts = receipts_during(&mut rx, pseudonym, Duration::from_millis(800)).await;
38367
38368        anyhow::ensure!(!receipts.is_empty(), "no receipt was sent");
38369        let (seq, tags, data) = &receipts[0];
38370        assert_eq!(1, *seq);
38371        assert_eq!((100..160).collect::<Vec<_>>(), *tags);
38372        assert!(data.surb_refund.is_counted(), "a receipt carries its refund");
38373        assert_eq!(consumed + receipts.len() as u64, estimator.consumed.load(Relaxed));
38374        data.surb_refund.give_back();
38375        assert_eq!(
38376            1,
38377            estimator.refunded.load(Relaxed),
38378            "a dropped receipt gives its SURB back"
38379        );
38380        Ok(())
38381    }

38383    /// Bursts of 250 awaiting the task, which cross the half-full mark mid-burst: the receipt must not wait for the
38384    /// 250 ms poll, or the packets that arrive meanwhile overflow the interval.
38385    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
38386    async fn a_fast_session_should_overflow_no_interval() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
38387        let (mgr, mut rx, _incoming, pseudonym) = exit_session_for_receipts(true, true, true, 1_000_000).await?;
38388        let mut next = 0;
38389        let mut receipts = Vec::new();
38390        for _ in 0..12 {
38391            deliver_tagged_data(&mgr, pseudonym, next, 250)?;
38392            next += 250;
38393            receipts.extend(receipts_during(&mut rx, pseudonym, Duration::from_millis(30)).await);
38394        }
38395        anyhow::ensure!(receipts.len() >= 3, "{} receipts", receipts.len());
38396        let seqs: Vec<u32> = receipts.iter().map(|(seq, ..)| *seq).collect();
38397        assert_eq!((1..=seqs.len() as u32).collect::<Vec<_>>(), seqs, "no overflow jump");
38398        Ok(())
38399    }

38401    /// A receipt is sent twice while a burst window is open, and once otherwise; every copy is counted.
38402    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
38403    async fn a_receipt_should_be_sent_twice_inside_a_burst_window_and_once_outside() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
38404        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
38405
38406        let (mgr, mut rx, _incoming, pseudonym) = exit_session_for_receipts(true, true, true, 1_000_000).await?;
38407        let estimator = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?.surb_estimator.clone();
38408        let consumed = estimator.consumed.load(Relaxed);
38409
38410        // The first packet opens no window; after a quiet second the next ones do
38411        deliver_tagged_data(&mgr, pseudonym, 0, 1)?;
38412        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1_100)).await;
38413        deliver_tagged_data(&mgr, pseudonym, 1, 10)?;
38414        let inside = receipts_during(&mut rx, pseudonym, Duration::from_millis(400)).await;
38415        assert_eq!(vec![1, 1], inside.iter().map(|(seq, ..)| *seq).collect::<Vec<_>>());
38416
38417        // Past the window (the cooldown keeps it from reopening) one copy
38418        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200)).await;
38419        deliver_tagged_data(&mgr, pseudonym, 11, 1)?;
38420        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(600)).await;
38421        deliver_tagged_data(&mgr, pseudonym, 12, 1)?;
38422        deliver_tagged_data(&mgr, pseudonym, 13, 60)?;
38423        let outside = receipts_during(&mut rx, pseudonym, Duration::from_millis(800)).await;
38424        assert_eq!(vec![2], outside.iter().map(|(seq, ..)| *seq).collect::<Vec<_>>());
38425
38426        assert_eq!(consumed + 3, estimator.consumed.load(Relaxed), "every copy is counted");
38427        Ok(())
38428    }
38429
38430    /// The second copy needs the stock to stay above the keep-alive reserve after the first.
38431    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
38432    async fn the_second_copy_should_keep_the_stock_above_the_reserve() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
38433        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
38434
38435        // The stock is the reserve plus 1 (one copy) or plus 2 (two)
38436        for (above_reserve, copies) in [(1u64, 1), (2, 2)] {
38437            let (mgr, mut rx, _incoming, pseudonym) = exit_session_for_receipts(true, true, true, 1_000).await?;
38438            let slot = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym).context("slot")?;
38439            let target = current_keep_alive_surb_reserve(&slot.surb_mgmt) + above_reserve;
38440            let estimator = slot.surb_estimator.clone();
38441            let held = estimator.saturating_diff();
38442            if held > target {
38443                estimator.consumed.fetch_add(held - target, Relaxed);
38444            } else {
38445                estimator.produced.fetch_add(target - held, Relaxed);
38446            }
38447            drop(slot);
38448
38449            deliver_tagged_data(&mgr, pseudonym, 0, 1)?;
38450            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1_100)).await;
38451            deliver_tagged_data(&mgr, pseudonym, 1, 10)?;
38452            let sent = receipts_during(&mut rx, pseudonym, Duration::from_millis(400)).await;
38453            assert_eq!(copies, sent.len(), "{above_reserve} above the reserve");
38454        }
38455        Ok(())
38456    }

38533    /// An Entry-side slot for `pseudonym` on a started manager that has `sink` installed.
38534    fn entry_with_sink(pseudonym: HoprPseudonym, sink: Arc<RecordingSink>) -> anyhow::Result<RecordingManager> {
38535        let mgr = RecordingManager::new(Default::default());
38536        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
38537        let (mock_sender, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
38538        mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
38539        assert!(mgr.set_forward_receipt_sink(sink));
38540
38541        let (dummy_tx, _) = crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async::<ApplicationDataIn>(SESSION_FORWARD_CAPACITY);
38542        let peer: Address = (&ChainKeypair::random()).into();
38543        mgr.sessions.insert(
38544            pseudonym,
38545            SessionSlot {
38546                session_tx: dummy_tx,
38547                routing_opts: DestinationRouting::Forward {
38548                    destination: Box::new(peer.into()),
38549                    pseudonym: Some(pseudonym),
38550                    forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(hopr_api::types::primitive::bounded::BoundedSize::MIN),
38551                    return_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(hopr_api::types::primitive::bounded::BoundedSize::MIN).into(),
38552                },
38553                abort_handles: Default::default(),
38554                surb_mgmt: Default::default(),
38555                surb_estimator: Default::default(),
38556                current_ssa_state: Default::default(),
38557                pix_supervisor: Default::default(),
38558                pix_egress_gate: Default::default(),
38559                pix_fill: Default::default(),
38560                exit_loss_signal: Default::default(),
38561                returned_packets: Default::default(),
38562                cycle_budget: None,
38563                admission_token: Default::default(),
38564                raised_surb_target: Default::default(),
38565                forward_receipts: None,
38566                exit_resume: Default::default(),
38567                instance: SlotInstance::new(0),
38568                opening: None,
38569            },
38570        );
38571        Ok(mgr)
38572    }

38639    /// A sink that keeps what it was told about the Session lifecycle, as `(pseudonym, instance, started)`.
38640    #[derive(Default)]
38641    struct LifecycleSink(parking_lot::Mutex<Vec<(HoprPseudonym, u64, bool)>>);
38642
38643    impl ForwardReceiptSink for LifecycleSink {
38644        fn receipts(&self, _: HoprPseudonym, _: u32, _: u32, _: &[u32]) {}
38645
38646        fn session_started(&self, pseudonym: HoprPseudonym, instance: u64) {
38647            self.0.lock().push((pseudonym, instance, true));
38648        }
38649
38650        fn session_ended(&self, pseudonym: HoprPseudonym, instance: u64) {
38651            self.0.lock().push((pseudonym, instance, false));
38652        }
38653    }

38655    /// Every teardown parks, which ends the receipts of its own instance once; the late teardown of a replaced
38656    /// instance names the old instance, which the sink must not mistake for its successor.
38657    #[test]
38658    fn a_teardown_should_end_the_receipts_of_its_own_instance_once() {
38659        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
38660        let sink = Arc::new(LifecycleSink::default());
38661        let (old, new) = (SlotInstance::new(1), SlotInstance::new(2));
38662        for instance in [&old, &new] {
38663            let _ = instance.receipts.set(sink.clone());
38664        }
38665        // The successor starts before the old instance's late teardown
38666        sink.session_started(pseudonym, new.id());
38667        old.park_records(pseudonym);
38668        old.park_records(pseudonym);
38669        new.park_records(pseudonym);
38670        assert_eq!(
38671            vec![
38672                (pseudonym, new.id(), true),
38673                (pseudonym, old.id(), false),
38674                (pseudonym, new.id(), false)
38675            ],
38676            *sink.0.lock()
38677        );
38678    }

38726        );
38727        assert!(
38728            wait_for_no_active_sessions(&exit.mgr).await,
38729            "the window's end closed the Session"
38730        );
38731        Ok(())
38732    }

38734    /// A session server that cannot take the new session, once the Entry has been told `SessionResumed`, detaches
38735    /// the new instance rather than destroying the funded cycle, and keeps successor requests deferred.
38736    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
38737    async fn a_takeover_the_session_server_cannot_take_detaches_the_new_instance() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
38738        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions::default()).await?;
38739        let original = exit.instance()?;
38740        // The application is gone: nothing can be delivered.
38741        drop(std::mem::replace(
38742            &mut exit.incoming,
38743            futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1).1,
38744        ));
38745
38746        let outcome = exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await;
38747        assert!(outcome.is_err());
38748        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
38749        assert_eq!(1, seen.resumed.len(), "the Entry was answered first: {seen:?}");
38750        assert_eq!(vec![StartErrorReason::Busy], seen.errors, "the Entry is told: {seen:?}");
38751        assert!(
38752            matches!(
38753                seen.error_identifiers[..],
38754                [ErrorIdentifier::Challenge(challenge)] if challenge == MIN_CHALLENGE + 1
38755            ),
38756            "addressed by the new instance's challenge: {seen:?}"
38757        );
38758        assert_eq!(0, seen.ssa_requests, "{seen:?}");
38759        let slot = exit.slot()?;
38760        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&slot.instance, &original));
38761        assert!(slot.is_detached(), "the new instance waits out the window");
38762        assert!(has_handle(&slot, SessionHandles::ResumeWindow));
38763        assert!(exit.gate()?.data_plane_detached(), "successor requests stay deferred");
38764        assert!(!exit.gate()?.is_poisoned());
38765        Ok(())
38766    }

38768    /// The session server writes the moment it is handed a Session. A takeover that loses its swap, to a
38769    /// competing takeover or to a close, never hands its plane over, and nothing of it is sent.
38770    #[rstest]
38771    #[case::to_a_competing_takeover(false)]
38772    #[case::to_a_close(true)]
38773    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
38774    async fn a_takeover_that_loses_the_swap_never_delivers_its_plane(#[case] close: bool) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
38775        let admission = GatedAdmission::default();
38776        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
38777            session_admission: Some(admission.sink()),
38778            fill: crate::supervision::PixFillConfig {
38779                min_surb_reserve: 1,
38780                drain_after_close: false,
38781                ..Default::default()
38782            },
38783            ..Default::default()
38784        })
38785        .await?;
38786        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
38787        exit.write_on_delivery.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
38788        let asked = admission.requests();
38789
38790        // The first request is held at the admission server, while the rival is carried out.
38791        admission.hold_next.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
38792        let loser = exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1);
38793        let rival = async {
38794            let rivalled = async {
38795                anyhow::ensure!(
38796                    eventually(Duration::from_secs(2), || admission.requests() == asked + 1).await,
38797                    "the first request reaches the admission server"
38798                );
38799                if close {
38800                    anyhow::ensure!(exit.mgr.close_session(&exit.pseudonym), "the close finds the session");
38801                } else {
38802                    exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 2)
38803                        .await
38804                        .context("the rival takes over")?;
38805                }
38806                Ok(())
38807            }
38808            .await;
38809            // Released on the error path too, so that the first request is not left waiting for its timeout.
38810            admission.release.notify_one();
38811            rivalled
38812        };
38813        let (outcome, rivalled) = tokio::join!(loser, rival);
38814        rivalled?;
38815        outcome?;
38816
38817        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
38818        // Busy where the swap lost, `NotResumable` where the close was already seen by the eligibility check.
38819        assert!(
38820            matches!(
38821                seen.errors[..],
38822                [StartErrorReason::Busy] | [StartErrorReason::NotResumable]
38823            ),
38824            "the loser is refused: {seen:?}"
38825        );
38826        let mut delivered = Vec::new();
38827        while let Ok(session) = exit.incoming.try_recv() {
38828            delivered.push(session);
38829        }
38830        if close {
38831            assert!(delivered.is_empty(), "nothing is delivered");
38832            assert!(seen.resumed.is_empty(), "{seen:?}");
38833            assert_eq!(0, seen.data, "nothing of the loser's plane is sent: {seen:?}");
38834        } else {
38835            assert_eq!(1, delivered.len(), "only the winner's plane is delivered");
38836            assert_eq!(
38837                delivered[0].session.slot_instance(),
38838                Some(exit.instance()?.id()),
38839                "and it is the current one"
38840            );
38841            assert_eq!(
38842                vec![MIN_CHALLENGE + 2],
38843                seen.resumed.iter().map(|r| r.orig_challenge).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
38844                "only the winner is answered: {seen:?}"
38845            );
38846            assert_eq!(1, seen.data, "only the winner's write is sent: {seen:?}");
38847        }
38848        Ok(())
38849    }

38851    /// A resume attempt whose held terms no longer fit the quota range admission now allows is refused as an
38852    /// ineligible takeover (`NotResumable`), not as `UnacceptablePixParams`, which would have the Entry retry it.
38853    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
38854    async fn a_resume_whose_terms_no_longer_fit_the_admitted_quota_is_not_resumable() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
38855        let admission = GatedAdmission::default();
38856        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
38857            session_admission: Some(admission.sink()),
38858            ..Default::default()
38859        })
38860        .await?;
38861        let before = exit.instance()?;
38862        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
38863
38864        admission.narrow_quota.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
38865        exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;

38867        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;

38869        assert_eq!(0, seen.resumed.len(), "{seen:?}");
38870        assert!(
38871            Arc::ptr_eq(&exit.slot()?.instance, &before),
38872            "the held slot is untouched"
38873        );
38874        Ok(())

38877    /// A resume request that cannot take the held Session over is refused without asking the session server.
38878    #[rstest]
38879    #[case::an_older_challenge(Refuse::OlderChallenge)]
38880    #[case::other_capabilities(Refuse::OtherCapabilities)]
38881    #[case::other_dimensions(Refuse::OtherParams)]
38882    #[case::other_behaviour_bits(Refuse::OtherBehaviourBits)]
38883    #[case::the_same_challenge(Refuse::SameChallenge)]
38884    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
38885    async fn an_ineligible_resume_never_asks_the_admission_server(#[case] why: Refuse) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
38886        let admission = GatedAdmission::default();
38887        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
38888            session_admission: Some(admission.sink()),
38889            ..Default::default()
38890        })
38891        .await?;
38892        exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 5).await?;
38893        let _second = exit.next_session().await?;
38894        let _ = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
38895        let asked = admission.requests();
38896        assert_eq!(2, asked, "the establishment and the takeover asked");
38897
38898        let request = match why {
38899            Refuse::OlderChallenge => exit.request(MIN_CHALLENGE + 3)?,
38900            Refuse::SameChallenge => exit.request(MIN_CHALLENGE + 5)?,
38901            Refuse::OtherParams => exit.request_with(
38902                MIN_CHALLENGE + 6,
38903                PixParams::try_new(50, 2, TEST_SURPLUS_SHARES, LOCAL_PIX_SUITE)?,
38904                exit.capabilities,
38905                true,
38906            )?,
38907            Refuse::OtherCapabilities => exit.request_with(
38908                MIN_CHALLENGE + 6,
38909                exit.params,
38910                exit.capabilities | Capability::NoDelay,
38911                true,
38912            )?,
38913            _ => {
38914                exit.additional_bits = INITIATION_BEHAVIOUR_BITS;
38915                exit.request(MIN_CHALLENGE + 6)?
38916            }
38917        };
38918        exit.mgr
38919            .handle_incoming_session_initiation(exit.pseudonym, request)
38920            .await?;
38921
38922        assert_eq!(asked, admission.requests(), "the admission server was not asked");
38923        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
38924        let expected = if matches!(why, Refuse::SameChallenge) {
38925            StartErrorReason::NoSlotsAvailable
38926        } else {
38927            StartErrorReason::NotResumable
38928        };
38929        assert_eq!(vec![expected], seen.errors, "{seen:?}");
38930        Ok(())
38931    }

38933    /// Behaviour bits of the initiation are part of the terms a takeover must match.
38934    #[rstest]
38935    #[case::equal_bits_are_taken_over(INITIATION_BEHAVIOUR_BITS, INITIATION_BEHAVIOUR_BITS, true)]
38936    #[case::bits_added_are_refused(0, INITIATION_BEHAVIOUR_BITS, false)]
38937    #[case::bits_dropped_are_refused(INITIATION_BEHAVIOUR_BITS, 0, false)]
38938    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
38939    async fn a_takeover_must_carry_the_behaviour_bits_of_the_establishment(
38940        #[case] established_with: u128,
38941        #[case] resumed_with: u128,
38942        #[case] taken_over: bool,
38943    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
38944        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
38945            additional_bits: established_with,
38946            ..Default::default()
38947        })
38948        .await?;
38949        let before = exit.instance()?;
38950        exit.additional_bits = resumed_with;
38951        exit.reconnect(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
38952
38953        let seen = exit.originated(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
38954        let after = exit.instance()?;

38956            assert_eq!(1, seen.resumed.len(), "{seen:?}");
38957            assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&before, &after));

38960            assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&before, &after), "the held slot is untouched");
38961        }
38962        Ok(())
38963    }

38965    /// A live Session that the idle eviction has removed leaves nothing to take over: a reconnect
38966    /// opens a fresh one.
38967    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
38968    async fn a_reconnect_after_the_idle_eviction_of_a_live_session_opens_a_fresh_session() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
38969        let (mut exit, _first) = paid_exit(PaidExitOptions {
38970            idle_timeout: Some(Duration::from_millis(1500)),
38971            fill: crate::supervision::PixFillConfig {
38972                min_surb_reserve: 1,
38973                drain_after_close: false,
38974                ..Default::default()
38975            },
38976            ..Default::default()
38977        })
38978        .await?;
38979        let old_plane = exit.slot()?.pix_supervisor.clone();
38980        // Left alone, the slot idles out: the fixture's own tasks look it up only through the plane's
38981        // own scope, which does not refresh it.
38982        assert!(
38983            eventually(Duration::from_secs(8), || {
38984                exit.mgr.sessions.run_pending_tasks();
38985                exit.mgr.sessions.iter().next().is_none()
38986            })
38987            .await,
38988            "the idle slot must be evicted"
38989        );
38990        assert!(wait_for_no_active_sessions(&exit.mgr).await);
38991
38992        exit.start_fresh(MIN_CHALLENGE + 1).await?;
38993        let _fresh = exit.next_session().await?;
38994        assert!(
38995            !Arc::ptr_eq(&old_plane, &exit.slot()?.pix_supervisor),
38996            "a fresh control plane"
38997        );
38998        assert!(!exit.gate()?.ever_funded());
38999        Ok(())
39000    }

39002    /// Challenges under one pseudonym strictly increase across reconnects, including the one that
39003    /// reuses the pseudonym of a first, random-pseudonym Session.
39004    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
39005    async fn challenges_for_one_pseudonym_strictly_increase_across_reconnects() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
39006        let rig = reconnect_rig(small_pix_params(), Default::default()).await?;
39007        let first = rig.connect(entry_cfg(Capabilities::empty(), None)).await?;
39008        let pseudonym = *first.id();
39009        let mut seen = vec![rig.mgr.last_challenges.get(&pseudonym).context("recorded")?];
39010        for _ in 0..3 {
39011            let _next = rig.connect(entry_cfg(Capabilities::empty(), Some(pseudonym))).await?;
39012            seen.push(rig.mgr.last_challenges.get(&pseudonym).context("recorded")?);
39013        }
39014        assert!(seen.windows(2).all(|w| w[0] < w[1]), "strictly increasing: {seen:?}");
39015        assert!(
39016            seen[0] <= hopr_api::types::crypto_random::MAX_RANDOM_INTEGER / 2,
39017            "the first is in the lower half"
39018        );
39019        Ok(())
39020    }

39022    /// The first challenge under a pseudonym is drawn from the lower half of the range, so that
39023    /// increments cannot realistically wrap; later ones follow the last, and a collision probes upward.
39024    #[test]
39025    fn challenge_selection_starts_low_follows_the_last_and_probes_upward() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
39026        use hopr_api::types::crypto_random::MAX_RANDOM_INTEGER;
39027
39028        for _ in 0..500 {
39029            let first = next_challenge(None, None);
39030            assert!((MIN_CHALLENGE..=MAX_RANDOM_INTEGER / 2).contains(&first), "{first}");
39031        }
39032        assert_eq!(8, next_challenge(Some(7), None), "strictly greater than the last");
39033        assert_eq!(9, next_challenge(Some(7), Some(8)), "a collision probes upward");
39034
39035        // Through the atomic claim, with 8 already taken by another initiation.
39036        let cache: moka::sync::Cache<StartChallenge, u8> = moka::sync::Cache::builder().max_capacity(10).build();
39037        cache.insert(8, 0);
39038        let (claimed, _) = insert_into_next_slot(&cache, |ch| next_challenge(Some(7), ch), |_| 1u8, Some(10))
39039            .context("a free challenge exists")?;
39040        assert_eq!(9, claimed);
39041        Ok(())
39042    }

39044    /// The record keeps the largest challenge whatever the order the notes arrive in.
39045    #[test]
39046    fn the_last_challenge_only_ever_grows() {
39047        let mgr = RecordingManager::new(Default::default());
39048        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
39049        mgr.note_challenge(pseudonym, 10);
39050        mgr.note_challenge(pseudonym, 5);
39051        assert_eq!(Some(10), mgr.last_challenges.get(&pseudonym));
39052        mgr.note_challenge(pseudonym, 12);
39053        assert_eq!(Some(12), mgr.last_challenges.get(&pseudonym));
39054    }
